paras.en: I’m the Problem is Wallen’s third album to log a full year at No. 1 on Top Country Albums. Dangerous: The Double Album clung to the top spot for 97 weeks from 2021-23. One Thing at a Time led for 87 weeks from 2023-25.
paras.zh: 《I'm the Problem》是 Wallen 连续一年位居顶级乡村专辑榜第一的第三张专辑。 2021-23 年间，《Dangerous: The Double Album》连续 97 周稳居榜首。从 2023-25 年开始，一次一件事领先了 87 周。

paras.en: Top Country Albums originated as Hot Country Albums in the Jan. 11, 1964 issue of Billboard. Johnny Cash’s Ring of Fire (The Best of Johnny Cash) headed the inaugural chart. The compilation was well-timed: “Ring of Fire” had headed Hot Country Songs for seven weeks the previous summer and had crossed over to reach the top 20 on the Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 顶级乡村专辑最初是 1964 年 1 月 11 日发行的《公告牌》中的热门乡村专辑。约翰尼·卡什 (Johnny Cash) 的《火环》(The Best of Johnny Cash) 在首张排行榜上名列前茅。这张合辑的时机恰到好处：去年夏天，《Ring of Fire》连续七周在热门乡村歌曲排行榜上名列前茅，并跨入 Billboard Hot 100 的前 20 名。

paras.en: The chart was named Hot Country LP’s from 1968 to 1984, when vinyl LPs were king.
paras.zh: 从 1968 年到 1984 年，这张唱片被命名为“Hot Country LP”，当时黑胶唱片占据了主导地位。

paras.en: Twenty-one artists have logged 50 or more weeks at No. 1 on Top Country Albums. Male solo artists dominate, as you might expect, though three female solo artists have achieved the feat, as have two groups. (One of those groups is an all-female group.) Only one Black artist has amassed 50 or more weeks at No. 1, though that may change as country becomes more inclusive.
paras.zh: 21 名艺术家已连续 50 周或以上在顶级乡村专辑排行榜上排名第一。正如你所预料的那样，男性独奏艺术家占据主导地位，尽管三名女性独奏艺术家和两个团体也实现了这一壮举。 （其中一个团体是全女性团体。）只有一位黑人艺术家连续 50 周或以上排名第一，尽管随着国家变得更具包容性，这种情况可能会发生变化。

paras.en: Here’s a look at all artists who have topped Top Country Albums for 50 or more weeks.
paras.zh: 以下是连续 50 周或更长时间位居顶级乡村专辑榜首的所有艺术家。

paras.en: - LeAnn Rimes (50 weeks) First week at No. 1: July 27, 1996 Most recent week at No. 1: Feb. 17, 2001 Longest-running No. 1: Blue (28 weeks in 1996-97) Notes: Rimes’ total includes a 1997 compilation of early recordings, Unchained Melody: The Early Years. Rimes was just 14 in February 1997 when she won a Grammy for best new artist. She remains the youngest winner ever in that category.
paras.zh: - LeAnn Rimes（50 周） 第一周排名第一：1996 年 7 月 27 日 最近一周排名第一：2001 年 2 月 17 日 最长排名第一：Blue（1996-97 年 28 周） 注：Rimes 的专辑包括 1997 年的早期唱片合辑《Unchained Melody: The Early Years》。 1997 年 2 月，莱姆斯获得格莱美最佳新人奖时年仅 14 岁。她仍然是该类别中最年轻的获奖者。

paras.en: - Eddy Arnold (51 weeks) First week at No. 1: Aug. 14, 1965 Most recent week at No. 1: May 4, 1968 Longest-running No. 1: My World (17 weeks in 1965-66) Notes: My World was the first country album to receive a Grammy nod for album of the year. The album included the crossover hit “Make the World Go Away,” which all but defined the “countrypolitan” sound.
paras.zh: - Eddy Arnold（51 周） 第一周排名第一：1965 年 8 月 14 日 最近一周排名第一：1968 年 5 月 4 日 连续排名第一时间最长：My World（1965-66 年 17 周） 注：My World 是第一张获得格莱美年度专辑提名的乡村专辑。这张专辑包括了跨界热门歌曲“Make the World Go Away”，它几乎定义了“乡村城市”的声音。

paras.en: - Glen Campbell (51 weeks) First week at No. 1: Feb. 10, 1968 Most recent week at No. 1: May 7, 1977 Longest-running No. 1: Wichita Lineman (20 weeks in 1968-69) Notes: Wichita Lineman is tied with Johnny Cash at San Quentin for the longest run at No. 1 of any album in the 1960s. Campbell’s tally of No. 1 albums also includes Bobbie Gentry & Glen Campbell, a collab with the singer of “Ode to Billie Joe.” The 1968 album was the first collaborative album to reach No. 1 on the chart.
paras.zh: - Glen Campbell（51 周） 第一周排名第一：1968 年 2 月 10 日 最近一周排名第一：1977 年 5 月 7 日 最长排名第一：Wichita Lineman（1968-69 年 20 周） 注：Wichita Lineman 与 San Quentin 的 Johnny Cash 并列，是 20 世纪 60 年代所有专辑中排名第一的最长记录。坎贝尔排名第一的专辑还包括与《Ode to Billie Joe》歌手合作的 Bobbie Gentry & Glen Campbell。 1968 年的专辑是第一张登上排行榜第一名的合作专辑。

paras.en: - Merle Haggard (51 weeks) First week at No. 1: Dec. 10, 1966 Most recent week at No. 1: June 20, 2015 Longest-running No. 1: Pancho & Lefty (with Willie Nelson) (eight weeks in 1983) Notes: Haggard’s tally of No. 1s includes eight albums on which his backing group, The Strangers, was also credited. Hag’s tally includes three live albums, Okie From Muskogee (1970), The Fightin’ Side of Me (1970)and I Love Dixie Blues … So I Recorded ‘Live’ in New Orleans (1973). It also includes two collabs with Willie Nelson, Pancho & Lefty and Django and Jimmie (2015).
paras.zh: - Merle Haggard（51 周） 第一周排名第一：1966 年 12 月 10 日 最近一周排名第一：2015 年 6 月 20 日 连续排名第一时间最长：Pancho & Lefty（与 Willie Nelson 合作）（1983 年八周） 注：Haggard 的排名第一包括八张专辑，其中他的支持乐队 The Strangers 也在其中已记入。 Hag 的专辑包括三张现场专辑：Okie From Muskogee (1970)、The Fightin’ Side of Me (1970) 和 I Love Dixie Blues … So I Recorded ‘Live’ in New Orleans (1973)。它还包括与 Willie Nelson 的两部合作作品《Pancho & Lefty》和《Django and Jimmie》(2015)。

paras.en: - Johnny Cash (57 weeks) First week at No. 1: Jan. 11, 1964 Most recent week at No. 1: April 12, 2014 Longest-running No. 1: Johnny Cash at San Quentin (20 weeks in 1969) Notes: Cash’s No. 1 albums spanned more than 50 years. Johnny Cash at San Quentin (which received a Grammy nod for album of the year) has had the longest run at No. 1 of any live album. It is also tied with Glen Campbell’s Wichita Lineman as the longest-running No. 1 album of the 1960s. Cash also reached No. 1 with two other live albums – Johnny Cash at Folsom Prison (1968) and The Johnny Cash Show (1970), which was recorded at the Grand Ole Opry. He also topped the chart with a 1985 collab LP with Willie Nelson, Waylon Jennings and Kris Kristofferson and with two posthumous albums – American V: A Hundred Highways (2006) and Out Among the Stars (2014).
paras.zh: - Johnny Cash（57 周） 第一周排名第一：1964 年 1 月 11 日 最近一周排名第一：2014 年 4 月 12 日 最长排名第一：San Quentin 的 Johnny Cash（1969 年 20 周） 注：Cash 排名第一的专辑跨越了 50 多年。圣昆汀 (San Quentin) 的约翰尼·卡什 (Johnny Cash)（该专辑获得格莱美年度专辑提名）是所有现场专辑中保持第一名时间最长的。它也与 Glen Campbell 的《Wichita Lineman》并列，成为 20 世纪 60 年代运行时间最长的第一张专辑。卡什还凭借另外两张现场专辑登上了排行榜第一的位置——《约翰尼·卡什在福尔瑟姆监狱》（Johnny Cash at Folsom Prison，1968 年）和《约翰尼·卡什秀》（The Johnny Cash Show，1970 年），后者是在大奥普里录制的。他还凭借 1985 年与 Willie Nelson、Waylon Jennings 和 Kris Kristofferson 合作的 LP 以及两张死后专辑《American V: A Hundred Highways》（2006 年）和《Out Between the Stars》（2014 年）登上排行榜榜首。

paras.en: - Buck Owens (60 weeks) First week at No. 1: Jan. 25, 1964 Most recent week at No. 1: April 20, 1968 Longest-running No. 1: I’ve Got a Tiger by the Tail (15 weeks in 1965) Notes: Owens’ first No. 1 album, Buck Owens Sings Tommy Collins (1964), was a tribute album to the singer/songwriter whose biggest hits included “You Better Not Do That” and “If You Can’t Bite, Don’t Growl.” Owens’ tally of No. 1 albums includes two live albums, Carnegie Hall Concert (1966) and Buck Owens and His Buckaroos in Japan! (1967).
paras.zh: - Buck Owens（60 周） 第一周排名第一：1964 年 1 月 25 日 最近一周排名第一：1968 年 4 月 20 日 连续排名第一时间最长：I've Got a Tiger by the Tail（1965 年 15 周） 注：Owens 的第一张排名第一的专辑 Buck Owens Sings Tommy Collins (1964) 是一张向 Tommy Collins 致敬的专辑歌手/词曲作家，其最热门歌曲包括“You Better Not Do That”和“If You Can’t Bite, Don’t Growl”。欧文斯排名第一的专辑包括两张现场专辑：《卡内基音乐厅音乐会》（Carnegie Hall Concert，1966 年）和《Buck Owens and His Buckaroos in Japan》！ （1967）。

paras.en: - George Strait (61 weeks) First week at No. 1: Feb. 18, 1984 Most recent week at No. 1: April 13, 2019 Longest-running No. 1s: Ocean Front Property (six weeks in 1987) and Carrying Your Love With Me (six weeks in 1997) Notes: Strait made this list the hard way – without a single album that logged more than six weeks at No. 1. Strait’s tally of No. 1 albums includes the 1992 soundtrack to Pure Country, in which he starred.
paras.zh: - George Strait（61 周） 第一周排名第一：1984 年 2 月 18 日 最近一周排名第一：2019 年 4 月 13 日 排名第一时间最长的专辑：Ocean Front Property（1987 年六周）和 Carrying Your Love With Me（1997 年六周） 注：Strait 上榜的过程很艰难，没有一张专辑在第一名上停留超过六周。 Strait 排名第一的专辑包括 1992 年他主演的《Pure Country》原声带。

paras.en: - The Chicks (73 weeks) First week at No. 1: Jan. 30, 1999 Most recent week at No. 1: Aug. 8, 2020 Longest-running No. 1: Fly (36 weeks in 1999-2000) Notes: The Chicks, formerly Dixie Chicks, are the second-highest ranking group on this list. Three of the group’s No. 1 albums – Fly, Home and Taking the Long Way – received Grammy nods for album of the year. The latter album won the award. The group’s most recent No. 1 album, Gaslighter, was bumped from the top spot by the debut album by a promising newcomer named Morgan Wallen.
paras.zh: - 小鸡队 (73 周) 第一周排名第一：1999 年 1 月 30 日 最近一周排名第一：2020 年 8 月 8 日 连续排名第一时间最长：Fly（1999-2000 年 36 周） 注：小鸡队（前身为迪克西小鸡队）是该榜单上排名第二高的球队。该乐队的三张排名第一的专辑——《Fly》、《Home》和《Taking the Long Way》——获得格莱美年度专辑提名。后者的专辑获得了该奖项。该乐队最近排名第一的专辑《Gaslighter》被一位名叫摩根·沃伦 (Morgan Wallen) 的前途光明的新人的首张专辑从榜首位置上挤了下来。

paras.en: - Waylon Jennings (76 weeks) First week at No. 1: Sept. 6, 1975 Most recent week at No. 1: June 14, 1986 Longest-running No. 1: Greatest Hits (16 weeks in 1979) Notes: Jennings’ tally of No. 1 albums includes three collabs with Nelson – one just with Nelson; one that also included Jessi Colter and Tompall Glaser; and one that included Johnny Cash and Kris Kristofferson as well. His tally also includes a 1976 live album, Waylon Live.
paras.zh: - Waylon Jennings（76 周） 第一周排名第一：1975 年 9 月 6 日 最近一周排名第一：1986 年 6 月 14 日 最长排名第一：Greatest Hits（1979 年 16 周） 注：詹宁斯排名第一的专辑包括三张与 Nelson 的合作——其中一张是与 Nelson 合作的；另一张是与 Nelson 合作的。其中还包括 Jessi Colter 和 Tompall Glaser；其中还包括约翰尼·卡什和克里斯·克里斯托弗森。他的专辑还包括 1976 年的现场专辑 Waylon Live。

paras.en: - Tim McGraw (76 weeks) First week at No. 1: April 9, 1994 Most recent week at No. 1: Sept. 5, 2020 Longest-running No. 1: Not a Moment Too Soon (29 weeks in 1994) Notes: McGraw’s tally includes a 2017 collab with his wife, Faith Hill, The Rest of Our Life. That title should probably be The Rest of Our Lives, but we’re not going to correct the grammar of someone who has logged 76 weeks at No. 1.
paras.zh: - 蒂姆·麦格劳（Tim McGraw）（76 周） 第一周排名第一：1994 年 4 月 9 日 最近一周排名第一：2020 年 9 月 5 日 连续排名第一时间最长：一刻不早（1994 年 29 周） 注：麦格劳的统计包括 2017 年与妻子 Faith Hill 合作的《The Rest of Our Life》。这个标题可能应该是《我们的余生》，但我们不会纠正一个连续 76 周排名第一的人的语法。

paras.en: - Randy Travis (80 weeks) First week at No. 1: Aug. 9, 1986 Most recent week at No. 1: Nov. 24, 1990 Longest-running No. 1: Always & Forever (43 weeks in 1987-88) Notes: Always & Forever had the longest run at No. 1 of any album in the 1980s.
paras.zh: - Randy Travis（80 周） 第一周排名第一：1986 年 8 月 9 日 最近一周排名第一：1990 年 11 月 24 日 最长排名第一：Always & Forever（1987-88 年 43 周） 注：Always & Forever 是 20 世纪 80 年代所有专辑中排名第一时间最长的。

paras.en: - Charley Pride (85 weeks) First week at No. 1: May 18, 1968 Most recent week at No. 1: May 17, 1980 Longest-running No. 1s: Charley Pride Sings Heart Songs (16 weeks in 1972) and The Best of Charley Pride, Volume 2 (16 weeks in 1972). Notes: The albums referenced above were No. 1 back-to-back and spent a combined total of 32 consecutive weeks at No. 1. Now, that’s what you call dominating a chart. Both albums contained Pride’s signature song, “Kiss an Angel Good Mornin.’” Pride’s final No. 1 album, There’s a Little Bit of Hank in Me (1980), was a tribute to Hank Williams. Pride is the only Black artist on this list so far.
paras.zh: - Charley Pride（85 周） 第一周排名第一：1968 年 5 月 18 日 最近一周排名第一：1980 年 5 月 17 日 连续排名第一时间最长：Charley Pride Sings Heart Songs（1972 年 16 周）和 The Best of Charley Pride, Volume 2（1972 年 16 周）。注：上面提到的专辑连续排名第一，并且总共连续 32 周排名第一。现在，这就是所谓的统治排行榜。两张专辑都包含了 Pride 的标志性歌曲“Kiss an Angel Good Mornin”。Pride 的最后一张第一专辑《There's a Little Bit of Hank in Me》（1980 年）是对 Hank Williams 的致敬。普莱德是迄今为止该名单上唯一的黑人艺术家。

paras.en: - Luke Combs (90 weeks) First week at No. 1: June 24, 2017 Most recent week at No. 1: April 4, 2026 Longest-running No. 1: This One’s for You (50 weeks in 2017-18) Notes: This One’s for You had the longest run at No. 1 of any album in the 2010s.
paras.zh: - Luke Combs（90 周） 第一周排名第一：2017 年 6 月 24 日 最近一周排名第一：2026 年 4 月 4 日 连续排名第一时间最长：This One’s for You（2017-18 年 50 周） 注：This One’s for You 是 2010 年代所有专辑中排名第一时间最长的。

paras.en: - Shania Twain (97 weeks) First week at No. 1: July 22, 1995 Most recent week at No. 1: Oct. 21, 2017 Longest-running No. 1: Come on Over (50 weeks in 1997-2000) Notes: Twain is the second-highest ranking female solo artist on this list. Come on Over had the longest run at No. 1 of any album in the 1990s. The hit-studded blockbuster spent time at No. 1 in four consecutive years – 1997 through 2000. It received a Grammy nod for album of the year, and spawned two song of the year nominees, “You’re Still the One” and “You’ve Got a Way.”
paras.zh: - Shania Twain（97 周） 第一周排名第一：1995 年 7 月 22 日 最近一周排名第一：2017 年 10 月 21 日 连续排名第一时间最长：Come Over（1997-2000 年 50 周） 注：吐温是该榜单上排名第二的女独唱艺术家。 《Come on Over》是 20 世纪 90 年代所有专辑中排名第一时间最长的专辑。这张热门大片从 1997 年到 2000 年连续四年位居第一。它获得了格莱美年度专辑奖，并催生了两首年度歌曲提名：《You're Still the One》和《You've Got a Way》。

paras.en: - Kenny Rogers (99 weeks) First week at No. 1: May 21, 1977 Most recent week at No. 1: April 4, 2020 Longest-running No. 1: Kenny (25 weeks in 1979-80) Notes: Kenny, which housed the hit “You Decorated My Life,” had the longest run at No. 1 of any album in the 1970s. Rogers’ tally includes a 1978 collab with Dottie West, Every Time Two Fools Collide, and a 2018 compilation, The Best of Kenny Rogers: Through the Years, which hit No. 1 following his death in March 2020.
paras.zh: - 肯尼·罗杰斯（Kenny Rogers）（99 周） 第一周排名第一：1977 年 5 月 21 日 最近一周排名第一：2020 年 4 月 4 日 连续排名第一时间最长：肯尼（Kenny，1979-80 年 25 周） 注：《肯尼》收录了热门歌曲《You Decorated My Life》，是 20 世纪 70 年代所有专辑中排名第一最长的专辑。罗杰斯的专辑包括 1978 年与多蒂·韦斯特 (Dottie West) 合作的《Every Time Two Fools Collide》，以及 2018 年合辑《The Best of Kenny Rogers: Through the Years》，该专辑在他于 2020 年 3 月去世后排名第一。

paras.en: - Taylor Swift (101 weeks) First week at No. 1: Aug. 4, 2007 Most recent week at No. 1: July 29, 2023? Longest-running No. 1: Fearless (35 weeks in 2008-09) Notes: Swift is the highest-charting female solo artist on this list, which is especially impressive given her mid-career pivot to pop. Her tally includes both the original and Taylor’s Version’s editions of Fearless, Speak Now and Red. With Fearless, Swift became the youngest Grammy winner for album of the year to that point, a title now held by Billie Eilish.
paras.zh: - 泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）（101 周） 第一周排名第一：2007 年 8 月 4 日 最近一周排名第一：2023 年 7 月 29 日？运行时间最长的第一名：Fearless（2008-09 年 35 周） 注：斯威夫特是该榜单上排名最高的女独唱艺术家，考虑到她在职业生涯中期转向流行音乐，这一点尤其令人印象深刻。她的专辑包括《Fearless》、《Speak Now》和《Red》的原版和泰勒版本。凭借《Fearless》，斯威夫特成为迄今为止最年轻的格莱美年度专辑得主，这一头衔现在由比莉·艾利什 (Billie Eilish) 持有。

paras.en: - Willie Nelson (107 weeks) First week at No. 1: Oct. 4, 1975 Most recent week at No. 1: May 20, 2017 Longest-running No. 1: Always on My Mind (22 weeks in 1982) Notes: Nelson’s tally includes a collab with Waylon Jennings, Jessi Colter and Tompall Glaser; another with Jennings, Johnny Cash and Kris Kristofferson; another with just Jennings, and two with Haggard. It also includes two live albums, Willie and Family Live (1979) and the Honeysuckle Rose soundtrack (1980).
paras.zh: - Willie Nelson（107 周） 第一周排名第一：1975 年 10 月 4 日 最近一周排名第一：2017 年 5 月 20 日 运行时间最长的第一名：永远在我脑海中（1982 年 22 周） 注：Nelson 的统计包括与 Waylon Jennings、Jessi Colter 和 Tompall Glaser 的合作；另一位是詹宁斯、约翰尼·卡什和克里斯·克里斯托弗森；另一个只有詹宁斯，还有两个是哈格德。它还包括两张现场专辑，《Willie and Family Live》（1979 年）和《Honeysuckle Rose》原声带（1980 年）。

paras.en: - Alabama (125 weeks) First week at No. 1: May 23, 1981 Most recent week at No. 1: Nov. 11, 2006 Longest-running No. 1s: Feels So Right (28 weeks in 1981-82) and Mountain Music (28 weeks in 1982-83). Notes: Alabama is the highest-ranking group on this list. Feels So Right (in May 1981) was the first No. 1 by a group that wasn’t named after its leader. (So, we’re discounting Merle Haggard and the Strangers, Sonny James and the Southern Gentlemen and The Charlie Daniels Band.) Alabama’s tally of No. 1 albums includes a 1988 live album, Alabama Live.
paras.zh: - 阿拉巴马州（125 周） 第一周排名第一：1981 年 5 月 23 日 最近一周排名第一：2006 年 11 月 11 日 运行时间最长的第一名：Feels So Right（1981-82 年 28 周）和 Mountain Music（1982-83 年 28 周）。注：阿拉巴马州是该列表中排名最高的组。 Feels So Right（1981 年 5 月）是第一个不以领袖名字命名的乐队获得第一名的乐队。 （因此，我们不考虑 Merle Haggard and the Strangers、Sonny James and the Southern Gentlemen 和 The Charlie Daniels Band。）阿拉巴马州排名第一的专辑包括 1988 年的现场专辑《Alabama Live》。

paras.en: - Garth Brooks (173 weeks) First week at No. 1: Oct. 13, 1990 Most recent week at No. 1: Dec. 23, 2017 Longest-running No. 1: No Fences (41 weeks in 1990-91) Notes: Brooks’ tally of No. 1 albums includes a double-disc live album, Double Live (1998); a pair of Christmas albums, Garth Brooks & the Magic of Christmas (1999) and Christmas Together (2016), the latter a collab with his wife, Trisha Yearwood; and a remarkable four box sets – The Limited Series (1998), Blame It All on My Roots: Five Decades of Influences (2013), The Ultimate Collection (2016) and The Anthology Part I: The First Five Years (2017).
paras.zh: - Garth Brooks（173 周） 第一周排名第一：1990 年 10 月 13 日 最近一周排名第一：2017 年 12 月 23 日 最长排名第一：No Fences（1990-91 年 41 周） 注：布鲁克斯排名第一的专辑包括一张双碟现场专辑《Double Live》（1998 年）；两张圣诞专辑《Garth Brooks & the Magic of Christmas》（1999 年）和《Christmas Together》（2016 年），后者是他与妻子 Trisha Yearwood 的合作作品；以及引人注目的四盒套装——《限量系列》（1998年）、《全部归咎于我的根源：五年的影响》（2013年）、《终极精选》（2016年）和《选集第一部分：第一个五年》（2017年）。

paras.en: - Morgan Wallen (238 weeks) First week at No. 1: Aug. 15, 2020 Most recent week at No. 1: Nov. 14, 2026 Longest-running No. 1: Dangerous: The Double Album (97 weeks in 2021-23) Notes: Dangerous: The Double Album had the longest run at No. 1 in the chart’s history. One Thing at a Time, which spent 87 weeks at No. 1, is in second place.
paras.zh: - Morgan Wallen（238 周） 第一周排名第一：2020 年 8 月 15 日 最近一周排名第一：2026 年 11 月 14 日 连续排名第一时间最长：Dangerous: The Double Album（2021-23 年 97 周） 注：Dangerous: The Double Album 是该排行榜历史上排名第一的最长记录。 《一次一件事》连续 87 周排名第一，目前排名第二。

articles.title: Ariana Grande Sings ‘O Christmas Tree’ With Robert De Niro & Ben Stiller on ‘Tonight Show’: Exclusive Preview
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Ariana Grande and her Focker-in-Law co-stars Robert De Niro and Ben Stiller are a Christmas caroling trio in a special preview clip from NBC’s The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, premiering here on Billboard just ahead of a special Sunday night (Nov. 8) episode of the late-night show beginning at 11:35 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 与她的福克 (Focker-in-Law) 搭档罗伯特·德尼罗 (Robert De Niro) 和本·斯蒂勒 (Ben Stiller) 在 NBC 吉米·法伦 (Jimmy Fallon) 主演的《今夜秀》的特别预览片段中组成了圣诞颂歌三人组，该片段在公告牌上首播，随后该深夜秀将于周日晚 (11 月 8 日) 晚上 11:35 开始播出。等。

paras.en: Fallon celebrates this weekend’s arrival of the 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas tree on tonight’s episode. The Focker-in-Law stars join in on the festivities with a surprise performance of the traditional tune “O Christmas Tree.”
paras.zh: 法伦在今晚的节目中庆祝本周末洛克菲勒中心 2026 年圣诞树的到来。 《Focker-in-Law》明星们惊喜地表演了传统曲调“O Christmas Tree”，加入庆祝活动。

paras.en: Grande takes the lead on vocals, of course, and the audience can’t help but applaud when she hits those high notes. Stiller gives a valiant effort for his part of the song, and De Niro — well, it’s worth tuning in to the sneak peek below to see how it all plays out.
paras.zh: 当然，格兰德在人声方面处于领先地位，当她唱出高音时，观众情不自禁地鼓掌。斯蒂勒为这首歌的部分做出了勇敢的努力，而德尼罗——好吧，值得先看看下面的内容，看看这一切是如何进行的。

paras.en: Grande, De Niro and Stiller will be chatting together with Fallon throughout Sunday’s episode, which also features Lil Baby as musical guest. The fun begins after the Buccaneers vs. Bears game on NBC.
paras.zh: 格兰德、德尼罗和斯蒂勒将在周日的这一集中与法伦一起聊天，其中还有莉尔·巴比作为音乐嘉宾。 NBC 播出的海盗队与熊队的比赛结束后，乐趣就开始了。

paras.en: The stars’ appearance together is part of their promo cycle for the Nov. 25 theatrical release of Focker-in-Law, the latest movie in the popular Meet the Parents franchise. Grande joins as Olivia Jones, who’s dating Greg and Pam Focker’s (Stiller and Teri Polo) now grown-up son Henry (Skyler Gisondo).
paras.zh: 明星们的共同亮相是 11 月 25 日上映的热门电影《拜见父母》系列的最新电影《福克》的宣传周期的一部分。格兰德饰演奥利维亚·琼斯，她正在与格雷格和帕姆·福克（斯蒂勒和泰瑞·波罗饰演）现已成年的儿子亨利（斯凯勒·吉桑多饰演）约会。

paras.en: The Nov. 8 Tonight Show episode is the second of four special episodes to air following NBC’s Sunday Night Football broadcasts this season; the first special broadcast was on Sept. 27, with guests Sylvester Stallone and Luke Bryan.
paras.zh: 11 月 8 日的《今夜秀》是继本季 NBC 周日橄榄球之夜播出后播出的四集特别节目中的第二集；第一次特别播出于 9 月 27 日播出，嘉宾包括西尔维斯特·史泰龙和卢克·布莱恩。

paras.en: Tonight’s Focker-in-Law cast takeover with Grande, De Niro and Stiller (plus Lil Baby) will be followed by an episode featuring Jennifer Lopez and Anthony Mackie, as well as a musical performance from Quavo, on Sunday, Nov. 15. Another post-Sunday Night Football episode of The Tonight Show is slated for Jan. 10, with guests to be announced.
paras.zh: 今晚由 Grande、De Niro 和 Stiller（加上 Lil Baby）主演的《Focker-in-Law》演员阵容将在 11 月 15 日（星期日）播出，由 Jennifer Lopez 和 Anthony Mackie 主演，以及 Quavo 的音乐表演。《今夜秀》周日晚间足球赛后的另一集定于 1 月 10 日播出，嘉宾名单待定。

articles.title: Trump Reflects on Republicans’ Midterm Losses, Reacts to J.D. Vance’s Own Analysis in ’60 Minutes’ Interview
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: President Donald Trump reflected on the Republicans’ big losses last week with 60 Minutes correspondent Ross Douthat in his first sit-down interview since the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统自中期选举以来首次接受采访，与《60 分钟》记者罗斯·杜塔特一起回顾了共和党上周的巨大损失。

paras.en: Douthat asked Trump for his analysis of what happened. “Well, No. 1, I was not on the ballot,” he replied. “But I campaigned hard for some people. And I think if I was on the ballot, it would’ve been a much different situation because you saw the level of popularity and love. There was love. We had massive rallies. You had to transfer those voters, however, to candidates that they didn’t like. But there’s something beyond that. They didn’t like the war. They didn’t like the fact that gasoline went up, ’cause I had it down at a low, and there’s a great dislike, incredibly, for Israel.”
paras.zh: 杜塔特询问特朗普对所发生事件的分析。 “嗯，第一，我没有参加投票，”他回答道。 “但我为一些人努力竞选。我想，如果我参加选票，情况会大不相同，因为你看到了受欢迎程度和爱的程度。有爱。我们举行了大规模集会。然而，你必须将这些选民转移到他们不喜欢的候选人身上。但除此之外还有一些事情。他们不喜欢战争。他们不喜欢汽油价格上涨，因为我把它降到了低位，而且有一个很好的选择。”令人难以置信的是，我不喜欢以色列。”

paras.en: The interview aired a few days after Vice President J.D. Vance posted his own lengthy and candid analysis of what he believed went wrong for his party. He outlined four things that disaffected Republicans wanted, which led to the Democrats reclaiming Congress: “End the war, focus on cost of living and inflation, put America first and change our relationship to Israel.”
paras.zh: 几天前，副总统 J.D. 万斯发表了自己对他认为政党出了问题的冗长而坦率的分析。他概述了心怀不满的共和党人想要的四件事，这导致民主党重新夺回国会：“结束战争，关注生活成本和通货膨胀，把美国放在第一位，改变我们与以色列的关系。”

paras.en: Douthat asked Trump if he agreed with Vance’s analysis. “I don’t disagree with it,” Trump replied, adding: “He asked me what do I think. I said, ‘You write what you want.'”
paras.zh: 杜塔特询问特朗普是否同意万斯的分析。 “我不反对，”特朗普回答道，并补充道：“他问我怎么想。我说，‘你想写什么就写什么。’”

paras.en: Trump added that he does wish Vance would have included one thing he didn’t: “The only thing I wish he would’ve said there, if he felt it, and you’d have to ask him about that, but if you had to do it again, would you do it? You know, he’s part of a decision-making process. And my answer is an emphatic yes because you can’t let Iran have a nuclear weapon. I think, historically, this will be a very good decision. Is it a good decision for today and tomorrow? Maybe not. But you know, I have to go with what’s right for our country. If they had a nuclear weapon during my term, I would be excoriated far worse than what’s happened. … I’ve stopped them from having a nuclear weapon. That’s a big thing.”
paras.zh: 特朗普补充说，他确实希望万斯能包括一件他没有提到的事情：“我唯一希望他能在那里说一件事，如果他感觉到了，你必须问他，但如果你必须再做一次，你会这样做吗？你知道，他是决策过程的一部分。我的答案是肯定的，因为你不能让伊朗拥有核武器。我认为，从历史上看，这将是一个非常好的决定。对于今天来说，这是一个好的决定吗？”明天呢？但你知道，如果他们在我任期内拥有核武器，我会受到比现在更严重的谴责……我阻止了他们拥有核武器，这是一件大事。”

paras.en: Trump argued that the economy has been strong during his second term, even though Douthat noted that polls have shown Americans are unhappy with the economy. “Cost of living, inflation, and so on,” he said. “Is that all just the Iran war?”
paras.zh: 特朗普辩称，他的第二个任期内经济一直强劲，尽管杜塔特指出民意调查显示美国人对经济不满意。 “生活成本、通货膨胀等等，”他说。 “这只是伊朗战争吗？”

paras.en: Trump replied: “Well, it’s not really the Iran war because the numbers are phenomenal. I think it was bad messaging, maybe by me, but I would talk about it all the time. So I don’t know, how much can I talk about it? Look, the press doesn’t cover … positive news for Republicans. They don’t cover certainly positive news for me. So I have to do it myself. I have to get it out there. We have historically good numbers. We have the highest stock market in history.”
paras.zh: 特朗普回答说：“嗯，这并不是真正的伊朗战争，因为数字是惊人的。我认为这是不好的信息，也许是我发出的，但我会一直谈论它。所以我不知道，我能谈论多少？看，媒体没有报道……对共和党人来说是积极的消息。他们没有报道对我来说肯定是积极的消息。所以我必须自己做。我必须把它公布出来。我们有历史上最好的数据。我们有历史上最高的股市。”

paras.en: Asked what the “bad message” was, Trump replied: “We couldn’t get the word across.”
paras.zh: 当被问及“坏消息”是什么时，特朗普回答说：“我们无法传达这个信息。”

paras.en: The interview also touched on Trump’s successor. Douthat asked the president if he will be endorsing a Republican nominee in two years. “Probably. Not necessarily,” he replied. As for how he decides whether to endorse a candidate, Trump said: “I don’t know, we have a tremendous bench. I mean, I have so many people that I have great relationships with.”
paras.zh: 采访还谈到了特朗普的继任者。杜塔特询问总统是否会在两年内支持共和党提名人。 “可能。不一定，”他回答道。至于如何决定是否支持某位候选人，特朗普表示：“我不知道，我们有一个巨大的替补席。我的意思是，我和很多人都关系很好。”

paras.en: Besides Vance, Trump cited U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio as a “great” option and said there are “others” including “some senators that are excellent” but he declined to name names. I know ’em all, I like ’em a lot,” he said. ” So I may or may not get involved. I don’t know. Maybe I’m better off not getting involved.”
paras.zh: 除了万斯之外，特朗普还称美国国务卿马可·卢比奥是一个“很好”的选择，并表示还有“其他人”，包括“一些优秀的参议员”，但他拒绝透露姓名。我认识他们所有人，我非常喜欢他们，”他说。“所以我可能会也可能不会参与其中。我不知道。也许我最好不要参与其中。”

paras.en: Asked if he thinks Democrats will try to impeach him a third time, Trump replied: “What have I done? I’ve had the best two years in the history of the presidency.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否认为民主党会第三次弹劾他时，特朗普回答道：“我做了什么？我度过了总统任期历史上最好的两年。”

paras.en: 60 Minutes‘ two-part Interview with Trump aired Sunday on CBS and Paramount+.
paras.zh: 《60 分钟》节目分为两部分，周日在哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 和派拉蒙+ (Paramount+) 频道播出。

articles.title: John Oliver Weighs In on Midterm Elections, Elon Musk and the Ultimate Southern Diss
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: John Oliver kicked off Sunday’s Last Week Tonight by running down a list of several Democratic wins from last week’s midterm elections.
paras.zh: 约翰·奥利弗 (John Oliver) 列出了上周中期选举中几项民主党胜利的名单，从而拉开了周日的《上周今晚》的序幕。

paras.en: The show started out with a blue wave crashing through the intro before Oliver cheerfully recapped the news: “It has been a busy week and, given the midterm results, a pretty good week too. Democrats won so big on Tuesday it was sometimes genuinely hard to take all the positive results in.”
paras.zh: 该节目一开始就在介绍中掀起了一阵蓝色浪潮，然后奥利弗兴高采烈地回顾了这一消息：“这是忙碌的一周，考虑到中期结果，这也是相当不错的一周。民主党在周二赢得了如此大的胜利，有时真的很难接受所有积极的结果。”

paras.en: He listed several big Democratic victories — earning loud applause from the audience after each — including the historically red Lone Star State: “It was genuinely hard to believe Texas had just turned blue.”
paras.zh: 他列举了民主党的几项重大胜利——每次胜利后都赢得了观众的热烈掌声——其中包括历史上红色的孤星州：“真的很难相信德克萨斯州刚刚变成了蓝色。”

paras.en: Oliver then turned his attention to a certain billionaire who spent a lot of money backing candidates who were ultimately defeated. “Then it hits you, Elon Musk wasted so much money,” he said. “The half a billion dollars he spent to try and buy the election just went up in flames faster than a parked Cybertruck. Speaking of which, we also learned this week he’s ending production of Cybertrucks, which isn’t technically an election result but kind of feels like one.”
paras.zh: 奥利弗随后将注意力转向了一位亿万富翁，他花了很多钱支持最终失败的候选人。 “然后你就会意识到，埃隆·马斯克浪费了这么多钱，”他说。 “他为赢得选举而花费的 5 亿美元，燃烧起来的速度比停放的赛博卡车还快。说到这里，我们本周还了解到他将停止生产赛博卡车，从技术上讲，这并不是选举结果，但感觉像是选举结果。”

paras.en: Oliver also spotlighted the Mississippi Senate race between Scott Colom and Cindy Hyde-Smith. It’s still too close to call, but the Last Week Tonight host noted that Hyde-Smith “appeared to have prematurely declared victory” on Wednesdsay. Colom, he said, “had a quintessentially Southern response.”
paras.zh: 奥利弗还重点关注了斯科特·科罗姆和辛迪·海德·史密斯之间的密西西比州参议院竞选。目前仍难分胜负，但《上周今夜秀》主持人指出，周三，海德·史密斯“似乎过早地宣布了胜利”。他说，科罗姆“有典型的南方反应。”

paras.en: Oliver showed a clip of Colom speaking to reporters. When asked about Hyde-Smith’s apparent gaffe, Colom paused for several seconds before saying, “Bless her heart.”
paras.zh: 奥利弗播放了科罗姆向记者讲话的片段。当被问及海德史密斯明显的失态时，科罗姆停顿了几秒钟，然后说：“祝福她的心。”

paras.en: Explained Oliver: “If you are not from the South, you should know it is basically not possible to say anything meaner than that down there. ‘Bless your heart’ was essentially invented in the South as a way to commit legal murder on someone without getting out of your church pew.”
paras.zh: 奥利弗解释说：“如果你不是来自南方，你应该知道，在南方基本上不可能说比这更刻薄的话。‘保佑你的心’本质上是南方发明的，作为一种在不离开教堂长椅的情况下对某人实施合法谋杀的方式。”

articles.title: ‘A Photographer in Cannes’ Follows an Estonian Who Knows the World’s Red (and Black) Carpets – and Loved Getting a Vin Diesel Fist Bump
articles.author: Georg Szalai

paras.en: You have seen the stars and red carpet glamour of the Cannes Film Festival through the lenses of photographers, TV cameras and mobile phones. Now you can get a backstage look at the life and not always so glamorous work of one of the hard-working red carpet photographers in the new documentary A Photographer in Cannes, which world premieres in the Special Screenings program of the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) in Estonia.
paras.zh: 你通过摄影师、电视摄像机和手机的镜头看到了戛纳电影节的明星和红毯魅力。现在，您可以在新纪录片《戛纳摄影师》中了解一位辛勤工作的红毯摄影师的后台生活，而不是总是那么迷人的作品，该片在爱沙尼亚第 30 届塔林黑夜电影节 (PÖFF) 的特别放映项目中进行了全球首映。

paras.en: Fitting the premiere location, the man taking the spotlight, while at the same time snapping pictures of the celebrities in it, is none other than Erlend Štaub, Estonia’s man on film festival carpets – both red, such as at Cannes and Berlin, or black, in the case of PÖFF. In fact, he has been the official photographer of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival for several years.
paras.zh: 与首映地点相匹配，这位在聚光灯下为明星拍照的男人不是别人，正是爱沙尼亚电影节地毯上的 Erlend Štaub - 地毯上有红色（例如戛纳和柏林），也有黑色（PÖFF）。事实上，他多年来一直担任塔林黑夜电影节的官方摄影师。

paras.en: A Photographer in Cannes comes from director and cinematographer Kullar Vilmne, who co-wrote the film with editor Erik Norkroos. The doc shows Štaub spending his days at exclusive parties, wild concerts and other events in Estonia, socializing and taking pictures, and spending his nights working on the photos to deliver them to the next morning. It also goes into the physical fitness, mental toughness and social skills needed to become a fixture of the world of glitz and glam. It is only fitting that the film also takes audiences to Cannes, which the veteran has attended for 15 years in a row, showing Štaub in his element on the red carpet and behind the scenes, where he is also shown running into Bella Hadid.
paras.zh: 《戛纳摄影师》由导演兼摄影师库拉尔·维尔姆尼 (Kullar Vilmne) 执导，他与剪辑师埃里克·诺克罗斯 (Erik Norkroos) 共同创作了这部电影。纪录片显示，斯塔布每天都在爱沙尼亚的独家派对、狂野音乐会和其他活动中度过，社交和拍照，并花晚上的时间处理照片，以便第二天早上将它们交付给他们。它还涉及成为浮华世界的一员所需的身体健康、心理韧性和社交技能。这部电影将观众带到了戛纳电影节，这是再合适不过的了，这位老将连续 15 年参加戛纳电影节，在红毯上和幕后展示了斯塔布的风采，还展示了他与贝拉·哈迪德 (Bella Hadid) 的邂逅。

paras.en: Štaub took time out of his busy schedule to talk to THR about A Photographer in Cannes, share tips for aspiring photographers, discuss one of his favorite celebrity encounters at Cannes 2026 and which stars he would love to photograph in the future.
paras.zh: 斯塔布从繁忙的日程中抽出时间与《THR》谈论《戛纳摄影师》，为有抱负的摄影师分享技巧，讨论他在 2026 年戛纳电影节上最喜欢的名人邂逅之一，以及他未来想拍摄哪些明星。

paras.en: How did Kullar, the director of the documentary, approach you, and what did you think when he told you he wanted to make a film about you?
paras.zh: 这部纪录片的导演库勒是如何接触你的？当他告诉你他想拍一部关于你的电影时，你有什么想法？

paras.en: First, I laughed loudly. Kullar texted me at six in the morning. I wrote him back, and I said it was not a good idea. And he told me, “Just listen to me. Let’s meet, and I’ll explain everything.” So, we met, and I listened to his idea. And I realized that the things that I’m doing are unbelievable to others. So, I said, “Okay, no problem. Do what you do, and I can help if you need help.”
paras.zh: 首先，我大声笑了。库勒早上六点给我发短信。我给他回了信，说这不是一个好主意。他告诉我，“听我说。我们见面吧，我会解释一切。”于是，我们见面了，我听了他的想法。我意识到我正在做的事情对其他人来说是难以置信的。所以，我说：“好吧，没问题。做你该做的事，如果你需要帮助，我可以提供帮助。”

paras.en: In your work, you are usually the person behind the camera. How was it to be in front of a camera, and did that affect your focus?
paras.zh: 在你的工作中，你通常是镜头后面的人。在镜头前感觉如何？这会影响你的注意力吗？

paras.en: When I’m working, I’m always focused, and I don’t notice anybody else – I only see the people of whom I want to take a picture. So, I didn’t have a problem with it.
paras.zh: 当我工作时，我总是很专注，不会注意到其他人——我只看到我想拍照的人。所以，我对此没有任何问题。

paras.en: How did the director get access with his camera to film you at Cannes? Did you have to help with that, and what was Cannes’ reaction?
paras.zh: 导演是怎么拿到相机在戛纳为你拍摄的？你需要帮忙吗？戛纳的反应是什么？

paras.en: My relationship with the Cannes festival is very, very good. I really appreciate what they are doing for me because Estonia is a very small country, and they have allowed me to take pictures on the red carpet along with the very good American photographers and France’s super photographers [and others].
paras.zh: 我和戛纳电影节的关系非常非常好。我真的很感激他们为我所做的一切，因为爱沙尼亚是一个非常小的国家，他们允许我与非常优秀的美国摄影师和法国的超级摄影师[以及其他人]一起在红地毯上拍照。

paras.en: The festival and I work together very well. I always have some kind of little present for them, and I really appreciate them. This time, I got my accreditation for the red carpet, which is good for 13 days [or so]. But filmmakers need to get a new red carpet accreditation every day. We told them about the project, and they are just such cool guys. We asked if it was possible to put a camera in [this and that spot], one behind me and one in front of me. And they [made it happen]. It was amazing. They are great guys and really helped the team and me.
paras.zh: 电影节和我合作得很好。我总是给他们准备一些小礼物，我真的很感激他们。这次，我获得了红地毯认证，有效期为 13 天[左右]。但电影制片人每天都需要获得新的红毯认证。我们告诉他们这个项目，他们真是太酷了。我们询问是否可以在[这个和那个地方]放置一台相机，一个在我后面，一个在我前面。他们[让这一切发生了]。太棒了。他们都是很棒的人，确实帮助了球队和我。

paras.en: The film shows you exercise and work out. How important is physical fitness for your work?
paras.zh: 这部电影向您展示了锻炼和锻炼。身体健康对于您的工作有多重要？

paras.en: It’s very important because this is stressful work, so your physical shape needs to be strong, like a military person. The pressure is so high, and I’m just afraid that maybe I’m going to die on the red carpet [if I am not in good shape] because there are too many things going on. Thank God I have my little gym room at home.
paras.zh: 这非常重要，因为这是一项压力很大的工作，所以你的体形需要像军人一样强壮。压力太大了，我只是担心我可能会死在红地毯上（如果我状态不好的话），因为发生的事情太多了。感谢上帝，我家里有我的小健身房。

paras.en: If a young person says, “I want to become a photographer,” especially for red carpets, do you have any advice or tips?
paras.zh: 如果一个年轻人说，“我想成为一名摄影师”，特别是红地毯摄影师，你有什么建议或技巧吗？

paras.en: First, don’t try to be anybody else. That is really important because you have your own business and your own personality, and people love that. It’s very funny because I think I’m crazy, I’m not a normal person. But people love [personality]. So, be yourself! People love that.
paras.zh: 首先，不要试图成为别人。这非常重要，因为你有自己的事业和自己的个性，人们喜欢这一点。这很有趣，因为我觉得我疯了，我不是一个正常人。但人们喜欢[个性]。所以，做你自己吧！人们喜欢这样。

paras.en: Do you have any stories about your personality?
paras.zh: 关于你的性格，你有什么故事吗？

paras.en: Seven or eight years ago, I was at the Berlinale. And there was one guy who I didn’t know and just took his picture. He came to PÖFF a year ago and told me, “Oh my God, you are the guy! I remember you from Berlin.” That’s what I do. Every person who comes to my camera remembers me. And for me, that’s very important.
paras.zh: 七八年前，我在柏林电影节。还有一个我不认识的人，只是拍了一张照片。一年前他来到 PÖFF 并告诉我，“天啊，你就是那个人！我记得你来自柏林。”这就是我所做的。每个来到我相机前的人都会记得我。对我来说，这非常重要。

paras.en: Are there any celebrities you find particularly easy to take photos of?
paras.zh: 有没有你觉得特别容易拍照的名人？

paras.en: There are lots who are great [for photos]. Bill Murray, Omar Sy, Harrison Ford, Penelope Cruz, Will Smith, and many others. I think they really love the audience. They love their fans, and you see that.
paras.zh: 有很多人都很擅长[拍照]。比尔·默里、奥玛·赛、哈里森·福特、佩内洛普·克鲁兹、威尔·史密斯等等。我认为他们真的很爱观众。他们爱他们的粉丝，你也看到了。

paras.en: Has there been anybody you were particularly excited to take a photo of?
paras.zh: 有没有哪个人让你特别兴奋想给他拍照？

paras.en: Vin Diesel! Oh my God, I had been waiting for this moment for a long time. I really love him, and I remember he came to the photocall at the Cannes Film Festival [this year]. And the first thing he did was give me a [fist bump]. And I said, “My God, this is the best day of my life.” He really appreciates all the people. He came and said, “Thank you, everybody. I want to tell you one thing. I’m here because of all of you. You journalists and photographers made me a real actor.” He really respects the photographers, the fans and the audience.
paras.zh: 范·迪塞尔！天哪，我等这一刻已经很久了。我真的很爱他，我记得他参加了[今年]戛纳电影节的拍照活动。他做的第一件事就是给了我一个[击拳]。我说：“天哪，这是我一生中最美好的一天。”他真的很感激所有人。他过来说道：“谢谢大家。我想告诉你们一件事。我之所以能站在这里，是因为你们所有人。你们记者和摄影师让我成为了一名真正的演员。”他非常尊重摄影师、粉丝和观众。

paras.en: Are there any celebrities you would still like to photograph one day?
paras.zh: 有没有哪位名人是您有一天仍想拍摄的？

paras.en: Yes. Samuel Jackson, Keanu Reeves, Anthony Hopkins, Charlie Hunnam, Ron Perlman, Danny Trejo. Yes, I love the badass. My favorite actor is Sylvester Stallone. I have taken his picture a couple of times. He’s amazing and an amazing person. There’s the film I Play Rocky now. I can’t wait to see it.
paras.zh: 是的。塞缪尔·杰克逊、基努·里维斯、安东尼·霍普金斯、查理·汉纳姆、朗·普尔曼、丹尼·特乔。是的，我喜欢坏蛋。我最喜欢的演员是西尔维斯特·史泰龙。我给他拍过几次照片。他很了不起，也是一个了不起的人。现在有电影《我扮演洛奇》。我等不及要看它了。

paras.en: How is PÖFF different? Is it more fun than other festivals because it’s your home place or does that mean there is more pressure?
paras.zh: PÖFF 有何不同？它比其他节日更有趣，因为它是你的家乡，还是意味着压力更大？

paras.en: No, it’s not pressure. Okay, a little bit, because we have so many people and everybody wants to have a photo. There is a really long line. And I see the [sad] faces when I must say, “Sorry, we need to close this black carpet.”
paras.zh: 不，这不是压力。好吧，有一点，因为我们有很多人，每个人都想拍照。队伍真的很长。当我必须说“对不起，我们需要关闭这条黑地毯”时，我看到了[悲伤]的面孔。

paras.en: What is your ideal set-up or condition for photo work at a big festival or event?
paras.zh: 您在大型节日或活动中进行摄影工作的理想设置或条件是什么？

paras.en: If I am the official photographer, I really want to work with every person one by one, so I can give them the glamor. And after that, every person remembers that.
paras.zh: 如果我是官方摄影师，我真的很想和每个人一一合作，这样我就能赋予他们魅力。在那之后，每个人都记得这件事。

paras.en: I always get the picture when people are looking straight at me. That’s, for me, the number one thing. Even at the Cannes Film Festival, if they are looking straight at my camera, that feels like I, the person [looking at the picture], and the celebrity are the only people in the room. There is a real connection.
paras.zh: 当人们直视我时，我总是能明白。对我来说，这是第一件事。即使在戛纳电影节上，如果他们直视我的相机，感觉就像我、[看照片]的人和名人是房间里唯一的人。存在真正的联系。

articles.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows

paras.en: Producer prices in China grew at the fastest rate since June 2022, accelerating for the third month in a row.
paras.zh: 中国生产者价格增速创2022年6月以来最快，连续第三个月加速。

paras.en: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters. The increase was driven by a sharp rise in prices in the mining and raw materials industries.
paras.zh: 10 月份 PPI 为 5.7%，而路透社调查的经济学家预期为 5.3%。这一增长是由采矿和原材料行业价格大幅上涨推动的。

paras.en: The increase was driven by very strong external demand, Zhang Zhiwei, president and chief economist at Pinpoint Asset Management, told CNBC's "Squawk Box Asia."
paras.zh: Pinpoint资产管理公司总裁兼首席经济学家张志伟告诉CNBC的“Squawk Box Asia”节目，这一增长是由非常强劲的外部需求推动的。

paras.en: Consumer inflation in China slowed to 0.7% in October, its first deceleration after two straight months of increases.
paras.zh: 10 月份中国消费者通胀率放缓至 0.7%，这是连续两个月上涨后首次放缓。

paras.en: The figure missed expectations of a 0.8% rise from economists polled by Reuters, and was lower than the 0.9% seen in September.
paras.zh: 该数字低于路透社调查的经济学家预期的增长 0.8%，也低于 9 月份的 0.9%。

paras.en: Core inflation, which strips out food and energy prices, came in at 0.8%, down from the 1% seen in the month before.
paras.zh: 扣除食品和能源价格后的核心通胀率为 0.8%，低于上个月的 1%。

paras.en: The rise in consumer prices were still held up by prices of gasoline, which was the largest contributor to the increase in prices, but this was offset by a sharper than expected fall in food prices, according to Dong Lijuan, chief statistician of the urban division at China's National Bureau of Statistics.
paras.zh: 中国国家统计局城市司首席统计师董丽娟表示，汽油价格仍然支撑了消费价格的上涨，汽油价格是物价上涨的最大推动因素，但这被食品价格降幅超出预期的幅度所抵消。

paras.en: The Chinese economy has shown some signs of expansion recently. It grew faster than expected in the third quarter, and September saw a sharp beat in retail sales.
paras.zh: 中国经济近期出现了一些扩张迹象。第三季度增长快于预期，9月份零售销售大幅增长。

paras.en: The mainland Chinese CSI 300 index gained 0.56% after the data release.
paras.zh: 数据公布后，沪深300指数上涨0.56%。

paras.en: Pinpoint's Zhang said that domestic demand has been rather weak due to the property market, and this is a key reason why inflation is not picking up in China
paras.zh: Pinpoint的张表示，受房地产市场影响，内需相当疲弱，这是中国通胀没有回升的一个关键原因

paras.en: "There's no clear sign of stabilization [in that sector] yet," he said, adding this was weighing on the household consumer confidence and local government revenue.
paras.zh: 他表示：“（该行业）还没有明显的稳定迹象。”他补充说，这正在影响家庭消费者信心和地方政府收入。

paras.en: "So the the overall economic momentum has been weak and hasn't really seen [a] clear sign of recovery," Zhang explained.
paras.zh: “所以整体经济势头一直疲弱，并没有真正看到明显的复苏迹象，”张解释道。

articles.title: From supermarket fridges to passenger flights, a wave of threats is testing Europe's defenses

paras.en: Cyberattacks, bomb threats against passenger flights, civil unrest and suspected acts of sabotage across Europe have raised questions about the continent's resilience — and how prepared it is to defend itself against modern security threats.
paras.zh: 欧洲各地的网络攻击、针对客运航班的炸弹威胁、内乱和涉嫌破坏行为引发了人们对欧洲大陆抵御能力以及抵御现代安全威胁的准备程度的质疑。

paras.en: Hackers remotely manipulated refrigeration systems at supermarkets across Europe last week, forcing retailers to discard spoiled food and exposing vulnerabilities in everyday infrastructure.
paras.zh: 上周，黑客远程操纵了欧洲各地超市的制冷系统，迫使零售商丢弃变质的食品，并暴露了日常基础设施的漏洞。

paras.en: French blood-bank refrigeration systems were subsequently targeted in what appeared to be a similar incident, while a wave of suspected hoax bomb threats disrupted dozens of flights across the continent, forcing diversions and, in some cases, fighter jet escorts.
paras.zh: 法国血库制冷系统随后在看似类似的事件中成为目标，而一波疑似恶作剧炸弹威胁扰乱了横跨非洲大陆的数十架航班，迫使改道，在某些情况下还需要战斗机护航。

paras.en: The week culminated with bomb threats targeting European news outlets, including the U.K.'s Sky News and Irish public broadcaster RTÉ.
paras.zh: 本周的高潮是针对欧洲新闻媒体的炸弹威胁，其中包括英国天空新闻台和爱尔兰公共广播公司 RTÉ。

paras.en: The incidents come against a backdrop of heightened geopolitical tensions and domestic unrest across parts of Europe, with civilian infrastructure potentially becoming an increasingly attractive target for hostile actors.
paras.zh: 这些事件发生的背景是欧洲部分地区地缘政治紧张局势加剧和国内动荡，民用基础设施可能成为敌对行动者越来越有吸引力的目标。

paras.en: While authorities have not established who was behind the attacks or whether they were connected, defense and security experts warn that disruption to everyday services can have consequences far beyond the immediate economic damage.
paras.zh: 尽管当局尚未确定袭击的幕后黑手或袭击是否有关联，但国防和安全专家警告说，日常服务中断所造成的后果远远超出了直接的经济损失。

paras.en: If Russia were responsible, such attacks could be intended to demonstrate the costs of Europe's continued support for Ukraine, said Sidharth Kaushal, a research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute, or RUSI.
paras.zh: 皇家联合军种研究所 (RUSI) 研究员西德哈斯·考沙尔 (Sidharth Kaushal) 表示，如果俄罗斯负责，此类袭击可能旨在展示欧洲继续支持乌克兰所付出的代价。

paras.en: "I think it's more about cost imposition," Kaushal told CNBC. "Convincing the European political leadership that the costs of a war can come home to them."
paras.zh: 考沙尔告诉 CNBC：“我认为这更多的是成本的增加。” “让欧洲政治领导层相信，战争的代价会让他们明白。”

paras.en: Russia didn't immediately respond to a CNBC request for comment.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: On Monday, supermarkets in Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden and the Netherlands found that refrigeration systems had been set to as much as 50 degrees Celsius, or 122 degrees Fahrenheit, affecting retailers including Ahold Delhaize, IKEA, Colruyt Group and Carrefour.
paras.zh: 周一，比利时、卢森堡、瑞典和荷兰的超市发现制冷系统温度高达 50 摄氏度（122 华氏度），影响了包括 Ahold Delhaize、宜家、Colruyt Group 和家乐福在内的零售商。

paras.en: It followed an October cyberattack that targeted hundreds of French supermarkets, causing fires, fridges to overheat and food to spoil. The incidents highlighted vulnerabilities in food-supply infrastructure.
paras.zh: 此前，十月份针对数百家法国超市的网络攻击导致火灾、冰箱过热和食物变质。这些事件凸显了食品供应基础设施的脆弱性。

paras.en: They also highlight the role of private companies in national resilience, as internet-connected equipment can be exploited to cause physical disruption.
paras.zh: 他们还强调了私营公司在国家复原力中的作用，因为联网设备可能被利用造成物理破坏。

paras.en: Fredrik Blix, cybersecurity expert at Visente and associate professor at Stockholm University, told CNBC that the supermarket attacks required very little technical sophistication since vulnerable refrigeration control systems were connected directly to the public internet, allowing potential attackers to find and exploit them.
paras.zh: Visente 网络安全专家、斯德哥尔摩大学副教授 Fredrik Blix 告诉 CNBC，超市攻击不需要什么复杂的技术，因为易受攻击的制冷控制系统直接连接到公共互联网，潜在的攻击者可以找到并利用它们。

paras.en: "These attacks, they don't really require any specific advanced knowledge to carry out," he said, adding that some systems were protected only by default passwords or easily guessed credentials.
paras.zh: 他说：“这些攻击实际上并不需要任何特定的高级知识来执行。”他补充说，一些系统仅受到默认密码或容易猜到的凭据的保护。

paras.en: "This is why this is so cheap to do," Blix said, warning that the publicity surrounding the incidents could encourage copycat attacks. "Anyone can do it, and it does not require any resources from a country or anything like that."
paras.zh: 布利克斯说：“这就是为什么这样做的成本如此之低。”他警告说，围绕这些事件的宣传可能会鼓励模仿攻击。 “任何人都可以做到，而且不需要国家提供任何资源或类似的东西。”

paras.en: Cyberattacks have become more common over the past decade as societies have become more digital and vulnerable systems have become easier to access, Blix said. However, he noted that mounting geopolitical tensions have also made European countries more alert to potential hybrid warfare threats, leading to scrutiny by both governments and media.
paras.zh: 布利克斯说，过去十年，随着社会变得更加数字化，脆弱的系统变得更容易访问，网络攻击变得更加普遍。不过，他指出，不断加剧的地缘政治紧张局势也使欧洲国家对潜在的混合战争威胁更加警惕，导致政府和媒体的密切关注。

paras.en: While Blix acknowledged the possibility of a state or state-backed actor being behind the attacks, he said the more likely scenario is someone testing the boundaries and "having some fun."
paras.zh: 虽然布利克斯承认国家或国家支持的行为者可能是这些攻击的幕后黑手，但他表示更可能的情况是有人测试边界并“享受一些乐趣”。

paras.en: Kaushal said the incidents should be viewed within the larger context of suspected sabotage and hybrid threats across Europe, including damage to undersea cables in the Baltic Sea.
paras.zh: 考沙尔表示，应该在整个欧洲涉嫌破坏和混合威胁的更大背景下看待这些事件，包括波罗的海海底电缆的损坏。

paras.en: "If this was an event in isolation, one might say 'okay, we should view it on its own merits,' but when you view it in the backdrop of all of that, it becomes less clear," he said, also citing death threats against European defense executives and a bomb placed on a DHL aircraft in 2024.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果这是一个孤立的事件，人们可能会说‘好吧，我们应该根据事件本身的优点来看待它’，但当你在所有这一切的背景下看待它时，事情就变得不那么清晰了。”他还引用了针对欧洲防务高管的死亡威胁以及 2024 年在 DHL 飞机上放置的一枚炸弹。

paras.en: European governments are contending with greater uncertainty over U.S. security guarantees after decades of underinvestment in defense, while facing a rise in unconventional but potentially devastating threats.
paras.zh: 在经历了几十年的国防投资不足之后，欧洲各国政府正在应对美国安全保障的更大不确定性，同时面临非常规但潜在破坏性威胁的增加。

paras.en: Hybrid warfare combines tactics such as cyberattacks, sabotage and disinformation to destabilize adversaries without triggering open military conflict.
paras.zh: 混合战争结合了网络攻击、破坏和虚假信息等战术，在不引发公开军事冲突的情况下破坏对手的稳定。

paras.en: Countries' abilities to withstand hybrid threats vary substantially across the continent, according to Kaushal. While Finland and Sweden have well-developed civilian defense programs reflecting their Cold War experience, much of Europe's infrastructure was built around economic efficiency rather than defense needs.
paras.zh: 考沙尔表示，整个非洲大陆各国抵御混合威胁的能力差异很大。虽然芬兰和瑞典拥有反映其冷战经验的完善的民用防御计划，但欧洲的大部分基础设施都是围绕经济效率而不是国防需求而建立的。

paras.en: "As one goes further west in Europe, the level of preparation, both against hybrid attacks, but also just simple missile attacks of the kind that we've seen in Ukraine, is far less great," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“随着欧洲进一步向西发展，无论是针对混合攻击，还是针对我们在乌克兰看到的那种简单的导弹攻击，准备程度都远远不够。”

paras.en: "Every attack generates a bit of resilience," he said, citing NATO's increased focus on threats to underwater cables and gas pipelines after the 2022 Nord Stream sabotage.
paras.zh: 他说：“每次攻击都会产生一点恢复力。”他指出，在 2022 年北溪破坏事件后，北约更加关注水下电缆和天然气管道面临的威胁。

paras.en: Oana Popescu-Zamfir, a senior research fellow specializing in European security at RUSI, said the recent incidents showed Europe had lagged in "preparing for something that we have known would be coming."
paras.zh: RUSI 专门研究欧洲安全的高级研究员瓦纳·波佩斯库-扎姆菲尔 (Oana Popescu-Zamfir) 表示，最近发生的事件表明欧洲在“为我们已知即将发生的事情做好准备”方面落后了。

paras.en: "We've been slow in adjusting to a new reality," she said. "We still tend to conceptually divide between peace and wartime, and that is no longer the case because we're not at war, but we're also not in peace time."
paras.zh: “我们在适应新现实方面进展缓慢，”她说。 “我们仍然倾向于在概念上区分和平时期和战时，但情况已不再如此，因为我们没有处于战争状态，但我们也不是处于和平时期。”

paras.en: She said Europe was likely to face sustained hybrid attacks designed to achieve military objectives without conventional military force.
paras.zh: 她表示，欧洲可能面临持续的混合攻击，旨在在没有常规军事力量的情况下实现军事目标。

paras.en: Popescu-Zamfir said Russia could draw on networks of proxies in Europe, some directly controlled and others more loosely coordinated, making responsibility difficult to trace directly to the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 波佩斯库-扎姆菲尔表示，俄罗斯可以利用欧洲的代理人网络，其中一些是直接控制的，另一些则是松散协调的，这使得责任很难直接追溯到克里姆林宫。

paras.en: She told CNBC that "the damage that can be done is huge" in targeted attacks on internet-connected systems, citing the potential disruption of blood reserves.
paras.zh: 她告诉 CNBC，针对互联网连接系统的针对性攻击“可能造成巨大损害”，并指出可能会破坏血液储备。

paras.en: The attacks are not a "piece of cake for Russia to carry out, but they're also not rocket science," she said, adding that they "can do tremendous damage in concrete terms and in terms of the psychological impact on our societies and the feeling that we are unprotected."
paras.zh: 她说，这些袭击“对俄罗斯来说并不是小菜一碟，但也不是火箭科学”，并补充说，这些袭击“可以在具体方面以及对我们社会的心理影响和我们没有受到保护的感觉方面造成巨大损害。”

paras.en: Blix said companies can take relatively straightforward steps to reduce their exposure.
paras.zh: 布利克斯表示，公司可以采取相对简单的措施来减少风险。

paras.en: "These are basic cyber hygiene things... You should not be allowed to connect industrial control systems and this kind of operational technology directly online without any proper security around it," he said.
paras.zh: “这些都是基本的网络卫生问题……如果没有任何适当的安全措施，就不应该允许你直接在线连接工业控制系统和这种操作技术，”他说。

paras.en: Responsibility is split among product manufacturers, maintenance providers and grocery chains, making accountability unclear as each points to the others.
paras.zh: 责任由产品制造商、维护提供商和杂货连锁店承担，这使得责任不明确，因为每个人都相互指责。

paras.en: Blix said maintenance companies sometimes prioritize convenience by enabling remote access despite manufacturers' security guidance, while retailers may fail to enforce adequate cybersecurity standards among suppliers.
paras.zh: 布利克斯表示，尽管制造商有安全指导，维护公司有时会通过启用远程访问来优先考虑便利性，而零售商可能无法在供应商之间执行足够的网络安全标准。

paras.en: "What worries me is that we don't really do anything," Blix said, adding that "we are shuffling a lot of papers" and "doing a lot of risk assessments" but failing to take meaningful action.
paras.zh: 布利克斯说：“令我担心的是，我们并没有真正采取任何行动。”他补充说，“我们正在整理大量文件”并“进行大量风险评估”，但未能采取有意义的行动。

paras.en: Europe has also seen widespread unrest in recent months, adding political pressure as households grapple with high living costs.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，欧洲也出现了广泛的骚乱，家庭面临高昂的生活成本，这增加了政治压力。

paras.en: Domestic political and economic tensions can also give foreign adversaries opportunities to deepen divisions, said Alexander Anderson, president and director of policy at the Centre for International Security and Economic Strategy.
paras.zh: 国际安全与经济战略中心主席兼政策主任亚历山大·安德森表示，国内政治和经济紧张局势也可能给外国对手提供加深分歧的机会。

paras.en: He told CNBC that Russian and potentially Chinese influence operations may work to amplify those divisions.
paras.zh: 他告诉 CNBC，俄罗斯和潜在的中国影响力行动可能会加剧这些分歧。

paras.en: "But we should be careful not to dismiss legitimate domestic grievances as the product of foreign interference," he said. "Doing so risks misunderstanding both the causes of political instability and the methods through which hostile actors seek to exploit it."
paras.zh: “但我们应该小心，不要将合理的国内不满视为外国干涉的产物，”他说。 “这样做可能会误解政治不稳定的原因以及敌对行为者试图利用政治不稳定的方法。”

paras.en: Weeks of nationwide protests, riots and strikes have increased pressure on the French government, complicating efforts to rein in public finances and deepening existing political divisions.
paras.zh: 连续数周的全国性抗议、骚乱和罢工增加了法国政府面临的压力，使控制公共财政的努力变得更加复杂，并加深了现有的政治分歧。

paras.en: In Spain, demonstrations and a parliamentary impasse over the housing crisis led Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call a snap election. The vote is scheduled for Nov. 29. The far-right Vox party is expected to make gains, putting Sanchez's left-leaning government at risk of losing power.
paras.zh: 在西班牙，示威活动和议会因住房危机陷入僵局导致总理佩德罗·桑切斯宣布提前举行选举。投票定于 11 月 29 日进行。极右翼 Vox 党预计将取得进展，这将使桑切斯的左倾政府面临失去权力的风险。

paras.en: Germany, Italy, Portugal and Albania have also seen unrest over rising living costs in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 最近几周，德国、意大利、葡萄牙和阿尔巴尼亚也因生活成本上涨而出现骚乱。

paras.en: On Friday, protesters in Amsterdam tried to enter a Microsoft data center, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，周五，阿姆斯特丹的抗议者试图进入微软数据中心。

paras.en: Meanwhile, elevated energy prices, persistent inflation, sluggish growth and large budget deficits are pushing up borrowing costs and leaving governments with less room to support struggling households.
paras.zh: 与此同时，能源价格上涨、持续通胀、增长乏力和巨额预算赤字正在推高借贷成本，使政府支持陷入困境的家庭的空间越来越小。

articles.title: Stock futures climb as investors eye AI trade, brace for more data and earnings: Live updates

paras.en: Stock futures were higher on Monday with traders eyeing whether technology shares can continue to recover, while they are awaiting the release of key inflation data and earnings from major AI companies this week.
paras.zh: 周一股指期货走高，交易员关注科技股能否继续复苏，同时等待本周公布的关键通胀数据和主要人工智能公司的收益。

paras.en: S&P 500 futures gained 0.42%, while the Nasdaq 100's added 0.18%. Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 375 points, or 0.73%.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.42%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 0.18%。道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 375 点，即 0.73%。

paras.en: Over in Asia, markets were mostly up on Monday, with Taiwanese equities leading the rise. The Taiwan Weighted Index was almost 6% up, powered by a rebound in key stocks TSMC and Hon Hai Precision Industry — also known as Foxconn.
paras.zh: 亚洲市场周一大部分上涨，其中台湾股市领涨。受主要股票台积电和鸿海精密工业（又称富士康）反弹的推动，台湾加权指数上涨近 6%。

paras.en: The Nikkei 225 gained 2.56% and the Topix climbed 3.06%, powered by financial and consumer cyclical stocks.
paras.zh: 在金融和消费周期性股票的推动下，日经 225 指数上涨 2.56%，东证指数上涨 3.06%。

paras.en: South Korea's benchmark Kospi index slipped 0.15% late in the session, while the small-cap Kosdaq index also dipped 0.1%.
paras.zh: 韩国基准 Kospi 指数尾盘下跌 0.15%，小型股科斯达克指数也下跌 0.1%。

paras.en: Tech heavyweights Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix were up 1.06% and 1.68% respectively.
paras.zh: 科技巨头三星电子和SK海力士分别上涨1.06%和1.68%。

paras.en: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index was up 0.12%, while the CSI 300 index on mainland China was 0.13% higher.
paras.zh: 香港恒生指数上涨0.12%，中国大陆沪深300指数上涨0.13%。

paras.en: Investors in Asia are also assessing October inflation data out from China, with the producer price index hitting its highest in over four years at 5.7%, and consumer inflation coming in slower than expected at 0.7%.
paras.zh: 亚洲投资者也在评估中国 10 月份的通胀数据，生产者价格指数触及 5.7% 的四年来最高水平，而消费者通胀则低于预期，为 0.7%。

paras.en: Friday's market partially rebounded from Thursday's brutal AI-driven selloff, as chip stocks recovered on renewed buying. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite bounced 1.09% to 24,579.42 and the broad-market S&P 500 rose 0.31% to 7,376.86. The blue-chip Dow, however, lost 237.33 points, or 0.46%, to settle at 51,285.73.
paras.zh: 周五市场从周四人工智能驱动的残酷抛售中部分反弹，芯片股因重新买盘而反弹。以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数反弹 1.09%，至 24,579.42 点；标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.31%，至 7,376.86 点。然而，蓝筹道指下跌 237.33 点，或 0.46%，收于 51,285.73 点。

paras.en: Broader investor sentiment remained cautious following a batch of stronger-than-expected jobs data. Additionally, concerns linger after the Democrats' strong midterm results, amid fears that tighter regulations on data center construction, energy use, and development costs could slow the AI infrastructure boom.
paras.zh: 在一系列强于预期的就业数据之后，更广泛的投资者情绪仍然保持谨慎。此外，在民主党取得强劲的中期选举结果后，人们仍然担心，对数据中心建设、能源使用和开发成本的更严格监管可能会减缓人工智能基础设施的繁荣。

paras.en: The tech sector will also be focused on the bombshell announcement Sunday that Nvidia's board of directors is opening an investigation into co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a businesswoman who U.S. intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy. A proxy for Nvidia shares was lower by 2% over the last 24 hours in trading on Hyperliquid.
paras.zh: 科技行业还将关注周日发布的重磅消息，即英伟达董事会正在对联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋与一名美国情报机构称其为中国间谍的女商人的关系展开调查。过去 24 小时内，Hyperliquid 交易中的 Nvidia 股票代理价格下跌了 2%。

paras.en: Liz Ann Sonders, Schwab Center for Financial Research chief investment strategist, noted that the Nasdaq and Nasdaq-100 are oversold, with heavy de-risking by traders. Thursday marked the biggest day of retail selling since the Covid pandemic, according to Vanda Research. Retail traders haven't been taking advantage of the selloff, Sonders said.
paras.zh: 施瓦布金融研究中心首席投资策略师利兹·安·桑德斯 (Liz Ann Sonders) 指出，纳斯达克指数和纳斯达克 100 指数已超卖，交易员大幅降低风险。 Vanda Research 的数据显示，周四是新冠大流行以来零售销售量最大的一天。桑德斯表示，零售交易商并未利用这次抛售的机会。

paras.en: "Retail has not proven to be the dip buyers that they have been in the past," she told CNBC's "Fast Money" on Friday. "You saw a really heavy amount of net selling … we may not fully be washed out yet, but we'll have to see whether that retail trader at some point decides to step back in."
paras.zh: 她周五对 CNBC 的“快钱”节目表示：“事实证明，零售业并没有像过去那样逢低买入。” “你看到了非常大量的净抛售……我们可能还没有完全被淘汰，但我们必须看看散户是否会在某个时候决定重新介入。”

paras.en: Sonders suggested that the next short-term focus should be on companies' adjustments to capex plans and expectations for future profit margins.
paras.zh: 桑德斯建议，接下来的短期重点应该放在公司对资本支出计划的调整以及对未来利润率的预期上。

paras.en: This week, investors are looking ahead to key AI-related earnings — CoreWeave, Cisco and Applied Materials are all on deck — as they assess the outlook for tech and whether the recent selloff has further to run.
paras.zh: 本周，投资者正在展望与人工智能相关的关键收益——CoreWeave、思科和应用材料公司都在准备——因为他们评估科技的前景以及最近的抛售是否会进一步持续。

paras.en: They'll also watch for the releases of both the consumer price index on Tuesday and the producer price index on Friday, looking for clues on the Fed's next move.
paras.zh: 他们还将关注周二公布的消费者价格指数和周五公布的生产者价格指数，寻找美联储下一步行动的线索。

paras.en: On Monday, traders will get September wholesale inventories data at 10 a.m. ET. Take-Two Interactive Software, Occidental Petroleum, KKR, Constellation Energy and Skydance are scheduled to report quarterly earnings.
paras.zh: 交易员将于美国东部时间周一上午 10 点获得 9 月份批发库存数据。 Take-Two Interactive Software、西方石油公司、KKR、Constellation Energy 和 Skydance 计划公布季度收益。

articles.title: Kevin Roose says the race to build superintelligence is accelerating

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman.
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：《科学美国人》的《科学快报》，我是雷切尔·费尔特曼。

paras.en: I remember when, just a few years ago, the idea of using generative AI to create a weird portrait of yourself was fringe enough to actually feel cool. A tech reporter in my circle spent literal days training a model on photos, then many hours more sifting through poorly rendered images to produce a set of slightly uncanny likenesses. It was something between a science experiment and an extremely fiddly crafting project.
paras.zh: 我记得就在几年前，使用生成式人工智能为自己创造一幅奇怪的肖像的想法还很边缘，实际上感觉很酷。我圈子里的一位科技记者花了几天时间训练照片模型，然后花费更多时间筛选渲染不佳的图像，以产生一组有点不可思议的相似之处。这是介于科学实验和极其复杂的手工项目之间的东西。

paras.en: Fast-forward to today, and it feels like I can’t walk 10 feet without seeing the unmistakable aesthetic of AI on a flyer or in a shop window. The street food fairs in my neighborhood are all flooded with AI, too, with photos of food either looking nauseatingly hyperreal thanks to AI retouching or having the vaguely eldritch flavor of AI-rendered culinary hallucinations. Even in the local parents’ WhatsApp, people share packing lists and childcare guides crafted by AI agents instead of offering their own, unfiltered advice.
paras.zh: 快进到今天，我感觉自己每走 10 英尺，就会在传单或商店橱窗里看到人工智能的明显美感。我家附近的街头食品集市也充斥着人工智能，食物的照片要么由于人工智能修饰而显得极其真实，要么带有人工智能渲染的烹饪幻觉的隐约怪异的味道。即使在当地家长的 WhatsApp 中，人们也会分享由人工智能代理制作的装箱单和儿童保育指南，而不是提供他们自己的、未经过滤的建议。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: In the course of a decade, we’ve gone from this sort of AI being basically useless to being treated by many as indispensable. How did we get here so fast, and what does that mean about where we’re headed?
paras.zh: 在十年的时间里，我们已经从这种基本上无用的人工智能变成了被许多人视为不可或缺的人工智能。我们是如何如此快地到达这里的？这对我们的前进方向意味着什么？

paras.en: Tech journalist Kevin Roose has had a front-row seat to this breakneck shift, and it’s the subject of his latest book: The AGI Chronicles: The Inside Story of the Race to Create an Artificial Superintelligence. He recently sat down to chat with Scientific American’s books and culture lead Bri Kane about his research on the AI boom. Here’s their conversation.
paras.zh: 科技记者凯文·罗斯 (Kevin Roose) 亲眼目睹了这一惊人的转变，这也是他最新著作《AGI 编年史：创建人工智能竞赛的内幕故事》的主题。他最近坐下来与《科学美国人》的书籍和文化领袖 Bri Kane 讨论了他对人工智能热潮的研究。这是他们的对话。

paras.en: Bri Kane: I’m really excited to talk to you about this because you’ve been a tech reporter. You’ve been inside the San Francisco bubble for 10 years now, and you argue in the book that the last decade—2016 to 2026—is really extraordinary technological advancements taking place. It is also extraordinarily historically relevant, and you’ve described this book as a historical document.
paras.zh: Bri Kane：我真的很高兴能和你谈论这个，因为你一直是一名科技记者。您已经在旧金山泡沫中生活了 10 年，您在书中指出，过去十年（2016 年至 2026 年）确实发生了非凡的技术进步。它也具有非凡的历史意义，您将这本书描述为历史文献。

paras.en: Kevin Roose: I really thought of this as a time capsule. I was not trying to write about AI up to the minute, which I think is a, sort of, a doomed project, considering how quickly everything changes in AI. But I was really interested in telling the story of how we went from AI that basically didn’t work in 2017, didn’t do much of anything—you could have Siri tell you the weather or Alexa try to, you know, play some music or put on a timer in the kitchen—but real AI, the kind that, sort of, thinks and learns for itself, that can be directed at a wide variety of tasks, didn’t exist. And we went from that to—now we have these AI systems that are used by billions of people, that are solving Millennium Prize Problems in math and doing groundbreaking scientific research, transforming jobs. Like, we went from nothing to something in a decade.
paras.zh: 凯文·罗斯：我真的认为这是一个时间胶囊。我并不是想写有关人工智能的最新文章，考虑到人工智能中一切变化的速度，我认为这是一个注定要失败的项目。但我真的很想讲述我们如何摆脱人工智能的故事，人工智能在 2017 年基本上不起作用，没有做任何事情——你可以让 Siri 告诉你天气，或者 Alexa 尝试播放一些音乐，或者在厨房里设置定时器——但真正的人工智能，那种能够自我思考和学习，可以针对各种各样的任务的人工智能，还不存在。我们从那时到现在，我们拥有这些被数十亿人使用的人工智能系统，它们正在解决数学中的千年奖问题，并进行突破性的科学研究，改变工作。就像，我们在十年内从无到有。

paras.en: And so my question was: How? How did we get there? How did the people making this stuff do it? What were they feeling at the time that they started to see it working? I often tell people that living in San Francisco feels a little like what I imagine living in Los Alamos felt like in 1943 when, like, the Manhattan Project rolled into town. And I just have, kind of, had this wildly privileged front-row seat to something that I think will go down in history as at least as significant as the Manhattan Project, if not more.
paras.zh: 所以我的问题是：如何？我们是怎么到达那里的？制作这个东西的人是怎么做到的？当他们开始看到它发挥作用时有什么感觉？我经常告诉人们，生活在旧金山的感觉有点像我想象的 1943 年生活在洛斯阿拉莫斯的感觉，就像曼哈顿计划进入城镇一样。我只是拥有了这个极其特权的前排座位，我认为这将载入史册，至少与曼哈顿计划一样重要，甚至更重要。

paras.en: Kane: Yeah, this comparison to the Manhattan Project is made pretty often, and it’s one that you mention in the book. Can you, kind of, dig into those comparisons? One, just for our audience, can you explain what the Manhattan Project is? But then specify: What are the parallels that you’re seeing between the advancements in AI and the, kind of, small community building it and the Manhattan Project and the scientific advancements that that fairly small community made as well?
paras.zh: 凯恩：是的，人们经常将其与曼哈顿计划进行比较，这也是您在书中提到的。你能深入研究一下这些比较吗？第一，请您向我们的观众解释一下曼哈顿计划是什么？但请具体说明：您认为人工智能的进步和构建它的小型社区与曼哈顿计划以及那个相当小的社区所取得的科学进步之间有什么相似之处？

paras.en: Roose: So the Manhattan Project was the American nuclear effort during World War II to harness this new technology, the nuclear chain reaction, or nuclear fission, splitting the atom, and turn it into weaponry that could be used to advance the American cause in World War II—and eventually did end the war when it was used in Japan.
paras.zh: 罗斯：曼哈顿计划是美国在二战期间的核努力，旨在利用核链式反应或核裂变、原子分裂这一新技术，将其转化为可用于推进美国在二战中事业的武器，并最终在日本使用时结束了战争。

paras.en: And the parallels here are explicit. So the people making AI are students of the Manhattan Project. In fact, for years, new hires at Anthropic would be given a copy of this book about the Manhattan Project, The Making of the Atomic Bomb, by Richard Rhodes, which was Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic’s, favorite book.
paras.zh: 这里的相似之处是显而易见的。所以创造人工智能的人是曼哈顿计划的学生。事实上，多年来，Anthropic 的新员工都会收到理查德·罗兹 (Richard Rhodes) 所著的一本有关曼哈顿计划的《原子弹的制造》一书，这本书是 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 最喜欢的书。

paras.en: And he had explicitly, sort of, patterned his career after that—not of [J. Robert] Oppenheimer, who is generally the, sort of, famous scientist that they make movies about—but of this other Manhattan Project scientist, Leo Szilard. And Leo Szilard came up with the nuclear chain reaction—the, sort of, technology that made the atomic bomb possible—and the first thing he did was: he tried to keep it a secret. He tried to lock it down. He wrote telegrams to scientists all over Europe saying, “Please don’t publish any research into this new technology.” And when that failed, when the Nazis, who were on the other side of World War II, got the technology, he decided that his moral obligation was to build it first, to, sort of, help lead the American nuclear project.
paras.zh: 他在那之后明确地、某种程度上地塑造了他的职业生涯——而不是[J.罗伯特·奥本海默（Robert Oppenheimer），通常是他们拍电影的著名科学家，但他是曼哈顿计划的另一位科学家利奥·西拉德（Leo Szilard）。利奥·西拉德提出了核链式反应——这种技术使原子弹成为可能——而他做的第一件事就是：他试图保守秘密。他试图将其锁定。他给欧洲各地的科学家写了电报说：“请不要发表任何有关这项新技术的研究。”当这一计划失败后，当二战另一边的纳粹分子获得了这项技术时，他决定，他的道德义务是首先建造它，在某种程度上帮助领导美国的核项目。

paras.en: So he convinced his friend Albert Einstein to write a letter to the president and, sort of, became one of the leaders of the Manhattan Project, not because he thought the technology was good but because he was worried about its destructive potential, and he wanted to keep it out of the bad guys’ hands by making sure that the good guys built it first.
paras.zh: 因此，他说服他的朋友阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦给总统写了一封信，并在某种程度上成为了曼哈顿计划的领导人之一，不是因为他认为这项技术很好，而是因为他担心它的破坏性潜力，他想通过确保好人先建造它来防止它落入坏人之手。

paras.en: So that is the, sort of, parallel here, is: this is a very small community of scientists and researchers who have been building something largely in secret that they believe will be as transformative for the global order, for the future of humanity, as nuclear weapons were, if not much more so. And there are some important differences, too, but those are the main parallels.
paras.zh: 因此，这与这里类似的是：这是一个由科学家和研究人员组成的非常小的社区，他们一直在秘密地建造一些东西，他们相信这些东西将像核武器一样改变全球秩序，改变人类的未来，甚至更是如此。也存在一些重要的差异，但这些是主要的相似之处。

paras.en: Kane: Do you think that the future of AGI [artificial general intelligence] is potentially as destructive as the atomic bomb?
paras.zh: 凯恩：您认为 AGI（通用人工智能）的未来可能像原子弹一样具有破坏性吗？

paras.en: Roose: Yes. I mean, I think it could, in fact, be even more destructive because, you know, the atomic bomb was a tool. It was an important tool. It was a deadly tool. It, you know, had enormous destructive potential—you could use it to blow up the world—but it was still a tool.
paras.zh: 罗斯：是的。我的意思是，我认为它实际上可能更具破坏性，因为，你知道，原子弹是一种工具。这是一个重要的工具。这是一个致命的工具。你知道，它具有巨大的破坏潜力——你可以用它来炸毁世界——但它仍然是一种工具。

paras.en: The difference with AI or with AGI, which is artificial general intelligence, which is the subject of the book, is that it is not just a tool. It can make decisions. It can take autonomous actions. It can pursue goals. So the nuclear bomb had to be dropped and used by humans, but AI could go rogue. We’ve seen examples of that already. And it could decide to wipe us out as part of a plan that we don’t even really understand and that we had nothing to do with.
paras.zh: 人工智能或通用人工智能（AGI，即通用人工智能，也是本书的主题）的区别在于，它不仅仅是一种工具。它可以做出决定。它可以采取自主行动。它可以追求目标。因此，核弹必须由人类投下和使用，但人工智能可能会失控。我们已经看到过这样的例子。它可能会决定消灭我们，作为一个我们甚至不真正理解并且与我们无关的计划的一部分。

paras.en: Kane: After the first usage of the atomic bomb, there was a social uproar, I’ll say, as to how destructive this was, and I think a lot of people didn’t understand the science until they witnessed the horrifying ramifications of the use of this bomb. And there was a massive uptick in political discourse around turning this off, just turning off this technology, making sure this was a one-time thing that we never, ever, ever, ever see again. Do you think that is what is going to happen with regulation with the future of AGI, or is that a pipe dream? Because, I have to say, something that you say in the book and that we’ve seen in AI coverage: A lot of people don’t actually understand what this is, and it’s hard to regulate something that you can’t fully grasp. So do you think that the powers that be today understand enough about AGI to regulate it properly?
paras.zh: 凯恩：在第一次使用原子弹之后，我想说的是，关于它的破坏性有多大，我认为很多人在亲眼目睹了使用这种炸弹的可怕后果之前并不了解科学。围绕关闭这一技术、关闭这项技术的政治讨论大幅增加，以确保这是我们永远、永远、永远、永远不会再看到的一次性事件。您认为这就是 AGI 未来监管将会发生的情况，还是这是一个白日梦？因为，我不得不说，你在书中所说的以及我们在人工智能报道中看到的一些内容：很多人实际上并不理解这是什么，并且很难规范你无法完全掌握的东西。那么您认为当今的权力机构对通用人工智能有足够的了解并能够对其进行适当的监管吗？

paras.en: Roose: I think they understand. I just don’t think they want to regulate it. I mean, we have, in Washington, [D.C.], an administration that has explicitly said it doesn’t want to regulate this technology. It wants to let it rip or let the private sector cook, as David Sacks, the former AI czar, put it. So they see the potential. I don’t think they fully grasp what it would mean for everyone on Earth to have access to the most advanced AI models, you know, the ones that only insiders have today. But I think they are wrong to dismiss the potential both for harm and good of this technology.
paras.zh: 罗斯：我想他们明白。我只是认为他们不想对其进行监管。我的意思是，我们华盛顿特区政府明确表示不想监管这项技术。正如前人工智能沙皇戴维·萨克斯(David Sacks)所说，它想让它撕裂，或者让私营部门做饭。所以他们看到了潜力。我认为他们没有完全理解，对于地球上的每个人来说，获得最先进的人工智能模型意味着什么，你知道，这些模型只有内部人士才能拥有。但我认为他们忽视这项技术的潜在危害和好处是错误的。

paras.en: And what you’re seeing actually is interesting. Like, in my career as a tech journalist, I have reported on a lot of promising new technologies. I reported on social media. But the people running the social media companies and the researchers working on the social media algorithms were not going around saying that the technology they were building could cause human extinction or some other calamity. The people who are most worried about AI are the people at the labs building the technology. And so part of the project of the book was to understand why. What are they seeing? What is their experience that causes them to be so alarmed about this thing?
paras.zh: 你所看到的实际上很有趣。就像，在我作为科技记者的职业生涯中，我报道了许多有前途的新技术。我在社交媒体上进行了报道。但社交媒体公司的运营者和社交媒体算法的研究人员并没有到处说他们正在开发的技术可能会导致人类灭绝或其他灾难。最担心人工智能的人是实验室里构建该技术的人。因此，本书的部分任务就是理解其中的原因。他们看到了什么？到底是什么经历让他们对这件事如此惊慌呢？

paras.en: And then why do they keep doing it? Why do they understand the risks and take them seriously and then wake up every day and try to make more capable AI systems? So those were some of the questions I was trying to untangle.
paras.zh: 那么他们为什么还要继续这样做呢？为什么他们了解风险并认真对待它们，然后每天醒来并尝试制造更强大的人工智能系统？这些是我试图解决的一些问题。

paras.en: Kane: I have to say—why would someone who works in these labs be so deeply concerned?—you have some really good examples in this book as to why one of those people would be really concerned. I have to say, speaking only personally, if I was at a company retreat, and my CEO dressed up in a white robe and burned an effigy of a demon in front of me and my friends, I would have concerns. That would concern me about what our real goals are here, and that is something that you report in the book.
paras.zh: 凯恩：我不得不说——为什么在这些实验室工作的人会如此深感担忧？——本书中有一些非常好的例子来说明为什么其中一个人会真正感到担忧。我不得不说，仅就我个人而言，如果我在公司静修会上，我的首席执行官穿着白袍，在我和我的朋友面前烧毁了恶魔的雕像，我会感到担忧。这会让我担心我们真正的目标是什么，这也是你在书中报告的内容。

paras.en: Roose: So Ilya Sutskever was the former chief scientist of OpenAI and one of the co-founders. It was his effigy burning ’cause he was sort of looking for a way— there’s this concept in AI of feeling the AGI. This was a big concept for Ilya; he used to pace the halls of OpenAI’s headquarters telling people to feel the AGI. And what he meant by that was essentially, like, “You can’t forget the stakes of what we are doing here.” Like, “This is the Manhattan Project. You are not working at a normal company that is making normal software.”
paras.zh: Roose：Ilya Sutskever 是 OpenAI 的前首席科学家，也是联合创始人之一。这是他的肖像燃烧，因为他在寻找一种方法——人工智能中有一个感受通用人工智能的概念。这对 Ilya 来说是一个很大的概念。他曾经在 OpenAI 总部的大厅里踱步，告诉人们感受 AGI。他的意思本质上是，“你不能忘记我们在这里所做的事情的风险。”就像，“这是曼哈顿计划。你不是在一家生产普通软件的普通公司工作。”

paras.en: And so he felt like, at a certain point—and this was back in 2022 when, like, there was no, sort of, mass movement of people who were freaked out about AI yet—he was trying to remind his colleagues of the stakes of their collective enterprise. And so he comes up with this ritual that he thinks is gonna, sort of, jolt people into feeling the AGI, and it involves this off-site. They’re outside of Yosemite National Park. He brings this, like, wooden statue of a demon, he plays the Requiem for a Dream theme song over a speaker, and all of his colleagues are, sort of, gathered around this bonfire, and they dress up in their white robes from the hotel—and it’s a little hokey and over the top. And the demon was supposed to symbolize the misaligned AGI, so the AGI that does not do what the human creators intend it to do.
paras.zh: 因此，他觉得，在某个时刻——那是在 2022 年，当时还没有出现对人工智能感到恐惧的大规模运动——他试图提醒他的同事们，他们集体事业的利害关系。所以他想出了这个仪式，他认为这个仪式会有点让人们感受到 AGI，它涉及到场外。他们位于优胜美地国家公园外。他带来了这个，就像一个恶魔的木制雕像，他通过扬声器播放《梦之安魂曲》主题曲，他所有的同事都聚集在篝火周围，他们穿着酒店的白色长袍——这有点做作，有点夸张。恶魔应该象征着错位的通用人工智能，因此通用人工智能不会做人类创造者想要做的事情。

paras.en: Roose: The evil AI. And so by burning this, sort of, as an effigy, he was sort of trying to signal to his colleagues like, “It is your job to prevent this demon, this misaligned AGI, from coming into the world.” And look, it’s a weird scene. I don’t think a lot of corporate off-sites have effigy burnings as part of their evening activities.
paras.zh: 罗斯：邪恶的人工智能。因此，通过焚烧这个雕像，他试图向他的同事们发出这样的信号：“你们的工作就是阻止这个恶魔，这个错位的 AGI，进入这个世界。”你看，这是一个奇怪的场景。我不认为很多公司会场外都会将焚烧雕像作为晚间活动的一部分。

paras.en: Roose: But it was very important for him to impress upon his co-workers this idea that they were not just building tools, they were not just building technology, they were building a, kind of, new life-form that he believed would have enormous destructive potential if it wasn’t safe.
paras.zh: 罗斯：但对他来说，让他的同事们记住这样一个想法非常重要：他们不仅仅是在建造工具，他们不仅仅是在建造技术，他们正在建造一种新的生命形式，他认为如果不安全，这种生命形式将具有巨大的破坏潜力。

paras.en: So they still do some version of this at OpenAI today. They have, like, a Feel the AGI Day, where they try to, like, give everyone time to, like, do these [sorts] of exercises. I don’t think they burn effigies anymore; I think that was, sort of, a limited-time offer. But they do try to really get people inside the company to feel the stakes of what they are doing.
paras.zh: 所以他们今天仍然在 OpenAI 上做一些这样的事情。他们有一个“感受 AGI 日”，他们尝试给每个人时间来做这些[种类]练习。我认为他们不再焚烧肖像了；我认为这有点像限时优惠。但他们确实试图让公司内部的人真正感受到他们所做的事情的风险。

paras.en: Kane: Yeah, I mean, these central figures that you talk about in the book that are leading the AI companies that are really on the forefront of this technology, they are building things that we have never seen before. Their programs are doing things that we did not think was possible 10 years ago, as you explained. Like, things that were really fringe, really weird to admit that you believed in San Francisco 10 years ago are now not only mainstream; they’re passé. We already did that three years ago with ChatGPT, and now we’re on to the next thing.
paras.zh: 凯恩：是的，我的意思是，你在书中谈到的这些核心人物正在领导真正处于这项技术最前沿的人工智能公司，他们正在构建我们以前从未见过的东西。正如您所解释的，他们的程序正在做我们 10 年前认为不可能的事情。就像，那些非常边缘、非常奇怪的事情，承认你十年前相信旧金山，现在不仅成为主流；而且还成为了主流。他们已经过时了。三年前我们已经通过 ChatGPT 做到了这一点，现在我们正在着手下一件事。

paras.en: But then you also—these exact same people are writing Harry Potter fan fiction that’s longer than War and Peace about the super AI coming, and they’re doing headstands in the corner muttering about feeling the AGI. I mean, it’s a really wacky kind of juxtaposition between, like, “Should I really take this person seriously?” and, if I do, what they’re talking about is very serious. So how do you, kind of, approach that in your reporting?
paras.zh: 但你也——这些完全相同的人正在写比《战争与和平》还要长的《哈利·波特》同人小说，讲述超级人工智能的到来，他们在角落里倒立，嘀咕着感受通用人工智能。我的意思是，这是一种非常古怪的并置，就像“我真的应该认真对待这个人吗？”如果我这样做了，他们谈论的事情就非常严肃了。那么，您在报告中如何处理这一问题呢？

paras.en: Roose: I think a lot of people are turned off by the, sort of, AI doomers or the people who feel the AGI because they can be quite weird. The examples you just mentioned are real. There actually is a researcher, Eliezer Yudkowsky, who wrote a very long Harry Potter fan fiction to, sort of, get across his message.
paras.zh: 罗斯：我认为很多人都对人工智能的厄运或感觉通用人工智能的人感到厌烦，因为它们可能很奇怪。你刚才提到的例子都是真实的。实际上有一位研究员，埃利泽·尤德科斯基（Eliezer Yudkowsky），他写了一篇很长的哈利·波特同人小说，以某种方式传达他的信息。

paras.en: The thing is, like, you had to be kind of weird to take the possibility of AGI seriously in 2016 or 2017 because nothing like modern AI existed then. Like, the systems of the day were very dumb, very narrow. They couldn’t do anything, really, be of value beyond, you know, one or two narrow tasks. And so the people who got interested in it were people who were, sort of, by definition, unorthodox, and they were ridiculed. They would get laughed at at academic conferences. Their papers would get rejected by the leading AI, sort of, conferences of the year. It was like, almost like, admitting that you believed in astrology as like a, you know, a Ph.D. in science. Like, it was that fringe.
paras.zh: 问题是，在 2016 年或 2017 年，你必须有点奇怪才能认真对待 AGI 的可能性，因为当时还不存在像现代人工智能这样的东西。就像，当时的系统非常愚蠢、非常狭窄。事实上，除了一两个狭隘的任务之外，他们什么也做不了。因此，对它感兴趣的人从定义上来说是非正统的，他们受到了嘲笑。他们会在学术会议上被嘲笑。他们的论文将被年度领先的人工智能会议拒绝。这就像，几乎就像，承认你相信占星学，就像一个，你知道的，博士学位一样。在科学中。就像，就是那个边缘。

paras.en: And yet they were correct, many of them. They made these bets on LLMs [large language models], on scaling. They had this conviction that you could build AGI, that you could build a, kind of, digital brain that would become as smart and flexible as the human brain, and they were correct. Like, we now have the systems that would satisfy all of the original definitions of AGI and then some.
paras.zh: 然而他们中的许多人都是正确的。他们把赌注押在法学硕士（大型语言模型）上，押注于扩展。他们坚信你可以构建通用人工智能，你可以构建一个像人脑一样智能和灵活的数字大脑，他们是正确的。就像，我们现在拥有的系统可以满足 AGI 的所有原始定义，甚至还可以满足一些。
