paras.en: ROTERMUND-REYNARD: Cultural looting was very much organized since the beginning. The Nazis knew the huge Jewish collections, and they started from June on to go to the families' places, to the apartments, and to take the work.
paras.zh: ROTERMUND-REYNARD：文化掠夺从一开始就是有组织的。纳粹知道犹太人的藏品数量巨大，他们从六月起就开始前往这些家庭的住所、公寓，并接受这项工作。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Some 100,000 artworks were spoliated during the Nazi occupation. Spoliated is a term used by the art world to refer to the pillaging, confiscation or sale under duress of a work of art. Many of the works were destined for a museum Hitler planned for his hometown in Linz, Austria. After Germany's defeat, there was a massive art recovery effort.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：纳粹占领期间约有 100,000 件艺术品被破坏。掠夺是艺术界使用的一个术语，指在胁迫下掠夺、没收或出售艺术品。许多作品都被运往希特勒为其家乡奥地利林茨规划的一座博物馆。德国战败后，进行了大规模的艺术恢复工作。

paras.en: (SOUNDBITE OF FILM, "THE MONUMENTS MEN")
paras.zh: （电影原声片段，“纪念碑人”）

paras.en: GEORGE CLOONEY: (As Frank Stokes) The Nazis have been stealing art out of Warsaw, Amsterdam, Paris. We've all been selected because we're going to need your knowledge.
paras.zh: 乔治·克鲁尼：（饰演弗兰克·斯托克斯）纳粹一直在从华沙、阿姆斯特丹、巴黎窃取艺术品。我们都被选中是因为我们需要您的知识。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: The film "Monuments Men," starring George Clooney and Matt Damon, shows how American forces led efforts to bring works back from Austria and Germany. Much of that recovery was made possible due to extensive documentation of the theft during the Nazi occupation by Rose Valland, a bespectacled middle-aged volunteer at the Jeu de Paume museum in Paris that served as a clearinghouse for the looted art. The Nazi officials who came and went didn't notice her, says Rotermund-Reynard, and unbeknownst to them, Valland spoke German.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：乔治·克鲁尼和马特·达蒙主演的电影《纪念碑人》展示了美国军队如何带头从奥地利和德国带回艺术品。大部分追回工作之所以能够实现，是因为罗斯·瓦兰（Rose Valland）对纳粹占领期间的盗窃案进行​​了广泛的记录，她是巴黎Jeu de Paume博物馆的一名戴眼镜的中年志愿者，该博物馆是被掠夺艺术品的交换所。罗特蒙德-雷纳德说，来来往往的纳粹官员没有注意到她，而且他们不知道的是，瓦兰会说德语。

paras.en: ROTERMUND-REYNARD: And thanks to her notes, like secret notes, a lot of these artworks have been recovered after the war.
paras.zh: ROTERMUND-REYNARD：多亏了她的笔记，就像秘密笔记一样，战后很多艺术品都被找回了。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Sixty thousand paintings and other art objects were brought back to France and 45,000 returned to their owners or surviving family members. But in 1950, the restitution work stopped as the world moved on. In the late '90s, interest in Nazi-era stolen art resurged, and there was a renewed effort to return paintings to their rightful owners. At a conference in Washington, D.C., in 1998, 44 countries agreed to investigate works with gaps in ownership between 1933 and 1945. David Zivie is head of the French government's renewed mission to return looted cultural property. He says the new exhibit room at the Musée d'Orsay is part of a push to reopen files and explore archives with a fresh eye.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：六万幅画作和其他艺术品被带回法国，其中 45,000 幅归还给它们的主人或幸存的家庭成员。但到了 1950 年，随着世界的发展，归还工作停止了。 20 世纪 90 年代末，人们对纳粹时代被盗艺术品的兴趣重新兴起，人们重新努力将画作归还给其合法所有者。 1998 年在华盛顿特区举行的一次会议上，44 个国家同意调查 1933 年至 1945 年间存在所有权差距的作品。大卫·齐维 (David Zivie) 是法国政府归还被掠夺文化财产新使命的负责人。他说，奥赛博物馆的新展览室是重新开放文件并以新的眼光探索档案的努力的一部分。

paras.en: DAVID ZIVIE: Yes, of course, it's late, and each year it's later, but a lot of work is now being made today - not only today, but in the last 20, 25 years. The room is really for also to explain, to show the work, and we are doing more and more restitution, even 80 years after the war.
paras.zh: DAVID ZIVIE：是的，当然，现在已经晚了，而且每年都晚了，但是今天正在做很多工作 - 不仅是今天，而且是在过去 20 年、25 年中。这个房间实际上也是为了解释、展示作品，我们正在做越来越多的恢复工作，即使在战后 80 年后也是如此。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: French museums are in temporary custody of some 2,000 likely Nazi-looted artworks. The works have a special status and are being held until their legal owners are found. It's complicated work, but there's been key progress in recent years, says Rotermund-Reynard. Formerly sealed wartime archives have been opened and others digitized.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：法国博物馆暂时保管着大约 2,000 件可能被纳粹掠夺的艺术品。这些作品具有特殊地位，在找到其合法所有者之前将被保留。罗特蒙德-雷纳德说，这是一项复杂的工作，但近年来取得了重大进展。以前密封的战时档案已被打开，其他档案已数字化。

paras.en: ROTERMUND-REYNARD: When I started to work on this subject, like, 20 years ago, it was still difficult, but today, you really have the information.
paras.zh: ROTERMUND-REYNARD：20 年前，当我开始研究这个主题时，这仍然很困难，但今天，你确实掌握了信息。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: She says the key is finding the last owner of a painting before the war. Looted paintings were often sold and resold at auctions, further obscuring their original ownership. I talked to longtime Paris art dealer Neal Fiertag in a crowded restaurant. He says gone are the days when you could buy or sell a piece of art without knowing its exact provenance during the war. He says institutions have been cracking down, especially in the last decade.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：她说关键是找到战前一幅画的最后一位主人。被掠夺的画作经常在拍卖会上出售和转售，进一步掩盖了它们的原始所有权。我在一家拥挤的餐厅里与长期担任巴黎艺术品经销商的尼尔·菲尔塔格进行了交谈。他说，战争期间你可以在不知道艺术品确切出处的情况下买卖一件艺术品的日子已经一去不复返了。他说，各机构一直在严厉打击，特别是在过去十年。

paras.en: NEAL FIERTAG: A friend and I were going to buy something at an auction in London, Italian drawing of the 16th century, but there was a gap. There was a gap from the 1930s to the early '50s. So we just said, no, we're not going to do it because we don't need the heartache of trying to prove where this work was during the war.
paras.zh: NEAL FIERTAG：我和一个朋友打算在伦敦的一次拍卖会上购买一些 16 世纪意大利绘画的东西，但有一个空白。从 20 世纪 30 年代到 50 年代初存在着一段差距。所以我们只是说，不，我们不会这样做，因为我们不需要试图证明这项工作在战争期间的位置而心痛。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: France has returned 16 paintings to families in the last 30 years, but things are speeding up, says writer Pauline de Perignon, who got back a painting that belonged to her great-grandfather.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：作家波琳·德·佩里尼翁 (Pauline de Perignon) 归还了曾祖父的一幅画作，她说，在过去 30 年里，法国已经向家庭归还了 16 幅画作，但事情正在加速。

paras.en: PAULINE DE PERIGNON: They really listened to my claim, and they helped me.
paras.zh: PAULINE DE PERIGNON：他们确实听取了我的主张，并且帮助了我。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: She now helps other families with their claims to recover lost artworks. She says the painting restitution ceremony where the French Minister of culture paid tribute to her great-grandfather was moving and healing.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：她现在帮助其他家庭追回丢失的艺术品。她说，法国文化部长向她曾祖父致敬的画作归还仪式令人感动和治愈。

paras.en: DE PERIGNON: Because all my family was there, you know, they were, like, 90-years-old uncles that never gathered together. So the family was united for this special occasion, listening to the story of their grandfather who they all loved and knew. It's very (speaking French) - positive for the family.
paras.zh: DE PERIGNON：因为我所有的家人都在那里，你知道，他们就像 90 岁的叔叔一样，从不聚在一起。因此，一家人在这个特殊的时刻团结在一起，聆听他们所爱和认识的祖父的故事。这对这个家庭来说非常（法语）积极。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED NARRATOR: (Speaking French).
paras.zh: 身份不明的旁白：（说法语）。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Back in the special exhibit room at the Orsay Museum, a video with English subtitles shows the dramatic history of the looted art. The Orsay's 225 works of unknown provenance will be rotated through here. Each has a QR code giving its history. The painting titled "A Brother And Sister Looking Out Over A Beach In Normandy" by Alfred Stevens was sold twice at a Paris auction - in 1939 and again in 1942, when it was acquired for Hitler. The painting's original owner has never been found. Eleanor Beardsley, NPR News, Paris.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：回到奥赛博物馆的特别展览室，一段带有英文字幕的视频展示了被掠夺艺术品的戏剧性历史。奥赛的225部来历不明的作品将在这里轮流展示。每个都有一个二维码，显示其历史。阿尔弗雷德·史蒂文斯 (Alfred Stevens) 创作的这幅题为《眺望诺曼底海滩的兄妹》的画作在巴黎拍卖会上两次售出，一次是 1939 年，另一次是 1942 年，当时它被希特勒收购。这幅画的原主人至今仍未找到。埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley)，NPR 新闻，巴黎。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: The world's largest telecoms firm is on trial and the outcome has global implications
articles.author: Michael Levitt

paras.en: The world's largest telecoms firm is on trial and the outcome has global implications
paras.zh: 全球最大的电信公司正在接受审判，结果具有全球影响

paras.en: Huawei, the world's biggest telecommunications company, is on trial in New York, accused of stealing American technology and evading US sanctions.
paras.zh: 全球最大的电信公司华为正在纽约受审，被指控窃取美国技术并逃避美国制裁。

paras.en: In a federal courtroom in Brooklyn, the world's biggest telecommunications company is on trial. Huawei is a Chinese firm that makes smartphones, laptops, routers and all sorts of telecoms equipment that's available all over the world. The U.S. has long alleged that Huawei products pose a security risk and have banned them from being sold in the United States. And according to the U.S. government, Huawei is also a criminal enterprise. U.S. prosecutors allege that Huawei built its telecoms empire by stealing from American companies and violated U.S. sanctions by doing business in Iran and North Korea. In 2018, this all came to a head.
paras.zh: 在布鲁克林的联邦法庭，世界上最大的电信公司正在接受审判。华为是一家中国公司，生产智能手机、笔记本电脑、路由器和各种电信设备，产品销往世界各地。美国长期以来一直声称华为产品存在安全风险，并禁止其在美国销售。而且根据美国政府的说法，华为也是一家犯罪企业。美国检察官指控华为通过窃取美国公司的资金建立了自己的电信帝国，并通过在伊朗和朝鲜开展业务违反了美国的制裁。 2018年，这一切都达到了紧要关头。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED REPORTER: Canadian authorities have arrested the chief financial officer of the Chinese telecommunications giant Huawei.
paras.zh: 身份不明的记者：加拿大当局逮捕了中国电信巨头华为的首席财务官。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: In what is widely seen as an act of retaliation, China arrested two Canadians living in China, detaining them for nearly three years.
paras.zh: 施密茨：中国逮捕了两名居住在中国的加拿大人，并将他们关押了近三年，这被广泛视为报复行为。

paras.en: SCOTT SIMON, BYLINE: Late last night, China released two Canadian businessmen who had been imprisoned in China for more than a thousand days.
paras.zh: 斯科特·西蒙连线：昨晚，中国释放了两名在中国被监禁一千多天的加拿大商人。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: The U.S. agreed to a plea deal that freed Meng and released the two Canadians. One of them, Michael Kovrig, joins us now. Welcome.
paras.zh: 施密茨：美国同意达成认罪协议，释放了孟晚舟并释放了两名加拿大人。其中一位迈克尔·康明凯 (Michael Kovrig) 现在加入我们。欢迎。

paras.en: MICHAEL KOVRIG: Hi, Rob. Good to be with you.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·科夫里格：嗨，罗布。很高兴和你在一起。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So before we begin, I think it's worth doing a thorough introduction, so our audience understands exactly who you are and why we are talking to you. In 2018, you were living in China, working as an analyst for the nonprofit International Crisis Group. Then in December of that year, Chinese police arrested you on suspicion of espionage. You were held for nearly three years. It's been around five years since you were released. Why do you think the Chinese targeted you?
paras.zh: 施密茨：所以在我们开始之前，我认为有必要做一个彻底的介绍，以便我们的观众准确地了解您是谁以及我们为什么要与您交谈。 2018 年，您住在中国，担任非营利组织国际危机组织的分析师。同年12月，中国警方以涉嫌间谍罪逮捕了您。你被关押了将近三年。距离你被释放已经五年了。你认为中国人为什么针对你？

paras.en: KOVRIG: It's a two-part question, Rob. The first is, why did they grab Canadians, and then why did they pick me specifically? So the Chinese Communist Party directed the Beijing State Security Bureau to abduct Canadians because they wanted to blackmail the Canadian government into releasing Meng Wanzhou. It was hostage diplomacy, that simple.
paras.zh: 柯里格：这是一个由两部分组成的问题，罗布。第一个是，他们为什么抓加拿大人，然后为什么他们专门选择我？所以中共指示北京国安局绑架加拿大人，是为了勒索加拿大政府释放孟晚舟。这就是人质外交，就这么简单。

paras.en: As to why they picked me, I think they probably chose me because my work dealt with foreign policy and national security issues. Everything I did was transparent and open. I was well-known to the Chinese system, but it was easier for them to trump up charges than, say, if they grabbed a random shoe salesman.
paras.zh: 至于他们为什么选择我，我想他们可能选择我是因为我的工作涉及外交政策和国家安全问题。我所做的一切都是透明和公开的。我在中国系统中很出名，但对他们来说，捏造指控比抓一个随机的鞋推销员更容易。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So they apprehend you. They throw you in prison. Tell me about what happened to you while you were in prison in China.
paras.zh: 施密茨：所以他们逮捕了你。他们把你扔进监狱。告诉我你在中国监狱期间发生了什么事。

paras.en: KOVRIG: First of all, they arbitrarily detained me and put me in what's called residential surveillance in a designated location, which is essentially a secret detention facility, where they held me in a padded cell for about 145 days, mostly in solitary confinement, with relentless coercive interrogation in which they tried to gaslight me into confessing to crimes that I didn't commit.
paras.zh: 柯夫里格：首先，他们任意拘留我，将我置于指定地点所谓的监视居住，这本质上是一个秘密拘留所，他们把我关在一个有软垫的牢房里大约145天，大部分时间是单独监禁，并进行无情的强制审讯，他们试图用煤气灯逼迫我承认我没有犯下的罪行。

paras.en: And then I spent the following two years in the State Security Bureau's detention center. So during that time, I never left the cell that I was in except for consular meetings or to occasionally visit a lawyer. So for those who went through the COVID time and felt that they were a bit confined at home, I spent that entire period without being able to leave a single cell.
paras.zh: 然后我在国家安全局看守所里度过了两年。所以那段时间除了领事会见或者偶尔去见律师之外，我从来没有离开过自己所在的牢房。因此，对于那些经历了新冠病毒时期并感到自己被限制在家里的人来说，我在整个时期都无法离开一个牢房。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: Wow. And now you are closely following the U.S. case against Huawei in New York. What are the details of the prosecutor's case against Huawei?
paras.zh: 施密茨：哇。现在你们正在密切关注美国在纽约针对华为的案件。检察官针对华为的案件细节是什么？

paras.en: KOVRIG: So I should note - I've been following this case since before I was detained. In fact, a few days before they abducted me, I gave a television interview explaining why Meng Wanzhou had been arrested. So, for me, this is coming full circle now...
paras.zh: 柯夫里格：所以我应该指出 - 从我被拘留之前我就一直在关注这个案件。事实上，在他们绑架我的前几天，我接受了电视采访，解释了孟晚舟被捕的原因。所以，对我来说，这一切现在又回到了原点......

paras.en: KOVRIG: ...Right? The trial is about crimes, not about spying, right? The jury's going to determine whether Huawei broke American laws on fraud, theft and sanctions violations, and that's worth knowing for itself. The hostage-taking didn't work. Beijing held us in an effort to free Meng Wanzhou. Her signed admissions have now been read to a Brooklyn jury.
paras.zh: 柯夫里格：……对吧？审判是关于犯罪，而不是关于间谍活动，对吗？陪审团将确定华为是否违反了美国有关欺诈、盗窃和违反制裁的法律，这一点本身就值得了解。劫持人质没有成功。北京扣押我们是为了释放孟晚舟。她签署的认罪书现已向布鲁克林陪审团宣读。

paras.en: The broader implication of the trial will be whether Huawei can be trusted as a provider of critical telecom infrastructure equipment, right? For governments, whether or not to allow Huawei gear in 5G networks or to rip and replace existing equipment is a risk assessment. And the trial has bearing on whether Huawei's word can be relied on that its equipment is risky or not.
paras.zh: 此次试验的更广泛影响将是华为作为关键电信基础设施供应商是否值得信赖，对吗？对于政府来说，是否允许华为设备进入5G网络或拆除和更换现有设备是一项风险评估。此次审判关系到华为关于其设备存在风险的说法是否可靠。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: So of course, Huawei dismisses the accusations against the company, saying that prosecutors are focusing on a smattering of isolated cases of bad behavior of a few people and that this is not proof of a company-wide conspiracy to steal technology or evade sanctions. For its part, the Chinese government is calling this trial an example of U.S. economic bullying of a Chinese company. What do you say to the criticism that Huawei will not get a fair trial inside the United States, where the company's supporters say the company has been demonized and treated unfairly?
paras.zh: 施密茨：当然，华为驳回了针对该公司的指控，称检察官正在关注少数人不良行为的个别案件，这并不是全公司范围内串谋窃取技术或逃避制裁的证据。就中国政府而言，此次审判是美国对中国企业进行经济欺凌的一个例子。对于华为在美国得不到公平审判的批评，该公司的支持者称该公司在美国受到妖魔化和不公平对待，你对此有何看法？

paras.en: KOVRIG: This trial is being run by a judge in the Eastern District Court of New York, and it's going to be decided by a jury of 12 American citizens. That's not something that can be politicized in the same way as a decision by a government official, right? And the issue is that, you know, whether or not Huawei committed crimes - right? - lying to banks about its business in Iran, evading U.S. sanctions and stealing technology from American companies, right? Prosecutors are calling it a racketeering enterprise and trying to show that it's a 20-year pattern, not a bunch of one-off mistakes. The point we're at now, the jury's heard from 61 prosecution witnesses, and now Huawei is starting to present its defense. So we'll be getting to hear what the company has to say about that.
paras.zh: 柯弗里格：这次审判由纽约东区法院的一名法官主持，并将由 12 名美国公民组成的陪审团做出裁决。这不能像政府官员的决定一样被政治化，对吗？问题是，你知道，华为是否犯了罪——对吧？ -就其在伊朗的业务向银行撒谎，逃避美国制裁并窃取美国公司的技术，对吗？检察官称其为敲诈勒索企业，并试图表明这是一个 20 年的模式，而不是一堆一次性错误。现在，陪审团已经听取了 61 名控方证人的证词，现在华为开始进行辩护。因此，我们将听到该公司对此有何评论。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: We're talking about the world's largest telecommunications company. You see its equipment everywhere in the developing world, whether it's routers, cellphones, you name it. What are the implications of this trial on Huawei and how it does business?
paras.zh: 施密茨：我们谈论的是世界上最大的电信公司。你在发展中国家随处可见它的设备，无论是路由器、手机，凡是你能想到的。这次试验对华为及其经营方式有何影响？

paras.en: KOVRIG: One, I think, is accountability, right? Prosecutors say Huawei deceived banks in moving money through the financial system and took technology from American companies. Those are crimes with victims, whatever Huawei sells. And so a trial does something that intelligence briefings and investigative journalism can't do. It puts evidence on the public record, tested by Huawei's own lawyers, decided by a jury of citizens for every bank and government to see.
paras.zh: 柯夫里格：我认为其中之一就是问责制，对吧？检察官称，华为在通过金融系统转移资金时欺骗了银行，并从美国公司窃取了技术。无论华为销售什么产品，这些都是针对受害者的犯罪行为。因此，审判可以做到情报简报和调查性新闻无法做到的事情。它将证据放在公共记录中，由华为自己的律师进行测试，并由公民组成的陪审团做出决定，供每家银行和政府查看。

paras.en: And so that ultimately has implications for every government that is deciding whether or not to use Huawei equipment, whether or not a government can take Huawei's word when Huawei says, our equipment is safe - or at least it's no riskier than any of its competitors' equipment - and that it won't allow the Chinese government to use its networks for espionage or to degrade networks or otherwise threaten critical telecommunications infrastructure. If the decision of this trial shows that you cannot take Huawei's word about that, that has implications for that risk calculation of every country that's considering whether to keep any Huawei equipment they have or get more or to rip and replace it.
paras.zh: 因此，这最终会对每个决定是否使用华为设备的政府产生影响，当华为表示我们的设备是安全的，或者至少不比任何竞争对手的设备风险更高，并且不会允许中国政府使用其网络进行间谍活动或降低网络性能或以其他方式威胁关键电信基础设施时，政府是否可以相信华为的话。如果这次审判的决定表明你不能相信华为的说法，那么这将对每个正在考虑是否保留或购买更多华为设备或拆除并更换其现有华为设备的国家的风险计算产生影响。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: That is Michael Kovrig. He's CEO of the geopolitical research firm, Kovrig Group, and is a former Canadian diplomat who served in China and the United Nations. Thank you.
paras.zh: 施密茨：那是迈克尔·科夫里格。他是地缘政治研究公司康明凯集团的首席执行官，也是曾在中国和联合国任职的加拿大前外交官。谢谢。

paras.en: KOVRIG: Thank you, Rob. It's a pleasure speaking with you.
paras.zh: 柯夫里格：谢谢你，罗布。很高兴与你交谈。

paras.en: SCHMITZ: In a previous statement, a spokesperson for the Chinese government maintained that its arrest of Michael Kovrig was in accordance with Chinese law, saying, quote, "there is no arbitrary detention at all." NPR also reached out to representatives for Huawei. They have not yet provided a response to our request for comment.
paras.zh: 施密茨：中国政府发言人在此前的一份声明中坚称，对康明凯的逮捕符合中国法律，并称“根本不存在任意拘留”。 NPR 还联系了华为的代表。他们尚未对我们的置评请求做出回应。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: How a bank collapse left millions in limbo and toppled Paraguay's president
articles.author: Charles Parkinson

paras.en: How a bank collapse left millions in limbo and toppled Paraguay's president
paras.zh: 银行倒闭如何让数百万人陷入困境并推翻巴拉圭总统

paras.en: ASUNCIÓN, Paraguay — When Ueno Bank's services abruptly stopped working in the early hours of Tuesday morning, the consequences were immediate for the millions of Paraguayans who had come to depend on it for everyday transactions.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭亚松森——当上野银行的服务在周二凌晨突然停止工作时，对数以百万计依赖该银行进行日常交易的巴拉圭人来说，后果是立竿见影的。

paras.en: "People don't have any trust," said Elizabeth González, a 28-year-old barista at a café in downtown Asunción, a few blocks from Paraguay's Congress building, where protesters had begun gathering after the bank's collapse was announced Tuesday.
paras.zh: “人们没有任何信任，”亚松森市中心一家咖啡馆的 28 岁咖啡师伊丽莎白·冈萨雷斯 (Elizabeth González) 说，该咖啡馆距离巴拉圭国会大厦只有几个街区。周二银行宣布倒闭后，抗议者开始聚集在那里。

paras.en: Earlier, one customer had walked into the café and insisted on paying in cash. He no longer trusted any bank.
paras.zh: 早些时候，一名顾客走进咖啡馆并坚持用现金付款。他不再信任任何银行。

paras.en: "If Paraguayans themselves aren't confident right now, foreign investors will be less so," González said.
paras.zh: 冈萨雷斯说：“如果巴拉圭人自己现在没有信心，那么外国投资者的信心也会减弱。”

paras.en: The collapse affected far more than the bank's shareholders. Ueno said it had 2.9 million customers — around 60% of Paraguay's adult population. The Central Bank said the bank had approximately 1.8 million depositors.
paras.zh: 此次倒闭所影响的远不止银行股东。 Ueno 表示，该公司拥有 290 万顾客——约占巴拉圭成年人口的 60%。央行表示，该银行约有 180 万储户。

paras.en: By Saturday, authorities said almost 1.2 million customers had received an advance payment under the state's deposit guarantee fund, but many were still waiting.
paras.zh: 截至周六，当局表示，近 120 万客户已收到州存款担保基金下的预付款，但许多人仍在等待。

paras.en: It also led to the impeachment and removal of President Santiago Peña, a close ally of President Donald Trump, and exposed a power struggle inside within the ruling Colorado Party.
paras.zh: 它还导致唐纳德·特朗普总统的亲密盟友圣地亚哥·佩纳总统被弹劾和罢免，并暴露了执政的科罗拉多党内部的权力斗争。

paras.en: The anger was palpable outside Congress on Friday, where hundreds had gathered to protest not only their inability to access their money but also what they saw as a broader failure of accountability.
paras.zh: 周五，国会外的愤怒情绪显而易见，数百人聚集在一起抗议，不仅抗议他们无法获得资金，还抗议他们认为更广泛的问责失败。

paras.en: "I came not because it affects me personally, but because it affects all of Paraguay," said Elodia Saveredo, a 71-year-old housewife who sells her own handicrafts online.
paras.zh: “我来不是因为它影响我个人，而是因为它影响整个巴拉圭，”71 岁的家庭主妇埃洛迪亚·萨维雷多 (Elodia Saveredo) 说，她在网上出售自己的手工艺品。

paras.en: Batarram Caballero, a 23-year-old fifth-year biochemistry student and president of the student center at the National University of Asunción, said classmates had money frozen that they needed to cover basic expenses.
paras.zh: 23 岁的生物化学五年级学生、亚松森国立大学学生中心主席巴塔拉姆·卡瓦列罗 (Batarram Caballero) 表示，同学们的钱被冻结，无法支付基本开支。

paras.en: "It wasn't a lot of money, perhaps, but it was money for their bus fare. It was money for their food," she said. "To hear that and not be able to do anything because I don't have the resources to help them is very discouraging."
paras.zh: “也许钱不是很多，但这是他们的公交车费。这是他们的食物钱，”她说。 “听到这个消息却因为没有资源来帮助他们而无法采取任何行动，这非常令人沮丧。”

paras.en: Ueno Bank launched as a fintech in 2021 and began operating as a bank in November 2023. Its meteoric rise to become one of the country's most important financial institutions was driven by slick marketing and a digital model based around convenience and cashback deals; customers could open accounts on their phones and were offered incentives to process payments through the platform.
paras.zh: 上野银行于 2021 年作为一家金融科技公司成立，并于 2023 年 11 月开始作为银行运营。其迅速崛起成为该国最重要的金融机构之一，得益于巧妙的营销以及基于便利和现金返还交易的数字模式；客户可以在手机上开设账户，并获得通过该平台处理付款的奖励。

paras.en: Caballero believes the crisis was foretold by an intense campaign in the days before accounts were frozen.
paras.zh: 卡瓦列罗认为，账户被冻结前几天的激烈活动就预示了这场危机。

paras.en: "They were bombarding us with messages telling us to put our money there," she said. "There were also rumors about what was already on the cards."
paras.zh: “他们用信息轰炸我们，告诉我们把钱放在那里，”她说。 “也有关于已经发生的事情的传言。”

paras.en: The bank also held substantial public funds. The Social Security Institute, known as IPS, had around $355 million invested in Ueno, roughly 9% of its portfolio.
paras.zh: 该银行还持有大量公共资金。社会保障研究所 (IPS) 在上野投资了约 3.55 亿美元，约占其投资组合的 9%。

paras.en: The sums involved have raised questions about how such a young bank came to hold so much public money.
paras.zh: 所涉及的金额引发了人们的疑问：这样一家年轻的银行如何持有如此多的公共资金。

paras.en: Manuel Ferreira, an economist and former finance minister, told local outlet ABC Color that the collapse raised fundamental questions about how the bank managed its assets. He pointed out that, in a typical bank, shareholders provide only a small portion of the money behind its assets, while the bulk comes from customer deposits.
paras.zh: 经济学家、前财政部长曼努埃尔·费雷拉 (Manuel Ferreira) 向当地媒体 ABC Color 表示，这次倒闭引发了关于该银行如何管理其资产的根本性问题。他指出，在典型的银行中，股东只提供资产背后的一小部分资金，而大部分来自客户存款。

paras.en: He also argued that marketing and discounts helped attract customers but did not create lasting assets. A bank's principal asset, he said, was its loan portfolio: money owed by borrowers.
paras.zh: 他还认为，营销和折扣有助于吸引顾客，但并不能创造持久的资产。他说，银行的主要资产是其贷款组合：借款人所欠的钱。

paras.en: But in the case of Ueno, many of those loans had gone to companies directly linked to the bank's controlling owners, Grupo Vásquez, including $146 million in loans made to just three companies. He described Ueno's promissory notes as being signed by the same people on both sides of some transactions.
paras.zh: 但就 Ueno 而言，其中许多贷款都流向了与该银行控股股东 Grupo Vásquez 直接相关的公司，其中仅向 3 家公司发放了 1.46 亿美元的贷款。他称上野的期票是由某些交易双方的同一个人签署的。

paras.en: The scandal hit Peña particularly hard because of his personal links to the bank's holding company, in which he held shares even after taking up the presidency. He also appointed Carlos Carvallo, who had led Ueno Bank, to head Paraguay's Central Bank in 2023.
paras.zh: 该丑闻对佩纳的打击尤其严重，因为他与该银行控股公司有个人联系，甚至在担任行长后仍持有该公司的股份。他还任命曾领导上野银行的卡洛斯·卡瓦洛 (Carlos Carvallo) 于 2023 年担任巴拉圭央行行长。

paras.en: In his asset declaration submitted weeks after taking up the presidency in 2023, Peña listed shares in Ueno Holding, then valued at around $845,000. Those shares represented around 1.6% of the company's paid-up capital when he later sold them in March 2025.
paras.zh: 佩纳在 2023 年就任总统几周后提交的资产申报中，列出了 Ueno Holding 的股票，当时估值约为 845,000 美元。当他后来于 2025 年 3 月出售这些股票时，这些股票约占公司实收资本的 1.6%。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege that, while president, he used his position to influence public agencies and state-owned entities to maintain deposits with the bank despite his connections to its parent group.
paras.zh: 检察官称，尽管他与银行母公司有联系，但在担任行长期间，他利用职务之便影响公共机构和国有实体在银行保留存款。

paras.en: Peña resigned Thursday and was impeached and removed from office Friday. The following day, prosecutors charged him with breach of trust and administration for personal gain. He was ordered held in pretrial detention at a military facility pending the investigation. Peña has pleaded not guilty. Pedro Alliana, the country's vice president, has been sworn in as president to serve out the rest of Peña's term until August 2028.
paras.zh: 佩纳周四辞职，周五被弹劾并免职。第二天，检察官指控他违反信任和谋取个人利益。他被下令在军事设施中进行审前拘留，等待调查。佩纳不认罪。该国副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳已宣誓就任总统，任期至 2028 年 8 月。

paras.en: Carvallo was also arrested and charged with breach of trust, administration for personal gain and producing false public documents. A judge ordered him held in pretrial detention at a police facility. Eight Ueno executives, including 36-year-old CEO Miguel Vásquez, were also arrested and charged.
paras.zh: 卡瓦洛还被捕并被指控违反信任、谋取私利和制作虚假公共文件等罪名。一名法官下令将他审前拘留在警察设施中。包括 36 岁首席执行官米格尔·巴斯克斯 (Miguel Vásquez) 在内的 8 名上野高管也被捕并受到指控。

paras.en: The crisis has also put the spotlight on Horacio Cartes, a tobacco magnate and former president of Paraguay who wields considerable political and economic influence.
paras.zh: 这场危机还让烟草巨头、巴拉圭前总统奥拉西奥·卡特斯成为人们关注的焦点，他在政治和经济方面拥有相当大的影响力。

paras.en: Cartes handpicked Peña, his former finance minister, to lead his Honor Colorado faction into the 2023 presidential election. But the relationship between the two men had become increasingly strained, apparently over Peña's efforts to establish his own power base within the party.
paras.zh: 卡特斯亲自挑选了他的前财政部长佩纳来领导他的科罗拉多荣誉派参加 2023 年总统选举。但两人之间的关系变得越来越紧张，显然是因为佩纳努力在党内建立自己的权力基础。

paras.en: In September, senators aligned with Cartes sought information from the Central Bank about Ueno's transactions with related companies and its public-sector deposits.
paras.zh: 九月份，与卡特斯结盟的参议员向中央银行寻求有关上野与相关公司的交易及其公共部门存款的信息。

paras.en: After the bank collapsed, Cartes publicly distanced himself from Peña, releasing a public statement on Wednesday calling for an investigation and insisting there should be "no impunity for anyone." The following day, his faction backed Peña's impeachment.
paras.zh: 银行倒闭后，卡特斯公开与佩尼亚保持距离，周三发表公开声明，呼吁进行调查，并坚称“任何人都不应有罪不罚”。第二天，他的派系支持弹劾佩纳。

paras.en: The move was widely seen as a decisive withdrawal of political protection for Peña, and an opportunity for Cartes to reassert his influence.
paras.zh: 此举被广泛认为是对佩尼亚政治保护的决定性撤回，也是卡特斯重新发挥影响力的机会。

paras.en: But for those gathered outside Congress protesting, the scandal was about more than a bank collapse. It was a reckoning with Paraguay's political establishment.
paras.zh: 但对于那些聚集在国会外抗议的人来说，这一丑闻不仅仅是银行倒闭。这是对巴拉圭政治体制的清算。

paras.en: For Rodrigo Piatti, a 45-year-old activist with the anti-corruption campaign group Comisión Escrache Ciudadano, the scandal would only lead to real change if the political establishment, including Cartes, were challenged.
paras.zh: 反腐败运动组织 Comisión Escrache Ciudadano 的 45 岁活动人士罗德里戈·皮亚蒂 (Rodrigo Piatti) 认为，只有包括卡特在内的政治机构受到挑战，丑闻才会带来真正的变革。

paras.en: "Everything that's wrong with Paraguay… is Horacio Cartes and his line of succession," Piatti said. "[Paraguay needs] the opposition to take power. A real opposition to take power, and for all these criminals to be put in prison. That's the dream of all Paraguayans."
paras.zh: “巴拉圭的一切问题都是奥拉西奥·卡特斯和他的继承人的问题，”皮亚蒂说。 “[巴拉圭需要]反对派夺取政权。真正的反对派夺取政权，并将所有这些罪犯投入监狱。这是所有巴拉圭人的梦想。”

paras.en: The crisis has also raised questions about Paraguay's image among foreign businesspeople. Eduardo López, a 35-year-old exporter whose company operates in Paraguay and the United States, said the scandal would only worsen the lack of confidence he had already seen among American business contacts.
paras.zh: 这场危机还引发了人们对巴拉圭在外国商人心目中形象的质疑。 35 岁的出口商爱德华多·洛佩斯 (Eduardo López) 的公司在巴拉圭和美国开展业务，他表示，这一丑闻只会加剧他在美国商业联系人中已经看到的信心缺失。

paras.en: "We are a serious Paraguayan company, but [American businesspeople] don't trust the Paraguayan government," he said. "It's a disaster."
paras.zh: “我们是一家严肃的巴拉圭公司，但（美国商人）不信任巴拉圭政府，”他说。 “这是一场灾难。”

paras.en: Nearby, Lizza Lugo, a 22-year-old student leader at the National University, expressed frustration with the status quo and said she hoped voters would bring change in the 2028 presidential election.
paras.zh: 附近，国立大学 22 岁的学生领袖 Lizza Lugo 对现状表示失望，并表示她希望选民在 2028 年总统选举中带来改变。

paras.en: "The laws apply differently to those who have money and those who don't. That is the reality in Paraguay," she said. "I do hope people don't have short memories, because they forget these things very quickly."
paras.zh: “法律对有钱人和没钱人的适用不同。这就是巴拉圭的现实，”她说。 “我确实希望人们不要记忆力差，因为他们很快就会忘记这些事情。”

articles.title: Bernie Sanders warns Democrats not to spend all their time investigating Trump

paras.en: Sen. Bernie Sanders said Democrats should hold President Donald Trump accountable after taking control of the House and Senate in January, but warned the party not to spend too much time on probing the president and his allies.
paras.zh: 参议员伯尼·桑德斯表示，民主党在一月份控制众议院和参议院后应该追究唐纳德·特朗普总统的责任，但警告该党不要花太多时间调查总统及其盟友。

paras.en: During an appearance on NBC News' "Meet the Press," the senator said it is still important to investigate Trump administration officials for alleged corruption and illegal activity, but stressed that the priority should be tackling affordability and supporting working-class families.
paras.zh: 这位参议员在美国全国广播公司新闻节目“会见媒体”节目中表示，调查特朗普政府官员涉嫌腐败和非法活动仍然很重要，但他强调，首要任务应该是解决负担能力问题并支持工薪阶层家庭。

paras.en: Asked by host Kristen Welker if he believes that spending two years investigating Trump and his officials could jeopardize the mandate to lower prices and make life more affordable, Sanders replied, "Yes, I do."
paras.zh: 主持人克里斯汀·韦尔克（Kristen Welker）问他是否认为花两年时间调查特朗普及其官员可能会危及降低物价和让生活变得更便宜的使命，桑德斯回答说：“是的，我相信。”

paras.en: "Do we want to hold the Trump administration accountable for their corruption, for their illegal, unconstitutional actions? Absolutely," Sanders said.
paras.zh: “我们想让特朗普政府对他们的腐败、非法、违宪行为负责吗？当然，”桑德斯说。

paras.en: However, Sanders said that Democrats "cannot spend all of our time investigating Trump."
paras.zh: 不过，桑德斯表示，民主党人“不能把所有时间都花在调查特朗普身上”。

paras.en: "At the end of the day, when you’ve got the highest rate of childhood poverty in America, of any major country, when 20% of our seniors are trying to survive on $15,000 a year, when people are scared to death that Elon Musk and the other billionaires are pushing AI down our throats with cataclysmic impacts on the economy, our privacy rights, on our health, and — and imposing an existential threat to humanity, we cannot spend all of our time investigating Trump," he said.
paras.zh: “归根结底，当美国的儿童贫困率是所有主要国家中最高的，当我们 20% 的老年人每年仅靠 15,000 美元生存时，当人们害怕埃隆·马斯克和其他亿万富翁正在把人工智能强推到我们的喉咙上，对经济、我们的隐私权、我们的健康造成灾难性影响时，并且对人类造成生存威胁时，我们不能把所有的时间都用来调查特朗普，”他说。说。

paras.en: "We’ve got to stand up for working-class families, make a real difference in their lives," Sanders continued.
paras.zh: 桑德斯继续说道：“我们必须支持工薪阶层家庭，真正改变他们的生活。”

paras.en: Democrats campaigned on affordability ahead of the midterms, blaming the Trump administration for the soaring costs of gas, groceries, housing and healthcare. Candidates linked the rise in costs, in part, to the U.S. military's war on Iran and Trump's tariffs on countries around the world.
paras.zh: 民主党人在中期选举前以负担能力为主题进行竞选，指责特朗普政府造成天然气、食品杂货、住房和医疗保健成本飙升。候选人将成本上升部分归因于美国军方对伊朗的战争以及特朗普对世界各国征收的关税。

paras.en: The Iran war, which Trump, Vice President JD Vance and other allies partially attributed to Republicans' midterm losses, led to surging fuel prices. Gas prices are nearly $1 per gallon higher than they were a year ago, according to AAA, which reported that the national average was $4.02 per gallon as of Sunday.
paras.zh: 特朗普、副总统万斯和其他盟友将伊朗战争部分归因于共和党中期选举的失败，导致燃油价格飙升。根据 AAA 的数据，天然气价格比一年前每加仑上涨近 1 美元，截至周日，全国平均价格为每加仑 4.02 美元。

paras.en: But after securing the majority in both chambers of Congress following last week's elections, several Democrats promised to use the power of the subpoena and investigate current and former Trump officials once they are sworn in.
paras.zh: 但在上周的选举后获得国会参众两院多数席位后，几名民主党人承诺在特朗普现任和前任官员宣誓就职后，将利用传票的权力对他们进行调查。

paras.en: Incoming House Oversight Committee leader Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., on Sunday warned that Democrats could investigate Trump's pardons as well as allies of the president, including tech executive Elon Musk and newly appointed White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.
paras.zh: 即将上任的众议院监督委员会主席、加利福尼亚州民主党众议员罗伯特·加西亚周日警告说，民主党人可以调查特朗普的赦免以及总统的盟友，包括科技高管埃隆·马斯克和新任命的白宫幕僚长斯蒂芬·米勒。

paras.en: Garcia also said last week that Oversight Democrats are "ready to take on the crooks, the con men, and the Trump crime family."
paras.zh: 加西亚上周还表示，监督民主党“已准备好打击骗子、骗子和特朗普犯罪家族”。

paras.en: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., who is expected to be the next House Speaker, also said last week that Democrats are "going to bring accountability to those who have visited unprecedented corruption on this country."
paras.zh: 预计将成为下一任众议院议长的众议院少数党领袖、纽约州民主党人哈基姆·杰弗里斯上周也表示，民主党“将追究那些在这个国家遭受前所未有的腐败行为的人的责任”。

paras.en: "Because if you have people in high office who are so focused on enriching themselves, their family members, their friends or their donors, then they’re not focused on making life better for the American people. But House Democrats will put the American people first," he continued.
paras.zh: “因为如果身居高位的人如此专注于让自己、家人、朋友或捐助者致富，那么他们就不会专注于让美国人民生活得更好。但众议院民主党人会把美国人民放在第一位，”他继续说道。

paras.en: Sanders said on Sunday that the election was not just about voters wanting to stop the Trump administration’s policies.
paras.zh: 桑德斯周日表示，这次选举不仅仅是选民想要阻止特朗普政府的政策。

paras.en: "What I think this election was about, is the American people not only expressing disgust with Trump and his policies, but are demanding real change, no more tinkering around the edges," said Sanders. "And what the American people are saying: 'Look, we are working long hours. We’re worried about our kids. We can’t afford healthcare. We can’t afford housing. Meanwhile, the wealthiest people in America have never, ever had it so good.' And right now is the moment where the Democrats have got to stand up to big money, create an economy and a government that works for all of us," Sanders said.
paras.zh: 桑德斯说：“我认为这次选举的目的是，美国人民不仅表达了对特朗普及其政策的厌恶，而且要求真正的改变，不再在边缘修修补补。” “美国人民说的是：‘看，我们工作时间很长。我们担心我们的孩子。我们买不起医疗保健。我们买不起住房。与此同时，美国最富有的人从来没有过得这么好。’现在是民主党必须勇敢地面对大笔资金、创造一个为我们所有人服务的经济和政府的时刻，”桑德斯说。

paras.en: The Vermont senator also accused Trump of being "mentally unbalanced" and "erratic," but acknowledged that the president is "a good politician" and "not stupid" who Democrats may be able to work with on economic and healthcare issues.
paras.zh: 这位佛蒙特州参议员还指责特朗普“精神不平衡”和“不稳定”，但承认总统是“一位优秀的政治家”并且“并不愚蠢”，民主党人可以在经济和医疗保健问题上与他合作。

paras.en: "Trump is many things. I personally believe he is mentally unbalanced, erratic, but he’s not stupid, and he is a good politician. And I think, when Trump looks out in the world and he sees millions of people working for starvation wages, he might not be unsympathetic to raising the minimum wage to a living wage. He would love, I think, to take credit for doing what every other major country does, guaranteeing healthcare to all people. Do I think we can work with Trump? Maybe. I’m, by no means, guaranteeing it. But it is certainly worth the effort," he said.
paras.zh: “特朗普有很多方面。我个人认为他精神不平衡、反复无常，但他并不愚蠢，而且他是一位优秀的政治家。我认为，当特朗普放眼世界，看到数百万人为挨饿的工资而工作时，他可能不会对将最低工资提高到生活工资表示同情。我认为，他很乐意因做其他主要国家所做的事情而获得赞誉，保证所有人的医疗保健。我认为我们可以与特朗普合作吗？也许我不能保证这一点，但这肯定是值得的，”他说。

articles.title: Jonathan Taylor delivers what sounds like a goodbye to Indianapolis after Colts' fifth straight loss

paras.en: Jonathan Taylor is done watching the Colts shoot themselves in the foot. Sunday's 27-23 loss to Dallas dropped Indy to an ugly 2-7, cementing their fifth straight defeat.
paras.zh: 乔纳森·泰勒已经厌倦了看着小马搬起石头砸自己的脚。周日，印第安纳波利斯队以 27-23 输给达拉斯队，战绩为 2-7，惨遭五连败。

paras.en: As the lone Pro Bowl weapon on a broken offense, the franchise running back has outgrown the dysfunction. And he can read the situation clearly.
paras.zh: 作为职业碗进攻被破坏的唯一武器，这位球队跑卫已经摆脱了这种功能障碍。而且他能清楚地读懂局势。

paras.en: With Tuesday's trade deadline looming and this Colts team firmly in fire-sale territory, Taylor didn't bother feeding reporters the company line at the podium, delivering what sounded an awful lot like a parting goodbye to Indy.
paras.zh: 随着周二交易截止日期的临近，小马队牢牢处于甩卖区域，泰勒没有费心在讲台上向记者介绍公司的台词，他的讲话听起来非常像印地的告别。

paras.en: "I think you play every game like it's your last, but at the end of the day this has been a spot where I grew up," Taylor said.
paras.zh: “我认为你把每场比赛都当作最后一场比赛来打，但归根结底，这是我成长的地方，”泰勒说。

paras.en: "I think I mentioned this to you guys, like you go to college, you're a young man, but you really grew up, you started a family and you really embraced this city, the people, and you're just like ... this place helped shape me into the man I am today. If it is [my last game], I'm very grateful for the city of Indianapolis."
paras.zh: “我想我向你们提到过这一点，就像你们上大学一样，你们是一个年轻人，但你们真的长大了，你们组建了家庭，你们真正拥抱了这座城市，这里的人民，你们就像……这个地方帮助我成为了今天的我。如果这是[我的最后一场比赛]，我非常感谢印第安纳波利斯市。”

paras.en: Taylor continued, "I just hope that they appreciate and know that I appreciate them and it was a pleasure to put on display not only my hard work but the team's hard work each and every single week, each and every single year. Just know it was a pleasure."
paras.zh: 泰勒继续说道：“我只是希望他们能够欣赏并知道我欣赏他们，我很高兴不仅能够展示我的辛勤工作，而且能够展示团队每一周、每一年的辛勤工作。你知道这是一种荣幸。”

paras.en: Before Sunday's kickoff, Fox NFL Insider Jay Glazer reported that the team hottest on Taylor's trail, the New York Giants, pulled their trade proposal. New York had put a second- and fifth-round pick package on the table with extra compensation, but backed off after the Colts held out for a first-rounder. That steep asking price remains the sticking point, but other contenders like Denver and Cincinnati are lingering — both clubs could use a premier bell-cow back to supercharge a postseason run.
paras.zh: 在周日开赛前，福克斯 NFL 内部人士杰伊·格雷泽 (Jay Glazer) 报道称，泰勒追踪中最热门的球队纽约巨人队撤回了他们的交易提案。纽约已经将第二轮和第五轮的选秀权放在了谈判桌上，并附有额外的补偿，但在小马队坚持争取首轮选秀权后放弃了。高昂的要价仍然是症结所在，但丹佛和辛辛那提等其他竞争者仍在徘徊——两家具乐部都可以利用顶级的钟牛回归来增强季后赛的竞争力。

paras.en: The three-time Pro Bowler already took home the NFL rushing crown in 2021 with over 1,800 yards and 18 touchdowns, and he delivered another monster campaign in 2025 with nearly 1,600 yards on the ground.
paras.zh: 这位三届职业投球手已经在 2021 年以超过 1,800 码和 18 次达阵摘得 NFL 冲球桂冠，并在 2025 年以近 1,600 码的冲球距离再次创造了怪物般的表现。

paras.en: The Colts already fired GM Chris Ballard and shipped off locker room leaders Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner for future draft capital. Taylor remains under contract through 2028, giving Indy leverage.
paras.zh: 小马队已经解雇了总经理克里斯·巴拉德，并送走了更衣室领袖昆顿·尼尔森和德福雷斯特·巴克纳，以换取未来的选秀资金。泰勒的合同将持续到 2028 年，这给印地带来了影响力。

paras.en: Unless the front office lowers its demands before Tuesday's 4 p.m. (ET) cutoff, Taylor will stay trapped in Indianapolis, carrying an offense that cannot stop beating itself.
paras.zh: 除非前台在周二下午 4 点之前降低要求。 （东部时间）截止，泰勒将继续被困在印第安纳波利斯，带着无法停止击败自己的进攻。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Bears survive Buccaneers in chaotic primetime finish after Caleb Williams throws four interceptions

paras.en: It was a win for the Bears, but turning the ball over five times is a brutal pill to swallow.
paras.zh: 这对熊队来说是一场胜利，但五次失误却是令人难以接受的残酷药丸。

paras.en: In an MVP-or-bust season for Caleb Williams, Sunday night delivered pure whiplash against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers — called by emergency replacement Noah Eagle after Mike Tirico was sidelined by an undisclosed health issue.
paras.zh: 在凯莱布·威廉姆斯 (Caleb Williams) 的 MVP 或失败赛季中，周日晚上对阵坦帕湾海盗队 (Tampa Bay Buccaneers) 的比赛中，在迈克·蒂里科 (Mike Tirico) 因未公开的健康问题缺席后，紧急替补诺亚·伊格尔 (Noah Eagle) 召集了比赛。

paras.en: Conventional wisdom says coughing up five turnovers gets you beat every single time, but Chicago found a way to grind out a 27-24 victory. Williams' first career four-interception game nearly doomed Chicago. But even in a messy performance, Caleb proved he can survive three quarters of disastrous football and still win.
paras.zh: 传统观点认为，每次出现 5 次失误就会被击败，但芝加哥找到了一种方法，以 27-24 取得胜利。威廉姆斯职业生涯的第一场四次拦截比赛几乎注定了芝加哥队的失败。但即使在混乱的表现中，凯莱布也证明了他可以在灾难性的足球比赛中幸存下来并仍然获胜。

paras.en: After the Bears built an early 14-0 lead, the offense stalled, opening the door for Tampa Bay to pull even.
paras.zh: 熊队早早建立起 14-0 的领先优势后，进攻陷入停滞，为坦帕湾队扳平比分打开了大门。

paras.en: Just when a flat-footed Chicago squad looked completely stalled out late in the third quarter, cornerback Jaylon Johnson made Baker Mayfield pay for his recklessness, baiting the quarterback into a crushing 67-yard pick-six that kept momentum swinging like a pendulum.
paras.zh: 正当芝加哥队在第三节末看上去完全陷入停滞时，角卫杰伦·约翰逊让贝克·梅菲尔德为他的鲁莽付出了代价，引诱这位四分卫进行了67码的67码六挡，让势头像钟摆一样摇摆不定。

paras.en: Yet when everything threatened to collapse after a late Tampa Bay surge, Williams rallied.
paras.zh: 然而，当坦帕湾后期的飙升后一切都面临崩溃的时候，威廉姆斯却反弹了。

paras.en: With 2:51 left and the game knotted at 24, he put together an eight-play, 49-yard drive — highlighted by a 38-yard strike to Colston Loveland — to set up Cairo Santos for the walk-off 38-yard field goal.
paras.zh: 比赛还剩 2 分 51 秒，比赛打到 24 分时，他完成了八次 49 码的冲球——其中最精彩的是科尔斯顿·洛夫兰 (Colston Loveland) 的 38 码射门——为开罗·桑托斯 (Cairo Santos) 送出 38 码的射门。

paras.en: Afterward, Williams was entirely unmoved by the turnover-heavy night.
paras.zh: 此后，威廉姆斯对这个失误过多的夜晚完全无动于衷。

paras.en: "I'm going to throw until I can't throw anymore," Williams said on the postgame podium. He wrapped up his night with 279 yards, two touchdown passes and four picks.
paras.zh: “我会一直投球，直到我不能再投球为止，”威廉姆斯在赛后领奖台上说道。他以 279 码、两次达阵传球和四次接球结束了他的夜晚。

paras.en: For Tampa Bay, Mayfield choked away the defense's impressive outing. Sacked four times with zero touchdowns, his 243-yard meltdown proved Tampa Bay's QB1 experiment is running on fumes. With an upcoming bye week, the 7-2 Bears get two full weeks to let this five-turnover scare fade into the rearview mirror.
paras.zh: 对于坦帕湾队，梅菲尔德扼杀了防守者令人印象深刻的表现。他四次以零达阵被解雇，他的 243 码崩溃证明坦帕湾的 QB1 实验已经失败。轮空周即将到来，7胜2负的熊队有整整两周的时间让这场五次失误的恐慌消失在后视镜中。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Victorian election 2026: Concern and scepticism among Labor MPs as new poll shows party trailing One Nation
articles.author: Benita Kolovos Victorian state correspondent

paras.en: Victorian Labor MPs are both sceptical and seriously concerned about a new poll ahead of the state election showing the party trailing third behind One Nation, with its primary vote at an all-time low of just 18%.
paras.zh: 维州工党议员对州选举前的一项新民意调查表示怀疑和严重担忧，该民意调查显示该党落后于一国党，落后于一国党，其初选得票率仅为 18%，创下历史新低。

paras.en: The DemosAU/PremierNational, first published by the Herald Sun on Monday, showed Labor’s primary vote share has crashed seven points to 18%, putting it in third place behind the Coalition’s 33% and One Nation’s 21%. At the same time, the Greens improved their primary vote to 17%, an increase of three points since September.
paras.zh: 《先驱太阳报》周一首次发布的 DemosAU/PremierNational 报告显示，工党的初选得票率已暴跌 7 个百分点，至 18%，位居第三，落后于联盟党 33% 和一国党 21%。与此同时，绿党的初选得票率提高至 17%，比 9 月份增加了 3 个百分点。

paras.en: It means the Coalition now leads Labor on a two-party preferred basis 56-44, compared with 52-48 in September.
paras.zh: 这意味着联盟党目前在两党优先的基础上以 56 比 44 领先工党，而 9 月份的比例为 52 比 48。

paras.en: George Hasanakos, DemosAU’s head of research, said if the poll were replicated on election night then many contests across the state would be between the Liberals or Nationals and One Nation, which would then result in a “clear Coalition majority”.
paras.zh: DemosAU 研究主管乔治·哈萨纳科斯 (George Hasanakos) 表示，如果在选举之夜重复进行民意调查，那么全州的许多竞争将在自由党或国家党和一国党之间展开，这将导致“联盟党明显占多数”。

paras.en: “If that happens, One Nation has to poll really, really well to have a chance of winning, because Labor and Greens preferences will flow to the Liberals,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果发生这种情况，一国党必须在民意调查中表现得非常非常好才有机会获胜，因为工党和绿党的偏好将流向自由党，”他说。

paras.en: On election night, the Victorian Electoral Commission plans to conduct a two-candidate-preferred count, or 2CP, between the two candidates it expects to finish with the most support after preferences are distributed. The commission is selecting the indicative 2CP for each seat based on polling, analysis of preference flows and results from previous elections. It will not publish the indicative 2CPs before election day to avoid influencing voter behaviour.
paras.zh: 在选举之夜，维多利亚州选举委员会计划对两名候选人进行优先计票（2CP），预计在分配优先权后将获得最多支持的两名候选人。该委员会正在根据民意调查、偏好流分析和之前选举的结果为每个席位选择指示性 2CP。它不会在选举日之前发布指示性 2CP，以避免影响选民的行为。

paras.en: Hasanakos added that he “double, triple, quadruple checked” the result of the “extraordinary” poll, which had 1,562 respondents, an effective sample of 818 and a margin of error of 3.4%.
paras.zh: 哈萨纳科斯补充说，他对这项“非凡”民意调查的结果进行了“双重、三重、四重检查”，该民意调查共有 1,562 名受访者，有效样本为 818 人，误差幅度为 3.4%。

paras.en: “We went to the trouble of a bigger sample here, and I stand by it,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们不辞辛劳地在这里采集了更大的样本，但我坚持这一点，”他说。

paras.en: Ben Carroll repeatedly refused to say whether he was worried about the poll at a press conference in South Melbourne on Monday morning.
paras.zh: 本·卡罗尔周一上午在南墨尔本举行的新闻发布会上多次拒绝透露他是否担心这次民意调查。

paras.en: “What I’m focused on every day is fighting for working people and making sure that every Victorian that goes into the ballot on November 28 knows that under my government you have a government on your side that will fight for you,” he told reporters.
paras.zh: 他告诉记者：“我每天关注的焦点是为工薪阶层而战，并确保每一位参加 11 月 28 日投票的维州人都知道，在我的政府领导下，有一个政府站在你一边，为你而战。”

paras.en: “The alternative is a Liberal-One Nation government that will fight against you – they’re going to shrink the economy, cause a recession and make life difficult for every single Victorian.”
paras.zh: “另一种选择是自由党一国政府将与你作对——他们将收缩经济，导致经济衰退，让每个维多利亚人的生活变得困难。”

paras.en: But the result has sparked serious concerns among the Labor caucus, even though some MPs are sceptical about the 18% figure. Inside Labor’s campaign headquarters, they are treating the result as an “outlier” and point to other public polls that have their primary vote in the 20s.
paras.zh: 但这一结果引发了工党核心小组的严重担忧，尽管一些议员对 18% 的数字持怀疑态度。在工党竞选总部内部，他们将这一结果视为“异常值”，并指出其他民意调查的初选票数为 20 多岁。

paras.en: Several Labor MPs, unauthorised to speak publicly, have told Guardian Australia there are many in the caucus questioning their party’s strategy.
paras.zh: 几位未经授权公开发言的工党议员告诉《澳大利亚卫报》，核心小组中有许多人质疑他们党的策略。

paras.en: This includes a focus in recent days on crime – an issue that is typically a Coalition strength. On Sunday, Carroll announced a $204m plan to enable judges to sentence low- and mid-level youth offenders to a new rehabilitation detention program, while on Monday he announced $70m to recruit 200 more police reservists to reopen stations and build and upgrade more stations.
paras.zh: 这包括最近几天对犯罪的关注——这是一个典型的联盟力量问题。周日，卡罗尔宣布了一项 2.04 亿美元的计划，使法官能够对低级和中级青少年罪犯判处新的改造拘留计划，而周一他宣布投入 7000 万美元，招募 200 名预备役警察，以重新开放警察局并建造和升级更多警察局。

paras.en: “Caucus is really angry and deflated, because this is all happening because of him,” one MP said.
paras.zh: 一名议员表示：“核心小组真的感到愤怒和泄气，因为这一切都是因为他而发生的。”

paras.en: “Even if it’s higher than 18, and we get back into something with a two in front of it, the experiment has been an epic fail, the campaign is in freefall, and it’s about to get a whole lot worse.”
paras.zh: “即使它高于 18，而且我们又回到了前面有 2 的情况，这个实验也是一次史诗般的失败，整个活动就像自由落体一样，而且情况还会变得更糟。”

paras.en: Another MP said the focus on crime was “diabolically stupid strategy” as the government had years to tackle community concern around rising rates.
paras.zh: 另一位议员表示，关注犯罪是“极其愚蠢的策略”，因为政府有多年的时间来解决社区对犯罪率上升的担忧。

paras.en: The opposition leader, Jess Wilson, on Monday said her party had a focus on “getting tough on crime”, including by introducing Aidan’s Law to toughen sentencing for attacks on people who step in to protect others.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖杰西·威尔逊(Jess Wilson)周一表示，她的政党的重点是“严厉打击犯罪”，包括引入艾丹法，以加强对那些介入保护他人的人的袭击的量刑。

paras.en: Carroll immediately matched the commitment to introduce the proposed law, named after 22-year-old Aidan Becker, who was fatally stabbed at Mernda station after stepping in to protect a 14-year-old during an alleged violent robbery.
paras.zh: 卡罗尔立即兑现了引入拟议法律的承诺，该法律以 22 岁的艾丹·贝克尔 (Aidan Becker) 的名字命名。艾丹·贝克尔在一次涉嫌暴力抢劫的事件中介入保护一名 14 岁的青少年，随后在默恩达车站被刺伤身亡。

paras.en: It comes as Pauline Hanson rejected reports by the Age and 60 Minutes on Sunday that her former national campaign director Sean Black continues to secretly work for One Nation in Victoria.
paras.zh: 周日，宝琳·汉森 (Pauline Hanson) 否认了《时代报》和《60 分钟》的报道，称她的前全国竞选总监肖恩·布莱克 (Sean Black) 继续秘密为维多利亚州的一国党 (One Nation) 工作。

paras.en: Black in 2018 was jailed for rape and subsequently lost his appeal against the conviction but was then rehired by One Nation in 2020 as a campaign director after serving his time. Hanson sacked him after political pressure earlier this year.
paras.zh: 布莱克于 2018 年因强奸罪入狱，随后对定罪上诉失败，但刑满后于 2020 年被一国党重新聘为竞选总监。今年早些时候，汉森在政治压力下解雇了他。

paras.en: She told the Australian Financial Review on Monday “the day that I sacked him [Sean Black] that was the day he finished up”.
paras.zh: 她周一告诉《澳大利亚金融评论报》，“我解雇他（肖恩·布莱克）的那一天，就是他结束的那一天”。

articles.title: Stop undermining Jim Chalmers, environment minister urges Labor colleagues
articles.author: Tom McIlroy Political editor

paras.en: The environment minister, Murray Watt, has urged ministers to stop undermining the treasurer, Jim Chalmers, as Labor struggles to sell its budget and looks to cut popular clean energy subsidies to help with the fight against inflation.
paras.zh: 环境部长默里·瓦特 (Murray Watt) 敦促部长们停止破坏财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 的影响，因为工党正在努力推销其预算，并希望削减受欢迎的清洁能源补贴以帮助对抗通货膨胀。

paras.en: Cabinet ministers met again on Monday to discuss potential budget savings to be included in next month’s mid-year update, part of efforts to reducing spending to ease pressure on the economy.
paras.zh: 内阁部长周一再次开会，讨论下个月年中更新中可能包含的预算节省，这是减少支出以缓解经济压力的努力的一部分。

paras.en: Watt was asked about speculation of tension between the treasurer and the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, and whether he’d like to see an end to “undermining and leaking” against Chalmers.
paras.zh: 瓦特被问及有关财政部长和总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯之间紧张关系的猜测，以及他是否希望看到针对查尔默斯的“破坏和泄密”结束。

paras.en: “Yes, I would,” Watt said. “As a member of the government, I take seriously the responsibility to work together to support government policies and also to get our work to support each other in what are very difficult times.
paras.zh: “是的，我愿意，”瓦特说。 “作为政府成员，我认真承担起共同努力支持政府政策的责任，并在非常困难的时期让我们的工作相互支持。

paras.en: “I think that Jim Chalmers is doing an excellent job as a treasurer in what are very difficult economic times; many of the features that are impacting on our economy are sort of well outside any treasurer’s control, and I very much support Jim Chalmers in his efforts.”
paras.zh: “我认为吉姆·查尔默斯在经济困难时期作为财务主管做得非常出色；影响我们经济的许多因素都超出了任何财务主管的控制范围，我非常支持吉姆·查尔默斯的努力。”

paras.en: Watt conceded Chalmers was being undermined from within Labor.
paras.zh: 瓦特承认查默斯正在受到工党内部的削弱。

paras.en: “It’s pretty obvious that there are all sorts of people making all sorts of comments.”
paras.zh: “很明显，各种各样的人都在发表各种各样的评论。”

paras.en: A new round of opinion polls added to Labor’s political pain on Monday, with the Resolve Political Monitor in the Age and Sydney Morning Herald showing Labor’s primary vote falling to 28 percentage points, down from 34.6% at last year’s election.
paras.zh: 周一的新一轮民意调查加剧了工党的政治痛苦，《时代解决政治观察》和《悉尼先驱晨报》显示工党的初选得票率下降至 28 个百分点，低于去年选举时的 34.6%。

paras.en: The Coalition also dropped one point to 22%, while One Nation was steady at 25%.
paras.zh: 联盟党的支持率也下降了 1 个百分点，至 22%，而一国党则稳定在 25%。

paras.en: A Redbridge poll in the Financial Review showed Labor’s primary vote slipped two percentage points to 26%, while the Coalition’s jumped four points to 25%. One Nation was down one point to 28%.
paras.zh: 《金融评论》的雷德布里奇民意调查显示，工党的初选得票率下滑了两个百分点，至 26%，而联盟党的得票率则跃升了四个百分点，至 25%。 One Nation 下降了一个百分点，至 28%。

paras.en: Monday’s meeting of the expenditure review committee of cabinet comes after last week’s interest rate hike from the Reserve Bank. The governor, Michele Bullock, said while it is up to governments to manage their budgets independently of the RBA, public and private spending had caused “excess demand” in the economy.
paras.zh: 继上周储备银行加息之后，周一召开了内阁支出审查委员会会议。行长米歇尔·布洛克表示，虽然政府有责任独立于澳大利亚央行管理预算，但公共和私人支出导致了经济“需求过剩”。

paras.en: Watt accused the Coalition and minor parties of leaving existing spending proposals to linger in parliament, including savings from changes to the private health insurance rebate for over 65s.
paras.zh: 瓦特指责联盟党和小党将现有的支出提案留在议会，其中包括通过改变 65 岁以上的私人医疗保险回扣而节省的开支。

paras.en: “Let’s not forget that for all of their demands that we find more savings, the Coalition currently are blocking the government from saving $10 billion in measures that are before the parliament,” Watt said.
paras.zh: 瓦特说：“我们不要忘记，尽管他们要求我们找到更多储蓄，但联盟党目前正在阻止政府采取议会面前的 100 亿美元储蓄措施。”

paras.en: Albanese has confirmed spending in the public service will be scrutinised as the government looks for savings in the budget update, expected in the middle of December. Last year, departments and agencies were asked to identify potential savings of as much as 5% from their annual budgets, part of the government’s efforts to cut lower-priority spending.
paras.zh: Albanese 已确认，随着政府在预计于 12 月中旬更新的预算中寻求节省开支，公共服务支出将受到审查。去年，各部门和机构被要求从其年度预算中确定多达 5% 的潜在节省，这是政府削减低优先级支出的努力的一部分。

paras.en: Spending on Labor’s $7bn home battery subsidy program and incentives for electric vehicle purchases could be reined in.
paras.zh: 工党 70 亿美元的家用电池补贴计划和电动汽车购买激励措施的支出可能会受到限制。

paras.en: Announced in April 2025, the batteries program was originally designed to cost about $2bn. More than 600,000 systems have been installed, but the program could have means testing rules added.
paras.zh: 该电池计划于 2025 年 4 月宣布，最初设计成本约为 20 亿美元。已经安装了超过 600,000 个系统，但该计划可能会添加经济状况测试规则。

paras.en: Separately, subsidies designed to promote uptake of electric vehicles has cost the budget far more than originally anticipated.
paras.zh: 另外，旨在促进电动汽车普及的补贴所花费的预算远远超过最初的预期。

paras.en: Angus Taylor announced an opposition “red tape razor gang” on Monday, designed to reduce the burden on business from costly regulation.
paras.zh: 安格斯·泰勒周一宣布成立反对派“繁文缛节剃须刀团伙”，旨在减轻昂贵的监管给企业带来的负担。

articles.title: Kraków shooting suspect who killed six has died, say police in Poland
articles.author: Staff and agencies

paras.en: A gunman suspected of killing six people in Kraków has died in hospital, police in Poland said early on Monday.
paras.zh: 波兰警方周一早些时候表示，一名涉嫌在克拉科夫杀害六人的枪手已在医院死亡。

paras.en: The suspect had been wounded in a shootout with police and had been in critical condition in hospital.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人在与警方的枪战中受伤，目前在医院情况危急。

paras.en: “We would like to inform you that the perpetrator of the tragic events died in hospital early this morning,” Malopolska Policja wrote on X.
paras.zh: Malopolska Policja 在 X 上写道：“我们想通知您，悲剧事件的肇事者今天凌晨在医院去世。”

paras.en: Polish prosecutors had opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square on Saturday afternoon, killing six including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies.
paras.zh: 周六下午，一名 24 岁男子在繁忙的集市广场开枪，造成包括一名英国人在内的 6 人死亡，17 人受伤，波兰检察官已展开恐怖主义调查，当局称这起袭击可能是受到极右意识形态的启发。

paras.en: Karolina Galecka, an interior ministry spokeswoman, told radio TOK FM on Monday: “There were many different emblems on the perpetrator’s clothing that have been partially examined and interpreted.
paras.zh: 内政部发言人卡罗琳娜·加莱卡 (Karolina Galecka) 周一对 TOK FM 电台表示：“肇事者的衣服上有许多不同的标志，这些标志已经过部分检查和解释。

paras.en: “These patches were associated with various motifs that are currently being analysed by specialists,” she added, declining to comment further as the investigation was ongoing.
paras.zh: “这些补丁与专家目前正在分析的各种图案有关，”她补充道，由于调查正在进行，她拒绝进一步置评。

paras.en: Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21.
paras.zh: 警方周日证实，周六下午袭击事件发生后，枪手家中发现三人死亡，分别是他 53 岁的父亲、52 岁的母亲和 21 岁的妹妹。

paras.en: As two days of national mourning began, the national prosecutor’s office said on social media it had launched an investigation into “the killing of six people … using a firearm, and the attempted murder of many others, including police officers, this act constituting a terrorist offence”.
paras.zh: 随着为期两天的全国哀悼开始，国家检察官办公室在社交媒体上表示，已对“使用枪支杀害六人，以及企图谋杀包括警察在内的许多人进行调查，这种行为构成恐怖主义犯罪”。

paras.en: The rare mass shooting has shocked a country that was considered safer than many of its European neighbours, and has deepened concern after several school stabbings in October that left one woman dead and which officials said were linked to extremist content online.
paras.zh: 这起罕见的大规模枪击事件震惊了这个被认为比许多欧洲邻国更安全的国家，并在十月份发生了几起导致一名妇女死亡的学校持刀伤人事件后加深了人们的担忧，官员们称这起事件与网上的极端主义内容有关。

articles.title: Inside the French drug gangs recruiting children to kill

paras.en: Warning: Strong language and descriptions of sexual violence
paras.zh: 警告：粗俗语言和性暴力描述

paras.en: Although she had just bought hashish from a drug dealer, the woman decided to call the police.
paras.zh: 尽管她刚刚从毒贩那里购买了大麻，但该女子还是决定报警。

paras.en: It was because, along with the illegal drugs, she had been handed a note by the young seller during their brief meeting on a Marseille housing estate in 2022.
paras.zh: 这是因为，2022 年，年轻卖家在马赛一处住宅区进行简短会面时，除了非法毒品之外，还给了她一张纸条。

paras.en: "We're being held captive and need help. We are 15-years-old," it read.
paras.zh: “我们被俘虏了，需要帮助。我们今年 15 岁，”上面写道。

paras.en: The teenage dealer, a French court heard earlier this year, was one of two boys being held by a gang which they had both initially approached looking for paid work - albeit illegal.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，法国法庭审理了这名青少年毒贩的案子，他是被一个团伙关押的两名男孩之一，他们最初都是为了寻找有酬工作——尽管是非法的。

paras.en: One boy had been tasked with handling money, the other worked streets around the Frais-Vallon estate. Soon though, bosses had accused them of being responsible for "shortfalls" in takings.
paras.zh: 一个男孩的任务是处理金钱，另一个男孩则在弗赖斯-瓦隆庄园周围的街道上工作。但很快，老板们就指责他们对收入“不足”负有责任。

paras.en: What followed were regular beatings, the court was told, and being forced to dance naked in front of a camera as a form of blackmail. One of the boys was also raped.
paras.zh: 法庭被告知，随之而来的是经常性的殴打，并被迫在镜头前裸体跳舞，作为一种勒索形式。其中一名男孩也被强奸。

paras.en: Hours after the woman was passed the note, the two teenagers had tried to escape from a second-storey window, injuring themselves in the process. One managed to get away, while the other was caught, beaten and stabbed, but survived.
paras.zh: 在这名女子收到纸条几小时后，这两名青少年试图从二楼的窗户逃走，并在过程中受伤。其中一人成功逃脱，另一人被抓、殴打和刺伤，但幸存。

paras.en: Arrests were made. Photos on the phone of one of the boys' alleged torturers showed several other young men in a similarly distressed condition. Six men have since been handed hefty sentences for what happened to the two teenagers.
paras.zh: 进行了逮捕。其中一名被指控施虐男孩的人手机上的照片显示，其他几名年轻男子也处于同样痛苦的境地。此后，六名男子因两名青少年的遭遇而被处以重刑。

paras.en: The boys' story highlights the grip that drug gangs hold over parts of France's second city.
paras.zh: 男孩们的故事凸显了贩毒团伙对法国第二大城市部分地区的控制。

paras.en: While the blend of Mediterranean culture, street art and hip-hop scene has made Marseille a popular tourist destination - beyond the city centre, it is another story.
paras.zh: 虽然地中海文化、街头艺术和嘻哈音乐的融合使马赛成为一个受欢迎的旅游目的地——但在市中心之外，则是另一回事了。

paras.en: After months of trying, a BBC team managed to enter this dangerous world - centred on deprived streets and high-rise housing estates in the port city, which police do not enter lightly.
paras.zh: 经过几个月的尝试，BBC 团队成功进入了这个危险的世界——以这座港口城市的贫困街道和高层住宅区为中心，警察不会轻易进入这些地方。

paras.en: We found an environment where ruthless gangs lure vulnerable young people with promises of easy money, but end up trapping them in a world of drug dealing, brutality and exploitation.
paras.zh: 我们发现，残酷的团伙以轻松赚钱的承诺来引诱脆弱的年轻人，但最终却让他们陷入了毒品交易、残暴和剥削的世界。

paras.en: We saw how gangs use social media to recruit hitmen and spoke to several young men caught up in the violence. From prison, one gang member accused of involvement in several murders explained how his "cold-bloodedness" had helped him rise through the ranks.
paras.zh: 我们看到了帮派如何利用社交媒体招募杀手，并采访了几名陷入暴力的年轻人。一名被指控参与多起谋杀案的帮派成员在监狱中解释了他的“冷血”如何帮助他晋升。

paras.en: The city's most powerful gang, DZ Mafia, emerged victorious from a bloody turf war and is now one of the most feared criminal organisations in France.
paras.zh: 该市最强大的帮派 DZ 黑手党在一场血腥的地盘争夺战中取得了胜利，现在已成为法国最令人畏惧的犯罪组织之一。

paras.en: DZ is the official internet country code for Algeria, where one of the gang's founders, a French-Algerian called Mehdi Laribi, was detained earlier this year under a French arrest warrant.
paras.zh: DZ 是阿尔及利亚的官方互联网国家代码，该团伙的创始人之一、法裔阿尔及利亚人迈赫迪·拉里比 (Mehdi Laribi) 今年早些时候根据法国逮捕令被拘留。

paras.en: The criminal outfit rose to prominence in 2023, when it became the first French gang to capitalise on its notoriety by releasing video statements - using social media to market itself as a brand - says the head of the country's anti-drug trafficking unit, Dimitri Zoulas.
paras.zh: 法国反毒品走私部门负责人迪米特里·祖拉斯 (Dimitri Zoulas) 表示，该犯罪团伙于 2023 年声名鹊起，成为法国第一个通过发布视频声明利用其恶名的团伙，利用社交媒体将自己打造成一个品牌。

paras.en: Its most recent statement came in July, when the mayor of a nearby town had to be placed in police protection, after intelligence suggested he was in danger of being targeted by the group.
paras.zh: 该组织最新的声明是在 7 月份发布的，当时附近一个城镇的市长有可能成为该组织的攻击目标，因此不得不接受警方保护。

paras.en: In an online video, six masked men dressed in black stood behind a table - as one of them read a statement denying DZ Mafia's involvement.
paras.zh: 在一段在线视频中，六名身着黑衣的蒙面男子站在桌子后面，其中一人宣读了一份否认 DZ Mafia 参与的声明。

paras.en: France's expanding illegal drugs market - which has seen a surge in cocaine imports alongside high volumes of cannabis and synthetic drugs - has also helped the gang grow rapidly.
paras.zh: 法国不断扩大的非法毒品市场——可卡因进口量激增，大麻和合成毒品数量也大量增加——也帮助该团伙迅速发展。

paras.en: The number of cocaine users in France is expected soon to reach two million, says Zoulas, up from 600,000 in 2017. Drug smuggling across France generates â¬7bn (Â£5.9bn) a year, involving 200,000 people, he adds.
paras.zh: 祖拉斯表示，法国的可卡因使用者人数预计很快将达到 200 万，而 2017 年为 60 万。他补充说，法国各地的毒品走私每年创收 70 亿欧元（59 亿英镑），涉​​及 20 万人。

paras.en: Many of those distributing the drugs are children and the authorities say the number of minors caught up in trafficking is increasing. During 2025, more than 10,000 children were involved in some way, according to official figures.
paras.zh: 许多贩毒者都是儿童，当局表示，被贩运的未成年人数量正在增加。根据官方数据，2025 年期间，有超过 10,000 名儿童以某种方式参与其中。

paras.en: DZ Mafia is a prime example. To reach more customers, it needs more gang members - more children.
paras.zh: DZ Mafia 就是一个典型的例子。为了吸引更多的顾客，它需要更多的帮派成员——更多的孩子。

paras.en: We have found it is now recruiting young people from across France - not just to sell drugs, but to carry out kidnap, torture and murder.
paras.zh: 我们发现它现在正在从法国各地招募年轻人——不仅仅是为了贩卖毒品，还为了实施绑架、酷刑和谋杀。

paras.en: They are a generation seen as easy to corrupt, but also expendable, by the kingpins who typically control them from prison or overseas.
paras.zh: 他们是容易腐败的一代人，但也被通常在监狱或海外控制他们的主要人物视为可牺牲品。

paras.en: And, as police and judges warn, once these children enter Marseille's underworld, it is very hard to get them out.
paras.zh: 而且，正如警方和法官警告的那样，一旦这些孩子进入马赛的黑社会，就很难将他们救出来。

paras.en: Few know the human cost of Marseille's gangs like mother Karine Brouillard - who lives at the other end of France, almost as far from the Mediterranean coast as you can get.
paras.zh: 很少有人像母亲卡琳·布鲁亚尔 (Karine Brouillard) 那样了解马赛帮派所造成的人员伤亡。她住在法国的另一端，几乎距离地中海海岸最远。

paras.en: Her son, Hugo, first ran away aged 15 - from his home in a village in the Nord department - after an argument with his family. He was picked up by police three days later, almost 1,000km (600 miles) away in Marseille, with money and cannabis on him. He was taken home.
paras.zh: 她的儿子雨果 (Hugo) 15 岁时，在与家人发生争执后，首次从北部省一个村庄的家中离家出走。三天后，他在近 1,000 公里（600 英里）外的马赛被警察抓获，身上带着钱和大麻。他被带回家了。

paras.en: But several years later, in 2023, Hugo planned to return south, telling his parents he had secured a holiday job at a restaurant near Marseille.
paras.zh: 但几年后，即 2023 年，雨果计划返回南方，告诉父母他已在马赛附近的一家餐厅找到了一份假期工作。

paras.en: "He gave regular updates," Karine remembers. "He called me, everything was going well."
paras.zh: “他定期更新，”卡琳回忆道。 “他打电话给我，一切都很顺利。”

paras.en: Three weeks later, a doctor called. Karine says she will never forget his words: "Your son arrived last night. He took a bullet to the head."
paras.zh: 三周后，医生打来电话。卡琳说她永远不会忘记他的话：“你的儿子昨晚到了。他的头部中了一颗子弹。”

paras.en: Police believe Hugo was brought for medical help from a gang-controlled area and suspect he was involved with one.
paras.zh: 警方认为雨果是从帮派控制区被带去寻求医疗帮助的，并怀疑他与其中有牵连。

paras.en: Our best way into Quartier Nord, where DZ Mafia wields power, is with the help of resident Fadella Ouidef, a 41-year-old mother-of-four who gives us a tour.
paras.zh: 我们进入北区（DZ 黑手党掌权的地方）的最佳方式是在当地居民 Fadella Ouidef 的帮助下，她是一位 41 岁的四个孩子的母亲，她带我们参观了这里。

paras.en: Thirty-seven seconds after entering one housing estate, we find ourselves cornered.
paras.zh: 进入一处住宅区三十七秒后，我们发现自己被逼入绝境。

paras.en: Car horns sound the moment Fadella's Peugeot passes a gang checkpoint - the teenagers manning the post immediately spot our camera. "Wait, stop filming," Fadella warns, as a grey 4x4 forces us to the side of the road.
paras.zh: 当法德拉的标致汽车通过帮派检查站时，汽车喇叭响起 - 负责哨所的青少年立即发现了我们的相机。 “等等，停止拍摄，”法德拉警告道，一辆灰色四驱车将我们逼到路边。

paras.en: "I'm making a report for my housing association," she tells the inquisitive driver. He eventually agrees to let us leave if we stop filming.
paras.zh: “我正在为我的住房协会做一份报告，”她告诉好奇的司机。他最终同意如果我们停止拍摄就让我们离开。

paras.en: It is unnerving to see a non-police vehicle move so assertively and a relief to watch it leave.
paras.zh: 看到一辆非警车如此果断地行驶令人不安，看到它离开又让人松了口气。

paras.en: "Lately, the gangs have been very aggressive," explains Fadella. "What we simply try to do is make sure our young people understand what's happening is wrong."
paras.zh: “最近，这些团伙非常具有攻击性，”法德拉解释道。 “我们只是想确保我们的年轻人明白正在发生的事情是错误的。”

paras.en: Fadella speaks to a wider fear among local families: that their children are enticed by huge sums of money to take a criminal path that robs them of their innocence.
paras.zh: 法德拉谈到了当地家庭中更广泛的恐惧：他们的孩子被巨额金钱引诱走上犯罪道路，剥夺了他们的清白。

paras.en: Money is what led one young man to spend his teenage years with DZ Mafia.
paras.zh: 金钱促使一名年轻人在 DZ Mafia 度过了自己的青少年时期。

paras.en: In order for our interviewees to speak freely, or because of safety concerns, we have agreed to protect their identities.
paras.zh: 为了让我们的受访者能够自由发言，或者出于安全考虑，我们同意保护他们的身份。

paras.en: Camil tells us he worked up the gang's ranks to "running security" in one area it controls.
paras.zh: 卡米尔告诉我们，他将该团伙的队伍提升为在其控制的一个地区“负责安全”。

paras.en: The now 20-year-old, who claims to have left the group, is highly suspicious of our presence, but agrees to tell us how the gang recruits young members.
paras.zh: 这位现年 20 岁的男子声称已经离开该组织，他对我们的存在高度怀疑，但同意告诉我们该团伙如何招募年轻成员。

paras.en: "They know how to get inside your head. Whatever you want, they give to you," he says. This can range from nice cars and spacious apartments, to drugs and prostitutes, he explains.
paras.zh: “他们知道如何进入你的大脑。无论你想要什么，他们都会给你，”他说。他解释说，这包括从漂亮的汽车和宽敞的公寓到毒品和妓女。

paras.en: "You feel loyalty because of what they give you. You'll stay until the very end, until either death or prison."
paras.zh: “你会因为他们给你的东西而感到忠诚。你会一直呆到最后，直到死亡或入狱。”

paras.en: Camil also gives a sobering assessment of what happens if the gang identifies a weakness in a recruit: "They'll exploit it. You're their bitch, it's over."
paras.zh: 卡米尔还对如果该团伙发现新兵的弱点会发生什么做出了发人深省的评估：“他们会利用它。你是他们的婊子，一切都结束了。”

paras.en: DZ Mafia member, Adam - not his real name - tells us he was part of a DZ Mafia hit squad when we speak to him in a Snapchat video call.
paras.zh: DZ 黑手党成员 Adam（化名）告诉我们，当我们在 Snapchat 视频通话中与他交谈时，他是 DZ 黑手党打击小组的一员。

paras.en: He is currently in prison awaiting trial, after being implicated in several murders.
paras.zh: 因涉嫌多起谋杀案，他目前正在监狱等待审判。

paras.en: "People noticed my determination, my cold-bloodedness and, without wanting to, I climbed up the ladder of the gang," says Adam. "It became my place, I had to roll with it."
paras.zh: “人们注意到了我的决心、我的冷血，我在不知不觉中爬上了帮派的阶梯，”亚当说。 “它成了我的地盘，我必须顺其自然。”

paras.en: During the chat, he agrees the killings he has been charged with were "quite shocking".
paras.zh: 在聊天中，他承认他被指控的杀戮行为“相当令人震惊”。

paras.en: "Attempts in broad daylight, in traffic jamsâ¦ it can range from going to hit a guy, slap him to taking him in front of his mother and burning him up in a car. I think I have good composure, I handle it fairly well."
paras.zh: “在光天化日之下，在交通堵塞的情况下……可能会打人、扇他耳光，或者把他带到他母亲面前，然后在车里把他烧死。我认为我镇静得很好，处理得还不错。”

paras.en: We challenge Adam on whether he feels regret when carrying out such acts of brutality.
paras.zh: 我们向亚当提出质疑，问他在实施这种残暴行为时是否感到后悔。

paras.en: He says he is "feeling in-part guilty" but claims to have no regrets.
paras.zh: 他说他“感到部分内疚”，但声称并不后悔。

paras.en: "If I hadn't done all of this, there are other people who would have done that in my place, and so on. I am just another brick in the wall," he says.
paras.zh: “如果我没有做这一切，其他人就会代替我做这件事，等等。我只是墙上的另一块砖，”他说。

paras.en: Like so many teenagers from Marseille, he knew large sums of money could be earned quickly in drug trafficking. Now in his twenties, he admits the environment he entered was a "trap".
paras.zh: 和许多来自马赛的青少年一样，他知道通过贩毒可以很快赚到大笔钱。如今二十多岁的他承认自己进入的环境是一个“陷阱”。

paras.en: At a so-called deal point in a social housing estate - sealed off and controlled by DZ Mafia - price lists for cocaine, hashish and marijuana are graffitied on a wall.
paras.zh: 在一个由 DZ 黑手党封锁和控制的社会住房的所谓交易点，墙上涂鸦着可卡因、印度大麻和大麻的价目表。

paras.en: The estate acts as a natural fortress for drug dealers. With one major road in and out, they can control the flow of customers and see if the police are coming.
paras.zh: 该庄园是毒贩的天然堡垒。进出一条主干道，他们可以控制客流，看看警察是否来了。

paras.en: It is not uncommon for the sound of automatic gunfire to fill the night air in these areas.
paras.zh: 在这些地区的夜间空气中，自动枪声并不少见。

paras.en: After months of negotiations, a deal-point manager from a rival gang agrees to meet us where he works.
paras.zh: 经过几个月的谈判，敌对帮派的一名交易点经理同意在他工作的地方与我们会面。

paras.en: We enter the estate early in the morning, the birdsong and children walking to school providing a stark contrast to the industrial-scale criminal operation that takes place here.
paras.zh: 我们一大早进入庄园，鸟鸣声和步行上学的孩子们与这里发生的工业规模犯罪活动形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: "Joe" says he was making â¬3,000 (Â£2,500) a month when he was 13. Now he says that has risen to between â¬5,000 and â¬10,000 a month.
paras.zh: “乔”说，他 13 岁时每个月的收入为 3,000 英镑（2,500 英镑）。现在他说这个数字已经上升到每月 5,000 英镑至 10,000 英镑。

paras.en: He seems to see his life path as pre-ordained, albeit a lucrative one.
paras.zh: 他似乎认为自己的人生道路是注定的，尽管这是一条有利可图的道路。

paras.en: We ask Joe if he thinks about the lives lost because of the violence carried out by his gang, but the 23-year-old has also long made peace with the pain and destruction drug trafficking can cause.
paras.zh: 我们问乔是否考虑过因帮派实施暴力而失去的生命，但这位 23 岁的年轻人也早已坦然面对贩毒可能造成的痛苦和破坏。

paras.en: "It destroys people, but we all make our own choices," he shrugs.
paras.zh: “它毁了人，但我们都会做出自己的选择，”他耸耸肩。

paras.en: The work that Joe's gang and DZ Mafia are doing represents a threat to national security, says Zoulas, of the anti-drug trafficking unit.
paras.zh: 反毒品贩运部门的祖拉斯表示，乔的团伙和 DZ 黑手党所做的工作对国家安全构成了威胁。

paras.en: There are road accidents, as well as family violence, depressions, suicides and more than 700 overdoses each year, he says, "and it distorts the economy".
paras.zh: 他说，每年都会发生交通事故、家庭暴力、抑郁症、自杀和700多起吸毒过量事件，“这扭曲了经济”。

paras.en: "We are heading towards a potential systemic breakdown of the criminal justice system."
paras.zh: “我们正在走向刑事司法系统潜在的系统性崩溃。”

paras.en: Police have had success in Marseille and other cities against drug gangs.
paras.zh: 马赛和其他城市的警方在打击贩毒团伙方面取得了成功。

paras.en: Criminal operations are being frustrated, more kingpins arrested and drugs seized.
paras.zh: 犯罪活动受到挫败，更多的头目被捕，毒品被查获。

paras.en: Since 2024, about 1,000 individuals associated with DZ Mafia have been arrested, and 600 incarcerated, police say.
paras.zh: 警方称，自 2024 年以来，约有 1,000 名与 DZ 黑手党有关联的人被捕，600 人被监禁。

paras.en: But overall, it is a battle that is becoming more arduous, rather than easier.
paras.zh: 但总体而言，这场战斗正在变得更加艰巨，而不是变得容易。

paras.en: As gangs seek to widen their operations, or replace members who have been arrested or killed, social media has become a potent recruitment tool - especially since the Covid pandemic, when many street-drug sales jumped online.
paras.zh: 随着帮派寻求扩大其活动范围，或替换已被捕或被杀的成员，社交媒体已成为一种有效的招募工具——尤其是自新冠疫情大流行以来，许多街头毒品销售在网上激增。

paras.en: On social media, we found countless posts advertising jobs in Marseille for aspiring drivers, couriers and hitmen, often with glamourised AI-generated images.
paras.zh: 在社交媒体上，我们发现无数帖子在马赛为有抱负的司机、快递员和杀手做广告，这些帖子通常带有人工智能生成的迷人图像。

paras.en: Nets are also being cast wider, as it becomes harder to entice young people locally because they know more about what might happen to them.
paras.zh: 网络也正在扩大，因为吸引当地的年轻人变得更加困难，因为他们更了解自己可能会发生什么。

paras.en: The ads can reach teenagers in most corners of France - including Paris, Nantes and Lille - and serve as a powerful pull to Marseille, and the Quartier Nord, police say.
paras.zh: 警方称，这些广告可以覆盖法国大部分地区的青少年，包括巴黎、南特和里尔，并对马赛和北区产生强大的吸引力。

paras.en: Online advertising has also changed the typical profile of someone who would join a gang's ranks, say law enforcement officials.
paras.zh: 执法官员表示，在线广告还改变了加入帮派行列的人的典型形象。

paras.en: Now, it is often someone without a criminal past, but who has exploitable vulnerabilities, like having a difficult family life.
paras.zh: 现在，通常是没有犯罪记录但有可利用弱点的人，例如家庭生活困难。

paras.en: "These people are recruited by unscrupulous sponsors who send them into the lion's den," explains Thibaut Fontaine, the head of France's anti-organised-crime unit.
paras.zh: 法国反有组织犯罪部门负责人蒂博·方丹（Thibaut Fontaine）解释说：“这些人是由不择手段的赞助商招募的，他们将他们送入狮穴。”

paras.en: Their lack of criminal experience, he says, makes them easier to arrest quickly.
paras.zh: 他说，他们缺乏犯罪经验，这使得他们更容易迅速被捕。

paras.en: Karine still has no idea why her son, Hugo, was shot.
paras.zh: 卡琳仍然不知道为什么她的儿子雨果被枪杀。

paras.en: Asked what she would say to gang leaders recruiting children and young men in Marseille, she says: "They destroy families. Little sisters, little brothers, grandparents. But then, I don't think those people have a heart, really."
paras.zh: 当被问及她对马赛招募儿童和年轻人的帮派头目有何看法时，她说：“他们摧毁了家庭。小姐妹、小兄弟、祖父母。但是，我认为这些人真的没有良心。”

paras.en: The restaurant where her son said he was going to work did exist, but staï¬ there told Karine they had never recruited anyone called Hugo.
paras.zh: 她儿子说他要去工作的那家餐厅确实存在，但那里的员工告诉卡琳，他们从未招募过叫雨果的人。

paras.en: The reason for his death almost certainly lies within Marseille's Quartier Nord.
paras.zh: 几乎可以肯定，他的死亡原因就在马赛北区。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Marianne Baisnee, Lea Guedj and Paul Pradier
paras.zh: Marianne Baisnee、Lea Guedj 和 Paul Pradier 的补充报道

articles.title: Jensen Huang: Silicon Valley superstar engulfed by personal scandal

paras.en: Jensen Huang is one of the technology industry's most high-profile figures.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋是科技行业最引人注目的人物之一。

paras.en: He rose to prominence as the business he leads - artificial intelligence (AI) chip giant Nvidia - became one of the world's most valuable companies.
paras.zh: 随着他领导的人工智能 (AI) 芯片巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 成为全球最有价值的公司之一，他声名鹊起。

paras.en: As the face of the AI boom, Huang also became close to Donald Trump as the president pushed for the US to keep its dominance of the technology over China.
paras.zh: 作为人工智能热潮的代言人，随着唐纳德·特朗普总统推动美国保持对中国的技术主导地位，黄仁勋也与特朗普关系密切。

paras.en: The 63-year-old who was once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech" and referred to as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan is now mired in scandal after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 这位曾被誉为“科技界泰勒·斯威夫特”、在台湾被称为“黄爸爸”的 63 岁老人，如今因与一名疑似中国间谍有染而深陷丑闻。

paras.en: Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US.
paras.zh: 黄1963年出生于台湾，九岁时全家搬到了美国西海岸。

paras.en: He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University.
paras.zh: 他毕业于俄勒冈州立大学电气工程师，随后在斯坦福大学获得同一领域的硕士学位。

paras.en: Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia.
paras.zh: 黄先生随后在美国芯片公司 AMD 工作，之后与他人共同创立了 Nvidia。

paras.en: He has an estimated fortune of $155bn, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index.
paras.zh: 根据彭博亿万富翁指数，他的财富估计为 1,550 亿美元。

paras.en: "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine - a biography on Huang, tells the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today.
paras.zh: “黄仁勋是像史蒂夫·乔布斯这样的技术梦想家，”黄仁勋传记《思考机器》一书的作者史蒂芬·威特 (Stephen Witt) 告诉 BBC，并补充说他负责创建我们今天所知的人工智能硬件。

paras.en: Huang has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang.
paras.zh: 黄与特朗普的关系是出了名的密切。最近在白宫举行的人工智能峰会上，有 42 名科技高管出席，总统的两侧是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和黄仁勋。

paras.en: Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，自调查消息传出以来，他还没有与英伟达老板交谈过。

paras.en: "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country".
paras.zh: 特朗普对记者说：“我只知道他是一个好人，但你永远不知道发生了什么。”他还补充说，他“为我们的国家做了一项了不起的工作”。

paras.en: Huang has long found himself at the centre of US-China tensions. Trump has repeatedly said the two nations are in a race for dominance.
paras.zh: 黄长期以来发现自己处于美中紧张局势的中心。特朗普多次表示，两国正在争夺主导地位。

paras.en: Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities.
paras.zh: 特朗普曾说过“谁赢得人工智能，谁就获胜”，人们担心的是，如果中国在人工智能方面占据上风，它将增强该国的军事和监视能力。
