paras.en: In 2023, the European Space Agency released the first images from its Euclid space telescope, which was designed to observe deep space in the hopes of unlocking the mysteries of the universe.
paras.zh: 2023年，欧洲航天局发布了其欧几里得太空望远镜的第一批图像，该望远镜旨在观测深空，以期解开宇宙之谜。

paras.en: In 2024, the eight bells of Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris rang out for the first time since a fire damaged the roof and spire of the historic church five years earlier. The historic building officially reopened a month later.
paras.zh: 2024年，巴黎圣母院的八钟钟声自五年前一场火灾烧毁这座历史悠久的教堂的屋顶和尖塔以来首次敲响。一个月后，这座历史建筑正式重新开放。

articles.title: Saudi Aramco building damaged in Houthi attack on Riyadh

paras.en: Nov. 8 (UPI) -- A building belonging to Saudi Arabia's state-run energy energy company Aramco sustained damage Sunday in an attack in Riyadh, the Ministry of Energy said.
paras.zh: 11月8日（合众社）——沙特阿拉伯能源部表示，周日，沙特阿拉伯国营能源公司阿美石油公司的一栋建筑在利雅得的一次袭击中遭到破坏。

paras.en: The ministry described the incident as "an attempted attack" in a statement posted to X.
paras.zh: 该部在发布给 X 的一份声明中将这一事件描述为“一次未遂袭击”。

paras.en: "The incident resulted in falling shrapnel that caused minor damage to the building, with no injuries or fatalities reported, thankfully," the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“这起事件导致弹片坠落，对建筑物造成轻微损坏，幸运的是没有人员伤亡的报告。”

paras.en: Video verified by CNN showed the building with damage to several floors, including blown-out windows.
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）核实的视频显示，该建筑的几层楼都遭到损坏，其中窗户被炸毁。

paras.en: A New York Times reporter in Riyadh described one floor of the building as severely damaged.
paras.zh: 利雅得的《纽约时报》记者称，该建筑的一层受到严重损坏。

paras.en: The Saudi Civil Defense issued an early-warning alert ahead of the attack on the King Abdullah Financial District.
paras.zh: 沙特民防部门在阿卜杜拉国王金融区遭受袭击之前发布了预警警报。

paras.en: The Houthi rebels in Yemen claimed responsibility, saying it was one of multiple attacks on Aramco sites. They also said they targeted Saudi ground forces in Yemen.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞叛乱分子声称对此事负责，称这是针对沙特阿美石油公司工地的多起袭击之一。他们还表示，他们的目标是沙特驻也门的地面部队。

paras.en: Saudi has supported the Yemeni government in its 12-year-long civil war with the Houthis, who are backed by Iran.
paras.zh: 沙特支持也门政府与胡塞武装进行长达12年的内战，胡塞武装得到伊朗的支持。

articles.title: Trains collide in Egypt, killing at least 7

paras.en: Nov. 8 (UPI) -- Two trains collided in Egypt on Sunday, killing at least seven people and injuring dozens, health officials said.
paras.zh: 11 月 8 日（UPI）——卫生官员称，周日两列火车在埃及相撞，造成至少 7 人死亡、数十人受伤。

paras.en: The Egyptian National Railways Authority said the crash site was between the Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations about 35 miles south of Cairo. The collision happened when a train traveling southwest from Giza to the Fayoum oasis struck the rear of another train traveling from Cairo to Aswan.
paras.zh: 埃及国家铁路局表示，坠机地点位于开罗以南约 35 英里的卡夫阿马尔车站和拉卡车站之间。事故发生时，一列从吉萨向西南开往法尤姆绿洲的火车与另一列从开罗开往阿斯旺的火车尾部相撞。

paras.en: The collision killed seven people and injured 112 others, the Egyptian Minister of Health and Population said. Injuries ranged from minor bruises and abrasions to more serious bone fractures, lacerations, and bruising to the chest and ribs.
paras.zh: 埃及卫生和人口部长表示，此次碰撞造成 7 人死亡、112 人受伤。受伤范围从轻微的瘀伤和擦伤到更严重的骨折、撕裂以及胸部和肋骨的瘀伤。

paras.en: The ministry said ambulances transported the injured to multiple area hospitals. Of those hospitalized, 45 were discharged.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，救护车已将伤者送往多个地区医院。住院患者中，45 人已出院。

paras.en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said he directed government agencies to provide care to those injured and to investigate the circumstances of the crash.
paras.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西表示，他指示政府机构为伤者提供护理，并调查坠机情况。

paras.en: "I am following the aftermath of the train collision with great concern and extend my deepest condolences to the families of those who lost their lives, along with my sincere wishes for a speedy recovery for the injured," he said in a statement on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 日的一份声明中表示：“我非常关注火车相撞事件的后果，并向遇难者家属表示最深切的哀悼，并衷心祝愿伤者早日康复。”

paras.en: The Egyptian Red Crescent society said it directed team members from four governorates to the site to support the injured and their families.
paras.zh: 埃及红新月会表示，已指示四个省份的工作人员前往现场，为伤者及其家人提供支持。

articles.title: Alanis Morissette Shares She Identifies as Pansexual
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Alanis Morissette identifies as pansexual, she revealed in a podcast appearance earlier this week. The hitmaker — who just dropped her first holiday album, Good Weather for Immaculate Conception, featuring new single “To an Empath at Christmas Time” — visited the Handsome Podcast as the podcast trio’s first in-person guest for an episode that was uploaded on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 艾拉妮丝·莫莉塞特 (Alanis Morissette) 在本周早些时候的播客节目中透露，她是一名泛性恋者。这位热门音乐制作人刚刚推出了她的第一张假日专辑《Good Weather for Immaculate Conception》，其中收录了新单曲“To an Empath at Christmas Time”。她作为播客三人组的第一位现场嘉宾访问了 Handsome Podcast，并观看了 11 月 3 日上传的一集节目。

paras.en: “I’m sorry for the men that hurt you, but I’m not sorry for the songs that came from it. Those are pretty amazing,” comedian Fortune Feimster, who co-hosts the show with Tig Notaro and Mae Martin, said at one point toward the end of the episode, adding, “Did it make you want to be a lesbian at any point?”
paras.zh: “我为那些伤害你的男人感到抱歉，但我并不为其中的歌曲感到抱歉。那些真是太棒了，”与蒂格·诺塔罗和梅·马丁共同主持该节目的喜剧演员福琼·费姆斯特在剧集接近尾声时说道，并补充道，“这是否让你在任何时候都想成为一名女同性恋？”

paras.en: “I’m pansexual, so yeah,” Morissette shared in reply. “I get everything.”
paras.zh: “我是泛性恋，所以是的，”莫莉塞特回答道。 “我得到了一切。”

paras.en: GLAAD defines someone who identifies as pansexual as “a person who has the capacity to form enduring physical, romantic, and/ or emotional attractions to any person, regardless of gender identity.” The term is different than the term bisexual, which means that a person is attracted to people of more than one gender (whereas pansexual means gender is not a determining factor in attraction).
paras.zh: GLAAD 将泛性恋定义为“有能力对任何人形成持久的身体、浪漫和/或情感吸引力的人，无论性别认同如何。”该术语与双性恋一词不同，双性恋意味着一个人会被多种性别的人所吸引（而泛性恋则意味着性别不是吸引力的决定因素）。

paras.en: Notaro then asked, “Wait, you’re not really pansexual, are you?” to which Morissette confirmed, “I am.”
paras.zh: 诺塔罗接着问道：“等等，你并不是真正的泛性恋者，是吗？”莫莉塞特确认道：“我是。”

paras.en: Joking that they should’ve launched the episode with this tidbit, Notaro said, “How did I not know this?”
paras.zh: 诺塔罗开玩笑说他们应该用这个花絮来启动这一集，他说：“我怎么不知道这一点？”

paras.en: “You know, I like to leave it for the epilogue,” quipped Morissette. “I like to confuse people on the way out. Is it confusing?”
paras.zh: “你知道，我喜欢把它留到尾声，”莫里塞特打趣道。 “我喜欢在出去的时候迷惑别人。这让人迷惑吗？”

paras.en: Morissette, who’s got three Billboard 200 No. 1 albums under her belt and whose top hit “Ironic” soared to No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1996, is married to husband Mario Treadway, aka the artist Souleye. The couple wed in 2010 and are parents to three children.
paras.zh: Morissette 拥有三张 Billboard 200 排名第一的专辑，其热门单曲《Ironic》于 1996 年在 Billboard Hot 100 中飙升至第四位，她的丈夫 Mario Treadway（又名艺术家 Souleye）已结婚。这对夫妇于 2010 年结婚，是三个孩子的父母。

paras.en: Her 14-track holiday album, Good Weather for Immaculate Conception, arrived on Friday (Nov. 6). The set was led by her recording of “Beautiful Star of Bethlehem,” featuring Brandi Carlile and Steve Martin; Morissette gets snowed-in in a music video for second single “To an Empath at Christmas Time,” released on Saturday.
paras.zh: 她的 14 首歌曲假日专辑《Good Weather for Immaculate Conception》已于周五（11 月 6 日）上市。该系列以她录制的“美丽的伯利恒之星”为主导，与布兰迪·卡莱尔和史蒂夫·马丁合作；莫莉塞特在周六发布的第二首单曲《圣诞节时的同理心》的音乐视频中大放异彩。

paras.en: “The lights are green and red and shimmering white/ These days are super dark and even quieter nights/ All this time to sense what all year felt not right/ Nothing to distract us from this heavy ride,” she sings on the opening of the midtempo “Empath.”
paras.zh: “灯光是绿色、红色和闪烁的白色/这些天非常黑暗，甚至是更安静的夜晚/一直以来都在感受这一整年感觉不对劲的地方/没有什么可以分散我们对这段沉重旅程的注意力，”她在中速“Empath”的开头唱道。

paras.en: On the song’s chorus, Morissette says, “You don’t have to smile big for us/ Nor have a joyous time/ You won’t have to hold your breath until New Year time/ Your precious sensitivity has felt like curse and crime/ But you’re not alone with your SOS inside/ To an empath at Christmas time.”
paras.zh: 在这首歌的副歌部分，莫莉塞特说：“你不必为我们大笑/也不必享受欢乐时光/你不必屏住呼吸直到新年/你宝贵的敏感感觉就像诅咒和犯罪/但你并不孤单，心里有你的求救信号/在圣诞节期间有同理心。”

paras.en: Watch her full conversation on the Handsome Podcast below.
paras.zh: 在下面的帅气播客中观看她的完整对话。

articles.title: The Strokes Get a Surprise Visit From Walton Goggins During ‘SNL’ Performance: Watch
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: The Strokes rocked Saturday Night Live with two new songs and a surprise appearance by Walton Goggins.
paras.zh: The Strokes 凭借两首新歌和沃尔顿·戈金斯的惊喜亮相，震撼了《周六夜现场》。

paras.en: The New York City rock band appeared during the Druski-hosted episode on Nov. 7, performing “Lonely in the Future” and “Going Shopping,” both featured on its seventh studio album, Reality Awaits, which arrived in July.
paras.zh: 这支纽约摇滚乐队出现在 11 月 7 日 Druski 主持的节目中，表演了《Lonely in the Future》和《Going Shopping》，这两首歌曲均收录在其 7 月发行的第七张录音室专辑《Reality Awaits》中。

paras.en: For their first performance, the Julian Casablancas-led quintet delivered “Lonely in the Future” against a backdrop of psychedelic visuals and elaborate lighting. Following the performance, the band released the song’s official music video, which features a cast of handcrafted puppets created in collaboration with the team behind the British satirical series Spitting Image.
paras.zh: 在他们的首场演出中，朱利安·卡萨布兰卡斯领导的五重奏在迷幻的视觉效果和精致的灯光背景下表演了《未来的孤独》。演出结束后，乐队发布了这首歌的官方音乐视频，其中展示了与英国讽刺剧《Spitting Image》背后的团队合作制作的手工木偶演员阵容。

paras.en: The group closed its SNL musical guest appearance with “Going Shopping,” which featured a surprise appearance by actor Goggins. Dressed in an all-black suit and sunglasses, the Fallout star joined the band on bongos, reprising his role in the song’s music video.
paras.zh: 该乐队以《Going Shopping》结束了《周六夜现场》音乐剧客串演出，其中演员戈金斯惊喜现身。这位《辐射》明星身穿全黑西装，戴着墨镜，敲着邦戈鼓加入了乐队，再次扮演了他在歌曲音乐录影带中的角色。

paras.en: Saturday’s appearance marked The Strokes’ fourth time as musical guests on SNL. The band made its debut on the NBC sketch comedy show in January 2002, followed by performances in 2006 and 2011.
paras.zh: 周六的亮相标志着 The Strokes 第四次作为 SNL 的音乐嘉宾。乐队于 2002 年 1 月在 NBC 喜剧小品节目中首次亮相，随后于 2006 年和 2011 年进行了演出。

paras.en: The Strokes are currently promoting Reality Awaits, which debuted at No. 13 on the all-genre Billboard 200 and No. 5 on the Top Rock & Alternative Albums chart.
paras.zh: The Strokes 目前正在宣传《Reality Awaits》，该专辑首次亮相就在 Billboard 200 各类专辑中排名第 13 位，在顶级摇滚和另类专辑排行榜上排名第 5。

paras.en: The nine-track set was recorded in Costa Rica with legendary producer Rick Rubin, who previously worked with the act on its 2020 album, The New Abnormal.
paras.zh: 这首包含 9 首曲目的专辑是由传奇制作人 Rick Rubin 在哥斯达黎加录制的，他曾在 2020 年专辑《The New Abnormal》中与该表演合作过。

paras.en: SNL is back Nov. 14 with fan favorite John Mulaney returning to host and Phoebe Bridgers taking the stage as musical guest.
paras.zh: 《SNL》将于 11 月 14 日回归，深受粉丝喜爱的约翰·木兰尼 (John Mulaney) 回归主持，菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers) 登台担任音乐嘉宾。

articles.title: Janusz Kaminski, the Polish Cameraman Who Taught Hollywood How to See
articles.author: Scott Roxborough

paras.en: Like pretty much every great cinematographer, Janusz Kamiński is Polish. As much as any single artist of his generation, he has also taught Hollywood how to see.
paras.zh: 和几乎所有伟大的电影摄影师一样，雅努什·卡明斯基 (Janusz Kamiński) 是波兰人。与他这一代的任何一位艺术家一样，他也教会了好莱坞如何观看。

paras.en: But there was a lot of longing in that gray. “Poland is a very lyrical country, to some degree,” he says. “There’s that melancholy, that certain wish for something else.” Theater troupes passed through, and the local cinema promised a world beyond the town. “We were exposed to work that we didn’t experience in real life, but we wanted to experience,” Kamiński says. “The primary reason I left home is because of the theater and movies, and a life of color.”
paras.zh: 但那灰色里却蕴藏着很多渴望。 “在某种程度上，波兰是一个非常抒情的国家，”他说。 “有一种忧郁，一种对别的东西的某种渴望。”剧团经过这里，当地的电影院向人们展示了城外的世界。 “我们接触到了现实生活中没有经历过的工作，但我们想体验一下，”卡明斯基说。 “我离开家的主要原因是因为戏剧和电影，以及丰富多彩的生活。”

paras.en: Kamiński left Poland as a political refugee in 1981, dreaming of American movies. He spoke no English. Landing in Chicago, he spent two years learning the language and then enrolled part-time at Columbia College. In an introductory filmmaking class, he found himself in a group of five. “We had to each pick: One would be the writer, one the actor, one the director, one the producer, and one the cinematographer,” he recalls. “We literally picked straws. I got cinematography. I was 22.”
paras.zh: 1981 年，卡明斯基作为政治难民离开波兰，梦想着美国电影。他不会说英语。抵达芝加哥后，他花了两年时间学习这门语言，然后在哥伦比亚学院兼职。在电影制作入门课程中，他发现自己属于五人小组。 “我们必须各自选择：一名是​​编剧，一名是演员，一名是导演，一名是制片人，一名是摄影师，”他回忆道。 “我们真的是捡了一根稻草。我得到了电影摄影。我当时 22 岁。”

paras.en: It was love at first sight. “I found out I really enjoyed creating images. It was just fascinating for me to see the flickering image on 16 mm black and white,” he says. “Just that mystery: Will it be in focus? Will it be properly exposed? Will it have a story?” A professor told him he was good at it and should keep going. “This is not a sad story, but it was the first time anyone every told me I was good at something,” says Kamiński. “In Poland, when I grew up, nobody’s parents said that kind of thing. It was: You have food, you eat, you’re good.”
paras.zh: 这是一见钟情。 “我发现我真的很喜欢创作图像。在 16 毫米黑白上看到闪烁的图像对我来说真是太有趣了，”他说。 “就是这个谜：它会成为焦点吗？它会被适当曝光吗？它会有故事吗？”一位教授告诉他，他很擅长，应该继续下去。 “这不是一个悲伤的故事，但这是第一次有人告诉我我擅长某件事，”卡明斯基说。 “在波兰，当我长大的时候，没有人的父母说过这样的话。那就是：你有食物，你吃，你很好。”

paras.en: All his classmates at Columbia wanted to direct, so Kamiński shot their movies. He loaded a station wagon with equipment every weekend and made student films, and picked up commercial work as a camera assistant, an electrician and a grip. One commercial spot a month would pay $250. “My rent was $280, so I was doing good,” he says. “I had a job, and for an immigrant, it’s essential that we support ourselves, because there was no mommy, no daddy, no cousins.”
paras.zh: 他在哥伦比亚大学的所有同学都想执导，所以卡明斯基拍摄了他们的电影。他每个周末都会在旅行车上装上设备，拍摄学生电影，并担任摄影助理、电工和握把等商业工作。 One commercial spot a month would pay $250. “我的房租是 280 美元，所以我过得很好，”他说。 “我有一份工作，对于一个移民来说，我们必须养活自己，因为没有妈妈，没有爸爸，没有表兄弟姐妹。”

paras.en: In the early days, The Hollywood Reporter came to his aid. Back then, in the back of the magazine, THR ran lists of movies going into production, including location shoots. “That’s how I got my first jobs, through The Hollywood Reporter,” says Kamiński. “I’d look at that films listed and I wouldn’t call on a Tom Cruise movie, but if it was something like Bambis from Hell, I’d call the producer up and say ‘Hi, my name is Janusz Kamiński. I’m a cinematographer. Would you like to look at my work? I got my first two features from that.”
paras.zh: 早期，《好莱坞报道》对他提供了帮助。当时，THR 在杂志的背面列出了即将制作的电影清单，其中包括外景拍摄。 “这就是我通过《好莱坞报道》获得第一份工作的方式，”卡明斯基说。 “我会看列出的电影，不会选择汤姆·克鲁斯的电影，但如果是《地狱斑比斯》之类的电影，我会打电话给制片人，说‘嗨，我叫贾努什·卡明斯基。我是一名电影摄影师。你想看一下我的作品吗？我的前两部作品就是从中得到的。”

paras.en: Kaminski knew Chicago would not get him to Hollywood. “Most of the movies that would originate in California would come into Chicago and use secondary crew members,” he says. “I don’t want to be secondary.” His girlfriend filled out an application to the American Film Institute, and he was accepted. “That was 1986/87. I moved to California, another place I’d never been to. I had no car.” He rented a place within walking distance of campus.
paras.zh: 卡明斯基知道芝加哥不会把他带到好莱坞。 “大多数源自加州的电影都会进入芝加哥并使用辅助剧组人员，”他说。 “我不想成为次要的。”他的女朋友向美国电影学院填写了一份申请，他被录取了。 “那是 1986/87 年。我搬到了加利福尼亚，另一个我从未去过的地方。我没有车。”他在校园步行范围内租了一个地方。

paras.en: A classmate’s husband, a cinematographer, was shooting a movie for Roger Corman and needed a key grip. Kamiński took the job. “Meanwhile, the gaffer quit. So I said, I like lighting. Let me. So I became the gaffer.” He kept shooting second unit and small independent films while he finished school.
paras.zh: 一位同学的丈夫是一名电影摄影师，正在为罗杰·科曼拍摄一部电影，需要一个关键的抓手。卡明斯基接受了这份工作。 “与此同时，灯光师辞职了。所以我说，我喜欢灯光。让我吧。所以我就成了灯光师。”完成学业后，他继续拍摄第二单元和小型独立电影。

paras.en: The real break came through his demo reel. A friend of a friend was Diane Keaton’s assistant. “He shows my demo reel, my student film demo reel, to Diane Keaton and, suddenly, I have a job shooting for Diane Keaton.” The film was Wildflower, a period TV movie with Patricia Arquette and Beau Bridges. Steven Spielberg saw it and offered Kaminski another TV gig, Class of ‘61, a pilot Spielberg was producing. The show, about West Point cadets on the eve of the Civil War, didn’t get picked up. But Spielberg liked what he saw. When the pilot wrapped, the two men met. “He says, ‘I’d like you to film my next movie. I’m doing a black and white movie called Schindler’s List. Would you be interested?’”
paras.zh: 真正的突破来自他的演示卷。朋友的朋友是黛安·基顿的助理。 “他向黛安·基顿展示了我的演示片，我的学生电影演示片，突然之间，我得到了为黛安·基顿拍摄的工作。”这部电影是《野花》，一部由帕特丽夏·阿奎特和博·布里奇斯主演的时代电视电影。史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格看到了，并为卡明斯基提供了另一部电视节目《Class of ‘61》，这是斯皮尔伯格正在制作的试播集。这部关于内战前夕西点军校学员的节目没有得到关注。但斯皮尔伯格喜欢他所看到的。试播集结束后，两人相遇了。 “他说，‘我想让你帮我拍下一部电影。我正在拍一部黑白电影，名叫《辛德勒的名单》。你有兴趣吗？’”

paras.en: Spielberg first went off to do Jurassic Park. “It took him eight to nine months to finish editing,” Kamiński recalls. “All that time I knew I had a job coming with Steven Spielberg. But nobody believed me. Only when I shot the movie, it became reality.”
paras.zh: 斯皮尔伯格首先去拍摄《侏罗纪公园》。 “他花了八到九个月的时间才完成编辑，”卡明斯基回忆道。 “一直以来，我都知道我会得到史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的一份工作。但没有人相信我。只有当我拍摄这部电影时，这才成为现实。”

paras.en: With Spielberg, Kamiński went home to Poland. The film he shot there, full of the gray light and smoky streets he had grown up in, changed how Hollywood shot history. He says the two of them barely discussed the visual style beforehand. “We knew it would be shot in Poland and be black-and-white, but we didn’t have a deep, in-depth conversation about how we’re going to make this movie,” he recalls. “We just wanted to strip away anything that would take us away from the story, so there was no crane, no dolly and no Steadicam. I brought in the idea of using handheld.”
paras.zh: 卡明斯基和斯皮尔伯格一起回到了波兰的家乡。他在那里拍摄的电影充满了他长大的灰色灯光和烟雾缭绕的街道，改变了好莱坞拍摄历史的方式。他说他们两人事先几乎没有讨论过视觉风格。 “我们知道这部电影将在波兰拍摄，并且是黑白的，但我们没有就如何制作这部电影进行深入的讨论，”他回忆道。 “我们只是想去掉任何让我们脱离故事的东西，所以没有起重机，没有移动车，也没有斯坦尼康。我引入了使用手持设备的想法。”

paras.en: Schindler’s List won Kamiński his first Oscar for Best Cinematography. Saving Private Ryan won him a second. The script for that film, he points out, contained one sentence about the landing at Normandy: “Now the troops land at Normandy. That’s it. So as a cinematographer, you have to create the language that corresponds to the story, to the emotions, to the sets and the locations.” What he and Spielberg came up with, all handheld, drained of color and chaotic, rewrote the language of the war movie.
paras.zh: 《辛德勒的名单》为卡明斯基赢得了他的第一个奥斯卡最佳摄影奖。 《拯救大兵瑞恩》为他赢得了第二个机会。他指出，这部电影的剧本中有一句话是关于诺曼底登陆的：“现在军队在诺曼底登陆了。就是这样。所以作为一名电影摄影师，你必须创造出与故事、情感、布景和地点相对应的语言。”他和斯皮尔伯格想出的全手持式、色彩枯燥、混乱的作品改写了战争电影的语言。

paras.en: Shooting Julian Schnabel’s The Diving Bell and the Butterfly, Kamiński took another phenomenal visual approach to depict the story of a man with locked-in syndrome, only able to see the world through a single functioning eye. In the film, won Camerimage’s Golden Frog honor in 2007, the lens shifts sharply in and out of focus, blurring most of the field of vision while some details pop with intense clarity.
paras.zh: 在拍摄朱利安·施纳贝尔的《潜水钟与蝴蝶》时，卡明斯基采用了另一种非凡的视觉方法来描绘一个患有闭锁综合症的人的故事，他只能通过一只正常的眼睛看世界。在这部荣获 2007 年 Camerimage 金蛙奖的影片中，镜头急剧地进出焦点，模糊了大部分视野，而一些细节却异常清晰。

paras.en: “The script, and the book it was based on, are great,” says Kamiński, but provided little guidance. “The whole description is: ‘The hero returns from darkness, from being unconscious for the last two weeks, and starts seeing the world through one eye.’ That’s it.”
paras.zh: “剧本和它所依据的书都很棒，”卡明斯基说，但几乎没有提供任何指导。 “整个描述是：‘英雄从黑暗中回来，从过去两周的昏迷中回来，开始用一只眼睛看世界。’就是这样。”

paras.en: Despite certain aesthetic preferences — ”I do like strong light, particularly backlight, I like characters in half-light, going into and out of the shadows. I like smoke” he says — Kamiński does not have a signature look. His approach is film follows function. Cold blues and metallic shadows to evoke the tech-dystopia of Minority Report. Retro pastels and smooth tracking shots to make the 60s swing in Catch Me If You Can. Grainy, handheld shots of muted oranges and browns in Munich to give the story the feel of a 1970s conspiracy thriller.
paras.zh: 尽管有一定的审美偏好——“我确实喜欢强光，特别是背光，我喜欢半光下的角色，进出阴影。我喜欢烟雾”，他说——但卡明斯基并没有标志性的外观。他的方法是电影追随功能。冷蓝色和金属阴影让人想起《少数派报告》中的科技反乌托邦。复古柔和的色彩和流畅的追踪镜头让《Catch Me If You Can》充满了 60 年代的风格。慕尼黑柔和的橙色和棕色的手持颗粒状镜头给这个故事带来了 20 世纪 70 年代阴谋惊悚片的感觉。

paras.en: The Kamiński/Spielberg collaboration, which now stretches over 30 years and more than 20 films, has to count as one of the most significant artistic collaborations in American cinema history. His work with Kamiński marks the second phase of Spielberg’s career, as the director moved from glossy, classical Hollywood imagery, sharp lights and bright colors, to a grittier, more naturalistic style, appropriate to the more mature, morally-ambivalent stories he wanted to tell.
paras.zh: 卡明斯基和斯皮尔伯格的合作现已持续 30 多年，拍摄了 20 多部电影，堪称美国电影史上最重要的艺术合作之一。他与卡明斯基的合作标志着斯皮尔伯格职业生涯的第二阶段，这位导演从光鲜亮丽的经典好莱坞形象、锐利的灯光和明亮的色彩转向更坚韧、更自然的风格，适合他想要讲述的更成熟、道德上矛盾的故事。

paras.en: Kamiński does not claim credit for the director’s evolution. “Steven was not ready to do Schindler’s List until he was ready,” he says. “He was moving that way and I entered his life at the right point where he was able to accept the aesthetics I gave him and embrace them. I think what he saw in me was someone new with a new point of view, someone who wasn’t biased by Hollywood, with a fresh approach. He saw me as a partner. And I saw him as a partner.”
paras.zh: 卡明斯基并没有将导演的进步归功于他。 “史蒂文在准备好之前还没有准备好拍摄《辛德勒的名单》，”他说。 “他就是这样走的，我在正确的时间点进入了他的生活，他能够接受我赋予他的美学并拥抱它们。我认为他在我身上看到的是一个具有新观点的新人，一个不受好莱坞偏见、采用新鲜方法的人。他将我视为合作伙伴。我也将他视为合作伙伴。”

paras.en: The partnership continues on Spielberg’s latest, Disclosure Day, which has Kamiński working in a different register. “As I’m getting older, things are becoming more simplistic,” he says. “I want to go slightly more reserved, relaxed.”
paras.zh: 这种合作关系在斯皮尔伯格最新的《披露日》中继续进行，卡明斯基在这一天以不同的方式工作。 “随着年龄的增长，事情变得越来越简单，”他说。 “我想要稍微保守一点、放松一点。”

paras.en: For the film, a sci-fi thriller about aliens, but set in the present day, he says he aimed for “something more naturalistic, more contemporary.” In one scene, in a safe house, a gray, very direct light comes through the window, slightly green, with a little flare in the background. “It’s got austerity in the images,” Kamiński says, “and that comes from growing up in Poland, with the images from my childhood.”
paras.zh: 这部电影是一部关于外星人的科幻惊悚片，但背景设定在当今，他说他的目标是“更自然、更现代的东西”。在一个场景中，在一个安全屋里，一束灰色的、非常直射的光从窗户射进来，略带绿色，背景中有一点耀斑。卡明斯基说：“这些图像中有一种朴素的感觉，这来自于我在波兰长大的经历，以及我童年时期的图像。”

paras.en: Next up is another collaboration with Spielberg, on an untitled Western, the director’s first, which Spielberg hopes to shoot next year. Kamiński is already imagining the landscape, drawing, as always, from the world he grew up in.
paras.zh: 接下来是与斯皮尔伯格的另一次合作，拍摄一部未命名的西部片，这是导演的第一部作品，斯皮尔伯格希望明年拍摄。卡明斯基已经开始想象风景，一如既往地从他成长的世界中汲取灵感。

paras.en: “We used to go to this region in the Sudeten Mountains, where it was just beautiful, rolling hills, looked like parts of Montana,” he says. “The lay of the land, the snow on the ground, the fog.” All these elements exist in America too, he acknowledges, but “those who shoot American movies tend to come from somewhere else, and we see these same things differently. That’s why there’s room in this profession for men and women from different countries who bring different aesthetics to American movies.”
paras.zh: “我们曾经去过苏台德山脉的这个地区，那里风景优美，连绵起伏的山丘，看起来就像蒙大拿州的一部分，”他说。 “地形、地上的雪、雾。”他承认，所有这些元素在美国也存在，但“那些拍摄美国电影的人往往来自其他地方，我们对同样的事情有不同的看法。这就是为什么这个行业有空间容纳来自不同国家的男人和女人，他们为美国电影带来了不同的美学。”

articles.title: THR Visionary: 5 Janusz Kaminski Shots
articles.author: Scott Roxborough

paras.en: Try to find a signature Janusz Kaminski “look” and you’ll come up empty. Yes, he likes backlighting and has a penchant for smoke and film-noir style. But the Polish-born cameraman, winner of the 2026 THR Visionary Award for excellence in cinematography, has spent three decades making images that bend to the story rather than the other way around.
paras.zh: 尝试寻找 Janusz Kaminski 标志性的“造型”，你会一无所获。是的，他喜欢逆光，并且喜欢烟雾和黑色电影风格。但这位出生于波兰的摄影师因出色的摄影而获得了 2026 年 THR 远见奖，他花了三十年的时间拍摄与故事相关的图像，而不是相反。

paras.en: Kaminski’s guiding principle is that form follows function. With lenses, film stocks, color palettes and camera movement chosen to serve what each film needs to tell its story. The result is a body of work remarkable for its originality and visual diversity. Here are five of Kaminski’s most original visions.
paras.zh: 卡明斯基的指导原则是形式服从功能。选择镜头、胶片、调色板和摄影机运动来满足每部电影讲述故事的需要。其结果是一系列以其原创性和视觉多样性而引人注目的作品。以下是卡明斯基最原始的五个愿景。

paras.en: Steven Spielberg’s Holocaust drama was shot in stark black-and-white. The choice wasn’t nostalgic but a way of conjuring newsreels and documentary record, with a handheld immediacy that keeps the audience in the room with the horror. Kaminski’s hard, contrasty lighting, harsh shadows and drifting smoke owe a debt to German Expressionism and postwar European cinema. Against this monochrome, the lone splash of color, the little girl’s red coat, lands as one of the most devastating images in modern film. It won him his first Oscar.
paras.zh: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的大屠杀剧情片是用纯黑白色拍摄的。这个选择并不是怀旧，而是一种召唤新闻片和纪录片的方式，通过手持的即时性让观众留在房间里，感受恐怖。卡明斯基的硬朗、对比鲜明的灯光、刺眼的阴影和飘逸的烟雾归功于德国表现主义和战后欧洲电影。与这种单色相反，小女孩的红色外套，孤独的色彩飞溅，成为现代电影中最具破坏性的图像之一。这为他赢得了第一座奥斯卡奖。

paras.en: For the Omaha Beach landing and the war that follows, Kaminski set out to make combat look like frontline footage rather than a Hollywood spectacle. Colors are leached out to a washed, metallic palette. He stripped protective coatings from his lenses to invite flare and a rawer, less polished image, and used a narrow shutter angle that makes explosions and bullet strikes snap with a jittery, staccato clarity. Handheld cameras and spattered lenses put the viewer on the sand with the soldiers. The look was so influential that it reshaped how war was filmed for a generation, and it earned him a second Oscar.
paras.zh: 对于奥马哈海滩登陆和随后的战争，卡明斯基着手让战斗看起来像前线镜头，而不是好莱坞奇观。颜色被浸出到水洗的金属调色板中。他剥去了镜头上的保护涂层，以引入眩光和更原始、不那么抛光的图像，并使用狭窄的快门角度，使爆炸和子弹击中的画面呈现出紧张、断断续续的清晰度。手持相机和飞溅的镜头让观众和士兵们一起站在沙滩上。这种造型影响深远，重塑了一代人的战争拍摄方式，并为他赢得了第二座奥斯卡奖。

paras.en: The Diving Bell and the Butterfly (2007)
paras.zh: 潜水钟与蝴蝶 (2007)

paras.en: In Julian Schnabel’s adaptation of Jean-Dominique Bauby’s memoir, written by a man paralyzed but for one eyelid, the camera becomes that eye. Kaminski opens the film from Bauby’s first-person perspective: blurred focus, tilted frames, sudden blinks and a claustrophobic narrowness of vision that gradually widens. As Bauby’s imagination takes flight, so does the imagery. Soft, luminous pastels and sunlit memories of Paris and the seaside offer escape from the hospital room. It’s an exercise in subjective cinematography that earned Kaminski an Oscar nomination.
paras.zh: 朱利安·施纳贝尔 (Julian Schnabel) 改编自让·多米尼克·鲍比 (Jean-Dominique Bauby) 的回忆录，该回忆录的作者是一位瘫痪但只有一只眼皮的男子，相机变成了那只眼睛。卡明斯基从鲍比的第一人称视角开始影片：焦点模糊、画面倾斜、突然眨眼以及逐渐变宽的幽闭恐惧症般的狭窄视野。随着鲍比的想象力飞扬，图像也随之飞扬。柔和、明亮的粉彩和巴黎和海边的阳光记忆让您远离病房。卡明斯基凭借主观摄影的表现获得了奥斯卡提名。

paras.en: If Saving Private Ryan rejected glossy spectacle, War Horse embraced it on purpose. Spielberg and Kaminski drew on the sweeping, painterly look of classic Hollywood Westerns and epics, with John Ford and David Lean in mind. Anamorphic widescreen frames showcase burnished golds, glowing skies and silhouetted figures against vast landscapes, giving the First World War tale a storybook romanticism before the mud and horror close in. It’s lush, deliberately old-fashioned and entirely suited to a story told through the eyes of a horse. It was another Oscar-nominated turn.
paras.zh: 如果说《拯救大兵瑞恩》拒绝华丽的场面，那么《战马》则有意拥抱它。斯皮尔伯格和卡明斯基借鉴了经典好莱坞西部片和史诗片的广阔、绘画般的外观，并考虑到了约翰·福特和大卫·里恩。变形宽银幕画面在广阔的风景中展现出闪亮的金色、发光的天空和剪影人物，在泥泞和恐怖逼近之前，为第一次世界大战的故事赋予了故事书般的浪漫主义色彩。它郁郁葱葱，刻意老式，完全适合通过马的眼睛讲述的故事。这是又一个获得奥斯卡提名的作品。

paras.en: For Spielberg’s tense thriller about the aftermath of the 1972 Olympics massacre, Kaminski looked to the gritty, paranoid cinema of the 1970s. The film has a grainy, slightly faded texture with muted, earthy colors, and frequently uses zoom lenses, a hallmark of the era’s thrillers, to create a sense of surveillance and unease. The images feel period-authentic without becoming pastiche, and their rough-edged restraint keeps the focus on the moral toll of the mission.
paras.zh: 在斯皮尔伯格这部讲述 1972 年奥运会大屠杀后果的紧张惊悚片中，卡明斯基着眼于 1970 年代坚韧、偏执的电影。这部电影具有颗粒感、略显褪色的质感，色彩柔和、朴实，并频繁使用变焦镜头（这是那个时代惊悚片的标志），以营造一种监视和不安的感觉。这些图像给人一种真实的感觉，但又不会成为模仿，它们的粗糙克制让人们把注意力集中在任务的道德代价上。

articles.title: How Democrats will try to end Trump's tariffs

paras.en: The battle for Congress is over. The war over President Donald Trump's tariffs is about to heat up.
paras.zh: 国会之争已经结束。围绕唐纳德·特朗普总统关税的战争即将升温。

paras.en: The knotted web of tariffs that Trump spent the last two years weaving could soon face its biggest threat, as Democrats prepare to unload their new legislative firepower against the Republican president's signature policy.
paras.zh: 随着民主党准备对共和党总统的标志性政策动用新的立法火力，特朗普过去两年编织的关税网可能很快就会面临最大的威胁。

paras.en: Democrats have made no secret of their plans to bombard Trump and his associates with investigations as soon as the next Congress is sworn in. They are also preparing a first-100-hours legislative blitz, putting forward a series of bills that would unwind much of Trump's agenda.
paras.zh: 民主党人毫不掩饰他们计划在下一届国会宣誓就职后立即对特朗普及其同伙进行调查。他们还准备发起首个100小时的立法闪电战，提出一系列法案，以消除特朗普的大部分议程。

paras.en: Both prongs of attack will take aim at Trump's unprecedented use of tariffs, which Democrats have quickly identified as a main target following their landslide victory in Tuesday's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 两方面的攻击都将针对特朗普前所未有地使用关税，民主党在周二中期选举中取得压倒性胜利后，很快将关税确定为主要目标。

paras.en: Ending Trump's tariff regime, and especially his trade war against Canada, is something Democrats "absolutely have to do immediately," Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed, D-Mich., told MS NOW's "Morning Joe" Thursday.
paras.zh: 密歇根州民主党参议员当选参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔·赛义德周四对 MS NOW 的《早安乔》节目表示，结束特朗普的关税制度，特别是他对加拿大的贸易战，是民主党人“绝对必须立即采取的行动”。

paras.en: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York, the Democratic minority leader who could be elected House speaker in the next Congress, has made clear that ending Trump's tariffs is a top priority.
paras.zh: 纽约州众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）是民主党少数党领袖，可能在下届国会当选众议院议长，他明确表示，结束特朗普的关税是当务之急。

paras.en: "We should restore congressional authority as it relates to tariffs, because the Trump tariffs are making life more expensive for the American people," he said at a press conference in late August.
paras.zh: 他在八月底的新闻发布会上表示：“我们应该恢复国会在关税方面的权威，因为特朗普的关税让美国人民的生活变得更加昂贵。”

paras.en: If picked as speaker, Jeffries would speed legislation to the House floor that reasserts congressional authority over trade.
paras.zh: 如果被选为议长，杰弗里斯将加快立法进程，重申国会对贸易的权威。

paras.en: Democrats are also laying the groundwork for investigations into Trump's tariffs, which the party folded into its winning campaign message linking high costs with alleged Trumpworld corruption.
paras.zh: 民主党人还在为调查特朗普的关税奠定基础，该党将关税纳入其获胜的竞选信息中，将高成本与所谓的特朗普世界腐败联系起来。

paras.en: Rep. Jamie Raskin of Maryland, the top Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee, on Oct. 28 asked Trump to hand over records related to tariff exemptions. Trump, Raskin alleges, has wielded the exemption power to cut "sweetheart deals" for industries whose leaders have plied the president with gifts.
paras.zh: 众议院司法委员会民主党领袖、马里兰州众议员杰米·拉斯金 (Jamie Raskin) 10 月 28 日要求特朗普交出与关税豁免相关的记录。拉斯金声称，特朗普利用豁免权，为那些领导人不断向总统赠送礼物的行业达成“甜心交易”。

paras.en: The plans are likely to ratchet up the pressure, both legally and politically, that Trump's tariffs were already facing.
paras.zh: 这些计划可能会加剧特朗普关税已经面临的法律和政治压力。

paras.en: The administration is already embroiled in multiple lawsuits challenging different parts of the government's tariff policy.
paras.zh: 政府已经卷入多起诉讼，挑战政府关税政策的不同部分。

paras.en: The most recent suit, filed Oct. 20, targets Trump's use of a Great Depression-era law to impose 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods.
paras.zh: 最近的诉讼于 10 月 20 日提起，针对特朗普利用大萧条时期的法律对一系列加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税。

paras.en: Another court case accuses Trump of trying to recreate the near-global "liberation day" tariffs that the Supreme Court struck down as illegal in late February. The administration has since been ordered to refund $166 billion in tariff revenue it had collected under the scrapped policy.
paras.zh: 另一起法庭案件指控特朗普试图重现近乎全球的“解放日”关税，最高法院在二月底裁定该关税为非法。此后，政府被勒令退还根据取消的政策征收的 1,660 亿美元关税收入。

paras.en: Congress, not the president, holds the power to levy taxes under the U.S. Constitution. Over decades, the legislative branch has ceded some of those powers to the executive. But Trump has asserted virtually unchecked tariff powers – which Democrats say they are intent on clawing back.
paras.zh: 根据美国宪法，国会而不是总统拥有征税权。几十年来，立法部门已将其中一些权力让给了行政部门。但特朗普声称拥有几乎不受限制的关税权力 — — 民主党人表示他们打算收回这种权力。

paras.en: "Every day Trump insists on his indiscriminate taxes on so many of the products Americans need, he digs a deeper hole for Republicans enabling his tariff spree," said Sen. Ron Wyden of Oregon, who is poised to lead the Senate Finance Committee when Democrats take it over.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州参议员罗恩·怀登(Ron Wyden)表示，“特朗普每天都坚持对美国人需要的如此多的产品不加区别地征税，他就为共和党人挖了一个更深的坑，让他的关税狂潮得以实现。”民主党接手参议院财务委员会后，他将担任该委员会的主席。

paras.en: "If Democrats somehow had a veto-proof majority, or if voters shame Republicans into doing the right thing, there would be no shortage of trade policies to address," Wyden said in a statement to CNBC before Election Day.
paras.zh: 怀登在选举日之前向 CNBC 发表的一份声明中表示：“如果民主党以某种方式获得了无法否决的多数席位，或者如果选民羞辱共和党做出正确的事情，那么就不乏需要解决的贸易政策。”

paras.en: "One of the most obvious priorities would be repealing Trump's tariffs on Canada, which are raising prices and harming communities on both sides of the border," he said. "I'll also continue to work to ensure Congress has the final say on tariffs, so future presidents can't reenact Trump's economically disastrous trade taxes."
paras.zh: 他说：“最明显的优先事项之一是废除特朗普对加拿大的关税，这导致价格上涨并损害了边境两侧的社区。” “我还将继续努力确保国会对关税拥有最终决定权，这样未来的总统就不能重蹈特朗普的经济灾难性贸易税的覆辙。”

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal, citing Wyden, reported Thursday that Democrats are eyeing the Canada trade war as the "first target" in their efforts against his tariff agenda.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周四援引怀登的话报道称，民主党人将加拿大贸易战视为反对其关税议程的“首要目标”。

paras.en: As Wyden's statement suggested, the Senate's rules will hamper Democrats' anti-tariff efforts.
paras.zh: 正如怀登的声明所暗示的那样，参议院的规则将阻碍民主党的反关税努力。

paras.en: Despite their blowout victory Tuesday night, the party will still lack a 60-vote filibuster-proof majority in the Senate, giving Republicans a crucial tool to block legislation even in their diminished state.
paras.zh: 尽管周二晚取得了压倒性胜利，但该党在参议院仍缺乏 60 票的阻挠议事多数席位，这为共和党人提供了一个重要的工具来阻止立法，即使在他们的状态已经衰落的情况下。

paras.en: Trump is also poised to lean heavily on his veto pen in the next Congress, presenting a major obstacle for Democrats' legislative priorities.
paras.zh: 特朗普还准备在下一届国会严重依赖他的否决权，这对民主党的立法优先事项构成了重大障碍。

paras.en: Overriding a presidential veto requires two-thirds majorities in both the House and Senate, meaning that even with their historic electoral gains, Democrats would need significant Republican help to force a bill into law over Trump's objection.
paras.zh: 推翻总统否决需要众议院和参议院三分之二多数票，这意味着即使民主党取得了历史性的选举胜利，民主党仍需要共和党的大力帮助，才能在特朗普的反对下将一项法案强制付诸法律。

paras.en: Democrats may consider it worthwhile to pass legislation even if Trump vetoes it, as doing so could help them build political narratives in the 2028 election cycle. But they may have other options available.
paras.zh: 即使特朗普否决，民主党人也可能认为通过立法是值得的，因为这样做可以帮助他们在 2028 年选举周期中构建政治叙事。但他们可能还有其他选择。

paras.en: "Absent the brute force of a veto-proof coalition, Congress might consider other political solutions, such as adding riders on 'must-pass' bills or negotiation with the administration," Kit Johnson, a senior tax manager for BDO's customs and international trade group, told CNBC in an email.
paras.zh: BDO 海关和国际贸易集团高级税务经理基特·约翰逊 (Kit Johnson) 在一封电子邮件中告诉 CNBC：“如果没有不可否决的联盟的强力力量，国会可能会考虑其他政治解决方案，例如在‘必须通过’法案上增加附加条款或与政府进行谈判。”

paras.en: Trump has said he plans to use the veto power to force Democrats to the negotiating table. But when it comes to tariffs, it's hard to imagine what deal Trump might accept.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他计划利用否决权迫使民主党坐到谈判桌前。但在关税方面，很难想象特朗普会接受什么协议。

paras.en: Trump has tried to reshape U.S. trade, foreign and economic policy around his asserted power to slap steep duties on imported goods. He describes tariffs as a win-win, praising them as both a powerful negotiating tool and a major revenue generator.
paras.zh: 特朗普试图围绕他声称的对进口商品征收高额关税的权力重塑美国的贸易、外交和经济政策。他将关税描述为双赢，称赞它们既是强大的谈判工具，又是主要的收入来源。

paras.en: After Tuesday's election, Trump seemed to suggest tariffs were non-negotiable.
paras.zh: 周二大选后，特朗普似乎暗示关税是不可谈判的。

paras.en: "If I took tariffs off — we have 3,000 plants under construction right now. Every single plant would stop building," Trump told CNBC's Eamon Javers in a phone call Wednesday.
paras.zh: “如果我取消关税，我们现在有 3,000 座工厂在建。每座工厂都将停止建设，”特朗普周三在电话中告诉 CNBC 的埃蒙·贾弗斯 (Eamon Javers)。

paras.en: Since taking office in January 2025, Trump has hiked tariffs on nearly every country on the planet, leading to multiple protracted trade wars, most notably against Canada and China. He insists Americans do not share the burden of the duties, even though tariffs by definition are taxes on foreign goods paid by those importing them. The nonprofit Tax Foundation estimates Trump's tariffs have raised the average U.S. household's tax burden by $820 in 2026.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 1 月上任以来，特朗普对地球上几乎每个国家都提高了关税，导致多起旷日持久的贸易战，尤其是针对加拿大和中国的贸易战。他坚称美国人不分担关税负担，尽管关税的定义是对进口外国商品征收的税。非营利组织税务基金会估计，特朗普的关税到 2026 年将导致美国家庭平均税负增加 820 美元。

paras.en: Trump has also consistently overstated the amount of revenue the government has amassed through his tariffs. He claimed before Election Day that tariffs enabled him to offer every U.S. adult $5,000 "dividend" checks if Republicans were to win both chambers of Congress – a plan that would cost roughly $1.2 trillion. But the duties – which are collected from U.S. importers – have only brought in around $300 billion in total between January 2025 and July 2026, according to the Penn Wharton Budget Model.
paras.zh: 特朗普还一贯夸大政府通过关税获得的收入数额。他在选举日之前声称，如果共和党赢得国会参众两院，关税使他能够向每个美国成年人提供 5,000 美元的“红利”支票 — — 该计划将耗资约 1.2 万亿美元。但根据宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院预算模型，这些向美国进口商征收的关税在 2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 7 月期间总共只带来了约 3000 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: What's more, about $138 billion of that total has been refunded since the Supreme Court ruling in February. Nearly $20 billion in tariff collections are still set to be refunded.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，自最高法院 2 月份裁决以来，其中约 1,380 亿美元已被退还。近 200 亿美元的关税仍待退还。

paras.en: Most voters do not share Trump's rosy view of tariffs. Sixty-five percent of respondents to the CNBC Voter Poll on Nov. 3 said the duties have hurt the U.S. economy, while just 22% say they helped.
paras.zh: 大多数选民并不认同特朗普对关税的乐观看法。 11 月 3 日 CNBC 选民民意调查中，65% 的受访者表示关税损害了美国经济，而只有 22% 的受访者表示有帮助。

paras.en: What remains to be seen is how hard Republicans in Congress will push back on Democrats' efforts.
paras.zh: 仍有待观察的是国会中的共和党人将如何努力反击民主党的努力。

paras.en: A number of GOP lawmakers came out against the duties during the campaign, as their opponents gained ground blaming inflation on Trump's tariffs and the Iran war.
paras.zh: 一些共和党议员在竞选期间站出来反对关税，因为他们的对手将通货膨胀归咎于特朗普的关税和伊朗战争。

paras.en: As they try to regroup and look forward to the 2028 election cycle, some Republicans – who largely supported free trade prior to Trump's political rise – may be less willing to continue aligning themselves with Trump's aggressive protectionism.
paras.zh: 当一些共和党人试图重组并展望 2028 年的选举周期时，他们在特朗普政治崛起之前主要支持自由贸易，他们可能不太愿意继续与特朗普激进的保护主义结盟。

articles.title: Poland mourns victims of Krakow mass shooting as security fears grow

paras.en: Poland began two days of national mourning on Sunday and police bolstered security after six people were killed in a mass shooting in the southern city of Krakow that the government said was likely inspired by far-right ideology.
paras.zh: 波兰南部城市克拉科夫发生大规模枪击事件，造成六人死亡，波兰周日开始为期两天的全国哀悼，警方称这起枪击事件可能是受到极右意识形态的影响。

paras.en: Saturday's attack in the city's historic main square shocked a country that has prided itself on being safer than many of its Western European neighbors, deepening public concern following a string of school stabbings in October that officials linked to extremist content online.
paras.zh: 周六发生在这座城市历史悠久的主广场的袭击事件震惊了这个自诩比许多西欧邻国更安全的国家，继10月份发生的一系列学校持刀伤人事件加深了公众的担忧，官员们将这些事件与网上的极端主义内容联系起来。

paras.en: Sixteen people were wounded in the attack, including two police officers and the suspected gunman, a 24-year-old Polish man who remained in a critical condition in hospital, local authorities said.
paras.zh: 地方当局称，袭击造成 16 人受伤，其中包括两名警察和一名 24 岁波兰男子，枪手嫌疑人仍在医院，情况危急。

paras.en: Krakow's old town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site that attracts visitors from around the globe, and several foreigners were among the casualties.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫的老城区被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产，吸引了来自世界各地的游客，伤亡者中有几名外国人。

paras.en: One of the people who died was identified as a British citizen and another as Austrian, while five foreign nationals from Austria, Germany, Portugal, Russia and Britain were among the wounded.
paras.zh: 其中一名死者是英国公民，另一名是奥地利人，伤者中有五名来自奥地利、德国、葡萄牙、俄罗斯和英国的外国人。

paras.en: In the suspect's hometown, Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski, about 200 km (124 miles) north of Krakow, police later found the bodies of his parents and sister at his home.
paras.zh: 在嫌疑人的家乡奥斯特罗维茨维托科日斯基（Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski），克拉科夫以北约 200 公里（124 英里）处，警方后来在他的家中发现了他父母和妹妹的尸体。

paras.en: Prosecutor's Office spokesperson Daniel Prokopowicz said it was "highly likely" that the killings in Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski and Krakow were carried out by the same person, but that investigations were ongoing.
paras.zh: 检察官办公室发言人丹尼尔·普罗科波维奇表示，奥斯特罗维茨维托科日斯基和克拉科夫的杀戮“极有可能”是同一人所为，但调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: The three bodies found there had gunshot wounds, and seven firearms and a "significant" quantity of ammunition were recovered from the property, Prokopowicz added.
paras.zh: 普罗科波维奇补充说，在那里发现的三具尸体都有枪伤，并从该财产中发现了七支枪支和“大量”弹药。

paras.en: Some nationalist politicians questioned a statement by Interior Minister Marcin Kierwinski on Saturday that the attack was likely inspired by far-right ideology.
paras.zh: 一些民族主义政界人士对内政部长马尔辛·基尔文斯基(Marcin Kierwinski)周六发表的声明提出质疑，该声明称此次袭击可能是受到极右意识形态的启发。

paras.en: "If Kierwinski has misinformed the public, he should face political consequences. We demand immediate explanations and access to information what he had based his statements on," Przemyslaw Czarnek, deputy head of the conservative opposition PiS party, wrote on X.
paras.zh: “如果基尔温斯基误导了公众，他应该面临政治后果。我们要求立即做出解释，并获取他的言论所依据的信息，”保守派反对派 PiS 党副主席 Przemyslaw Czarnek 在 X 上写道。

paras.en: The suspect belonged to a shooting club, but little more information about him has come to light so far.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人属于一个射击俱乐部，但到目前为止，有关他的更多信息还没有曝光。

paras.en: In Krakow, the old town's main market square — one of Europe's largest medieval squares — and the surrounding streets remained closed, with police allowing only essential workers to pass. Many nearby cafes were closed and flags at the city hall were at half-mast. Mourners placed candles in several locations in the area.
paras.zh: 在克拉科夫，老城区的主要集市广场（欧洲最大的中世纪广场之一）和周围的街道仍然关闭，警察只允许必要的工作人员通过。附近的许多咖啡馆都关门了，市政厅也下半旗志哀。哀悼者在该地区的多个地点放置了蜡烛。

paras.en: The traditional hourly trumpet call from St Mary's church on the square was suspended for 12 hours to commemorate the dead, the first time this has happened since 1939, state news agency PAP reported.
paras.zh: 据国家通讯社人民行动党报道，广场上的圣玛丽教堂每小时吹响的传统喇叭声暂停了 12 个小时，以纪念死者，这是自 1939 年以来的第一次。

paras.en: In the capital, Warsaw, police said on Saturday they were strengthening security measures in busy areas popular with tourists. Barriers were installed on streets leading onto the Krakowskie Przedmiescie street in the historic heart of the capital.
paras.zh: 在首都华沙，警方周六表示，他们正在加强受游客欢迎的繁忙地区的安全措施。位于首都历史中心的通往克拉科夫市中心的街道上安装了路障。

paras.en: In Krakow, locals and tourists spoke of their shock on Sunday.
paras.zh: 在克拉科夫，当地人和游客周日谈到了他们的震惊。

paras.en: "This is terrible for me, that (this) can happen in Poland because it's never happened like this in Poland... I think that this can be a new era in my country," local resident Witold Slowikowski said.
paras.zh: 当地居民维托尔德·斯洛维科夫斯基 (Witold Slowikowski) 表示：“这对我来说太可怕了，波兰可能会发生这种情况，因为波兰从来没有发生过这样的事情……我认为这可能会成为我国家的一个新时代。”

paras.en: In Warsaw, Maria, a 20-year-old cafe employee, said she "almost burst into tears" when she heard about the shooting.
paras.zh: 在华沙，20 岁的咖啡馆员工玛丽亚说，当她听到枪击事件时，她“几乎哭了”。

paras.en: "Recent events — not just this one, but things happening lately — are really affecting our sense of security," she said.
paras.zh: “最近发生的事件——不仅仅是这件事，还有最近发生的事情——确实影响了我们的安全感，”她说。

paras.en: Leading daily newspaper Rzeczpospolita said in an editorial that the mass shooting brought a "brutal end to an era in which Poland was considered an island of safety."
paras.zh: 领先的日报《共和国报》在一篇社论中表示，大规模枪击事件“残酷地结束了波兰被视为安全岛的时代”。

paras.en: Officials and members of the public also praised the actions of police officers who apprehended the gunman, who was armed with a semi-automatic rifle.
paras.zh: 官员和公众也赞扬了警察逮捕持半自动步枪的枪手的行动。

paras.en: The two officers, who sustained gunshot wounds while overpowering the gunman after a close-range shootout, have regained consciousness, a regional government official told a press conference. Both had undergone surgery.
paras.zh: 当地政府官员在新闻发布会上表示，这两名警察在近距离枪战中制服枪手时受枪伤，目前已恢复知觉。两人都接受了手术。

paras.en: Prime Minister Donald Tusk praised their bravery. "They likely saved many human lives, disregarding the risk to their own," he said on Saturday in a post on X.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·图斯克总理赞扬了他们的勇敢。 “他们可能拯救了许多人的生命，却无视自己面临的风险，”他周六在 X 上发帖称。

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces bipartisan congressional scrutiny over reported China spy link

paras.en: Lawmakers from both sides of the aisle are ramping up calls for investigations into reports of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Some are also questioning what the Trump administration knew about the matter.
paras.zh: 两党立法者都在加大力度呼吁对英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍关系的报道进行调查。一些人还质疑特朗普政府对此事了解多少。

paras.en: "The more I learn about the insane relationship between the Trump Administration, Chinese spies, and AI billionaires, the more I'm convinced there is nothing this administration does that isn't corrupt," Sen. Chris Coons, D-Del., posted on X on Saturday. "Congress will investigate and get answers."
paras.zh: “我对特朗普政府、中国间谍和人工智能亿万富翁之间的疯狂关系了解得越多，我就越相信这届政府所做的一切都是腐败的，”特拉华州民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 周六在 X 上发帖称。 “国会将调查并得到答案。”

paras.en: Coons is in line to chair the Senate Foreign Relations Committee when his party takes control of the chamber in January.
paras.zh: 当他的政党在一月份控制参议院时，库恩斯将担任参议院外交关系委员会主席。

paras.en: Three House Republican committee chairs sent a letter to Huang on Wednesday requesting that he sit for a closed-door briefing with lawmakers on Nov. 18, a day after the company is scheduled to report third-quarter earnings.
paras.zh: 周三，三位众议院共和党委员会主席致信黄仁勋，要求他在 11 月 18 日（该公司计划公布第三季度收益的第二天）与议员们举行闭门简报会。

paras.en: "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the [People's Republic of China's] access to sensitive U.S. technology and information," the GOP lawmakers wrote in a letter to Huang.
paras.zh: 共和党议员在给黄的信中写道：“最近的报告引发了有关中华人民共和国获取美国敏感技术和信息的重大国家安全担忧。”

paras.en: The reports refer to Huang's alleged relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based tech company that the U.S. has suspected of helping China circumvent artificial intelligence chip sales prohibitions.
paras.zh: 这些报道提到黄与中国公民、新加坡科技公司 Megaspeed 的高管 Alice Huang 之间的关系，美国怀疑该公司帮助中国规避人工智能芯片销售禁令。

paras.en: Policymakers in the Trump administration received a memo last spring with intelligence identifying Alice Huang as having been recruited by China's Ministry of State Security and revealing her relationship with Nvidia's chief executive, The New York Times first reported on Friday.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》周五首次报道，特朗普政府的政策制定者去年春天收到了一份备忘录，其中有情报显示黄爱丽已被中国国家安全部招募，并透露了她与英伟达首席执行官的关系。

paras.en: When asked by the Times whether Huang would appear before lawmakers to discuss the matter, Nvidia spokesman John Rizzo declined to comment. "Our chief executive has an outstanding security team that accompanies him where needed," Mr. Rizzo said in a statement to the Times.
paras.zh: 当《纽约时报》询问黄仁勋是否会出现在立法者面前讨论此事时，英伟达发言人约翰·里佐拒绝置评。里佐在给《纽约时报》的一份声明中表示：“我们的首席执行官拥有一支出色的安全团队，可以在需要时陪伴他。”

paras.en: Rizzo said the Nvidia CEO's interactions with Ms. Huang were consistent with meetings he has had with any of Nvidia's customers, the Times reported.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，里佐表示，英伟达首席执行官与黄女士的互动与他与英伟达客户的会面一致。

paras.en: Separately, Texas Republican Sen. John Cornyn shared a Times article published Saturday reporting that the Trump administration approved a Chinese firm, New Matrix, to assemble chips for Nvidia in Beijing. The Times found little evidence of meaningful operations at its listed address, despite Trump's Commerce Department clearing it for national security risks.
paras.zh: 另外，得克萨斯州共和党参议员约翰·科宁 (John Cornyn) 分享了周六发表的《泰晤士报》文章，报道称特朗普政府批准了一家中国公司 New Matrix 在北京为 Nvidia 组装芯片。尽管特朗普商务部清除了该地址的国家安全风险，但《纽约时报》几乎没有发现其所列地址有任何有意义的运营的证据。

paras.en: Cornyn called the report "outrageous" in his post on X.
paras.zh: 科宁在 X 上的帖子中称这份报告“令人愤慨”。

paras.en: Rep. Seth Magaziner, D-R.I., who sits on the House Committee on Homeland Security, called on Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify before Congress along with Huang.
paras.zh: 众议院国土安全委员会成员、罗德岛州众议员赛斯·马加齐纳 (Seth Magaziner) 呼吁商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 与黄一起在国会作证。

paras.en: Neither Nvidia nor the Commerce Department immediately responded to CNBC's request for comment.
paras.zh: 英伟达和商务部均未立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

articles.title: Have astronomers spotted Planet Nine?

paras.en: The outer solar system is getting crowded with theoretical planets.
paras.zh: 外太阳系正变得越来越挤满了理论上的行星。

paras.en: Well, it’s not crowded, exactly. Billions of small rocky, icy bodies orbit the Sun out past Neptune. But space is so vast that they rarely pass within a million kilometers of one another. There’s lots of room out there.
paras.zh: 嗯，确切地说，这里并不拥挤。数十亿个小型岩石冰体围绕太阳运行，经过海王星。但太空是如此广阔，它们很少在相距一百万公里的范围内经过。那里有很多空间。

paras.en: In fact, that’s part of the problem for planet hunters right now: this volume of space is so unimaginably huge and so far away that searching it for even relatively large objects is tricky.
paras.zh: 事实上，这就是目前行星搜寻者面临的部分问题：这个空间体积如此之大，而且如此遥远，以至于在其中寻找即使是相对较大的物体也很棘手。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: That hasn’t stopped astronomers from trying—because it’s entirely possible the outer solar system still harbors a world big enough to measurably alter its surroundings but small enough to have avoided direct detection. Often called Planet Nine—poking fun at professional astronomers’ 2006 demotion of Pluto from being the solar system’s ninth planet—this hypothetical body’s existence has been hotly debated, though that hasn’t slowed the search.
paras.zh: 这并没有阻止天文学家进行尝试——因为太阳系外层仍然存在着一个足够大的世界，足以显着改变其周围环境，但又小得足以避免直接探测到，这是完全有可能的。通常被称为“九号行星”——取笑专业天文学家 2006 年将冥王星从太阳系第九行星的地位降级——这个假想天体的存在引起了激烈的争论，尽管这并没有减缓搜索的步伐。

paras.en: In 2025 an international team of astronomers published a paper in the Publications of the Astronomical Society of Australia reporting a candidate for Planet Nine in the deep trans-Neptunian darkness. The scientists’ claim made a minor splash last year and has enjoyed something of a renaissance recently, thanks to an article in BBC Sky at Night Magazine and social media. Their research is under fire from others, however, including, ironically, a pair of astronomers who were largely responsible for the Planet Nine search in the first place.
paras.zh: 2025 年，一个国际天文学家团队在《澳大利亚天文学会出版物》上发表了一篇论文，报道了海王星深处黑暗中的第九大行星的候选者。科学家们的说法去年引起了不小的轰动，最近又因英国广播公司夜间天空杂志和社交媒体上的一篇文章而得到复兴。然而，他们的研究受到了其他人的批评，讽刺的是，其中包括两位主要负责九号行星搜索的天文学家。

paras.en: What the international team did hearkens back to the days of old, when American astronomer Clyde Tombaugh discovered Pluto in 1930. Others had predicted the existence of a ninth planet (somewhat confusingly referred to as Planet X at the time, with the “X” standing for “mysterious and unknown” rather than the Roman numeral for 10). And using the mathematics of orbital mechanics, those others had predicted where in the sky it might be.
paras.zh: 国际团队所做的事情让人回想起过去，当时美国天文学家克莱德·汤博 (Clyde Tombaugh) 在 1930 年发现了冥王星。其他人曾预测存在第九颗行星（当时被称为 X 行星，有些令人困惑，“X”代表“神秘和未知”，而不是代表 10 的罗马数字）。其他人利用轨道力学的数学原理预测了它可能在天空中的位置。

paras.en: Tombaugh methodically photographed a large area of the sky surrounding that position, night after night, and then compared the images to look for any blip of light that moved against the background stars as such a distant planet should. After months of searching, he found Pluto. As it happens, though, this whole endeavor was a happy accident: the predictions of its position were based on faulty assumptions, so Pluto was, in fact, found by coincidence.
paras.zh: 汤博一夜又一夜有条不紊地拍摄了该位置周围的大片天空，然后比较图像，寻找在背景恒星上移动的任何光点，就像一颗遥远的行星应该发生的那样。经过几个月的寻找，他找到了冥王星。然而，碰巧的是，这整个努力是一个令人愉快的意外：对其位置的预测是基于错误的假设，所以冥王星实际上是巧合发现的。

paras.en: But Tombaugh’s search method is still valid, and we now have much more sophisticated techniques with which to perform it: many modern ground- and space-based telescopes are undertaking wide-area surveys that are stored digitally, making their data much easier to sift through for signs of any slow-moving, distant planet.
paras.zh: 但汤博的搜索方法仍然有效，而且我们现在拥有更复杂的技术来执行它：许多现代地面和太空望远镜正在进行以数字方式存储的广域调查，使他们的数据更容易筛选任何缓慢移动的遥远行星的迹象。

paras.en: Not that it’s easy. For one thing, a planet that far out will be incredibly faint in reflected light because the meager amount that reaches it from the Sun will attenuate even more as that light bounces back from the world into our telescopes on and around Earth. This means the brightness drops as the fourth power of the planet’s distance from us, a seriously steep decline. Even a large planet will be a difficult target.
paras.zh: 但这并不容易。一方面，一颗如此遥远的行星在反射光中会非常微弱，因为从太阳到达它的微量光线会随着光线从世界反射回地球上和地球周围的望远镜而更加衰减。这意味着亮度会随着行星与我们距离的四次方而下降，这是一个严重的急剧下降。即使是一颗大行星也将是一个困难的目标。

paras.en: The math gets better, however, for searches in infrared light: if the otherwise chilly Planet Nine exists, it would still emit such light, making it appear brighter at those wavelengths. So the international team took advantage of that, using data from the Infrared Astronomical Satellite (IRAS), which surveyed the sky in the early 1980s, and the Japanese, space-based AKARI infrared observatory, which operated for about 18 months in 2006 and 2007.
paras.zh: 然而，对于红外光搜索来说，数学会变得更好：如果原本寒冷的九号行星存在，它仍然会发出这样的光，使其在这些波长下显得更亮。因此，国际团队利用了这一点，利用了 20 世纪 80 年代初对天空进行观测的红外天文卫星 (IRAS) 和日本天基 AKARI 红外天文台（在 2006 年和 2007 年运行了约 18 个月）的数据。

paras.en: The two-decade gap between the two missions is a key factor. That’s a long enough baseline for a far-out world to exhibit significant orbital motion. In a nutshell, the researchers looked for objects that only appeared (as blobs of light) at one spot in the IRAS data and at another spot in the AKARI data, possibly indicating motion of the same object across the intervening decades. Moreover, each object in the apparent pairs of detections had to be about the right brightness and move the correct amount for a planet orbiting the Sun several hundred times farther out than Earth.
paras.zh: 两个任务之间的两个十年的差距是一个关键因素。对于遥远的世界来说，这是一个足够长的基线，可以表现出显着的轨道运动。简而言之，研究人员寻找仅在 IRAS 数据中的一个点和 AKARI 数据中的另一个点出现（作为光斑）的物体，这可能表明同一物体在数十年中的运动。此外，对于一颗绕太阳运行的行星来说，明显的探测对中的每个物体都必须具有正确的亮度，并且移动的距离比地球远数百倍。

paras.en: After cross-checking between hundreds of thousands of potential objects in the images, they were able, astonishingly, to narrow their search down to a single candidate. It checked all the right boxes, including the expected motion and brightness. Could this be Planet Nine?!
paras.zh: 在对图像中数十万个潜在物体进行交叉检查后，令人惊讶的是，他们能够将搜索范围缩小到单个候选物体。它检查了所有正确的框，包括预期的运动和亮度。这会是第九行星吗？！

paras.en: One problem is that two points do not a planet a make. In this case, that’s enough for calculating a crude orbit, but at least one more spatially separate point is mathematically necessary to estimate anything about that orbit’s shape.
paras.zh: 一个问题是，两点并不能构成一颗行星。在这种情况下，这足以计算粗略轨道，但在数学上至少需要一个空间上分离的点来估计有关该轨道形状的任何信息。

paras.en: Also, there’s no guarantee these two detections, one in each dataset, come from the same (or any) moving object: these points of light in the data could be false positives. Very faint variable stars changing their brightness and then fading back into obscurity, for example, might also explain either or both points. Supermassive black holes in distant galaxies can flare powerfully, appearing and then disappearing from view as well. While the astronomers did look for potential galaxies in those positions, not finding them doesn’t preclude their existence.
paras.zh: 此外，无法保证这两个检测（每个数据集中都有一个）来自同一（或任何）移动物体：数据中的这些光点可能是误报。例如，非常微弱的变星改变其亮度，然后又重新变得模糊，也可能解释其中一个或两个点。遥远星系中的超大质量黑洞可以发生强烈的耀斑，出现然后从视野中消失。虽然天文学家确实在这些位置寻找潜在的星系，但没有找到它们并不排除它们的存在。

paras.en: Perhaps the biggest problem, though, is the orbit that is implied by the two points. While its shape cannot be determined, its orientation in space can be: a line connecting the two points is a pretty good indicator of how tilted the orbit is with respect to Earth’s (what astronomers call inclination).
paras.zh: 不过，也许最大的问题是这两点所暗示的轨道。虽然它的形状无法确定，但它在空间中的方向可以是：连接两点的线可以很好地指示轨道相对于地球的倾斜程度（天文学家称之为倾角）。

paras.en: This is critical because the search for Planet Nine is motivated primarily by that world’s predicted effects on the orbits of other, smaller objects in the outer solar system. Several large, icy bodies, called trans-Neptunian objects (TNOs), have been found in oddly aligned orbits at large distances from the Sun, when those orbits should instead be randomly oriented in space. One way to explain this peculiar comportment is the existence of a massive planet gravitationally influencing these bodies, coaxing their orbits into a roughly systematic arrangement.
paras.zh: 这一点至关重要，因为寻找第九行星的主要动机是预测该行星对太阳系外其他较小天体轨道的影响。人们在距离太阳很远的地方发现了几个被称为海王星外天体（TNO）的大型冰冷天体，它们的轨道排列得很奇怪，而这些轨道在太空中应该是随机定向的。解释这种奇特行为的一种方法是存在一颗巨大的行星，它对这些天体产生引力影响，迫使它们的轨道形成大致系统的排列。

paras.en: This is what led American astronomers Mike Brown and Konstantin Batygin to concoct their Planet Nine hypothesis in 2016. They’ve been the champions of this hunt ever since and have worked through the math to determine the characteristics of this possible planet, including its physical properties and orbital shape.
paras.zh: 这促使美国天文学家迈克·布朗和康斯坦丁·巴蒂金在 2016 年提出了他们的第九大行星假说。从那时起，他们一直是这场搜寻的冠军，并通过数学来确定这颗可能行星的特征，包括其物理特性和轨道形状。

paras.en: They have found that, for Planet Nine to explain the TNOs, its inclination would have to be 15 to 20 degrees from Earth’s orbital plane. As described in an article in Science, Brown looked at the infrared data and measured the inclination of the international team’s candidate planet: 120 degrees, a wildly divergent angle. That pretty well precludes it from being Planet Nine, even if it’s genuine.
paras.zh: They have found that, for Planet Nine to explain the TNOs, its inclination would have to be 15 to 20 degrees from Earth’s orbital plane.正如《科学》杂志上的一篇文章所述，布朗查看了红外数据并测量了国际团队候选行星的倾角：120 度，这是一个截然不同的角度。 That pretty well precludes it from being Planet Nine, even if it’s genuine.

paras.en: He and Batygin haven’t necessarily discounted the possibility that this candidate is real, but they have pointed out that if it does exist, it isn’t their proposed Planet Nine. Batygin has called it “Planet 8.5.”
paras.zh: 他和巴特金不一定排除这个候选者真实存在的可能性，但他们指出，如果它确实存在，那也不是他们提出的第九大行星。 Batygin 将其称为“Planet 8.5”。

paras.en: What’s really needed here, of course, is more observations. In the 2025 paper, the authors pointed out that the Dark Energy Camera (DECam) can get images that could spot a potential planet, and of course, the Vera C. Rubin Observatory is taking broad and deep images of the sky even now and could possibly reveal the candidate planet’s presence. Rubin’s observations have already, in fact, revealed one possible new world beyond Neptune: a candidate “dwarf planet” announced in October and dubbed 2026 ED138 that is at least 600 km wide and in an approximately 280-Earth-year orbit around the Sun.
paras.zh: 当然，这里真正需要的是更多的观察。在 2025 年的论文中，作者指出，暗能量相机（DECam）可以获得可以发现潜在行星的图像，当然，维拉·C·鲁宾天文台现在仍在拍摄广泛而深入的天空图像，并可能揭示候选行星的存在。事实上，鲁宾的观测已经揭示了海王星之外的一个可能的新世界：一颗于 10 月宣布的候选“矮行星”，被称为 2026 ED138，它至少宽 600 公里，绕太阳运行约 280 个地球年的轨道。

paras.en: But Rubin can take away just as easily as it gives: the telescope’s unique observations could also end up refuting the 2025 claim of a Planet 8.5—and, for that matter, Batygin and Brown’s original proposal for Planet Nine.
paras.zh: 但鲁宾可以像给予一样轻松地带走：望远镜独特的观测结果也可能最终驳斥 2025 年行星 8.5 的说法，以及就此而言，巴特金和布朗最初提出的九号行星的提议。

paras.en: The bottom line is: we don’t know if either of these planets exists, yea or nay. All we can do is keep watching the skies—and keep crunching the numbers.
paras.zh: 底线是：我们不知道这些行星是否存在，是或不。我们所能做的就是继续观察天空并继续计算数字。

articles.title: Acorns—not deer—can predict a rise in Lyme-spreading ticks

paras.en: If you hear “deer tick,” chances are you think “Lyme disease.” The infection spreads when diseased black-legged ticks, often in their young, nymph state, bite unlucky hosts, including humans. These arachnids feed and mate on white-tailed deer, hence the nickname. But if you want to predict the risk of Lyme disease, don’t look at the deer—count acorns instead.
paras.zh: 如果您听到“鹿蜱”，您很可能会想到“莱姆病”。当患病的黑腿蜱虫（通常处于幼虫状态）叮咬包括人类在内的不幸宿主时，感染就会传播。这些蜘蛛以白尾鹿为食并交配，因此得名。但如果你想预测莱姆病的风险，不要看鹿，而要数橡子。

paras.en: That’s the takeaway from a 35-year study of forested areas in New York State, published in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA. The research highlights a chain of events that helps to spread the disease: If red oak acorns are abundant during the fall, more white-footed mice have food to survive the winter, and their population booms the next summer. These mice are ideal hosts for tick larvae, which are far more likely to survive to the nymph stage after feeding on mice than on other animals. Mice are also highly efficient at infecting the ticks that bite them with the Lyme bacterium. The more mice one year, the more tick nymphs the next—and the likelihood of human Lyme infection is largely determined by the number of nymphs near people outdoors.
paras.zh: 这是对纽约州森林地区进行 35 年研究的结果，该研究发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。这项研究强调了有助于传播这种疾病的一系列事件：如果秋天红橡树橡子丰富，更多的白脚老鼠就会有食物来度过冬天，并且它们的数量会在明年夏天激增。这些小鼠是蜱幼虫的理想宿主，蜱幼虫在以小鼠为食后比以其他动物为食后更有可能存活到若虫阶段。小鼠也能高效地用莱姆细菌感染叮咬它们的蜱虫。一年中的老鼠越多，下一年的蜱若虫就越多，而人类感染莱姆病的可能性很大程度上取决于户外人群附近若虫的数量。

paras.en: “We can predict which years will be really bad [for Lyme infections] almost two years in advance based on acorn production,” says Richard Ostfeld, lead study author and a senior scientist at the Cary Institute of Ecosystem Studies in upstate New York.
paras.zh: 纽约州北部卡里生态系统研究所的高级科学家、该研究的主要作者、高级科学家理查德·奥斯特菲尔德 (Richard Ostfeld) 表示：“我们可以根据橡子产量提前近两年来预测哪些年份（莱姆病感染）会真正严重。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The study solidifies earlier work from the same team suggesting that acorns and mice affect the number of tick nymphs, says Columbia University disease ecologist Maria Diuk-Wasser, who wasn’t involved in the study. “Thirty-five years of research on any ecological system is really incredible because long-term studies are very rare in any field, especially in tick-borne diseases,” she says. She notes, however, that the role of deer should not be downplayed. Adult ticks feed on deer blood before laying eggs, so “you can’t have ticks without deer,” Diuk-Wasser says. Indeed, previous research has shown that reducing deer populations to very low levels does limit ticks. But where deer are abundant, as in this study, adding or losing a few animals doesn’t seem to affect tick numbers. She also notes that the study indicates an increase in nymphs but not necessarily in those carrying Lyme bacteria, as ticks may also bite animals that transmit the bacterium less efficiently.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚大学疾病生态学家玛丽亚·迪克-瓦塞尔（Maria Diuk-Wasser）没有参与这项研究，她说，这项研究巩固了同一团队的早期研究成果，即橡子和老鼠会影响蜱若虫的数量。 “对任何生态系统进行三十五年的研究确实令人难以置信，因为长期研究在任何领域都非常罕见，尤其是在蜱传疾病方面，”她说。然而，她指出，鹿的作用不应被低估。成年蜱虫在产卵前以鹿血为食，因此“没有鹿就不可能有蜱虫，”迪克-瓦瑟说。事实上，之前的研究表明，将鹿的数量减少到非常低的水平确实可以限制蜱虫的数量。但在鹿数量较多的地方，就像在这项研究中一样，增加或减少一些动物似乎不会影响蜱虫的数量。她还指出，这项研究表明若虫数量有所增加，但携带莱姆病细菌的若虫数量不一定有所增加，因为蜱虫也可能会叮咬传播莱姆病细菌效率较低的动物。

paras.en: In a further wrinkle, the researchers found that warmer weather increased mouse numbers but decreased nymphal ticks. Diuk-Wasser speculates that in warmer winters ticks might stay active and burn their lipid reserves instead of hibernating, dying before the summer.
paras.zh: 更进一步的是，研究人员发现，温暖的天气增加了老鼠的数量，但减少了若虫蜱虫的数量。迪克-瓦塞尔推测，在温暖的冬季，蜱虫可能会保持活跃并燃烧它们的脂质储备，而不是冬眠，在夏季之前死亡。

paras.en: For now, climate change’s net effect on Lyme disease risk is still unclear. “Climate warming seems to allow the ticks to expand into new areas that were formerly too harsh, but once ticks are established, warming might not cause populations to grow,” Ostfeld says.
paras.zh: 目前，气候变化对莱姆病风险的净影响仍不清楚。奥斯特菲尔德说：“气候变暖似乎使蜱虫能够扩展到以前环境恶劣的新地区，但一旦蜱虫定居，变暖可能不会导致种群数量增长。”

articles.title: Why do some people hear pitch better than others? Internal noise may be the key

paras.en: People who have lived most of their lives blind often have extraordinary hearing abilities. In new research published in the Journal of Neuroscience, my colleagues and I discovered that this ability arises from how their auditory systems are able to more consistently and reliably process sounds compared with people who aren’t blind. And interestingly, sighted musicians seem to enhance their hearing through a similar mechanism.
paras.zh: 一生大部分时间失明的人往往具有非凡的听力。在《神经科学杂志》上发表的新研究中，我和我的同事发现，这种能力源于他们的听觉系统与非盲人相比能够更一致、更可靠地处理声音。有趣的是，有视力的音乐家似乎通过类似的机制来增强听力。

paras.en: Hearing is a complicated process. It involves many stages, starting from how the ears detect sounds and going all the way up to how the brain extracts meaningful information from those sounds.
paras.zh: 听力是一个复杂的过程。它涉及许多阶段，从耳朵如何检测声音开始，一直到大脑如何从这些声音中提取有意义的信息。

paras.en: Different mechanisms are involved, too. You can get better at hearing by being more selective or more consistent. Think of writing the letter “A.” You can practice to make your “A” either more distinguishable from “B” or look more similar to other “A’s” every time you write it. The latter is called internal noise—how consistently your auditory system responds to the same sound over time. The less internal noise you have, the more reliably you can tell similar sounds apart.
paras.zh: 还涉及不同的机制。通过更有选择性或更一致，您可以提高听力。想想写字母“A”。每次写“A”时，你都可以练习让“A”与“B”更容易区分，或者看起来与其他“A”更相似。后者称为内部噪声，即您的听觉系统随着时间的推移对相同声音的响应的一致性。内部噪音越少，您就越能可靠地区分相似的声音。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: We recruited nine individuals who became blind before the age of 2 and 18 sighted individuals. Participants in both groups had varying levels of musical training, giving us an opportunity to examine how musical experience can also affect hearing abilities.
paras.zh: 我们招募了 9 名 2 岁前失明的人和 18 名视力正常的人。两组参与者都接受了不同程度的音乐训练，这让我们有机会研究音乐体验如何影响听力。

paras.en: Participants completed two simple hearing tasks. In one task, they detected a tone presented in background noise, which allowed us to assess how the cochlea in the inner ear processes different sound frequencies. In the other task, they judged which of the two tones had a higher pitch, a task that also relies on how the brain interprets sound information.
paras.zh: 参与者完成了两项简单的听力任务。在一项任务中，他们检测到背景噪音中出现的音调，这使我们能够评估内耳中的耳蜗如何处理不同的声音频率。在另一项任务中，他们判断两种音调中哪一种音调更高，这项任务也依赖于大脑如何解释声音信息。

paras.en: We found that people with early-life blindness were better than sighted people only in the pitch discrimination task. This means that their improved hearing abilities may selectively originate from changes in how their brains process auditory information and not from how their ears detect sounds.
paras.zh: 我们发现，早年失明的人仅在音调辨别任务中比视力正常的人表现更好。这意味着他们听力能力的提高可能有选择地源于大脑处理听觉信息方式的变化，而不是耳朵检测声音的方式的变化。

paras.en: Importantly, we used a mathematical model to better understand what drives differences in pitch discrimination. The model showed that the enhanced ability to tell pitches apart in people with early-life blindness happens by reducing internal noise: more consistent and reliable processing of sounds rather than greater selectivity for different sound frequencies.
paras.zh: 重要的是，我们使用了数学模型来更好地理解是什么导致了音高辨别力的差异。该模型表明，早年失明的人区分音调的能力增强是通过减少内部噪音来实现的：对声音的处理更加一致和可靠，而不是对不同声音频率有更大的选择性。

paras.en: Surprisingly, we found that musical training seems to similarly reduce internal noise. Sighted musicians also responded to sounds more consistently compared with people who neither experienced early-life blindness nor received extensive musical training.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，我们发现音乐训练似乎同样可以减少内部噪音。与那些既没有经历过早年失明也没有接受过广泛音乐训练的人相比，有视力的音乐家对声音的反应也更加一致。

paras.en: Because your brain doesn’t know what kind of sensory environment it’ll encounter when you’re born, it’s equipped with a special ability: to tune its responses to parts of the world that matter to it.
paras.zh: 因为你的大脑不知道你出生时会遇到什么样的感官环境，所以它具有一种特殊的能力：调整对世界上对其重要的部分的反应。

paras.en: This ability helps people see, hear and master new skills as their experiences change, like when children learn to read and when adults learn to identify different bird species. Words and birds have become a meaningful part of their experiences, so their brains are tuned to the new information.
paras.zh: 这种能力可以帮助人们随着经历的变化看到、听到和掌握新技能，例如当孩子学习阅读时以及成人学习识别不同的鸟类时。言语和鸟类已经成为他们经历中有意义的一部分，因此他们的大脑会适应新信息。

paras.en: Our study identifies internal noise as an important factor that facilitates this brain plasticity. There are many ways a person can come to have reduced levels of internal noise, and one is by building a more accurate template for perceiving the world.
paras.zh: 我们的研究发现内部噪音是促进大脑可塑性的一个重要因素。降低内心噪音水平的方法有很多，其中之一就是建立一个更准确的感知世界的模板。

paras.en: It is possible that sensory experience, whether it be being blind or being a musician, might help create and fine-tune the perceptual template relevant for hearing.
paras.zh: 感官体验，无论是盲人还是音乐家，都可能有助于创建和微调与听力相关的感知模板。

paras.en: If sensory experiences and training can tap into the brain’s ability to adapt, researchers may be able to use them to improve perceptual abilities. For example, targeted training to hear sound locations could help people who are beginning to lose vision learn to rely on other senses to navigate.
paras.zh: 如果感官体验和训练可以挖掘大脑的适应能力，研究人员也许可以利用它们来提高感知能力。例如，有针对性的训练来听到声音的位置可以帮助那些开始失去视力的人学会依靠其他感官来导航。

paras.en: However, researchers still don’t know how much training is needed and what aspects of the auditory experience are key to drive behaviorally meaningful changes in the brain.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员仍然不知道需要多少训练，以及听觉体验的哪些方面是驱动大脑发生有意义的行为变化的关键。

paras.en: Another important question is whether and how this brain plasticity varies depending on when someone loses their vision or begins musical training. The brain might have greater plasticity early in development, and how sensory experiences shape the brain may differ in adulthood.
paras.zh: 另一个重要的问题是，这种大脑可塑性是否以及如何变化取决于一个人何时失去视力或开始音乐训练。大脑在发育早期可能具有更大的可塑性，而感官体验如何塑造大脑在成年后可能会有所不同。

paras.en: How far can people push their ability to learn? Can everyone become super listeners with training? If the brain’s plasticity is limited in adulthood, are there ways to reopen the door? And what role does internal noise play in this learning?
paras.zh: 人们可以将自己的学习能力提升到什么程度？通过训练每个人都可以成为超级倾听者吗？如果成年后大脑的可塑性受到限制，有没有办法重新打开这扇门？内部噪音在这种学习中扮演什么角色？

paras.en: Moving forward, our team is interested in understanding whether the enhanced pitch discrimination we saw in people with early-life blindness and sighted musicians extends to more complex, everyday listening.
paras.zh: 展望未来，我们的团队有兴趣了解我们在早年失明的人和视力正常的音乐家中看到的增强的音高辨别力是否会扩展到更复杂的日常听力。

paras.en: This article was first published by The Conversation. Read the original article here.
paras.zh: 本文最初由《对话》发表。在这里阅读原文。

articles.title: Earwax’s surprisingly slippery but sticky properties deters insects
articles.author: Elizabeth Pennisi

paras.en: There are few things more annoying than having a bug fly into your ear. But the body is prepared to fend off these insect invasions, says David Hu, a bioengineer at Georgia Tech.
paras.zh: 没有什么比虫子飞进你的耳朵更烦人的了。但佐治亚理工学院的生物工程师 David Hu 表示，人体已做好抵御这些昆虫入侵的准备。

paras.en: The goop inside our ears may act as a natural insect repellent, Hu’s team reports 28 October in Soft Matter. What we call earwax is not really waxy at all. Instead, the brownish substance absorbs water, a property that might help it regulate moisture in the ear and keep bugs out, the new analysis shows. “[This] familiar biological material may represent a sophisticated physical defense against small arthropods,” says Stanislav Gorb, a functional morphologist at the University of Kiel in Germany, who was not involved with the work.
paras.zh: Hu 的团队于 10 月 28 日在 Soft Matter 杂志上发表报告称，我们耳朵内的粘液可能具有天然驱虫剂的作用。我们所说的耳垢根本不是真正的蜡质。新的分析显示，这种棕色物质会吸收水分，这种特性可能有助于调节耳朵的湿度并防止虫子进入。 “这种熟悉的生物材料可能代表了针对小型节肢动物的复杂物理防御，”德国基尔大学功能形态学家斯坦尼斯拉夫·戈尔布（Stanislav Gorb）说，他没有参与这项工作。

paras.en: Researchers have not studied earwax as much as other body fluids, such as snot, spit or even pee. “It’s a big mystery why we even have [it] in our ears,” Hu says. It can frankly seem like a nuisance. Earwax can build up, clogging earbuds and hearing aids and interfering with hearing, so understanding this substance better may help resolve those problems.
paras.zh: 研究人员对耳垢的研究不如对鼻涕、唾液甚至尿液等其他体液的研究多。 “为什么我们的耳朵里会有它，这是一个很大的谜，”胡说。坦率地说，这看起来很麻烦。耳垢会积聚，堵塞耳塞和助听器并干扰听力，因此更好地了解这种物质可能有助于解决这些问题。

paras.en: Hu and colleagues analyzed the mechanical and chemical properties of 36 earwax samples from pigs, sheep, dogs, cows, rabbits and humans. They also observed how fire ants (Solenopsis invicta) reacted to both natural and synthetic earwax.
paras.zh: Hu 及其同事分析了来自猪、羊、狗、牛、兔子和人类的 36 个耳垢样本的机械和化学特性。他们还观察了火蚁（Solenopsis invicta）对天然和合成耳垢的反应。

paras.en: Even though ants seem able to scale kitchen cabinets with ease to invade countertops, they flounder when they attempt to climb earwax. Hu thinks the earwax sucks moisture from the ants’ feet that helps them grip. But earwax also sticks to ants’ bodies, causing the insects to start grooming incessantly trying to get rid of it. “It’s both sticky and slippery,” Hu says.
paras.zh: 尽管蚂蚁似乎能够轻松地爬过厨房橱柜并侵入工作台面，但当它们试图爬上耳垢时，它们就会陷入困境。胡认为耳垢会吸收蚂蚁足部的水分，帮助它们抓地力。但耳垢也会粘在蚂蚁的身体上，导致蚂蚁开始不断地梳理毛发，试图清除耳垢。 “它既粘又滑，”胡说。

paras.en: The chemical analyses provide some clues about the origins of these properties. Dead skin cells make up 60 percent of earwax, along with a smattering of oils and moisture. The earwax contains pores that Hu believes may be shaped like ink bottles to help it absorb twice its weight in water and prevent water from sloshing around in the ear canal. Like snot, earwax has a huge range of consistencies.
paras.zh: 化学分析提供了有关这些特性起源的一些线索。耳垢的 60% 是由死皮细胞以及少量的油脂和水分组成。胡认为耳垢中含有孔，形状可能像墨水瓶，有助于吸收两倍重量的水，并防止水在耳道中晃动。与鼻涕一样，耳垢也有很大的稠度范围。

paras.en: Under normal conditions, earwax becomes dry and crumbly in about 10 weeks. As it dries, it’s moved outward by a layer of cells lining the ear canal that act as a cleaning conveyor belt. In this way, the ear maintains just the right thickness of earwax to keep insects at bay, Hu says. “It’s most potent when it’s thin,” he explains. “Too much, and the ants can use their tiny claws to grab hold and climb in.”
paras.zh: 正常情况下，耳垢会在大约 10 周内变得干燥且易碎。当它干燥时，它会被耳道内衬的一层细胞向外移动，充当清洁传送带。胡说，通过这种方式，耳朵可以保持适当的耳垢厚度，以防止昆虫进入。 “当它很薄时，它是最有效的，”他解释道。 “太多了，蚂蚁可以用它们的小爪子抓住并爬进去。”

paras.en: Hu admits there’s no practical way to turn earwax into a commercial insect repellent. Each person has a volume of earwax about equivalent to that of a grain of rice in each ear at any given time, says Hu, so even if you add up all the earwax on Earth, “it’s a pretty rare substance.” But, he adds, companies “are trying to come up with biodegradable and biofriendly ways to deal with insects.” And, says Gorb, perhaps earwax “could inspire a new generation of physical, nontoxic pest control surfaces,” that could provide coatings for protecting stored food, agricultural products and technology.
paras.zh: 胡承认没有实际的方法可以将耳垢变成商业驱虫剂。胡说，每个人在任何特定时间每只耳朵中的耳垢量大约相当于一粒米的量，所以即使你把地球上所有的耳垢加起来，“它也是一种非常稀有的物质。”但是，他补充说，公司“正在努力想出可生物降解和生物友好的方法来对付昆虫。”戈尔布说，也许耳垢“可以激发新一代物理、无毒的害虫防治表面”，为保护储存的食物、农产品和技术提供涂层。

articles.title: This armored amphibian once lived and hunted on the seafloor
articles.author: Allie Skalnik

paras.en: Most amphibians shrivel or suffocate in saltwater. But long ago, an oddball armored amphibian may have dwelled deep in the ocean.
paras.zh: 大多数两栖动物在盐水中会枯萎或窒息。但很久以前，一种奇怪的装甲两栖动物可能居住在海洋深处。

paras.en: Scientists have found evidence that an ancient amphibian with a flattened body and upturned eyes may have once stalked the seafloor. The animal, Gerrothorax maritimus, is the first ever amphibian known to have lived without access to land or freshwater, researchers report October 26 in Nature Ecology & Evolution.
paras.zh: 科学家发现的证据表明，一种身体扁平、眼睛向上的古代两栖动物可能曾经在海底潜行。研究人员于 10 月 26 日在《自然生态学与进化》杂志上发表报告称，这种名为 Gerrothorax maritimus 的动物是已知的第一种在没有陆地或淡水的情况下生活的两栖动物。

paras.en: G. maritimus, which lived 237 million years ago, was rather unlike today’s amphibians, which breathe and drink through their porous skin. The creature’s lifestyle was unimaginable for an amphibian, says Ryosuke Motani, a paleobiologist at the University of California, Davis. Of the more than 8,000 amphibians known today, none live solely in saltwater.
paras.zh: G. maritimus 生活在 2.37 亿年前，与今天的两栖动物截然不同，它们通过多孔的皮肤呼吸和饮水。加州大学戴维斯分校的古生物学家 Motani Ryosuke Motani 表示，这种生物的生活方式对于两栖动物来说是难以想象的。当今已知的 8,000 多种两栖动物中，没有一种只生活在咸水中。

paras.en: Motani and his colleagues inspected two well-preserved G. maritimus fossils from the late Triassic Period, which spanned roughly 237 million to 201 million years ago. Each creature measured around 70 centimeters, about as long as a skateboard, and was swathed in armor made of bony plates. The specimens appeared nearly identical to their closest relatives, other amphibians that dwelled in freshwater, Motani says. But the fossils’ location was unusual: They were found in what was once a seabed, roughly 30 kilometers from any ancient land.
paras.zh: Motani 和他的同事检查了两块保存完好的三叠纪晚期的 G. maritimus 化石，该时期的时间跨度约为 2.37 亿年至 2.01 亿年前。每个生物长约 70 厘米，大约有滑板那么长，并包裹着由骨板制成的盔甲。莫塔尼说，这些标本与它们的近亲、生活在淡水中的其他两栖动物几乎一模一样。但这些化石的位置很不寻常：它们是在曾经的海底发现的，距离任何古代陆地大约 30 公里。

paras.en: It wasn’t clear whether the creatures lived in the ocean or were landlubbers that got buried there after they perished. So the team performed a chemical analysis. Levels of different forms of strontium in the fossil bones matched those of the Triassic ocean. This telltale sign revealed that G. maritimus ate seafood and drank seawater. “That means it lived there,” Motani says.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些生物是生活在海洋中，还是死后被埋在那里的旱鸭子。因此，研究小组进行了化学分析。骨骼化石中不同形式的锶含量与三叠纪海洋中的锶含量相匹配。这个迹象表明，G. maritimus 吃海鲜、喝海水。 “这意味着它住在那里，”莫塔尼说。

paras.en: For amphibians, “this is the first time that that we have hard evidence that they were actually adapted for long-term life in the sea,” says Lachlan Hart, a paleobiologist at the University of New South Wales in Sydney who was not involved with the new study. Hart and his colleagues previously suggested that a different ancient amphibian may have been seafaring but probably did not dwell in the ocean.
