articles.title: Flexell Space and Satoro Agree to Collaborate on In-Orbit Demonstration of Next-Generation Space Solar Cells
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Two demonstration missions planned aboard SpaceX Falcon 9, one each in 2027 and 2028
paras.zh: – 计划在 SpaceX Falcon 9 上执行两次演示任务，分别于 2027 年和 2028 年执行一次

paras.en: – Satoro to provide “Satellite-as-a-service” solution; Flexell Space to supply solar cells and test modules
paras.zh: – Sataro 提供“卫星即服务”解决方案； Flexell Space 供应太阳能电池和测试模块

paras.en: Uiwang-si, Korea – Flexell Space, a space energy company led by CEO Taehun Ahn, announced that it has signed an agreement with Singapore-based CubeSat specialist Satoro, led by CEO Mark Lu, for the in-orbit demonstration and validation (IOD/IOV) of next-generation space solar cells.
paras.zh: 韩国义王市 - 由首席执行官 Taehun Ahn 领导的空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布，它已与由首席执行官 Mark Lu 领导的新加坡 CubeSat 专家 Satoro 签署协议，以进行下一代空间太阳能电池的在轨演示和验证 (IOD/IOV)。

paras.en: The agreement aims to verify the performance and reliability of Flexell Space’s solar cells in the actual space environment. The companies plan to conduct two demonstration missions, one in 2027 and another in 2028. Each demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.
paras.zh: 该协议旨在验证Flexell Space太阳能电池在实际太空环境中的性能和可靠性。两家公司计划执行两次演示任务，一次在 2027 年，另一次在 2028 年。每颗演示卫星都计划搭载 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射。

paras.en: Flexell Space previously conducted two space demonstration missions through launches aboard Korea’s KSLV-II, in November 2025 and October 2026. Building on this experience, the agreement with Satoro will expand opportunities for in-orbit validation of its next-generation space solar cells and support the continued accumulation of operational data needed for commercialization.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 此前曾于 2025 年 11 月和 2026 年 10 月通过韩国 KSLV-II 发射进行了两次太空演示任务。基于这一经验，与 Satoro 的协议将扩大其下一代空间太阳能电池在轨验证的机会，并支持持续积累商业化所需的操作数据。

paras.en: Under the agreement, Satoro will manufacture the satellites for the demonstration missions, while Flexell Space will supply the solar cells and test modules to be integrated into them. The companies will coordinate technical requirements for the CubeSat platforms and demonstration payloads, working together to evaluate the solar cells’ operating characteristics and performance in orbit.
paras.zh: 根据协议，Satoro 将制造用于演示任务的卫星，而 Flexell Space 将提供太阳能电池和集成到卫星中的测试模块。两家公司将协调立方体卫星平台和演示有效载荷的技术要求，共同评估太阳能电池的运行特性和在轨性能。

paras.en: Through these missions, Flexell Space plans to compare and validate ground-test results against in-orbit operational data and assess the solar cells’ power output characteristics and performance changes over time. Data collected from both missions will support further design improvements and reliability validation, strengthening the technical foundation for evaluations by global customers and future commercial supply.
paras.zh: 通过这些任务，Flexell Space 计划将地面测试结果与在轨运行数据进行比较和验证，并评估太阳能电池的功率输出特性和性能随时间的变化。从这两个任务收集的数据将支持进一步的设计改进和可靠性验证，加强全球客户评估和未来商业供应的技术基础。

paras.en: The collaboration brings together Satoro’s expertise in CubeSat manufacturing and demonstration missions with Flexell Space’s capabilities in next-generation solar cell development. Flexell Space is developing solar cell technologies based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskites, with a focus on commercializing low-cost, large-area, ultralight power solutions for satellites and a wide range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 此次合作将 Sataro 在 CubeSat 制造和演示任务方面的专业知识与 Flexell Space 在下一代太阳能电池开发方面的能力结合在一起。 Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿的太阳能电池技术，重点是将用于卫星和各种空间基础设施的低成本、大面积、超轻电源解决方案商业化。

paras.en: “Commercializing space solar cells requires both ground-based performance validation and data collected in orbit,” said Taehun Ahn, CEO of Flexell Space. “With two demonstration opportunities secured for 2027 and 2028, we will systematically verify the performance and reliability of our next-generation solar cells and build the technical evidence required by global customers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 首席执行官 Taehun Ahn 表示：“太空太阳能电池的商业化需要地面性能验证和在轨道上收集的数据。” “通过在 2027 年和 2028 年获得两次演示机会，我们将系统地验证下一代太阳能电池的性能和可靠性，并建立全球客户所需的技术证据。”

paras.en: He added, “Our collaboration with Satoro establishes a clear path from development to in-orbit demonstration and will accelerate our preparations for future commercial supply.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们与 Sataro 的合作建立了从开发到在轨演示的清晰路径，并将加速我们为未来商业供应做准备。”

paras.en: “We are pleased to work with Flexell Space on the demonstration of its next-generation space solar cells,” said Mark Lu, CEO of Satoro. “Drawing on Satoro’s CubeSat platforms and mission integration capabilities, we will work closely with Flexell Space to help secure the in-orbit data needed to validate its technology.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴与 Flexell Space 合作展示其下一代太空太阳能电池，”Satoro 首席执行官 Mark Lu 表示。 “利用 Satoro 的 CubeSat 平台和任务集成能力，我们将与 Flexell Space 密切合作，帮助确保验证其技术所需的在轨数据的安全。”

paras.en: He added, “We look forward to these two demonstration missions advancing the commercial potential of new space power technologies and laying the groundwork for continued technical collaboration between our companies.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们期待这两项示范任务能够提升新太空动力技术的商业潜力，并为我们公司之间的持续技术合作奠定基础。”

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems and develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions. The company focuses on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products based on CIGS and perovskite solar cell technologies, with an emphasis on the durability, radiation tolerance, and long-term operational reliability required for space applications. Through collaboration with global satellite manufacturers and space agencies, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业，致力于开发下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案。该公司专注于基于 CIGS 和钙钛矿太阳能电池技术的低成本、大面积、超轻产品，重点关注空间应用所需的耐用性、耐辐射性和长期运行可靠性。通过与全球卫星制造商和航天机构合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星和空间基础设施太阳能电池技术的商业化。

paras.en: Satoro is a Singapore-based “Satellite-as-a-service” solutions company providing integrated services spanning satellite manufacturing, payload integration, launch coordination, and in-orbit operations, demonstration, and validation (IOD/IOV). Since 2021, the company has successfully deployed 11 satellites into orbit across eight launches, achieving a 100% launch success rate. Drawing on this experience and technical expertise, Satoro supports global customers in validating and commercializing their space technologies.
paras.zh: Satero 是一家总部位于新加坡的“卫星即服务”解决方案公司，提供涵盖卫星制造、有效载荷集成、发射协调以及在轨运行、演示和验证 (IOD/IOV) 的综合服务。 2021年以来，公司共发射8次，成功将11颗卫星送入轨道，发射成功率100%。凭借这些经验和技术专长，Satoro 支持全球客户验证其空间技术并将其商业化。

articles.title: Advice for optimizing the space industry with Laura Crabtree
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, Mike Gruss speaks with Laura Crabtree, the CEO of Epsilon3, who is also a former SpaceX astronaut trainer. They talk about ways that space companies can organize themselves to increase speed, especially to remove roadblocks around testing and certification.
paras.zh: 在本集中，迈克·格鲁斯 (Mike Gruss) 与 Epsilon3 首席执行官劳拉·克拉布特里 (Laura Crabtree) 进行了交谈，劳拉·克拉布特里也是前 SpaceX 宇航员培训师。他们讨论了航天公司如何组织起来提高速度，特别是消除测试和认证方面的障碍。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对喜欢谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

articles.title: How to Expand Reliable, Flexible Access to Space
articles.author: Exolaunch

paras.en: The space industry launched more rockets into orbit last year than ever before, yet satellite operators are confronting an unexpected problem: There still aren’t enough rides to go around.
paras.zh: 去年，航天工业向轨道发射的火箭数量比以往任何时候都要多，但卫星运营商却面临着一个意想不到的问题：仍然没有足够的运载火箭可供绕行。

paras.en: And increasingly, the shortage isn’t simply about the number of rockets.
paras.zh: 而且，短缺问题越来越不仅仅与火箭数量有关。

paras.en: Satellite companies want launches to more orbital destinations, with more regularity and aboard a wider range of vehicles. Instead, much of the industry has come to depend on a relatively small number of frequently launched rockets that often go to similar orbits. That’s left some companies and their spacecraft waiting months or years for a suitable ride.
paras.zh: 卫星公司希望以更多的规律性和更广泛的运载工具向更多的轨道目的地发射卫星。相反，该行业的大部分公司已经开始依赖数量相对较少、经常发射且通常进入相似轨道的火箭。这使得一些公司和他们的航天器需要等待数月或数年才能获得合适的飞行。

paras.en: “Demand is crazy,” said Robert Sproles, chief executive of Exolaunch, a Berlin-based broker of global launch services that has put 912 satellites into orbit during 51 separate launch events. “The demand curve is so much steeper than the supply curve.”
paras.zh: Exolaunch 首席执行官罗伯特·斯普罗尔斯 (Robert Sproles) 表示：“需求太疯狂了。”Exolaunch 是一家总部位于柏林的全球发射服务经纪商，在 51 次单独的发射活动中已将 912 颗卫星送入轨道。 “需求曲线比供给曲线陡峭得多。”

paras.en: The squeeze comes despite a historic expansion in launch activity. Data from the FAA shows the agency licensed 187 launches in fiscal year 2026. That’s up from less than 100 a decade earlier and governments are pushing for still more. The Trump administration has called for U.S. spaceports to support more than 1,000 launches and reentries annually by 2030.
paras.zh: 尽管发射活动出现了历史性的扩张，但这种挤压还是出现了。 FAA 的数据显示，该机构在 2026 财年批准了 187 次发射。这一数字高于十年前的不到 100 次，而且各国政府正在推动更多发射。特朗普政府呼吁美国太空港到 2030 年每年支持 1000 多次发射和重返大气层。

paras.en: But raw launch numbers obscure a problem that is becoming increasingly important as the space economy grows. A rocket going to the wrong orbit at the wrong time isn’t necessarily useful to a satellite operator.
paras.zh: 但原始发射数据掩盖了一个随着太空经济增长而变得越来越重要的问题。火箭在错误的时间进入错误的轨道对于卫星运营商来说不一定有用。

paras.en: All of that is turning choice, not just capacity, into one of the launch industry’s biggest constraints.
paras.zh: 所有这些都使选择（而不仅仅是容量）成为发射行业最大的限制之一。

paras.en: In order to truly close the gap between supply and demand, Sproles said, space transportation companies must also increase the diversity of available launches.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯表示，为了真正缩小供需差距，航天运输公司还必须增加可用发射的多样性。

paras.en: “Yes, we need to meet demand. But we also need to make sure we’re putting that demand in the right places,” he said. “We need to recognize what types of launches are best for what types of missions, and we need to make sure those types of launches are available when the launch customer needs them.”
paras.zh: “是的，我们需要满足需求。但我们还需要确保将需求放在正确的地方，”他说。 “我们需要认识到哪种类型的发射最适合哪种类型的任务，并且我们需要确保在发射客户需要时可以使用这些类型的发射。”

paras.en: Market research firm Novaspace reports that the global space economy reached a valuation of $626 billion in 2025. Citing “consolidation, integration, and closer institutional alignment around security, resilience, and operational performance,” it forecasts annual growth of 5.5% through 2034 — at which point it predicts the global space economy will be worth over $1 trillion.
paras.zh: 市场研究公司 Novaspace 报告称，到 2025 年，全球太空经济估值将达到 6260 亿美元。该公司援引“围绕安全、弹性和运营绩效的整合、一体化和更紧密的机构协调”，预测到 2034 年年增长率将达到 5.5%，届时全球太空经济价值将超过 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: Markets that large are not monolithic, Sproles said, which means the industry needs multiple launch providers operating regularly across different orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯表示，这么大的市场并不是单一的，这意味着该行业需要多个发射提供商在不同的轨道范围内定期运营。

paras.en: “If you rewind to, say, 2016, there was more launch diversity in the market at that time than there is today. There was not more capacity, but there was a wider variety of vehicles that you could reliably gain access to,” Sproles said. The reasons for that decline in launch diversity includes changes in technology, geopolitics, and supply chains since the COVID-19 pandemic, all of which have led to the concentration of launch capacity in a small number of highly active launch providers.
paras.zh: “如果回溯到 2016 年，当时市场上的发射多样性比现在更多。运力并没有更多，但你可以可靠地获得更多种类的车辆，”斯普罗尔斯说。发射多样性下降的原因包括自COVID-19大流行以来技术、地缘政治和供应链的变化，所有这些都导致发射能力集中在少数高度活跃的发射提供商手中。

paras.en: But that variety is necessary, Sproles argues, because launch customers want to be able to optimize for when they can launch, where they need to go, and how much it will cost.
paras.zh: 但斯普罗尔斯认为，这种多样性是必要的，因为发布客户希望能够针对何时发布、需要去哪里以及需要花费多少进行优化。

paras.en: Consider the two most prolific launch providers today: SpaceX — whose Falcon 9 vehicle is optimized for large commercial constellations, human spaceflight, and heavy commercial rideshares — and Rocket Lab, whose Electron vehicle favors small satellites and CubeSats that require custom orbital planes.
paras.zh: 考虑一下当今最多产的两家发射提供商：SpaceX（其 Falcon 9 运载火箭针对大型商业星座、载人航天和重型商业共享出行进行了优化）和 Rocket Lab（其 Electron 运载火箭偏爱需要定制轨道飞机的小型卫星和立方体卫星）。

paras.en: “You could not come up with two more different vehicles both in terms of performance and commercial offerings, which just goes to show you that the industry is as hungry for choice as it is for capacity,” Sproles said.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯说：“在性能和商业产品方面，你无法再推出两种不同的车辆，这只会向你表明，该行业对选择的渴望与对容量的渴望一样。”

paras.en: In today’s launch market, rideshare services are a foundation of the space industry. “Rideshare is appropriate when your schedule is flexible enough to align with when a planned rideshare is launching, and when you have enough orbital wiggle room to go where the masses want to go,” Sproles said. “Basically, it makes sense when you have less rigid mission constraints.”
paras.zh: 在当今的发射市场中，拼车服务是航天工业的基础。斯普罗尔斯说：“当你的日程安排足够灵活，能够与计划的拼车服务启动时间保持一致，并且你有足够的轨道回旋空间去大众想去的地方时，拼车服务就是合适的。” “基本上，当你的任务限制不那么严格时，这是有意义的。”

paras.en: But as missions become more complex and bespoke, one size doesn’t fit all. Rideshare alternatives are needed, including shared launches — where launches are conceived from the outset with multiple customers in mind, instead of one customer’s mission piggybacking haphazardly onto another’s — and dedicated launches, wherein a customer procures an entire launch that’s customized to their unique schedule, destination, and payload, Sproles said
paras.zh: 但随着任务变得更加复杂和定制化，一种方法并不适合所有人。斯普罗尔斯表示，需要共享出行替代方案，包括共享发射（即从一开始就考虑到多个客户的情况来构思发射，而不是一个客户的任务随意地搭载在另一个客户的任务上）和专用发射（其中客户购买根据其独特的时间表、目的地和有效负载定制的整个发射）

paras.en: Exolaunch points to four planned missions that underscore the benefits of launch diversity:
paras.zh: Exolaunch 指出了四项计划任务，强调了发射多样性的好处：

paras.en: - In 2027, the company will conduct a mid-inclination rideshare mission aboard Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ H3 rocket. It will be the company’s first launch from Japan.
paras.zh: - 2027年，该公司将搭乘三菱重工的H3火箭执行中倾角拼车任务。这将是该公司首次在日本推出。

paras.en: - In late 2027 and 2028, respectively, Exolaunch will launch its Exo-1 and Exo-2 missions aboard two dedicated SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets procured exclusively for an anchor customer that in both instances will use approximately 40% of the launch vehicle; Exolaunch will sell the remaining 60% to other customers seeking a rideshare model.
paras.zh: - 分别于 2027 年末和 2028 年，Exolaunch 将利用专为主要客户采购的两枚专用 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射 Exo-1 和 Exo-2 任务，在这两种情况下，该客户将使用约 40% 的运载火箭； Exolaunch 将把剩余的 60% 出售给其他寻求拼车模式的客户。

paras.en: - In late 2028, Exolaunch will serve as the launch co-integrator for the Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment-Continuity (GRACE-C) mission that is a joint effort of the German Space Agency’s German Aerospace Center (DLR) and NASA. The company will provide a custom structure with which to secure the mission’s payload inside a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket that DLR and NASA had already secured for their launch; in return, DLR and NASA will allow it to provide the rocket’s unused capacity to other customers.
paras.zh: - 2028 年末，Exolaunch 将作为重力恢复和气候实验连续性 (GRACE-C) 任务的发射联合集成商，该任务是德国航天局德国航空航天中心 (DLR) 和 NASA 的共同努力。该公司将提供一种定制结构，用于将任务有效载荷固定在 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭内，DLR 和 NASA 已经为发射做好了准备；作为回报，德国航天中心和美国宇航局将允许其向其他客户提供火箭未使用的容量。

paras.en: The first eight launches for Exolaunch in 2026 took place across four different launch vehicles from three continents. By securing capacity across a diverse portfolio of launch vehicles, inclinations, and spaceports, Sproles said, Exolaunch gives launch customers not only more predictable access to orbit, but also increased flexibility with regard to cost, schedule, and orbital destination.
paras.zh: 2026 年 Exolaunch 的前八次发射是通过来自三大洲的四种不同的运载火箭进行的。 Sproles 表示，通过确保各种运载火箭、倾角和太空港的容量，Exolaunch 不仅为发射客户提供了更可预测的进入轨道的机会，而且还提高了成本、时间表和轨道目的地方面的灵活性。

paras.en: Sproles ultimately envisions a future where customers can launch at any time and to any orbit without ever having to consider available launch vehicles or schedules — just as manufacturers in other industries can ship their products knowing that there’s always a container ship, train, or truck available to transport them.
paras.zh: Sproles 最终设想的未来是，客户可以在任何时间、任何轨道发射火箭，而无需考虑可用的运载火箭或时间表，就像其他行业的制造商可以运送他们的产品一样，因为他们知道总有集装箱船、火车或卡车可以运输它们。

paras.en: “The ideal situation is that customers don’t have to think about what the vehicle is or when it’s going because there’s always an option to get to the desired orbit at the time when their satellite is manufactured,” Sproles said.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯说：“理想的情况是，客户不必考虑车辆是什么或何时行驶，因为在制造卫星时总有一个选择可以到达所需的轨道。”

paras.en: That future is in the hands of launch companies.
paras.zh: 这个未来掌握在发射公司手中。

paras.en: “We have multiple launch providers who have shown they can launch rockets. Now, we need those launchers to launch. We need them operating reliably at cadence, and we need them going to multiple orbits. They can do it. We just need them to execute.”
paras.zh: “我们有多家发射提供商已经证明他们可以发射火箭。现在，我们需要这些发射器来发射。我们需要它们以节奏可靠地运行，我们需要它们进入多个轨道。他们可以做到。我们只需要他们执行。”

articles.title: NASA Announces $1 Million to Students for Moon Base Challenge
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: On Sunday, NASA announced the opening of its $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge during a MAX POWER event at Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex in Florida. As part of a Golden Age of Science, the competition invites student teams at U.S. high schools and post-secondary schools to contribute designs for the Moon Base.
paras.zh: 周日，美国宇航局宣布在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心游客中心举行的 MAX POWER 活动期间启动价值 100 万美元的月球基地学生挑战赛。作为科学黄金时代的一部分，该竞赛邀请美国高中和专上学校的学生团队为月球基地贡献设计。

paras.en: “We’re looking for students ready to think creatively, work as a team, and take on real problems connected to NASA’s future on the Moon,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “You do not have to wait until graduation to contribute. Curiosity, creativity, and the willingness to tackle hard problems without obvious answers are exactly the qualities we need as we build what comes next.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 表示：“我们正在寻找愿意创造性思考、团队合作并解决与美国宇航局月球未来相关的实际问题的学生。” “你不必等到毕业才能做出贡献。好奇心、创造力以及在没有明显答案的情况下解决难题的意愿正是我们在构建未来产品时所需要的品质。”

paras.en: NASA is building a Moon Base where astronauts will live, work, and explore at the lunar South Pole region. A permanent human presence on the Moon paves the way for future crewed missions to Mars and requires talent from various industries and backgrounds.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在建造一个月球基地，宇航员将在月球南极地区生活、工作和探索。人类在月球上的永久存在为未来载人火星任务铺平了道路，并且需要来自不同行业和背景的人才。

paras.en: “As we build and design the foundations of Moon Base, we want to leverage all the ingenuity and innovation to think of every consideration our explorers might need to live and work there,” said Carlos García-Galán, manager, Moon Base Program. “Students bring exactly the bold ideas that we’re looking for, and I’m looking forward to their fresh perspective. Ultimately, Moon Base is for them, people who will experience a world where humans are on the Moon to stay.”
paras.zh: 月球基地项目经理卡洛斯·加西亚-加兰 (Carlos García-Galán) 表示：“当我们建造和设计月球基地的基础时，我们希望利用所有的独创性和创新性来考虑我们的探险家在那里生活和工作可能需要的每一个因素。” “学生们带来的正是我们正在寻找的大胆想法，我期待着他们的新鲜视角。最终，月球基地是为他们准备的，他们将体验人类在月球上居住的世界。”

paras.en: The multiphase challenge supports NASA’s commitment to cultivating the technical skills of tomorrow’s aerospace workforce. For this challenge, student teams will design innovative solutions for Moon Base across six categories: power generation and storage, construction, life-support systems, surface mobility, communications networks, and astronaut safety. The challenge gives participants an opportunity to develop necessary skills for careers in the space industry while helping advance new concepts for Moon Base technologies.
paras.zh: 这一多阶段的挑战支持了 NASA 培养未来航空航天劳动力技术技能的承诺。针对这一挑战，学生团队将为月球基地设计创新解决方案，涵盖六个类别：发电和存储、建筑、生命支持系统、地面移动、通信网络和宇航员安全。该挑战为参与者提供了发展航天工业职业所需技能的机会，同时帮助推进月球基地技术的新概念。

paras.en: Participants are required to register for the challenge through the NASA STEM Gateway. Registration is open until Jan. 25, 2027.
paras.zh: 参与者需要通过 NASA STEM Gateway 注册参加挑战。注册截止日期为 2027 年 1 月 25 日。

paras.en: “Students are the next generation of explorers and innovators. Their unique perspectives are key to helping us envision a future away from Earth, and I’m excited to see the creativity and ingenuity spurred by this challenge,” said Elaine Ho, associate administrator for the Office of STEM Engagement at NASA Headquarters.
paras.zh: “学生是下一代的探索者和创新者。他们独特的视角是帮助我们设想远离地球的未来的关键，我很高兴看到这一挑战激发出创造力和独创性，”NASA 总部 STEM 参与办公室副主任 Elaine Ho 说道。

paras.en: The Moon Base Student Challenge addresses authentic environmental and mission design parameters for life and operations on the lunar surface. The deliverables reflect industry skills – such as trade studies, concept proposals, and stakeholder briefings – allowing participants across technical, vocational, and various academic tracks to build career-relevant skills without requiring prior specialized engineering or technical experience.
paras.zh: 月球基地学生挑战赛解决了月球表面生命和运行的真实环境和任务设计参数。可交付成果反映了行业技能，例如贸易研究、概念提案和利益相关者简报，使技术、职业和各种学术领域的参与者能够培养与职业相关的技能，而无需事先具备专业的工程或技术经验。

paras.en: The Office of STEM Engagement designed the challenge in collaboration with the Moon Base Program. The Institute of Competition Sciences administers the challenge through a contract with the NASA Center of Excellence for Collaborative Innovation within the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate.
paras.zh: STEM 参与办公室与月球基地计划合作设计了这项挑战。竞争科学研究所通过与 NASA 研究和技术任务理事会内的卓越协作创新中心签订的合同来管理这项挑战。

paras.en: For complete competition details, eligibility requirements, and official rules, visit:
paras.zh: 有关完整的竞赛详细信息、资格要求和官方规则，请访问：

articles.title: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis

paras.en: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis
paras.zh: 处于气候危机前线的难民“无处可逃”

paras.en: The climate emergency is an immediate crisis for refugees, with three in four – nearly 90 million people – living in countries facing high to severe exposure to hazards such as drought, floods and extreme heat.
paras.zh: 气候紧急情况对难民来说是迫在眉睫的危机，四分之三的难民（近 9000 万人）生活在面临干旱、洪水和酷热等危险的国家。

paras.en: Vulnerable as they are, climate financing is failing to reach many communities at risk, the UN refugee agency, UNHCR, warned in a report published on Friday ahead of the COP31 climate change conference opening next week in Antalya, Türkiye.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署难民署在下周于土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候变化会议之前发布的一份报告中警告说，尽管气候融资很脆弱，但气候融资未能惠及许多面临风险的社区。

paras.en: “Refugees face a double injustice. Forced to flee conflicts they did not cause, they are now on the frontlines of a climate crisis they have contributed least to,” said Antón Leis García, Assistant High Commissioner for Operations.
paras.zh: “难民面临着双重不公正。被迫逃离并非由他们造成的冲突，他们现在处于气候危机的最前线，而他们对气候危机的贡献最小，”负责行动的助理高级专员安东·莱斯·加西亚 (Antón Leis García) 说。

paras.en: “For millions, climate change is not a distant threat. It is destroying shelters, undermining livelihoods and putting their hopes of rebuilding their lives at risk.”
paras.zh: “对于数百万人来说，气候变化并不是一个遥远的威胁。它正在摧毁庇护所，破坏生计，并使他们重建生活的希望面临风险。”

paras.en: The report – No Escape III – finds that the fragile and conflict-affected countries that host large refugee populations receive only around 10 per cent of global funding to address climate change.
paras.zh: 报告《无处可逃 III》发现，收容大量难民的脆弱且受冲突影响的国家仅获得了全球应对气候变化资金的 10% 左右。

paras.en: It highlights the stories of eight representatives from displaced communities on the frontlines of the climate crisis, such as Monira Bahraldin from Sudan.
paras.zh: 它重点讲述了来自气候危机前线的流离失所社区的八名代表的故事，其中包括来自苏丹的莫尼拉·巴哈尔丁。

paras.en: She fled El Fasher in wartorn Sudan’s Darfur region in June 2023 and now lives in a refugee settlement in eastern Chad where climate shocks are an ever-present risk, amid ongoing drought and persistent conflict.
paras.zh: 她于 2023 年 6 月逃离饱受战争蹂躏的苏丹达尔富尔地区的法希尔，现在住在乍得东部的一个难民安置点，那里的气候冲击是一个始终存在的风险，而且持续干旱和持续冲突。

paras.en: “The peak of the dry season in Chad is much hotter than in Darfur, and the journey to fetch water becomes even longer, just as the family’s demand for water increases,” she told the authors.
paras.zh: “乍得的旱季高峰期比达尔富尔要热得多，取水的路程变得更长，而家庭对水的需求也在增加，”她告诉作者。

paras.en: By 2050, one in three refugee settlements across sub-Saharan Africa could face at least 100 days of dangerous heat each year, according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，到 2050 年，撒哈拉以南非洲地区三分之一的难民定居点每年可能面临至少 100 天的危险高温。

paras.en: Weather-related disasters triggered hundreds of millions of internal displacements worldwide over the past decade, while severe flooding linked to El Niño is expected to force three million people across Somalia, Kenya, South Sudan and Uganda to flee their homes by the end of the year.
paras.zh: 过去十年，与天气有关的灾害在全球范围内引发了数亿人流离失所，而与厄尔尼诺现象有关的严重洪水预计将迫使索马里、肯尼亚、南苏丹和乌干达的 300 万人在年底前逃离家园。

paras.en: Climate change is also making it harder to find lasting solutions for displaced people. More than two-thirds of refugees who returned home in the first half of 2026 went back to countries that are highly vulnerable to climate hazards.
paras.zh: 气候变化也使得为流离失所者找到持久解决方案变得更加困难。 2026 年上半年返回家园的难民中有超过三分之二回到了极易受到气候灾害影响的国家。

paras.en: In Syria, meanwhile, nearly four million people have recently returned to the country, where declining groundwater and severe climate shocks are threatening recovery after more than a decade of war. Flooding along the Euphrates River in May damaged homes, displacing thousands once again.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在叙利亚，近四百万人最近返回该国，那里的地下水下降和严重的气候冲击正在威胁着十多年战争后的复苏。五月份幼发拉底河沿岸的洪水损坏了房屋，再次导致数千人流离失所。

paras.en: Meanwhile, nearly 90 per cent of stateless people worldwide live in countries that are highly exposed to climate hazards. When climate disasters strike, many struggle to access relief and support, because they lack legal recognition.
paras.zh: 与此同时，全球近 90% 的无国籍人生活在高度受气候灾害影响的国家。当气候灾难发生时，许多人难以获得救济和支持，因为他们缺乏法律认可。

paras.en: The report also shows how refugees and host communities are developing innovative ways to respond to climate change, including solar-powered water systems in the Sahel, climate-resilient agriculture in Uganda and land and mangrove restoration in Colombia.
paras.zh: 该报告还展示了难民和收容社区如何开发创新方法来应对气候变化，包括萨赫勒地区的太阳能供水系统、乌干达的气候适应型农业以及哥伦比亚的土地和红树林恢复。

paras.en: “Refugees are on the frontlines of the climate crisis, but they are also part of the solution,” Mr. Leis García said.
paras.zh: “难民处于气候危机的前线，但他们也是解决方案的一部分，”莱斯·加西亚先生说。

paras.en: “COP31 must be a turning point, recognising their leadership and translating bold commitments into concrete investments that reach those most at risk.”
paras.zh: “第三十一届缔约方会议必须成为一个转折点，承认他们的领导地位，并将大胆的承诺转化为具体的投资，惠及那些面临最大风险的人。”

articles.title: Sudan’s suffering is plain for all to see say aid teams, as brutal war continues

paras.en: Sudan’s suffering is plain for all to see say aid teams, as brutal war continues
paras.zh: 援助队表示，苏丹的苦难是有目共睹的，残酷的战争仍在继续

paras.en: Aid teams working to help millions of people uprooted by the ongoing war in Sudan appealed on Friday for more international assistance amid desperate funding shortages, empty warehouses and overwhelming needs.
paras.zh: 周五，在资金严重短缺、仓库空空如也、需求巨大的情况下，致力于帮助因苏丹持续战争而背井离乡的数百万人的援助小组呼吁国际社会提供更多援助。

paras.en: A staggering 15.4 million people urgently require shelter across the country, where war that erupted in April 2023 between former allies turned rival military forces is deepening the suffering of civilians.
paras.zh: 全国有 1540 万人迫切需要庇护所，数量惊人，2023 年 4 月，前盟友之间爆发的战争加剧了平民的苦难。

paras.en: “Just yesterday, we had 16 trucks arriving in Darfur, but they were just the last that we had in our stocks. We are facing serious problems. Our supplies are running out,” said Mohamed Refaat, Chief of mission in Sudan for the UN migration agency, IOM, speaking from Khartoum.
paras.zh: 联合国移民机构国际移民组织驻苏丹代表团团长穆罕默德·雷法特在喀土穆表示：“就在昨天，我们有 16 辆卡车抵达达尔富尔，但它们只是我们库存中的最后一批卡车。我们面临着严重的问题。我们的物资即将耗尽。”

paras.en: Aid access to vulnerable displaced and returning people is better than it was, meaning that “we can reach more people”, the veteran humanitarian officer noted.
paras.zh: 这位经验丰富的人道主义官员指出，对弱势流离失所者和返回者的援助比以前更好，这意味着“我们可以接触到更多的人”。

paras.en: But “this means also that we can listen to the stories of their suffering…We cannot say that we don’t know”.
paras.zh: 但是“这也意味着我们可以倾听他们的苦难故事……我们不能说我们不知道”。

paras.en: Shifting front lines also continue to force more families to flee their homes, leaving many without anywhere safe to sleep or even a blanket to stay warm, insisted Abubakarr Jalloh, UN refugee agency (UNHCR)’s Deputy Representative in Sudan, speaking via video from Khartoum.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署驻苏丹副代表阿布巴卡尔·贾洛在喀土穆通过视频表示，前线的转移还继续迫使更多家庭逃离家园，导致许多人没有安全的地方睡觉，甚至没有毯子取暖。

paras.en: “For a woman who has lost everything, a tent is more than just a shelter; it means the difference between sleeping in the open, surrounded by strangers and having a space of her own. It means dignity. It is privacy. And it is safety for that woman and family.”
paras.zh: “对于一个失去一切的女人来说，帐篷不仅仅是一个庇护所；它意味着在露天睡觉、被陌生人包围和拥有自己的空间之间的区别。它意味着尊严。它是隐私。它是那个女人和家人的安全。”

paras.en: For people displaced by conflict, “a solar lamp is more than just a source of light, it is safety,” Mr. Jalloh continued.
paras.zh: 对于因冲突而流离失所的人们来说，“太阳能灯不仅仅是一个光源，它还是安全，”贾洛先生继续说道。

paras.en: “It means a woman can reach a latrine at night without walking in darkness. A kitchen set is also more than a collection of household items. It means a mother can cook for children, without exposing herself to the unnecessary risk.”
paras.zh: “这意味着女性可以在晚上到达厕所，而无需在黑暗中行走。厨房用具也不仅仅是家庭用品的集合。这意味着母亲可以为孩子做饭，而不会让自己面临不必要的风险。”

paras.en: In a joint statement issued on Friday, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) and the International Organization for Migration (IOM) stressed that humanitarian agencies can only assist around one in 10 of those in need because of funding shortages today.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署（UNHCR）和国际移民组织（IOM）在周五发表的联合声明中强调，由于目前资金短缺，人道主义机构只能帮助大约十分之一的需要帮助的人。

paras.en: Three in four internally displaced people in Sudan are women and children, Mr. Jalloh said, adding that El Niño-related weather conditions have made people more vulnerable because of significantly below-average rainfall across Sudan this year.
paras.zh: 贾洛先生说，苏丹四分之三的国内流离失所者是妇女和儿童，他补充说，由于今年苏丹各地的降雨量大大低于平均水平，与厄尔尼诺现象相关的天气条件使人们更加脆弱。

paras.en: This has affected harvests in Darfur, Kordofan and other areas already devastated by ongoing fighting. Although food prices would normally ease after the harvest season, prices remain “painfully high”, the UNHCR official said.
paras.zh: 这影响了达尔富尔、科尔多凡和其他已经因持续战斗而遭到破坏的地区的收成。难民署官员表示，虽然粮食价格通常会在收获季节后回落，但价格仍然“高得令人痛苦”。

paras.en: “For a family that has lost everything, every Sudanese pound spent on food is money that cannot be spent on a blanket or on materials needed for safe shelter,” Mr. Jalloh stressed.
paras.zh: “对于一个失去一切的家庭来说，在食物上花费的每一苏丹镑都不能用来购买毯子或安全住所所需的材料，”贾洛先生强调。

paras.en: As emergency supplies reaching critically low levels, the UN agencies warned that unless flexible funding is urgently provided, more families will face the coming winter months unprotected from harsh weather conditions, insecurity and the risks of violence and exploitation.
paras.zh: 由于紧急物资供应严重不足，联合国机构警告说，除非紧急提供灵活的资金，否则更多家庭将在即将到来的冬季面临恶劣天气条件、不安全以及暴力和剥削风险的保护。

paras.en: “This year, I was able to distribute more than 40,000 tonnes [of relief assistance]. But our warehouses are completely empty now,” Mr. Refaat said, also speaking via video from Khartoum.
paras.zh: “今年，我分发了超过 40,000 吨（救援物资）。但我们的仓库现在完全空了，”雷法特先生在喀土穆通过视频说道。

paras.en: More than 5.2 million people have returned to their areas of origin but many are unable to go back to their homes, as countless numbers have been destroyed or looted.
paras.zh: 超过 520 万人已返回原籍地，但许多人无法返回家园，因为无数人遭到破坏或抢劫。

paras.en: Healthcare, electricity and water services are also largely unavailable in many locations, meaning that people might be forced to leave again, “without any hope of returning”.
paras.zh: 许多地方的医疗、电力和供水服务也基本上无法提供，这意味着人们可能被迫再次离开，“没有任何返回的希望”。

paras.en: The IOM official also highlighted that Sudanese nationals now constitute the largest nationality arriving in Europe via the so-called Eastern Mediterranean route. “If we are not able to provide aid in Sudan at scale, it means neighbouring countries will be impacted, other countries will be impacted,” he said.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织官员还强调，苏丹国民现在是通过所谓的东地中海航线抵达欧洲的最大国民。 “如果我们无法向苏丹提供大规模援助，这意味着邻国将受到影响，其他国家也会受到影响，”他说。

paras.en: Despite facing the world’s largest displacement crisis, Sudan’s 2026 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan remains severely underfunded. Only 47 per cent of the required $2.9 billion has been received so far.
paras.zh: 尽管面临世界上最严重的流离失所危机，苏丹的 2026 年人道主义需求和应对计划仍然严重资金不足。迄今为止，所需的 29 亿美元只收到了 47%。

paras.en: Mr. Refaat said that millions of Sudanese families have already lost so much: “We cannot undo what they have endured, but we can make sure that they have a safe place to sleep tonight.”
paras.zh: 雷法特表示，数百万苏丹家庭已经损失惨重：“我们无法挽回他们所承受的痛苦，但我们可以确保他们今晚有一个安全的地方睡觉。”

articles.title: From a ship frozen into Arctic ice, a warning to world leaders: Trust the science

paras.en: From a ship frozen into Arctic ice, a warning to world leaders: Trust the science
paras.zh: 一艘被冻结在北极冰层中的船只向世界领导人发出警告：相信科学

paras.en: Drifting through the polar darkness, a team of scientists is documenting a rapidly changing Arctic. As sea ice retreats and oil tankers move in, a conversation with the UN chief reveals why the battle for climate science matters far beyond the North Pole.
paras.zh: 一组科学家漂流在极地的黑暗中，正在记录快速变化的北极。随着海冰消退和油轮驶入，与联合国秘书长的对话揭示了为什么气候科学之战的重要性远远超出了北极。

paras.en: Somewhere in the darkness of the Arctic Ocean, 12 people and a dog named Örkki are drifting right now across the frozen sea, with little say over where they are going.
paras.zh: 在北冰洋黑暗的某个地方，12 个人和一只名叫 Örkki 的狗正在冰冻的海洋上漂流，几乎不知道他们要去哪里。

paras.en: Their home for the winter is Tara Polar Station, a 26-metre-long French research vessel that departed Norway in August with an unusual purpose: to become trapped in ice.
paras.zh: 它们过冬的家是塔拉极地站，这是一艘 26 米长的法国科考船，于 8 月离开挪威，有一个不寻常的目的：被困在冰里。

paras.en: Locked into a floating sheet of sea ice above more than 2,500 metres of water, the station moves wherever the winds and currents carry it. There is no destination to steer towards, and in the middle of the polar night, no sunlight to mark the passing days.
paras.zh: 该站被锁定在超过 2,500 米水面以上的漂浮海冰中，可以随风和洋流移动。没有目的地可以驶向，在极夜里，没有阳光来纪念过去的日子。

paras.en: The team is taking part in Tara Polaris I, the first of 10 planned expeditions in a 20-year international programme to study the transformation of the Arctic Ocean. What they are already witnessing has caught the attention of UN Secretary-General António Guterres.
paras.zh: 该团队正在参加塔拉北极星一号 (Tara Polaris I)，这是一项为期 20 年的研究北冰洋转变的国际计划中计划进行的 10 次探险活动中的第一个。他们所目睹的一切引起了联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯的注意。

paras.en: What happens in the Arctic doesn't stay in the Arctic.
paras.zh: 北极发生的事情不会只留在北极。

paras.en: Ahead of the COP31 UN climate conference, the UN chief spoke this week by video link to the expedition’s chief scientist, Maxime Geoffroy, asking what message he should take to world leaders about an Arctic which is warming three to four times faster than the global average.
paras.zh: 在 COP31 联合国气候会议召开之前，联合国秘书长本周通过视频连线与探险队首席科学家马克西姆·杰弗罗伊 (Maxime Geoffroy) 交谈，询问他应该向世界领导人传达什么关于北极变暖速度比全球平均水平快三到四倍的信息。

paras.en: “I think that, unfortunately, the political leadership in this world is not yet entirely aware of how serious the situation is,” the UN chief said.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长表示：“不幸的是，我认为世界政治领导层尚未完全意识到局势有多严重。”

paras.en: Mr. Geoffroy’s message was simple: “What happens in the Arctic doesn't stay in the Arctic.”
paras.zh: 杰弗罗伊先生传达的信息很简单：“北极发生的事情不会只留在北极。”

paras.en: The changes unfolding beneath the expedition’s feet could have far-reaching consequences for the world’s oceans, climate and biodiversity, he warned.
paras.zh: 他警告说，探险队脚下发生的变化可能会对世界海洋、气候和生物多样性产生深远的影响。

paras.en: The mission draws inspiration from Norwegian explorer Fridtjof Nansen, who famously allowed his vessel to freeze into Arctic sea ice in 1893 and drift with the currents.
paras.zh: 此次任务的灵感来自挪威探险家弗里乔夫·南森 (Fridtjof Nansen)，他曾于 1893 年让自己的船只冻结在北极海冰中并随水流漂流。

paras.en: More than 130 years later, Mr. Geoffroy and his colleagues are following in his footsteps, with one striking difference: there is considerably less ice in their way.
paras.zh: 130 多年后，杰弗罗伊先生和他的同事们追随他的脚步，但有一个显着的区别：路上的冰块明显减少了。

paras.en: The expedition spent three weeks navigating along Russia's northern coast before heading into the Arctic ice pack in search of a suitable floe (a large flat piece of floating ice) for its research station.
paras.zh: 该探险队花了三周时间沿着俄罗斯北部海岸航行，然后进入北极冰层为其研究站寻找合适的浮冰（一大块平坦的浮冰）。

paras.en: “We reached 82 degrees north just through leads,” Mr. Geoffroy said, referring to channels of open water between the floes.
paras.zh: “我们仅通过线索就到达了北纬 82 度，”杰弗罗伊先生说，他指的是浮冰之间的开阔水域。

paras.en: When Nansen made his voyage, his vessel became trapped in ice hundreds of kilometres farther south. Now, open stretches of water allowed Mr. Geoffroy's team to travel much deeper before becoming icebound.
paras.zh: 当南森航行时，他的船在向南数百公里处被困在冰中。现在，开阔的水域让杰弗罗伊的团队可以在被冰封之前航行到更深的地方。

paras.en: But the retreating ice is only part of the story.
paras.zh: 但消退的冰只是故事的一部分。

paras.en: The Secretary-General asked Mr. Geoffroy about one of his greatest fears for the future:
paras.zh: 秘书长向杰弗罗伊先生询问他对未来最担心的事情之一：

paras.en: “One of the things that has scared me most was the perspective that in a number of years we might have no ice in the Arctic, during summer.”
paras.zh: “最让我害怕的一件事是，在未来的几年里，夏季期间北极可能没有冰。”

paras.en: Arctic sea ice plays a vital role in regulating the Earth’s temperature and keeping the planet cool.
paras.zh: 北极海冰在调节地球温度和保持地球凉爽方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

paras.en: “This large ice sheet on which we are drifting, when the sun comes back, acts as a mirror,” the scientist explained.
paras.zh: 这位科学家解释说：“当太阳回来时，我们漂流的这片大冰盖就像一面镜子。”

paras.en: Like a giant reflector, the white ice sends much of the Sun’s energy back into space. But as it melts, the darker ocean beneath absorbs that heat instead, warming the water and accelerating the loss of ice.
paras.zh: 就像一个巨大的反射镜一样，白冰将大部分太阳能量发送回太空。但当它融化时，下面较暗的海洋反而会吸收热量，使海水变暖并加速冰的流失。

paras.en: The consequences are far reaching. Ocean currents carry heat far beyond the North Pole, influencing marine ecosystems and climate patterns across the planet.
paras.zh: 其后果是深远的。洋流将热量带到北极以外的地方，影响着全球的海洋生态系统和气候模式。

paras.en: As Arctic ice disappears, these circulation systems could be disrupted, with consequences scientists are still struggling to predict.
paras.zh: 随着北极冰层消失，这些循环系统可能会受到干扰，科学家们仍在努力预测其后果。

paras.en: “We have models, but we don't know when, how, and what will be the exact impacts,” Mr. Geoffroy acknowledged.
paras.zh: “我们有模型，但我们不知道何时、如何以及什么会产生确切的影响，”杰弗罗伊先生承认。

paras.en: The central Arctic remains poorly studied. Firsthand observations are crucial to improving climate models and predicting what lies ahead.
paras.zh: 北极中部的研究仍然很少。第一手观测对于改进气候模型和预测未来至关重要。

paras.en: From ancient life to an uncertain future
paras.zh: 从古老的生活到不确定的未来

paras.en: But the team's questions go far beyond climate forecasts, reaching into one of humanity's oldest mysteries: the origins of life.
paras.zh: 但该团队的问题远远超出了气候预测，触及了人类最古老的谜团之一：生命的起源。

paras.en: Could life on Earth have begun in sea ice?
paras.zh: 地球上的生命可能始于海冰吗？

paras.en: Mr. Geoffroy pointed to organisms that survive extreme cold thanks to antifreeze proteins, and to the intriguing hypothesis that frozen environments may have played a role in life's earliest beginnings.
paras.zh: 杰弗罗伊先生指出，生物体能够在极寒环境下生存，要归功于抗冻蛋白，并提出了一个有趣的假设，即冰冻环境可能在生命的最早起源中发挥了作用。

paras.en: Other researchers on board are tackling a more practical mystery: how many fish live in the central Arctic Ocean?
paras.zh: 船上的其他研究人员正在解决一个更实际的谜团：北冰洋中部生活着多少鱼？

paras.en: Despite growing commercial interest, researchers still don't know whether its waters could sustain fisheries without threatening fragile ecosystems.
paras.zh: 尽管商业兴趣不断增长，研究人员仍然不知道其水域是否能够在不威胁脆弱生态系统的情况下维持渔业。

paras.en: “To understand the loss of biodiversity and protection of biodiversity, you need to know what is there,” the scientist explained.
paras.zh: “要了解生物多样性的丧失和生物多样性的保护，你需要知道那里有什么，”科学家解释道。

paras.en: The research programme brings together 80 scientists and some 220 research protocols to investigate everything from how marine life responds to warming to the ocean’s role in storing carbon.
paras.zh: 该研究项目汇集了 80 名科学家和约 220 个研究方案，研究从海洋生物如何应对变暖到海洋在储存碳方面的作用等各个方面。

paras.en: The Secretary-General, a longstanding advocate for ocean protection, smiled when he heard Mr. Geoffroy describe the international effort as a "miniature United Nations for Arctic science".
paras.zh: 作为海洋保护的长期倡导者，秘书长在听到杰弗罗伊先生将这一国际努力描述为“北极科学领域的微型联合国”时笑了。

paras.en: But while researchers race to understand the disappearing ice, others are already looking to profit from its retreat.
paras.zh: 然而，当研究人员竞相了解正在消失的冰层时，其他人已经开始寻求从冰层消退中获利。

paras.en: On their way north, the scientists encountered another unmistakable sign of change: oil tankers navigating the Northeast Passage along Russia’s Arctic coast.
paras.zh: 在向北的途中，科学家们遇到了另一个明显的变化迹象：沿着俄罗斯北极海岸航行的东北航道的油轮。

paras.en: The retreating ice makes the route more accessible but increases the risks of pollution and accidents.
paras.zh: 消融的冰层使路线更容易通达，但也增加了污染和事故的风险。

paras.en: “I can guarantee you that we saw a lot of oil tankers going through that passage,” Mr. Geoffroy told the Secretary-General. “So, it's not just a forecast. It is happening.”
paras.zh: “我可以向你们保证，我们看到很多油轮通过该通道，”杰弗罗伊先生告诉秘书长。 “所以，这不仅仅是一个预测。它正在发生。”

paras.en: An oil spill in these waters could be disastrous. Petroleum can become trapped in the ice for long periods, threatening marine life and making cleanup exceptionally difficult.
paras.zh: 这些水域的石油泄漏可能会造成灾难性的后果。石油可能会长时间滞留在冰中，威胁海洋生物并使清理工作变得异常困难。

paras.en: Commercial interests are not the only ones turning their attention north. Guterres pointed to tensions surrounding Greenland and the growing strategic importance of the Arctic, warning that countries increasingly viewing the region through a security lens could threaten the very environment scientists are trying to understand.
paras.zh: 商业利益并不是唯一将注意力转向北方的人。古特雷斯指出了格陵兰岛周围的紧张局势以及北极日益增长的战略重要性，他警告说，各国越来越多地通过安全视角看待该地区，可能会威胁到科学家们试图了解的环境。

paras.en: For Mr. Geoffroy, whose expedition brings together researchers from 12 countries, the question was whether science could help bridge those geopolitical divides.
paras.zh: 杰弗罗伊的探险队汇集了来自 12 个国家的研究人员，对他来说，问题是科学是否能够帮助弥合这些地缘政治分歧。

paras.en: “I think that is a central battle we have now. The battle for truth and the battle for science,” the UN chief replied.
paras.zh: “我认为这是我们现在面临的一场核心战斗。为真理而战，为科学而战，”联合国秘书长回答道。

paras.en: The Secretary-General accused powerful economic interests, particularly those linked to fossil fuels, of seeking to obscure scientific evidence and undermine its role in public debate.
paras.zh: 秘书长指责强大的经济利益集团，特别是那些与化石燃料有关的经济利益集团，试图掩盖科学证据并削弱其在公共辩论中的作用。

paras.en: “We went from the climate denial to the climate [...] delay and ‘green hushing’,” Mr. Geoffroy observed, lamenting how climate action has slipped down political agendas despite decades of scientific warnings.
paras.zh: 杰弗罗伊先生评论道：“我们从否认气候变化转向了气候变化拖延和‘绿色沉默’。”他感叹，尽管数十年来科学警告不断，但气候行动却从政治议程中滑落。

paras.en: Before ending their conversation, the UN chief invited Mr. Geoffroy to imagine addressing world leaders gathering at COP31.
paras.zh: 在结束谈话之前，联合国秘书长邀请杰弗罗伊先生想象一下在 COP31 上聚集的世界领导人演讲的情景。

paras.en: “The findings of this science [...] need to be trusted, they need to be followed and they need to be supported.”
paras.zh: “这门科学的发现……需要被信任、被遵循、被支持。”

paras.en: For Guterres, the warning struck a personal chord. He recalled visits to Antarctica and the Himalayas, where he had witnessed glaciers retreating.
paras.zh: 对于古特雷斯来说，这一警告引起了个人的共鸣。他回忆起对南极洲和喜马拉雅山的访问，在那里他亲眼目睹了冰川的消退。

paras.en: Those experiences, combined with the continued refusal of some political leaders to act, had left him with more than concern.
paras.zh: 这些经历，加上一些政治领导人持续拒绝采取行动，让他感到担忧的不仅仅是这些。

paras.en: “All these things I think have created in me a sense of urgency and, to be honest, also a sense of fury,” he admitted. “It’s an existential battle.”
paras.zh: “我认为所有这些事情都让我产生了一种紧迫感，说实话，也产生了一种愤怒感，”他承认。 “这是一场关乎生存的战斗。”

paras.en: In the Arctic, the researchers will continue their slow drift through the polar darkness, gathering evidence from a region changing before their eyes.
paras.zh: 在北极，研究人员将继续在极地黑暗中缓慢漂流，从他们眼前发生变化的地区收集证据。

paras.en: Örkki the dog will keep watch for polar bears while the team measures the ice, water and atmosphere. Thousands of kilometres away, world leaders will gather in Antalya, Türkiye at COP31 to negotiate how to confront the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 当团队测量冰、水和大气时，狗 Örkki 将监视北极熊。数千公里外的世界领导人将齐聚土耳其安塔利亚，出席 COP31，商讨如何应对气候危机。

paras.en: And while the scientists have no control over where the ice carries them, the future they are documenting remains a matter of human choice.
paras.zh: 虽然科学家无法控制冰将他们带到哪里，但他们记录的未来仍然是人类选择的问题。

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: Five-star Falkirk thump sorry Hearts to move up to third

paras.en: Hearts vs Falkirk. Scottish Premiership.
paras.zh: 红心队对阵福尔柯克队。苏格兰超级联赛。

paras.en: Hearts 2-5 Falkirk: Bairns end Jambos impressive home Premiership record to replace them in third
paras.zh: Hearts 2-5 Falkirk ： Bairns结束了Jambos令人印象深刻的主场英超纪录，取代了他们的第三名

paras.en: Report as Falkirk beat Hearts 5-2 at Tynecastle Park; Finley Barbrook opened the scoring with Owen Eames, Liam Henderson and Jacob Murrell's double putting the five in front; Sabri Guendouz and Claudio Braga pulled two goals back for the Jambos
paras.zh: 报道福尔柯克在泰恩卡斯尔公园球场 5-2 击败红心队；芬利·巴布鲁克凭借欧文·埃姆斯、利亚姆·亨德森和雅各布·穆雷尔的双打首开纪录，五人领先；萨布里·冈杜兹和克劳迪奥·布拉加为詹博队扳回两球

paras.en: Rampant Falkirk obliterated Hearts' 18-month unbeaten home record in the Scottish Premiership with a stunning 5-2 win at Tynecastle as they leapfrogged the Jambos into third place.
paras.zh: 猖獗的福尔柯克以 5-2 击败泰恩卡斯尔队，打破了哈茨队在苏格兰超级联赛中 18 个月不败的主场纪录，超越詹博斯队升至第三位。

paras.en: Wouter Vrancken's beleaguered side, missing 11 players through injury amid a gruelling fixture list, were in disarray as the swashbuckling Bairns romped into a five-goal lead early in the second half through Finley Barbrook, Owen Eames, Liam Henderson and Jacob Murrell's double.
paras.zh: 沃特·弗兰肯 (Wouter Vrancken) 的球队陷入困境，在一场艰苦的赛程中因伤缺席了 11 名球员，下半场一开始，拜恩斯 (Bairns) 凭借芬利·巴布鲁克 (Finley Barbrook)、欧文·埃姆斯 (Owen Eames)、利亚姆·亨德森 (Liam Henderson) 和雅各布·穆雷尔 (Jacob Murrell) 的梅开二度，取得五球领先优势，球队陷入混乱。

paras.en: Hearts hit back through substitute Sabri Guendouz and a Claudio Braga penalty, but Falkirk were well worthy of making it five top-flight wins in a row for the first time since 1995.
paras.zh: 哈茨队通过替补萨布里·古恩杜兹和克劳迪奥·布拉加的点球进行反击，但福尔柯克队自 1995 年以来首次实现顶级联赛五连胜。

paras.en: - Watch FREE Scottish Prem highlights | Latest Scottish Prem news | Latest scores
paras.zh: - 免费观看苏格兰Prem 精彩集锦|最新的苏格兰Prem新闻|最新成绩

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream the Scottish Prem with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新的天空体育交易或无合同的苏格兰Prem直播

paras.en: It was a first league defeat at Tynecastle for Hearts since April 2025. To exacerbate their grim predicament, the Jambos, who have won just two of their last 11 matches, lost yet another senior player as Malachi Fagan-Walcott limped off in the second half.
paras.zh: 这是红心队自 2025 年 4 月以来在泰恩卡斯尔的首次联赛失利。让他们严峻的困境雪上加霜的是，在过去 11 场比赛中只赢了 2 场的詹博队，由于马拉奇·法根-沃尔科特在下半场一瘸一拐地下场，又失去了一名高级球员。

paras.en: There were two changes to the Hearts side that started Thursday's Conference League defeat to Thun as Stephen Kingsley and Guendouz were replaced by Yan Dhanda and Landry Kabore.
paras.zh: 在周四联盟联赛输给图恩的比赛中，红心队做出了两项调整，斯蒂芬·金斯利和古恩杜兹被扬·丹达和兰德里·卡博雷取代。

paras.en: Falkirk boss John McGlynn, named manager of the month for October, made one enforced change from the side that defeated Celtic last Sunday as Jack McMillan took over from injured right-back Ryan Strain.
paras.zh: 福尔柯克主帅约翰·麦克格林被评为十月最佳主教练，他对上周日击败凯尔特人队的球队做出了一项强制调整，杰克·麦克米兰接替了受伤的右后卫瑞恩·斯特林的位置。

paras.en: The Bairns are now one point above Hearts after their fifth straight Premiership victory.
paras.zh: 拜恩队在英超取得五连胜后，现在领先红心队一分。

articles.title: 'I gave it everything' - DeChambeau breaks silence on LIV Golf

paras.en: Bryson DeChambeau issues statement on LIV Golf after league scraps reboot plans and files for bankruptcy
paras.zh: 布莱森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 在 LIV Golf 联盟取消重启计划并申请破产后发表声明

paras.en: Bryson DeChambeau issues statement on LIV Golf after league scraps reboot plans and files for bankruptcy: DeChambeau has lost his DP World Tour exemption for 2028 and 2029.
paras.zh: 在联盟取消重新启动计划并申请破产后，布莱森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 就 LIV Golf 发表声明：布赖森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 失去了 2028 年和 2029 年 DP 世界巡回赛的豁免权。

paras.en: Bryson DeChambeau appears to have confirmed his LIV Golf exit, telling fans he "gave it everything" to keep the league alive.
paras.zh: 布莱森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 似乎已经确认退出 LIV Golf，并告诉球迷他“竭尽全力”以保持联盟的活力。

paras.en: LIV Golf has confirmed plans to wind down operations and enter liquidation, abandoning hopes of launching a new version due to a lack of financial backing. Lawyers representing the company confirmed the plans during a bankruptcy hearing in New Jersey on Thursday.
paras.zh: LIV Golf 已确认计划停止运营并进入清算阶段，由于缺乏财务支持，放弃了推出新版本的希望。代表该公司的律师周四在新泽西州举行的破产听证会上证实了该计划。

paras.en: DeChambeau has until November 15 to declare his intention to become a DP World Tour member in 2027, or risk being frozen out of professional golf. He has defended his decision to join LIV from the outset and thanked his supporters in a statement posted on X on Sunday.
paras.zh: 德尚博必须在 11 月 15 日之前宣布他打算在 2027 年成为 DP 世界巡回赛会员，否则将面临被职业高尔夫排除在外的风险。他从一开始就为自己加入 LIV 的决定进行了辩护，并在周日在 X 上发布的声明中感谢了他的支持者。

paras.en: "I'm not going to rewrite the last four years," DeChambeau wrote.
paras.zh: “我不会改写过去的四年，”德尚博写道。

paras.en: "I made a decision I believed in, and I'm grateful for what came with it: playing in front of fans new and old around the world who rarely got to see the best players at home. The record crowds in Adelaide and Johannesburg will stick with me for the rest of my life.
paras.zh: “我做出了一个我相信的决定，我很感激随之而来的结果：在世界各地的新老球迷面前比赛，他们很少能在国内见到最好的球员。阿德莱德和约翰内斯堡创纪录的观众人数将伴随我一生。

paras.en: "I believed this game could reach more people, in more places, in a new way. I still believe that. And I gave it everything I had to keep team golf alive.
paras.zh: “我相信这项运动可以以一种新的方式在更多的地方惠及更多的人。我仍然相信这一点。我为它付出了一切，以保持团队高尔夫的活力。

paras.en: "I want to say thank you to the people who believed in this from the start: the staff, the operations crews, the caddies, and everyone behind the scenes at LIV and Crushers GC who bet their careers on this. You gave everything. And thank you to my Crushers team-mates, our sponsors, and every fan who came out.
paras.zh: “我想对那些从一开始就相信这一点的人表示感谢：工作人员、运营人员、球童以及LIV和Crushers GC幕后的每个人，他们将自己的职业生涯押在了这件事上。你们付出了一切。并感谢我的Crushers队友、我们的赞助商以及每一位出来的粉丝。

paras.en: "I still believe in team golf. It may look different in the future, but I still believe it's essential to growing the game."
paras.zh: “我仍然相信团队高尔夫。未来可能会有所不同，但我仍然相信这对于发展这项运动至关重要。”

paras.en: The two-time major champion explained last week that he was hopeful the league could "exist forever", with Dechambeau also revealing he had played a role in plotting out how LIV 2.0 could move forward.
paras.zh: 这位两届大满贯冠军上周解释说，他希望联盟能够“永远存在”，德尚博还透露，他在规划 LIV 2.0 如何向前发展方面发挥了作用。

paras.en: Despite LIV's impending liquidation, the American golfer remained tight-lipped about his own future:
paras.zh: 尽管 LIV 即将清算，这位美国高尔夫球手仍然对自己的未来守口如瓶：

paras.en: "Arnold Palmer said no player is bigger than the game, and I want to acknowledge that, along the way, I've said some things that didn't help. Whatever comes next, I'll approach it with humility and respect for the people who carried this game long before me.
paras.zh: “阿诺德·帕尔默说过，没有一个球员比这项运动更伟大，我想承认，一路走来，我说了一些无济于事的事情。无论接下来发生什么，我都会以谦虚的态度对待它，并尊重那些在我之前很久就完成了这项运动的人。

paras.en: "In December, I'll compete at the Nedbank Golf Challenge, Gary Player's event, in front of fans who made my first visit to South Africa unforgettable. Beyond that, I'll go about whatever is next the right way.
paras.zh: “12月，我将在球迷面前参加莱利银行高尔夫挑战赛，这是加里·普莱尔的赛事，他们让我第一次访问南非变得难忘。除此之外，我会以正确的方式去做接下来的事情。

paras.en: "My passion has been to grow this game. That's still the goal. Thank you for sticking with me.
paras.zh: “我的热情一直是发展这款游戏。这仍然是目标。感谢您坚持我。

paras.en: "Together we can all grow this great game we love."
paras.zh: “我们齐心协力，就能发展我们喜爱的这款伟大游戏。”

paras.en: Analysis by Sky Sports News' Jamie Weir:
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻的杰米·威尔分析：

paras.en: Love him or hate him, DeChambeau has star factor. He puts bums on seats, he commands eyeballs and column inches. He is box office.
paras.zh: 不管你爱他还是恨他，德尚博都有明星因素。他把流浪汉放在座位上，他控制着眼球和柱子。他是票房。

paras.en: Until the bitter end, he believed fully in LIV 2.0, the phoenix from the flames version of the beleaguered and controversial golf tour.
paras.zh: 直到痛苦的结局，他都完全相信LIV 2.0，即陷入困境和争议的高尔夫巡回赛的浴火凤凰版本。

paras.en: One source told me that in a meeting of LIV's 13 team captains in August, when the end was seemingly nigh, DeChambeau was the only one who still passionately felt there was a way forward and attempted to win over the other 12, who were resigned to LIV's fate. No one was willing to take that leap into the unknown with him.
paras.zh: 一位消息人士告诉我，在 8 月份 LIV 13 队队长的一次会议上，当末日似乎即将到来时，德尚博是唯一一个仍然热情地认为还有前进的道路并试图赢得其他 12 名队长的人，他们已经听从了 LIV 的命运。没有人愿意和他一起迈向未知的一跃。

paras.en: By virtue of winning the 2024 US Open at Pinehurst, DeChambeau earned a five-year exemption on the DP World Tour. However, the rules state that for every year a major champion fails to take up his membership, they lose a year off the end of this period.
paras.zh: 凭借在松树丛举行的 2024 年美国公开赛夺冠，德尚博获得了 DP 世界巡回赛五年的豁免权。然而，规则规定，大满贯冠军每年未能加入其会员资格，他们将在该期限结束后失去一年的资格。

paras.en: In other words, having failed to take up DP World Tour membership in 2025 and 2026, DeChambeau lost his exemption for 2028 and 2029.
paras.zh: 换句话说，由于未能在 2025 年和 2026 年成为 DP 世界巡回赛会员，德尚博失去了 2028 年和 2029 年的豁免资格。

paras.en: That means he does still have the option of taking up membership for the 2027 season, but must inform the tour of his intention to do so by its deadline of November 15.
paras.zh: 这意味着他仍然可以选择在 2027 赛季成为会员，但必须在 11 月 15 日截止日期之前告知美巡赛他的打算。

articles.title: Burrow and Chase star as Bengals beat Falcons at Bernabeu

paras.en: NFL Madrid 2026: Ja'Marr Chase and Joe Burrow star as Cincinnati Bengals beat Atlanta Falcons at Bernabeu
paras.zh: NFL 马德里 2026：贾马尔·蔡斯 (Ja'Marr Chase) 和乔·布罗 (Joe Burrow) 主演辛辛那提猛虎队在伯纳乌击败亚特兰大猎鹰队

paras.en: Ja'Marr Chase produced a dominant first-half performance to set the tone for a Cincinnati Bengals win that lifts them to 6-2; the NFL was playing at Madrid's Bernabeu Stadium for the second year in a row as part of a record nine international games during the 2026 season
paras.zh: 贾马尔·蔡斯上半场表现出色，为辛辛那提猛虎队的胜利奠定了基调，最终将比分提升至 6-2； NFL 连续第二年在马德里伯纳乌球场举行比赛，这是 2026 赛季创纪录的九场国际比赛的一部分

paras.en: The big three of Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins feasted in Madrid as the Cincinnati Bengals stormed to a 34-17 over the Atlanta Falcons at the Santiago Bernabeu on Sunday.
paras.zh: 乔·伯罗、贾马尔·蔡斯和蒂·希金斯三巨头在马德里大放异彩，周日，辛辛那提猛虎队在圣地亚哥伯纳乌以 34-17 战胜亚特兰大猎鹰队。

paras.en: Burrow had spoken of his admiration for Madrid's museums and galleries during the week. Come gameday he was the provider of fine art while going 24 of 29 for 271 yards and three touchdowns alongside a rushing score to bolster his growing MVP case and underline Cincinnati's Super Bowl threat.
paras.zh: 本周，伯罗谈到了他对马德里博物馆和画廊的钦佩。比赛日到来时，他29投24中，推进271码，取得3次达阵，并以冲球得分巩固了他不断增长的MVP地位，并凸显了辛辛那提对超级碗的威胁。

paras.en: Chase logged much of his dominance in the first half and finished with 10 catches from 12 targets for 155 yards and a touchdown, while Tee Higgins, who entered the weekend second in the NFL in receiving yards, added two touchdown receptions to help Zac Taylor's side improve to 6-2.
paras.zh: 蔡斯在上半场发挥了很大的统治力，最终从 12 个目标中完成 10 次接球，推进 155 码并达阵，而本周末 NFL 接球码数第二的蒂·希金斯 (Tee Higgins) 又接球达阵两次，帮助扎克·泰勒 (Zac Taylor) 的球队将战绩提高到 6-2。

paras.en: Bijan Robinson, as is so often the case, was Atlanta's chief hope as he persisted to 100 rushing yards and a touchdown from 19 carries, while Michael Penix Jr was limited to 162 yards passing for one touchdown and a pick.
paras.zh: 比扬·罗宾逊（Bijan Robinson）一如既往地成为亚特兰大队的主要希望，因为他坚持冲球 100 码并有 19 次冲球达阵，而小迈克尔·佩尼克斯（Michael Penix Jr）的传球距离只有 162 码，只有 1 次达阵和 1 次接球。

paras.en: The NFL arrived in Madrid for the second year running as it celebrated the seventh of its record nine international games being played in 2026, with Munich and Mexico City to round off the historic slate later this month.
paras.zh: NFL 连续第二年来到马德里，庆祝 2026 年举行的九场国际比赛中的第七场，本月晚些时候，慕尼黑和墨西哥城将完成这一历史性的比赛。

paras.en: The Falcons continuously hurt their efforts to dig into their deficit by racking up 12 penalties for a loss of 88 yards as they fell to 3-6.
paras.zh: 猎鹰队连续受到 12 个罚球，落后 88 码，最终以 3-6 落后，继续损害了他们缩小差距的努力。

paras.en: By the end of the first half alone Chase had eight catches for 142 yards and a touchdown to help the Bengals build a 24-10 cushion that quashed the early prospects of a shootout.
paras.zh: 仅上半场结束时，蔡斯就完成了 8 次接球，推进 142 码并达阵，帮助孟虎队建立了 24-10 的缓冲，打破了点球大战的早期前景。

paras.en: Robinson spearheaded the Atlanta response out of the break as he kicked outside for a one-yard touchdown to cap an 11-play drive during which he had touched the ball eight times.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊在中场休息后带头为亚特兰大队做出回应，他在外线踢出一码达阵，结束了他在 11 场比赛中触球 8 次的进攻。

paras.en: But such are the Bengals, such is Burrow, such is Higgins, the retaliation was emphatic. Higgins snagged his second touchdown catch of the day with suction hands under tight coverage at the back of the end zone to make it 31-17, the possession notably driven by Chase Brown and the running game.
paras.zh: 但孟加拉虎队就是这样，巴罗就是这样，希金斯就是这样，他们的报复是强烈的。希金斯在达阵区后部的严密防守下，用吸力双手完成了当天的第二次达阵接球，将比分改写为31-17，这一控球主要是由蔡斯·布朗和跑动比赛推动的。

paras.en: Nick Folk squandered a chance to cut into the Bengals' lead when he missed a 38-yard field goal, before Evan McPherson's 43-yard kick made it 34-17.
paras.zh: 尼克·福尔克(Nick Folk)错过了38码的射门，浪费了孟加拉虎领先优势的机会，随后埃文·麦克弗森(Evan McPherson)的43码射门将比分改写为34-17。

paras.en: Cincinnati called game with four minutes to play when Penix Jr was intercepted by Barrett Carter on a pass intended for Robinson.
paras.zh: 比赛还剩四分钟时，辛辛那提队宣布比赛结束，小佩尼克斯传给罗宾逊的球被巴雷特·卡特拦截。

paras.en: The Falcons struck first in Madrid when Penix Jr floated a one-yard touchdown pass to Charlie Woerner to cap the opening drive of the game.
paras.zh: 猎鹰队在马德里率先发起进攻，小佩尼克斯将一码达阵传球给查理·沃尔纳，结束了比赛的开局。

paras.en: It would prompt a ruthless Bengals response, beginning with Burrow's touch perfect 47-yard touchdown strike to Chase as the Bernabeu erupted to the sight of the NFL's superstar tandem linking up.
paras.zh: 这引发了猛虎队的残酷回应，首先是伯罗为蔡斯完美的 47 码触地得分，伯纳乌球场爆发出 NFL 超级巨星串联的景象。

paras.en: Cincinnati's under-the-microscope defense followed up with a red zone stand, helped by Falcons penalties, to pave the way for more points.
paras.zh: 在猎鹰队罚球的帮助下，辛辛那提队在显微镜下的防守随后进入了红区，为获得更多分数铺平了道路。

paras.en: It was Burrow himself who punched in a one-yard touchdown at the end of an 11-play 70-yard march after Brown was stuffed at the goalline.
paras.zh: 在布朗被塞到球门线后，伯罗本人在 11 次 70 码行进结束时一拳达阵。

paras.en: Chase starred again moments later with a stunning toe-drag sideline catch to convert on third down, teeing up Burrow's five-yard touchdown lob to the hands of Higgins for 21-10.
paras.zh: 片刻之后，蔡斯再次表现出色，在第三次进攻中用脚尖拖拽边线接球，将伯罗的五码达阵吊球传给希金斯，以21-10。

paras.en: McPherson extended Cincinnati's lead at the end of the half with a 56-yard field goal.
paras.zh: 麦克弗森在半场结束时以56码的射门扩大了辛辛那提的领先优势。

articles.title: Investors try to regain their footing after tech stocks tank
articles.author: Rob Wile

paras.en: Tech stocks in the U.S. steadied Friday after suffering one of their worst routs in years, as investors weighed the prospect of an AI investment slowdown resulting from Democratic midterm victories against the sector’s long-term growth potential.
paras.zh: 美国科技股在遭遇多年​​来最严重的暴跌之一后周五企稳，投资者权衡民主党中期选举胜利导致人工智能投资放缓的前景与该行业的长期增长潜力。

paras.en: The tech-focused Nasdaq 100 closed up 1.1% after plunging 6.3% on Thursday, its worst single-day performance since the Covid-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: 以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数周四暴跌 6.3%，收盘上涨 1.1%，这是自 Covid-19 大流行以来最糟糕的单日表现。

paras.en: The broader S&P 500 finished 0.3% higher, after tanking 4.4% Thursday, a drop that wiped out $2.8 trillion worth of wealth on paper.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数周四下跌 4.4%，收盘上涨 0.3%，这一跌幅抹去了纸面价值 2.8 万亿美元的财富。

paras.en: A strong October jobs report Friday morning increased the odds that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates at its next policy meeting in December. The prospect of higher borrowing costs helped to push stocks down from their highs earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 周五上午强劲的 10 月份就业报告增加了美联储在 12 月份下一次政策会议上加息的可能性。借贷成本上升的前景推动股市从当天早些时候的高点回落。

paras.en: Investors continue to digest the results of Tuesday’s midterm elections, in which a crop of Democratic candidates were elected to office who had pledged to rein in AI and data centers. They include Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa of Texas, a state that is among the largest data center markets in the country.
paras.zh: 投资者继续消化周二中期选举的结果，一批承诺控制人工智能和数据中心的民主党候选人当选。其中包括德克萨斯州当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨（Gina Hinojosa），该州是美国最大的数据中心市场之一。

paras.en: The AI boom is responsible for an ever-increasing share of U.S. stock market gains and economic growth, so any threat to the narrative of demand-fueled growth can rattle investors.
paras.zh: 人工智能的繁荣在美国股市上涨和经济增长中所占的份额不断增加，因此任何对需求拉动增长的说法的威胁都会让投资者感到不安。

paras.en: “Markets are being punished according to their dependence on the U.S. AI infrastructure cycle,” Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Singapore-based SAXO Markets, told NBC News.
paras.zh: 总部位于新加坡的 SAXO Markets 首席投资策略师查鲁·查纳纳 (Charu Chanana) 告诉 NBC 新闻：“市场因其对美国人工智能基础设施周期的依赖而受到惩罚。”

paras.en: The incoming Democratic-controlled Congress could also tighten scrutiny of the AI industry, including its infrastructure projects, which could cause delays and additional costs.
paras.zh: 即将上任的民主党控制的国会也可能会加强对人工智能行业的审查，包括其基础设施项目，这可能会导致延误和额外成本。

paras.en: This would add to existing worries investors already have about the long-term profitability of these investments.
paras.zh: 这将加剧投资者对这些投资的长期盈利能力的现有担忧。

paras.en: Some analysts viewed Thursday’s dramatic sell-off as overblown — merely a sign of some froth coming off an overstretched market — rather than the end of the line for the AI investment boom.
paras.zh: 一些分析师认为周四的大幅抛售有些言过其实——这只是过度扩张的市场出现一些泡沫的迹象——而不是人工智能投资热潮的终结。

paras.en: Recent declines are “just speed bumps,” said economist and investor Ed Yardeni.
paras.zh: 经济学家兼投资者埃德·亚德尼 (Ed Yardeni) 表示，最近的下跌“只是减速带”。

paras.en: Rather than spelling doom for the sector, Yardeni said, losses like this week’s could ultimately help keep the AI bubble from overheating.
paras.zh: 亚德尼表示，像本周这样的损失最终可能有助于防止人工智能泡沫过热，而不是给该行业带来厄运。

paras.en: Until it becomes clearer how much data center construction is truly threatened by newly elected lawmakers, volatility is likely to continue.
paras.zh: 在弄清楚新当选的立法者对数据中心建设的真正威胁有多大之前，波动可能会持续下去。

paras.en: “This is a stock market that is trying to figure out the right valuations for the AI trade, which is grappling with a swift sentiment shift after the midterm elections,” said Alex Guiliano, the chief investment officer at New Jersey-based Resonate Wealth Partners.
paras.zh: 总部位于新泽西州的 Resonate Wealth Partners 首席投资官亚历克斯·吉利亚诺 (Alex Guiliano) 表示：“股市正试图为人工智能行业找到正确的估值，该行业正在努力应对中期选举后情绪的迅速转变。”

paras.en: Friday kicked off with steep losses in Asia. Japan’s Nikkei suffered its worst week since 2020, falling as much as 6% and more than 20% since its most recent high, putting it in bear-market territory. South Korea’s Kospi index tumbled more than 8%, triggering a temporary marketwide trading halt. There, AI data center memory suppliers Samsung and SK Hynix plunged more than 10% in the early hours, before recovering some of their losses.
paras.zh: 周五亚洲股市大幅下跌。日本日经指数遭遇 2020 年以来最糟糕的一周，跌幅高达 6%，自近期高点以来跌幅超过 20%，进入熊市区域。韩国 Kospi 指数暴跌超过 8%，引发全市场暂时停牌。其中，AI数据中心内存供应商三星和SK海力士早盘暴跌超过10%，随后收复了部分跌幅。

paras.en: In Taiwan, home to some of the most critical AI companies, including chip supplier TSMC, the benchmark TAIEX index dropped 9%.
paras.zh: 在台湾，一些最重要的人工智能公司（包括芯片供应商台积电）的所在地，基准 TAIEX 指数下跌了 9%。

paras.en: The companies in Taiwan, South Korea and Japan are linked to the global AI spending cycle and “hence I am not surprised to see the magnitude of correction today following the sharp correction in the U.S.,” Tai Hui, J.P. Morgan’s APAC chief market strategist, told NBC News in emailed comments.
paras.zh: 台湾、韩国和日本的公司与全球人工智能支出周期相关，“因此，在美国大幅调整之后，今天看到如此大的调整幅度，我并不感到惊讶，”摩根大通亚太区首席市场策略师泰辉在电子邮件评论中告诉 NBC 新闻。

paras.en: The months leading up to the American elections had already been a roller coaster for Asian investors, who saw their fortunes soar in June during the AI stock boom, but have been suffering from a brutal recent sell-off.
paras.zh: 美国大选前的几个月对亚洲投资者来说就像过山车一样，他们的财富在 6 月份人工智能股票繁荣期间飙升，但最近却遭受了残酷的抛售。

paras.en: A sense that valuations of key AI companies were inflated was troublesome enough for markets in Asia, but the Democratic sweep has introduced another layer of uncertainty.
paras.zh: 对于亚洲市场来说，主要人工智能公司估值过高的感觉已经够麻烦的了，但民主党的横扫又带来了另一层不确定性。

paras.en: Markets had largely expected losses for Trump’s Republicans, but not on this scale.
paras.zh: 市场很大程度上预计特朗普领导下的共和党会遭受损失，但规模并没有这么大。

paras.en: “This matters enormously for Asia because much of the hardware supporting America’s AI ambitions is manufactured here,” Chanana, from SAXO Markets, said.
paras.zh: 盛宝市场 (SAXO Markets) 的查纳纳 (Chanana) 表示：“这对亚洲非常重要，因为支持美国人工智能雄心的大部分硬件都是在这里制造的。”

paras.en: In China, both the tech-focused Star 50 and the AI Index slumped as much as 5% before recouping some losses.
paras.zh: 在中国，以科技股为主的 Star 50 指数和 AI 指数均下跌了 5%，然后收复了部分跌幅。

paras.en: “There is a legitimate argument that parts of China’s AI equity bubble have already burst,” Chanana said.
paras.zh: “有一个合理的论点认为，中国部分人工智能股票泡沫已经破裂，”查纳纳说。

paras.en: But she added that unlike the U.S., where much of the investment is commercially driven, “China treats AI and semiconductor self-sufficiency as strategic national priorities.”
paras.zh: 但她补充说，与美国的大部分投资是商业驱动的不同，“中国将人工智能和半导体自给自足视为国家战略优先事项。”

paras.en: “This means investment can continue for reasons beyond immediate profitability, including technological independence, industrial competitiveness and national security.”
paras.zh: “这意味着投资可以出于短期盈利之外的原因继续进行，包括技术独立性、产业竞争力和国家安全。”

paras.en: That is not the case in South Korea, whose market darlings, memory makers SK Hynix and Samsung, are an integral part of the commercial AI build-out. That makes the country particularly sensitive to any U.S. slowdowns.
paras.zh: 韩国的情况并非如此，韩国的市场宠儿、内存制造商 SK 海力士和三星是商业人工智能建设不可或缺的一部分。这使得该国对美国经济放缓特别敏感。

paras.en: South Korea’s benchmark Kospi index more than doubled in market value in June, but by Friday had shed most of the gains made this year. Like South Korea, there is acute exposure for Taiwan — key for advanced chip manufacturing and TSMC’s headquarters.
paras.zh: 韩国基准 Kospi 指数 6 月份市值增长了一倍多，但到周五已经回吐了今年的大部分涨幅。与韩国一样，台湾也面临着巨大的风险——对于先进芯片制造和台积电总部来说至关重要。

paras.en: Nevertheless, most of the Asian indexes are still higher than they were a year ago: South Korea’s Kospi is up 25%, Japan’s Nikkei 225 is up 13%, and TSEC Taiwan Technology is also up by 47%.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，大多数亚洲指数仍高于一年前：韩国综合指数上涨25%，日本日经225指数上涨13%，台湾科技股指也上涨47%。

paras.en: “For semiconductor and memory makers in Asia Pacific, as long as global demand for computing power continues to grow, demand for the underlying hardware should remain healthy over the medium term,” J.P. Morgan’s Hui said.
paras.zh: 摩根大通的 Hui 表示：“对于亚太地区的半导体和内存制造商来说，只要全球对计算能力的需求持续增长，对底层硬件的需求在中期内就应该保持健康。”

paras.en: “There may be constraints on where the ‘gold’ can be mined, but as long as demand for the gold remains, the picks and shovels will still be needed elsewhere,” he added.
paras.zh: “开采‘黄金’的地点可能会受到限制，但只要对黄金的需求仍然存在，其他地方仍然需要镐和铲子，”他补充道。

articles.title: Pope Leo, who had cancer surgery weeks ago, begins South American tour
articles.author: Claudio Lavanga

paras.en: ABOARD THE PAPAL FLIGHT — Three countries in 12 days, a dozen flights, two helicopter rides and nine Masses on a trip covering around 19,000 miles. Less than a month after Pope Leo XIV underwent cancer surgery, he set off on what the Vatican called a “homecoming” tour of South America.
paras.zh: 搭乘教皇航班 — 12 天内穿越三个国家，乘坐十几次航班，乘坐两次直升机并举行九场弥撒，行程约 19,000 英里。教皇利奥十四世接受癌症手术后不到一个月，他就开始了梵蒂冈所谓的南美“返乡”之旅。

paras.en: The 71-year-old’s long trip across the strongly Catholic region will take him to Uruguay and Argentina, as well as to Peru, where he lived for decades and served as a bishop until 2023.
paras.zh: 这位 71 岁的老人将穿越这个天主教氛围浓厚的地区，前往乌拉圭和阿根廷，以及秘鲁，他在那里生活了几十年，并担任主教直至 2023 年。

paras.en: Leo considers the tour, one of the most grueling undertaken by a Catholic leader in decades, a “homecoming to places where he spent a long time and to which he feels closely connected,” Vatican spokesperson Matteo Bruni told journalists at a briefing Tuesday.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈发言人马泰奥·布鲁尼在周二的新闻发布会上对记者说，利奥认为这次旅行是几十年来天主教领袖进行的最艰苦的旅行之一，“一次回到他度过了很长时间、感觉与他有密切联系的地方”。

paras.en: The Chicago-born pontiff, who is also a citizen of Peru, told pilgrims at his weekly audience in St. Peter’s Square on Wednesday that he was hoping to “strengthen the faith, renew hope” and “rekindle the fire of charity.”
paras.zh: 这位出生于芝加哥的教皇也是秘鲁公民，周三他在圣彼得广场每周一次的接见中对朝圣者说，他希望“坚定信仰，重燃希望”并“重新点燃慈善之火”。

paras.en: Leo will hold several meetings with survivors of sexual abuse by Catholic clergy during the trip, the Vatican has said, without yet providing further details.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，利奥将在旅途中与天主教神职人员性虐待的幸存者举行几次会议，但尚未提供更多细节。

paras.en: Bruni said the pope would also address a range of issues facing the continent, including environmental destruction, arms trafficking and regional political instability, bringing “a message of communion and unity.”
paras.zh: 布鲁尼表示，教皇还将解决非洲大陆面临的一系列问题，包括环境破坏、武器贩运和地区政治不稳定，带来“共融与团结的信息”。

paras.en: Leo departed from Rome’s Fiumicino Airport early Friday, and arrived in Uruguay on Friday afternoon for the country’s first papal visit since 1988.
paras.zh: 利奥周五早些时候从罗马菲乌米奇诺机场出发，周五下午抵达乌拉圭，这是自 1988 年以来教皇首次访问该国。

paras.en: After takeoff, Leo told journalists aboard the plane that he had no doubt he would embark on the trip.
paras.zh: 起飞后，利奥告诉飞机上的记者，他毫不怀疑自己会踏上这次旅行。

paras.en: “I know some people were doubtful about this trip taking place. I confess that from the first day I had no doubt,” he said. “I was convinced that this trip had to go forward and very happy to say, praise the Lord and thanks to wonderful medical assistants, I am here today, I think, in fairly good shape.”
paras.zh: “我知道有些人对这次旅行表示怀疑。我承认从第一天起我就没有怀疑，”他说。 “我确信这次旅行必须继续进行，并且非常高兴地说，赞美主并感谢出色的医疗助手，我认为我今天在这里，状态相当好。”

paras.en: Asked if he had any advice for other people facing cancer, Leo replied, “Not to be afraid, early detection is obviously the best way to go, regular check ups and take care of yourself.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否对其他面临癌症的人有什么建议时，Leo回答说：“不要害怕，早期发现显然是最好的方法，定期检查并照顾好自己。”

paras.en: Leo also noted in response to a question from NBC News that “trust in God, good doctors, good surgeons, and, overall, a healthy lifestyle” had contributed to his quick recovery.
paras.zh: 利奥在回答 NBC 新闻的问题时还指出，“对上帝的信任、好医生、好外科医生以及总体而言健康的生活方式”促成了他的快速康复。

paras.en: Leo, who is the first pope to vote in a U.S. election, was also asked about the importance of voting.
paras.zh: 利奥是第一位在美国选举中投票的教皇，他也被问及投票的重要性。

paras.en: “I am proud to be an American and to exercise my right,” he said.
paras.zh: “我为自己是美国人并行使我的权利感到自豪，”他说。

paras.en: Considered the most secular country in the region, where only a fraction of people go to Mass regularly, Uruguay was the first in the world to legalize marijuana for recreational use and the second country in Latin America to decriminalize abortion.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭被认为是该地区最世俗的国家，只有一小部分人定期参加弥撒，乌拉圭是世界上第一个将娱乐用大麻合法化的国家，也是拉丁美洲第二个将堕胎合法化的国家。

paras.en: In October 2025, the country of just 3.5 million people became the first in the region to approve legislation for assisted dying despite strong opposition from the Catholic Church.
paras.zh: 2025年10月，尽管天主教会强烈反对，这个只有350万人口的国家成为该地区第一个批准安乐死立法的国家。

paras.en: After Uruguay, Leo’s tour will take him to Argentina for three days, where he is expected to meet with right-wing President Javier Milei, a close ally of President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭之后，利奥将前往阿根廷进行为期三天的访问，预计他将在那里会见唐纳德·特朗普总统的亲密盟友、右翼总统哈维尔·米莱。

paras.en: It will be the first papal visit to Argentina since Pope John Paul II traveled to the country in 1987.
paras.zh: 这将是教皇约翰·保罗二世自1987年访问阿根廷以来首次访问阿根廷。

paras.en: Leo’s immediate predecessor, Pope Francis, was born in Argentina, the first pontiff from the region, but he declined numerous invitations to return to his homeland.
paras.zh: 利奥的前任教皇方济各出生于阿根廷，是该地区的第一位教皇，但他多次拒绝返回祖国的邀请。

paras.en: The biggest crowds of the trip are likely next week during his six-day visit to Peru, where Leo is widely celebrated as a beloved national figure. He will stop off in the capital, Lima, before visiting his former diocese of Chiclayo, where he was ordained bishop in 2014 and remained until taking up a Vatican post in 2023.
paras.zh: 此次旅行的最大人群可能是下周他对秘鲁进行为期六天的访问期间，利奥在秘鲁被广泛认为是一位受人爱戴的国家人物。他将在首都利马停留，然后访问他的前奇克拉约教区，他于 2014 年被任命为主教，并一直任职到 2023 年就任梵蒂冈职位。

paras.en: Leo, who was treated last month for lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer, will also make several high-altitude visits in the Peruvian Andes.
paras.zh: 利奥上个月接受了肺腺癌（最常见的肺癌）治疗，他还将前往秘鲁安第斯山脉进行几次高海拔访问。

paras.en: Doctors have said that the disease was localized and that he would not require any further treatments; Bruni said Leo had recovered enough that no additional medical measures would be necessary during his trip.
paras.zh: 医生表示，他的病情是局部的，不需要任何进一步的治疗；布鲁尼表示，利奥已经康复得足够好，在旅途中不需要采取额外的医疗措施。

paras.en: Speaking at the same briefing Tuesday, Maria Montserrat Alvarado, the Vatican’s new communications chief, said Leo was grateful for the concern about his health and the demands the journey might make on him.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈新任通讯主管玛丽亚·蒙特塞拉特·阿尔瓦拉多 (Maria Montserrat Alvarado) 在周二的同一场新闻发布会上表示，利奥很感谢大家对他健康状况的担忧以及这次旅行可能对他提出的要求。

paras.en: But, she said, he was “so excited” to make the trip.
paras.zh: 但是，她说，他对这次旅行“非常兴奋”。

articles.title: Kraków shooting that killed 6 was motivated by far-right views, authorities say
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: World leaders have paid tribute as Poland declared two national days of mourning after a shooter motivated by far-right ideologies killed six people in Kraków on Saturday, in what the country’s defense minister characterized as a “terror attack.”
paras.zh: 周六，克拉科夫一名出于极右意识形态的枪手造成六人死亡，波兰国防部长将此次事件定性为“恐怖袭击”，波兰宣布全国哀悼两天，世界各国领导人对此表示哀悼。

paras.en: The gunman, described by officials as having “ultranationalistic” beliefs, is reported to have opened fire in Kraków’s main market square. Four women and two men were killed in the midday attack, the country’s deadliest shooting in decades, while a policeman who confronted the gunman is in critical condition.
paras.zh: 据报道，这名枪手在克拉科夫的主要集市广场开枪，官员称这名枪手具有“超民族主义”信仰。中午的袭击造成四名妇女和两名男子死亡，这是该国几十年来最严重的枪击事件，而与枪手对峙的一名警察情况危急。

paras.en: The suspect is being investigated on suspicion of murder in connection with the six deaths, Polish Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek said on X Sunday, adding that he “acted with the aim of seriously intimidating a large number of people, making this a terrorist offence.”
paras.zh: 波兰司法部长瓦尔德马·茹雷克 (Waldemar Żurek) 周日表示，嫌疑人因涉嫌与六人死亡有关的谋杀罪正在接受调查，并补充说，他“采取行动的目的是严重恐吓大量民众，使这起事件成为恐怖主义罪行”。

paras.en: The same suspect is facing a separate murder charge over killings in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyskie, Żurek said, a town some 93 miles northeast of Kraków where three of the man’s relatives were found dead in his home.
paras.zh: 祖雷克说，同一名嫌疑人因在奥斯特罗维茨圣十字区杀人而面临单独的谋杀指控，该镇位于克拉科夫东北约 93 英里处，该男子的三名亲属被发现死在家中。

paras.en: “Establishing all the circumstances of these tragic events, determining the full sequence of the perpetrator’s actions and securing evidence are currently the priorities of the investigation,” which is being led by terror offense specialists within the prosecutor’s office, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“查明这些悲惨事件的所有背景，确定肇事者行为的全部顺序并获取证据是目前调查的首要任务”，调查由检察官办公室内的恐怖犯罪专家领导。

paras.en: Krakow‘s prosecutor Eryk Stasielak said the shooter was in critical condition and victim autopsies were set to start on Monday, according to PAP, a Polish news service.
paras.zh: 据波兰新闻机构 PAP 报道，克拉科夫检察官埃里克·斯塔西拉克 (Eryk Stasielak) 表示，枪手情况危急，受害者尸检将于周一开始。

paras.en: “Tomorrow we will be deciding the fate of the attacker, if he survives, because he remains in critical condition,” Stasielak said, according to a translation of the report.
paras.zh: 根据报告的翻译，斯塔西拉克说：“明天我们将决定袭击者的命运，如果他还活着，因为他仍处于危急状态。”

paras.en: Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński did not name the suspect but identified him as a Polish national in his mid-20s from Ostrowiec Świętokrzyskie. He used an automatic rifle, Kierwiński said Saturday, describing him as having “ultranationalistic” views.
paras.zh: 内政部长 Marcin Kierwiński 没有透露嫌疑人的名字，但确认他是来自奥斯特罗维茨圣十字省的 20 多岁的波兰国民。基尔温斯基周六表示，他使用的是自动步枪，并称他有“超民族主义”观点。

paras.en: “Everything indicates he was fascinated by far-right ideologies,” he said.
paras.zh: “一切都表明他对极右意识形态着迷，”他说。

paras.en: The suspect was shot by police at the scene and taken to the hospital around 3 p.m. local time. He remains in critical condition, regional governor Krzysztof Klęczar told a news conference Sunday.
paras.zh: 下午3点左右，嫌疑人在现场被警察开枪射杀，并被送往医院。当地时间。地区州长克日什托夫·克勒恰在周日的新闻发布会上表示，他的情况仍然危急。

paras.en: A man and two women later found dead in an apartment are believed to be the suspect’s parents and sister, according to Andrzej Fijołek, deputy inspector of Police National Headquarters.
paras.zh: 国家警察总部副巡视员安杰伊·菲霍莱克 (Andrzej Fijołek) 表示，后来在公寓里发现的一名男子和两名妇女死亡，据信是嫌疑人的父母和妹妹。

paras.en: Two national days of mourning on November 8 and 9 were announced by the Interior Ministry on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，内政部宣布11月8日和9日为两个全国哀悼日。

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV issued a message to the archbishop of Krakow on Sunday expressing sadness over the tragedy. The Pope “implores the gift of Christian hope for the families overwhelmed by grief and joins with all those experiencing these days of mourning,” the message read, according to a translation.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日向克拉科夫大主教发表讲话，对这场悲剧表示悲伤。根据翻译，教宗“恳求为那些悲痛欲绝的家庭带来基督教的希望，并与所有经历这些日子哀悼的人们一起”。

paras.en: Żurek, the justice minister, said on social media early on Sunday that Senior Constable Jakub Kulik “is fighting for his life in hospital” after he confronted the shooter.
paras.zh: 司法部长祖雷克周日早些时候在社交媒体上表示，高级警官雅库布·库里克在与枪手对峙后“正在医院为自己的生命而战”。

paras.en: “One of his lungs is not functioning, and he needs every drop of blood he can get,” he posted on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上发帖称：“他的一个肺部无法正常工作，他需要得到每一滴血。”

paras.en: Police later said that blood banks in Kraków were full and thanked those who donated.
paras.zh: 警方后来说，克拉科夫的血库已满，并对献血者表示感谢。

paras.en: “Senior constable Jakub Kulik and senior constable Artur Moranski are true heroes,” said Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said, referring to both policemen.
paras.zh: “高级警员雅库布·库里克和高级警员阿图尔·莫兰斯基是真正的英雄，”波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在谈到这两名警察时说道。

paras.en: Klęczar said that without “the efficient and selfless intervention” of the officers, “the number of victims could have been significantly higher.”
paras.zh: 克勒查尔说，如果没有警察“高效和无私的干预”，“受害者人数可能会大大增加”。
