paras.en: Danny Shaw, a crime commentator and former BBC correspondent, posted on X that while the maximum sentence for rape in the UK is life, 10 years is the average sentence, and Brand was likely to receive between four to 13 years of prison time.
paras.zh: 犯罪评论员、前 BBC 记者丹尼·肖 (Danny Shaw) 在 X 上发帖称，虽然英国强奸罪的最高刑期为无期徒刑，但平均刑期为 10 年，布兰德可能会被判 4 至 13 年监禁。

paras.en: The trial examined seven historic charges against Brand, brought forward by six different women. He was found guilty on four of the charges: for raping a woman who'd been to one of his comedy shows in 2009, and sexually assaulting three others between 2004 and 2009. The locations of the sexual assaults were a bar, radio station and TV studio. Brand was also found not guilty of two counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault.
paras.zh: 审判审查了六名不同女性对布兰德提出的七项历史性指控。他被判犯有四项罪名：强奸一名曾在 2009 年观看他的喜剧节目的妇女，以及在 2004 年至 2009 年间对另外三人进行性侵犯。性侵犯的地点是一家酒吧、广播电台和电视演播室。布兰德还被判犯有两项强奸罪和一项未遂猥亵罪。

paras.en: Brand's lawyer asked the judge on Thursday to grant his client bail so that he could spend the weekend with his three children, which the judge denied. Instead the one-time celebrity darling spent his first weekend in a prison cell in London.
paras.zh: 布兰德的律师周四请求法官准予他的当事人保释，以便他可以与三个孩子共度周末，但法官拒绝了这一请求。相反，这位曾经的名人宠儿在伦敦的牢房里度过了他的第一个周末。

paras.en: He showed little emotion when the verdict was handed down, though his wife Laura — who has supported him throughout — quickly left the courtroom.
paras.zh: 判决下达后，他几乎没有表现出任何情绪，但一直支持他的妻子劳拉很快就离开了法庭。

paras.en: Many have called the verdict a significant milestone in the #MeToo movement, which has seen influential men held to account for using their power to abuse women.
paras.zh: 许多人称这一判决是#MeToo运动中的一个重要里程碑，在该运动中，有影响力的男性因利用权力虐待女性而被追究责任。

paras.en: Brand has also faced allegations of crimes in the United States. In 2023, a woman, named only as "Jane Doe," accused Brand of sexually assaulting her while she was working as a film extra during the making of the 2010 comedy movie "Arthur." That year, Brand married pop star Katy Perry, though the union lasted for just over a year before they divorced.
paras.zh: 布兰德在美国也面临犯罪指控。 2023 年，一名名叫“Jane Doe”的女性指控布兰德在她 2010 年喜剧电影《亚瑟》制作期间担任临时演员时对她进行了性侵犯。那一年，布兰德与流行歌星凯蒂·佩里结婚，尽管这段婚姻只维持了一年多就离婚了。

paras.en: Addressing the media last week, London police detective Andy Furphy said that Brand had "used his influence, status and fame to prey on women — as his profile grew, so too did his sense of entitlement."
paras.zh: 伦敦警探安迪·弗菲上周向媒体发表讲话时表示，布兰德“利用他的影响力、地位和名气来掠夺女性——随着他的知名度不断提高，他的权利意识也随之增强。”

paras.en: Camilla Long, a journalist for The Sunday Times — one of the first newspapers that investigated allegations of abuse against Brand — wrote in a column this weekend that "To sit in court 3 at Southwark crown court, hearing how Brand grabbed, pushed, groped and degraded his victims, was one of the most disgusting experiences of my life."
paras.zh: 《星期日泰晤士报》的记者卡米拉·朗（Camilla Long）是最早调查布兰德虐待指控的报纸之一，她在本周末的一篇专栏文章中写道，“坐在南华克皇家法院第三法庭，听到布兰德如何抓住、推搡、摸索和侮辱他的受害者，是我一生中最恶心的经历之一。”

paras.en: Long questioned how Brand got away with his behavior for so long, saying: "Never has a predator so loudly declared himself, yet been so roundly ignored."
paras.zh: 朗质疑布兰德为何能在这么长的时间里逍遥法外，他说：“从来没有一个掠夺者如此大声地宣称自己，但却被如此彻底地忽视。”

articles.title: After a successful trip to Uruguay, Pope Leo heads to Argentina
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: After a successful trip to Uruguay, Pope Leo heads to Argentina
paras.zh: 成功访问乌拉圭后，教皇利奥前往阿根廷

paras.en: FLORIDA, Uruguay — Pope Leo XIV wrapped up his visit to Uruguay on Sunday by praising the women who have passed the Catholic faith onto younger generations, as he highlighted the role the church has played since the founding of Latin America's most secular country.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭佛罗里达州—教皇利奥十四世周日结束了对乌拉圭的访问，赞扬了将天主教信仰传递给年轻一代的女性，他强调了自拉丁美洲最世俗的国家成立以来教会所发挥的作用。

paras.en: Leo traveled to the city of Florida, north of Montevideo, to mark an important Catholic feast day before heading to Argentina for the second leg of his South American tour. It's expected to be the most politically delicate stop, given the Catholic Church's sharp criticisms of the austerity program of libertarian President Javier Milei.
paras.zh: 利奥前往蒙得维的亚北部的佛罗里达市，庆祝一个重要的天主教节日，然后前往阿根廷进行南美之旅的第二站。鉴于天主教会对自由主义总统哈维尔·米莱的紧缩计划提出尖锐批评，预计这将是政治上最微妙的一站。

paras.en: For his final event in Uruguay, Leo celebrated the feast of the Virgin of the Thirty-three. According to tradition, 33 independence patriots acquired the Guaraní statue and had it with them when independence was declared from the Brazilian empire in Florida on Aug. 25, 1825.
paras.zh: 在乌拉圭的最后一场比赛中，利奥庆祝了三十三圣母的盛宴。根据传统，1825 年 8 月 25 日佛罗里达州宣布脱离巴西帝国独立时，33 名独立爱国者获得了瓜拉尼雕像并随身携带。

paras.en: Leo became the first pope in nearly four decades to visit Uruguay, in hopes of reminding its people that the Catholic Church is part of their very identity as a nation — even if, in subsequent decades, the country went on a deeply secular, and at times anticlerical, route.
paras.zh: 利奥成为近四十年来第一位访问乌拉圭的教皇，希望提醒人民，天主教会是他们国家身份的一部分——即使在接下来的几十年里，这个国家走上了一条极其世俗、有时甚至是反教权的道路。

paras.en: Pope thanks the mothers who passed on the faith
paras.zh: 教宗感谢传递信仰的母亲们

paras.en: In his homily, delivered in front of Florida's cathedral, Leo recalled the presence of the statue at the time of independence in reminding Uruguayans that "the history of peoples, too, cannot be fully understood without reference to God," and especially a mother.
paras.zh: 在佛罗里达大教堂前发表的讲道中，利奥回忆了独立时期这座雕像的存在，提醒乌拉圭人“如果不参考上帝，尤其是母亲，就无法完全理解各国人民的历史”。

paras.en: He thanked all the mothers and grandmothers who have passed the faith onto younger generations, and acknowledged their pain when their efforts didn't stick.
paras.zh: 他感谢所有将信仰传递给年轻一代的母亲和祖母，并承认他们的努力未能坚持下去所带来的痛苦。

paras.en: "You taught your children to pray, and today they no longer do so. You used to attend Mass together, and it has been years since they entered a church," he said. But he urged them to not despair.
paras.zh: “你教你的孩子们祈祷，但今天他们不再这样做了。你们曾经一起参加弥撒，他们已经好几年没有进入教堂了，”他说。但他敦促他们不要绝望。

paras.en: "Mothers and grandmothers: never tire of passing on the faith!"
paras.zh: “母亲们、祖母们：传承信仰永不疲倦！”

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people packed Florida's main square for the Mass under brilliant blue skies, some walking for several kilometers (miles) to reach the site. The city has a population of about 40,000 but the Vatican estimated 50,000 were on hand.
paras.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在佛罗里达州的主要广场上，在蔚蓝的天空下参加弥撒，有些人步行数公里（英里）到达现场。该市人口约 40,000，但梵蒂冈估计有 50,000 人。

paras.en: Fiama Pirez, an English professor, traveled from Montevideo for the Mass even though she could have seen Leo in the capital. She said she preferred a family outing to Florida so her mother could fulfill a dream to see a pope.
paras.zh: 英语教授菲亚玛·皮雷斯 (Fiama Pirez) 从蒙得维的亚赶来参加弥撒，尽管她本可以在首都见到利奥。她说她更喜欢全家去佛罗里达郊游，这样她的母亲就可以实现见到教皇的梦想。

paras.en: "I'm religious in my own way, and although I never strayed far from the Catholic faith, I'm rediscovering it today," she said.
paras.zh: “我以自己的方式信仰宗教，虽然我从未偏离天主教信仰太远，但今天我重新发现了它，”她说。

paras.en: A potentially delicate meeting with Milei
paras.zh: 与 Milei 的一次潜在微妙的会面

paras.en: In Buenos Aires, Milei is due to greet Leo at the airport before the two appear together for the traditional welcome ceremony and exchange of speeches. The Catholic Church has criticized Milei's austerity measures that have slashed social spending, and his embrace of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在布宜诺斯艾利斯，米莱将在机场迎接利奥，然后两人一起出席传统的欢迎仪式并交换讲话。天主教会批评米莱削减社会支出的紧缩措施以及他对人工智能的拥抱。

paras.en: Milei has staked his presidency on cutting social spending to overhaul Argentina's troubled economy and deliver a long-elusive budget surplus. He has called social justice "an aberration" that amounts to stealing, and mocked as "huge stupidity" the increasingly common complaint in Argentina that families squeezed by his austerity program can't make it to the end of the month.
paras.zh: 米雷将自己的总统任期寄托在削减社会支出上，以彻底改革阿根廷陷入困境的经济，并实现长期难以实现的预算盈余。他称社会正义是“一种失常”，相当于偷窃，并嘲笑阿根廷日益普遍的抱怨，即受到紧缩计划挤压的家庭无法度过本月底，这是“巨大的愚蠢”。

paras.en: Leo, who took his name from the 19th-century pope whose encyclical on labor laid the foundation of Catholic social teaching, has made the poor and vulnerable a focus of his papacy, carrying on the legacy of his Argentine predecessor, Pope Francis.
paras.zh: 利奥的名字取自 19 世纪的教皇，他关于劳动的通谕奠定了天主教社会教义的基础，他继承了阿根廷前任教皇方济各的遗产，将穷人和弱势群体作为教皇的关注焦点。

paras.en: Posters reading "At last, a Lion who unites" appeared across Buenos Aires this weekend, a jab playing on the pope's name in Spanish — León, or lion — and the lion imagery Milei often uses to portray himself on social media.
paras.zh: 本周末，布宜诺斯艾利斯各地出现了写着“最后，一头团结的狮子”的海报，其中刺痛了教皇的西班牙语名字——莱昂，即狮子——以及米莱经常在社交媒体上描绘自己的狮子形象。

paras.en: "Argentina is a society currently experiencing significant upheaval, deep polarization, and an economic crisis, along with a president who defies conventional protocol — a leader who, at one point, even challenged Pope Francis," said Luis Bahamondes, a professor at the Center for Judaic Studies at the University of Chile.
paras.zh: 智利大学犹太教研究中心教授路易斯·巴哈蒙德斯表示：“阿根廷社会目前正在经历重大剧变、严重两极分化和经济危机，总统也无视传统礼仪，甚至一度挑战教皇方济各。”

paras.en: The Argentine church is a sharp Milei critic
paras.zh: 阿根廷教会是米雷的尖锐批评者

paras.en: Since taking office in December 2023, Milei has slashed Argentina's healthcare budget by 48% in real terms. Planned cuts to the public university system, which represents a near-universal point of pride in the crisis-prone country, sent students into the streets.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 12 月上任以来，米莱已将阿根廷医疗保健预算实际削减了 48%。公立大学系统的计划削减几乎代表了这个危机频发的国家的普遍自豪感，导致学生们走上街头。

paras.en: According to official data, poverty in Argentina reached 32.3% of the population during the first half of 2026, representing about 15 million people.
paras.zh: 根据官方数据，2026年上半年，阿根廷贫困人口达到32.3%，约1500万人。

paras.en: Much like its allies in the Trump administration, Milei's government has portrayed the cuts as part of a necessary reform process to remake Argentina's troubled economy and eliminate fraud and waste in the federal bureaucracy.
paras.zh: 与特朗普政府的盟友非常相似，米莱政府将削减开支描述为重塑阿根廷陷入困境的经济并消除联邦官僚机构中的欺诈和浪费的必要改革进程的一部分。

paras.en: Like Trump, Milei has also courted AI investment and data centers with promises of limited regulation. Leo has warned that the AI race poses threats to humanity and the environment and called for strict, internationally policed safeguards on its development.
paras.zh: 与特朗普一样，米雷也以有限监管的承诺来吸引人工智能投资和数据中心。利奥警告说，人工智能竞赛对人类和环境构成威胁，并呼吁对其发展采取严格的、国际监管的保障措施。

paras.en: Milei's government insists the papal trip is purely religious. "The pope belongs to all Argentines. He doesn't belong to a political party or a political camp," Karina Milei, the president's sister and secretary-general of the presidency, told reporters after a recent planning meeting for Leo's visit with church leaders.
paras.zh: 米莱政府坚称教皇此次旅行纯粹是出于宗教目的。 “教皇属于所有阿根廷人。他不属于任何政党或政治阵营，”总统的妹妹、总统府秘书长卡琳娜·米莱(Karina Milei)在最近一次利奥与教会领袖访问的计划会议后告诉记者。

paras.en: A trip to complete Francis' unfinished business
paras.zh: 完成弗朗西斯未竟事业的旅行

paras.en: In Argentina, Leo is completing unfinished business left by Francis. The Argentine Jesuit, the former archbishop of Buenos Aires, never returned home during his 12-year pontificate, confounding friends and foes alike.
paras.zh: 在阿根廷，利奥正在完成弗朗西斯留下的未竟事业。这位阿根廷耶稣会士、布宜诺斯艾利斯前大主教在其 12 年教宗任期内从未回国，这让朋友和敌人都感到困惑。

paras.en: "There's a lot of disagreement over Francis and his legacy in Argentina," said David Lantigua, a theology professor and faculty fellow at the University of Notre Dame's Kellogg Institute, which focuses especially on Latin American affairs.
paras.zh: “对于方济各和他在阿根廷的遗产存在很多分歧，”圣母大学凯洛格学院的神学教授兼教员戴维·兰蒂瓜说，该学院特别关注拉丁美洲事务。

paras.en: Much of the polemics stems from his tenure in Buenos Aires, when the former Cardinal Jorge Mario Bergoglio was a slum priest who advocated for the poorest and most marginalized — the sector of Argentines feeling Milei's social spending cuts the most.
paras.zh: 大部分争论源于他在布宜诺斯艾利斯的任期，当时前红衣主教豪尔赫·马里奥·贝尔戈利奥是一位贫民窟牧师，他为最贫穷和最边缘化的人辩护——阿根廷人认为米莱的社会支出削减最多。

paras.en: "I think we'll see that kind of tension with Leo — that's the ministry Francis left behind," Lantigua said.
paras.zh: 兰蒂瓜说：“我认为我们会看到与利奥的那种紧张关系——这是弗朗西斯留下的事工。”

paras.en: Leo, who spent two decades as a missionary priest in Peru ministering to poor people, is very much a pastor in Francis' image and owes his pontificate to the late pope. But unlike Francis, he is returning home to Peru on the last leg of this trip, visiting a country where he spent two decades as a missionary.
paras.zh: 利奥在秘鲁担任了二十年的传教士牧师，为穷人服务，他在很大程度上是一位按照方济各形象的牧师，他的教宗地位应归功于已故教皇。但与方济各不同的是，他将在这次旅行的最后一站返回秘鲁，访问一个他曾担任传教士二十年的国家。

paras.en: Argentina's state intelligence agency said Saturday that a person had been arrested over death threats against Leo ahead of his arrival. A federal court in Campana, some 70 kilometers (45 miles) northwest of Buenos Aires, ordered the arrest less than 24 hours after the agency was tipped off, it said, without elaborating.
paras.zh: 阿根廷国家情报机构周六表示，一名男子因在利奥抵达前对他进行死亡威胁而被捕。位于布宜诺斯艾利斯西北约 70 公里（45 英里）处的坎帕纳的一家联邦法院在该机构接到举报后不到 24 小时就下令逮捕，但没有详细说明。

articles.title: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
paras.zh: 新西兰大选没有明显的赢家，领导人准备进行数周的会谈

paras.en: WELLINGTON, New Zealand — New Zealanders will wait for weeks to discover who will lead the country after Saturday's election failed to deliver a decisive win for the right or the left, leaving fraught negotiations for a wafer-thin governing majority the only apparent path to victory for either side.
paras.zh: 新西兰惠灵顿——周六的选举未能为右翼或左翼带来决定性胜利，新西兰人将等待数周时间才能发现谁将领导该国，导致为微弱的执政多数而进行的充满争议的谈判成为双方唯一明显的胜利之路。

paras.en: The tightest vote in years delivered a stinging rebuke to the major parties which have long dominated New Zealand politics, Christopher Luxon's center-right National party and center-left Labour led by Chris Hipkins, as voters threw more support behind minor parties on the ideological flanks than before. On Saturday's numbers, minor parties would enter negotiations for a governing deal with leverage to extract deeper policy concessions from a weakened National or Labour.
paras.zh: 多年来最激烈的投票对长期主导新西兰政坛的主要政党——克里斯托弗·卢克森(Christopher Luxon)领导的中右翼国家党和克里斯·希普金斯(Chris Hipkins)领导的中左翼工党——进行了严厉的谴责，选民对意识形态侧翼小党派的支持比以前更多。周六的数据显示，小党派将就一项治理协议进行谈判，以争取弱势的国家党或工党做出更深入的政策让步。

paras.en: The near-deadlock was partly produced because voters, apparently weary of New Zealand's economic woes and apathetic about both Luxon and Hipkins, chose to propel a new entrant group to Parliament for the first time in years. Opportunity, led by 38-year-old business consultant and political newcomer Qiulae Wong, is unaligned with either bloc and Wong has said she could work with either side to form a government.
paras.zh: 造成这种近乎僵局的部分原因是，选民显然厌倦了新西兰的经济困境，对卢克森和希普金斯都漠不关心，多年来首次选择将一个新的进入议会的团体推入议会。由 38 岁的商业顾问和政治新人 Qiulae Wong 领导的机会组织与任何一个集团都没有结盟，而 Wong 表示她可以与任何一方合作组建政府。

paras.en: Wong's pledges of evidence-based centrism and an end to partisan bickering had on Saturday's results secured seven seats for Opportunity — enough to frustrate both left and right in a simple path to power. It was a staggering ascension for a party that made three failed attempts at Parliament before Wong became leader less than a year ago.
paras.zh: 黄的基于证据的中间派承诺和结束党派争吵在周六的结果中为机会党赢得了七个席位——足以挫败左派和右派的简单权力之路。对于一个在黄不到一年前成为党魁之前曾三次试图进入议会失败的政党来说，这是一次令人震惊的提升。

paras.en: The conservative bloc has a simpler route to victory, but results could change
paras.zh: 保守派集团有更简单的获胜路线，但结果可能会改变

paras.en: Other winners were harder to identify and on Sunday, "who won the election 2026" was the top trending Google search in New Zealand. So unclear was the result that parties won't begin negotiations to form a government until final tallies are released on Nov. 27, confirming the exact number of seats they've won.
paras.zh: 其他获胜者更难确定，周日，“谁赢得了 2026 年大选”成为新西兰谷歌搜索的热门话题。结果如此不明朗，以至于各党派在 11 月 27 日公布最终计票结果（确认他们赢得的确切席位数）之前不会开始组建政府的谈判。

paras.en: With 2.8 million ballots counted on election night, the conservative incumbent government led by Luxon's National party appeared close to the slimmest possible return to power — by just one seat. However, Luxon didn't claim victory, instead striking a note of cautious optimism that he could negotiate a second term in power.
paras.zh: 选举之夜已清点了 280 万张选票，卢克森国家党领导的保守派现任政府似乎距离重新掌权已经很近了——仅差一个席位。然而，卢克森并没有宣布胜利，而是对他可以通过谈判连任的态度表现出谨慎乐观的态度。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters Sunday, Luxon blamed public dissatisfaction on global shocks which have buffeted New Zealand's trade-based economy, noting that other incumbent governments worldwide have faced voters' rancor over living costs.
paras.zh: 卢克森周日向记者发表讲话，将公众的不满归咎于全球冲击，这些冲击冲击了新西兰以贸易为基础的经济，并指出全球其他现任政府也面临着选民对生活成本的不满。

paras.en: Yet his opponent Hipkins, who was turfed from office in 2023 largely over discontent about the same economic issues, didn't appear to benefit on Saturday. The left-wing bloc appeared to fall short of a majority but was still hopeful it could triumph — though that seemed a more remote prospect.
paras.zh: 然而，他的对手希普金斯 (Hipkins) 似乎并没有在周六受益，希普金斯于 2023 年被赶下台，主要是因为对同样的经济问题的不满。左翼集团似乎未能获得多数席位，但仍然希望能够获胜——尽管这似乎是一个更遥远的前景。

paras.en: Electoral officials were due on Sunday to begin counting nearly 400,000 so-called special votes, including from New Zealanders who live abroad, a process expected to take three weeks.
paras.zh: 选举官员定于周日开始清点近 40 万张所谓的特别选票，其中包括居住在国外的新西兰人，这一过程预计需要三周时间。

paras.en: Those ballots have historically granted an additional seat or two in Parliament to left-wing parties, which could snatch the current razor-thin majority from the right, although such an outcome would likely leave the left struggling to form a majority too. If a government can't be formed, New Zealand could face a fresh vote.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，这些选票为左翼政党在议会中增加了一两个席位，这可能会从右翼手中夺走目前微弱的多数席位，尽管这样的结果可能会让左翼也难以获得多数席位。如果无法组建政府，新西兰可能面临新的投票。

paras.en: Incumbent Luxon urges people to 'calm down' and enjoy a break from politics
paras.zh: 现任卢克森敦促人们“冷静下来”并享受远离政治的休息

paras.en: "I think everyone's over politics so let's all have a bit of a break for the next three weeks," Luxon told reporters on Sunday. He will lead a caretaker government until an outcome is reached.
paras.zh: “我认为每个人都已经厌倦了政治，所以让我们在接下来的三周里休息一下，”卢克森周日告诉记者。他将领导看守政府，直至达成结果。

paras.en: Luxon suggested that National had a viable path to power and boasted that it had secured more seats in Parliament than any other group. However, Saturday night was bleak for his party.
paras.zh: 卢克森表示，国家党有一条可行的掌权之路，并吹嘘它在议会中获得的席位比任何其他团体都多。然而，周六晚上对他的派对来说却是惨淡的。

paras.en: Several of National's most senior lawmakers would exit politics on results so far, including the ministers of finance and defense, the speaker of parliament, and the attorney general. With the party's traditional governing partners winning increased support, Luxon faces a more strident list of policy demands to secure their backing.
paras.zh: 国家党几位最资深的议员将根据迄今为止的结果退出政坛，其中包括财政部长和国防部长、议会议长和司法部长。随着党的传统执政伙伴赢得越来越多的支持，Luxon 面临着一系列更严厉的政策要求，以确保他们的支持。

paras.en: Libertarian ACT won 13 seats and populist New Zealand First won 12. Both are led by canny veteran politicians, and detractors of Luxon, a former business executive who entered politics in 2020, said his dealings with them in the three years since he took office had highlighted his political inexperience.
paras.zh: 自由主义行动党赢得了 13 个席位，民粹主义新西兰优先党赢得了 12 个席位。两者都由精明的资深政客领导，2020 年进入政坛的前企业高管卢克森的批评者表示，他上任三年以来与他们的交往凸显了他政治经验的缺乏。

paras.en: The vote was a slap for both major parties
paras.zh: 这次投票对两个主要政党来说都是一记耳光

paras.en: New Zealanders don't vote for prime ministers. Instead they cast two votes, one for their preferred party and another for the candidate they want as their local representative.
paras.zh: 新西兰人不投票选举总理。相反，他们投了两票，一张投给他们喜欢的政党，另一张投给他们想要作为当地代表的候选人。

paras.en: The country has one house of Parliament and no states, so the central government holds ultimate sway over New Zealand's direction. Governments in the South Pacific nation of 5.6 million people are elected every three years.
paras.zh: 该国只有一院，没有州，因此中央政府对新西兰的方向拥有最终决定权。这个拥有 560 万人口的南太平洋国家的政府每三年选举一次。

paras.en: National won just 29.21% of the preferred party vote as of Sunday, a collapse of its previous result, and secured its 42 seats entirely by winning local constituency races. Luxon, who unusually faced two separateconfidence votes among his own lawmakers this year, further slumped in popularity as leader close to election day.
paras.zh: 截至周日，国家党仅赢得 29.21% 的首选党派选票，比之前的结果大跌，并通过赢得当地选区比赛完全确保了 42 个席位。卢克森今年不同寻常地在自己的立法者中面临两次独立的信任投票，临近选举日时，他作为领导人的支持率进一步下滑。

paras.en: However, Labour also won just 29.36% of the party vote, a result that appeared to suggest a second election defeat for career politician Hipkins. Despite winning about the same party vote percentage as National, Labour has secured only 36 seats on numbers so far because they won fewer local races.
paras.zh: 然而，工党也仅赢得了 29.36% 的党内选票，这一结果似乎表明职业政治家希普金斯在第二次选举中失败。尽管工党赢得的政党选票比例与国家党大致相同，但到目前为止，工党仅获得了 36 个席位，因为他们赢得的地方选举较少。

paras.en: Minor parties on the left saw bolstered support. The environmentally-focused Greens won 16 seats and Indigenous rights group Te Pāti Māori secured five.
paras.zh: 左翼小党派获得了更多支持。注重环保的绿党赢得了 16 个席位，原住民权利组织 Te Pāti Māori 获得了 5 个席位。

paras.en: The total number of seats in New Zealand's Parliament changes due to quirks in how seat allocations are calculated. There would currently be 131 lawmakers elected, with 66 seats required for a majority.
paras.zh: 由于席位分配计算方式的特殊性，新西兰议会的席位总数发生变化。目前将有 131 名议员当选，需要 66 个席位才能获得多数席位。

paras.en: Luxon's conservative bloc would currently hold 67, a razor-thin margin likely to discomfit a leader managing a three-way government with two emboldened minor parties. However, the left bloc held only 57 seats before the historically left-leaning special votes were counted.
paras.zh: 卢克森的保守派集团目前将获得 67 个席位，这一微弱的优势可能会让领导一个拥有两个大胆小党的三元政府的领导人感到不安。然而，在历史上左倾的特别选票统计之前，左翼集团只获得了57个席位。

paras.en: Even if the final tally boosted the left bloc's seats slightly, Hipkins would apparently need support from newcomer Wong to govern.
paras.zh: 即使最终计票结果略微增加了左翼集团的席位，希普金斯显然也需要新人黄的支持才能执政。

paras.en: Before the election, Luxon repeatedly ruled out negotiating with Wong. He sidestepped questions on Sunday about whether his vanishingly slim lead had changed his mind.
paras.zh: 选举前，卢克森一再排除与黄进行谈判的可能性。周日，他回避了有关他微弱的领先优势是否改变了主意的问题。

articles.title: Leavitt reveals what Republicans must do to survive politically after Trump leaves White House

paras.en: Former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said Saturday that Republicans must find a new leader capable of connecting with working-class Americans and rebuilding President Donald Trump's political coalition once he leaves the White House.
paras.zh: 前白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特周六表示，共和党人必须找到一位新领导人，能够与美国工薪阶层建立联系，并在唐纳德·特朗普总统离开白宫后重建他的政治联盟。

paras.en: "President Trump wasn't on the ballot in these midterms. He'll never be at the top of the ticket again, and I think we need somebody who is America first, who can really tap into the forgotten men and women that President Trump drew to the Republican Party in historic way from 2016 all the way through 2024," Leavitt said on "My View with Lara Trump"
paras.zh: 莱维特在“我对劳拉·特朗普的看法”节目中表示：“特朗普总统在中期选举中没有出现在选票上。他永远不会再名列前茅，我认为我们需要一个以美国为先的人，能够真正利用特朗普总统从 2016 年一直到 2024 年以历史性方式吸引到共和党的那些被遗忘的男男女女。”

paras.en: "You need someone who can really get out, speak to people about their struggles, their challenges, relate to them and offer promise and hope," she added, acknowledging that Democrats successfully motivated voters during the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 她补充道：“你需要一个真正能够走出去，与人们谈论他们的挣扎和挑战，与他们建立联系并提供承诺和希望的人。”她承认民主党在中期选举中成功地激励了选民。

paras.en: Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in Tuesday's midterm elections, capturing battleground Senate seats in Michigan, Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina, Maine and Minnesota while flipping key House seats in Virginia, Iowa and Nebraska.
paras.zh: 民主党在周二的中期选举中赢得了国会参众两院的控制权，夺取了密歇根州、得克萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州、北卡罗来纳州、缅因州和明尼苏达州的参议院战场席位，同时还击败了弗吉尼亚州、爱荷华州和内布拉斯加州的关键众议院席位。

paras.en: Leavitt urged Republicans to study their election losses and analyze individual races to determine how to correct course.
paras.zh: 莱维特敦促共和党人研究他们的选举失利，并分析各个种族的情况，以确定如何纠正路线。

paras.en: "I think that's something Democrats did well in this election, in the midterms, was they obviously inspired people to turn out to vote because they made the people feel like we're going to make your lives better," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为民主党在这次中期选举中做得很好，他们显然激励了人们去投票，因为他们让人们觉得我们会让你们的生活变得更好，”她说。

paras.en: "We need to do that again the same way, the same fashion President Trump did. It just has to be a new person at the top of the ticket."
paras.zh: “我们需要以同样的方式再次做到这一点，就像特朗普总统所做的那样。它必须是一个新的人选。”

paras.en: Leavitt also reflected fondly on her time as White House press secretary, expressing gratitude for the experience. She said she has no plans to run for office, preferring to spend time at home with her young children.
paras.zh: 莱维特还深情地回忆了自己担任白宫新闻秘书的时光，对这段经历表示感谢。她说她没有竞选公职的计划，更愿意花时间在家里陪伴年幼的孩子。

paras.en: "I'm so happy being with my kids. I have zero plans to run for office," she said. "I'm all set."
paras.zh: “我很高兴和我的孩子们在一起。我竞选公职的计划为零，”她说。 “我已经准备好了。”

articles.title: Two female deer throwdown in a backyard as the they appear to be protecting their young

paras.en: Deer facing off with one another and settling matters physically isn't reserved for just the bucks during rutting season. Female deer will throw down too, especially if they feel the need to protect their young.
paras.zh: 在发情季节，鹿之间相互对峙并以身体方式解决问题的方法并不只是雄鹿的专利。雌鹿也会摔倒，尤其是当它们觉得需要保护自己的幼崽时。

paras.en: Back in September, this was on display in an amateur photographer's backyard. She heard noises coming from the yard and when she looked out of her window she saw two does going at it.
paras.zh: 早在九月份，这幅作品就在一位业余摄影师的后院展出。她听到院子里传来噪音，当她向窗外看去时，她看到两只母鹿正在扑过来。

paras.en: She grabbed her phone and captured a viral video. They weren't cracking skulls like the males do when they tangle antlers, they were on their hind legs using their front hooves to deliver blows.
paras.zh: 她抓起手机，拍下了一段在网上疯传的视频。它们不像雄性缠住鹿角时那样敲碎头骨，而是用后腿用前蹄进行打击。

paras.en: These ladies were absolutely letting them fly with combinations that a boxer would be proud of.
paras.zh: 这些女士绝对让她们以拳击手引以为豪的组合飞翔。

paras.en: "This happened in my yard yesterday evening," the woman who recorded the action wrote. "I was upstairs when I heard this noise outside like thumping, bumping and thrashing. My window was open so I ran towards it and saw these two deer fighting. Both were females protecting their young ones I think."
paras.zh: “这件事昨天晚上发生在我的院子里，”记录这一事件的女士写道。 “当时我在楼上，听到外面有重击、碰撞和殴打的声音。我的窗户开着，所以我跑向窗户，看到这两只鹿在打架。我认为它们都是雌鹿在保护它们的幼崽。”

paras.en: She added, "First time I have witnessed that. WOW! I immediately ran for my cell and started to video it through my mesh screen so hope it’s okay to view. The wildlife I see in my yard. Always thrilling."
paras.zh: 她补充道，“我第一次目睹这一幕。哇！我立即跑向我的手机，开始通过我的网状屏幕进行视频拍摄，希望可以观看。我在院子里看到的野生动物。总是令人兴奋。”

paras.en: A mesh screen isn't ideal for recording video, but it doesn't interfere at all with this action. The two go at it as a couple of fawns look on.
paras.zh: 网状屏幕并不适合录制视频，但它完全不会干扰此操作。两人在几只小鹿的注视下进行着。

paras.en: After several exchanges, one of them decides they've had enough. A valiant effort by both of the deer.
paras.zh: 经过几次交流后，其中一人认为他们已经受够了。两只鹿的英勇努力。

paras.en: They will live to fight another day, although one of them is going to enter their next scrap with a little more confidence than the other. That's life. You win some and you lose some.
paras.zh: 他们将活着再战，尽管其中一个人将比另一个人更有信心进入下一场比赛。这就是生活。你赢得了一些，也失去了一些。

articles.title: The week of the backup QB in the NFL kicks off as Sanders, Milton, Minshew, Lock, and Wentz start

paras.en: It is the week of the backup quarterback around the NFL and by the time we're done, we could come to understand why the quarterback-driven league is, for some teams, a backup-quarterback-driven week.
paras.zh: 这是 NFL 替补四分卫的一周，当我们完成时，我们可以理解为什么对于某些球队来说，四分卫驱动的联盟是替补四分卫驱动的一周。

paras.en: Five backup quarterbacks are starting for their teams in Week 9, with three of those players thrust into the starting job on teams with playoff expectations.
paras.zh: 五名替补四分卫将在第九周为他们的球队首发，其中三名球员在有季后赛预期的球队中担任首发。

paras.en: This is the week Shedeur Sanders starts for Deshaun Watson with the Cleveland Browns, Drew Lock starts instead of Sam Darnold for the Seattle Seahawks, Carson Wentz starts for Kyler Murray with the Minnesota Vikings – all playing on teams in thick of a playoff hunt.
paras.zh: 本周，谢德尔·桑德斯 (Shedeur Sanders) 为克利夫兰布朗队 (Cleveland Browns) 的德肖恩·沃森 (Deshaun Watson) 首发，德鲁·洛克 (Drew Lock) 代替萨姆·达诺德 (Sam Darnold) 为西雅图海鹰队 (Seattle Seahawks) 首发，卡森·温茨 (Carson Wentz) 为凯勒·穆雷 (Kyler Murray) 的明尼苏达维京队 (Minnesota Vikings) 首发——他们都在为争夺季后赛而战。

paras.en: The situation is probably different for the Arizona Cardinals, who are starting Gardner Minshew, and the Philadelphia Eagles, who are turning to Joe Milton because both those teams are currently outside the playoff picture and indeed under .500.
paras.zh: 对于由加德纳·明修首发的亚利桑那红雀队和由乔·米尔顿首发的费城老鹰队来说，情况可能有所不同，因为这两支球队目前都在季后赛之外，而且确实低于 0.500。

paras.en: So here's the breakdown of five new starters and what is at stake:
paras.zh: 以下是五名新首发球员的详细情况以及利害关系：

paras.en: - Gardner Minshew, Cardinals: Minshew is starting for Arizona because he played well in relief of Jacoby Brissett last week, throwing three touchdown passes in a comeback victory, prompting coach Mike LaFleur to name him the starter going forward. The Cardinals used Minshew's play to give them confidence to trade Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens.
paras.zh: - 加德纳·明修（Gardner Minshew），红雀队：明修将为亚利桑那队首发，因为他上周接替雅各比·布里塞特（Jacoby Brissett）时表现出色，在一场翻盘胜利中传出三记达阵传球，促使教练迈克·拉弗勒尔（Mike LaFleur）任命他为首发球员。红雀队利用明修的表现给了他们信心将布里塞特交易到巴尔的摩乌鸦队。

paras.en: Minshew's last start before this week was Oct. 6, 2024, with the Raiders, and unlike most of the others in this group, he has already been given a chance to extend his tenure beyond this game.
paras.zh: 明修在本周之前最后一次首发是在 2024 年 10 月 6 日，在突袭者队，与该组中的大多数其他人不同，他已经有机会在这场比赛之后延长自己的任期。

paras.en: - Joe Milton, Eagles: Milton is starting for Philadelphia after coach Nick Sirianni benched Tanner McKee following three consecutive losses, with the Eagles hoping Milton’s arm strength and mobility can spark an offense that has struggled since Jalen Hurts went on injured reserve with a blood clot issue.
paras.zh: - 乔·米尔顿，老鹰队：在教练尼克·西里亚尼(Nick Sirianni)连续三场失利后将坦纳·麦基(Tanner McKee)放在替补席上后，米尔顿开始为费城首发，老鹰队希望米尔顿的手臂力量和灵活性能够激发自杰伦因血栓问题进入伤病预备队以来一直在苦苦挣扎的进攻。

paras.en: This will be Milton’s first NFL start, and while the Eagles have not committed beyond this game, Hurts’ season-ending injury gives Milton a legitimate opportunity to keep the job if he plays well.
paras.zh: 这将是米尔顿在 NFL 的首次首发，虽然老鹰队在这场比赛之后还没有做出任何承诺，但赫茨赛季报销的伤病给了米尔顿一个合法的机会，如果他表现出色的话，他将有一个合法的机会保住这份工作。

paras.en: - Carson Wentz, Vikings: Wentz is starting for Minnesota because Kyler Murray is dealing with a hamstring injury that the Vikings consider week to week. Wentz last started Sept. 20 against Chicago, when he completed 11 of 20 passes for 143 yards in a victory. His assignment is considered temporary, but he could remain the starter if Murray’s injury lingers or Wentz significantly outplays what Murray has delivered so far this season. It should be noted, that the Vikings have been in conversations with the Indianapolis Colts about a possible trade for that team's starting quarterback.
paras.zh: - 卡森·温茨（Carson Wentz），维京人队：温茨将在明尼苏达首发，因为凯勒·穆雷（Kyler Murray）正在处理腿筋受伤的问题，维京人队每周都在考虑这一问题。温茨上一次首发是在9月20日对阵芝加哥的比赛中，当时他20次传球完成11次，推进143码，取得了胜利。他的任务被认为是暂时的，但如果穆雷的伤势持续，或者温茨的表现明显超过穆雷本赛季迄今为止的表现，他可能会继续担任首发。应该指出的是，维京人队一直在与印第安纳波利斯小马队就可能交易该队的首发四分卫进行谈判。

paras.en: - Drew Lock, Seahawks: Lock is making another start for Seattle because Sam Darnold is sidelined by a quadriceps injury that removed him from the lineup this week and could do the same in Week 10.
paras.zh: -海鹰队的德鲁·洛克（ Drew Lock ） ：洛克正在为西雅图重新开始，因为山姆·达诺德（ Sam Darnold ）因股四头肌受伤而缺阵，本周将他从阵容中移除，并可能在第10周做同样的事情。

paras.en: Lock’s most recent start was Sept. 20 against Arizona, when he threw for 235 yards and three touchdowns. Darnold is expected to reclaim the job when healthy.
paras.zh: 洛克最近一次首发是在 9 月 20 日对阵亚利桑那队的比赛中，当时他传球推进 235 码并取得 3 次达阵。达诺德预计在健康后将重新担任这份工作。

paras.en: - Shedeur Sanders, Browns: Sanders is starting for Cleveland because Deshaun Watson spent most of last week in the concussion protocol. Although Watson cleared the protocol late in the week, he is nonetheless expected to be inactive against the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
paras.zh: - Shedeur Sanders，布朗队：桑德斯将在克利夫兰首发，因为德肖恩·沃森上周大部分时间都在接受脑震荡治疗。尽管沃森在本周晚些时候通过了协议，但预计他将不会在周日对阵新奥尔良圣徒队的比赛中出战。

paras.en: Sanders last started an NFL regular season game on Jan. 4, 2026, in the Browns’ 20-18 victory over Cincinnati, the seventh of his 2025 rookie season.
paras.zh: 桑德斯上一次首发参加 NFL 常规赛是在 2026 年 1 月 4 日，当时布朗队以 20-18 战胜辛辛那提队，这是他 2025 年新秀赛季的第七场。

paras.en: Sanders is not expected to take the starting job from Watson although playing well opens the door for him to be considered more of an option if Watson suddenly reverts to the type of play that made him something of an enigma in Cleveland before the 2026 season.
paras.zh: 预计桑德斯不会从沃森手中接过首发位置，尽管如果沃森突然恢复到2026赛季之前让他在克利夫兰成为一个谜的那种打法，那么他的出色表现将为他打开大门，让他被认为是一个更好的选择。

paras.en: The biggest opportunity of the week is sitting there for Wentz. He has thrown 5 TD passes in 101 snaps for the Vikings this year.
paras.zh: 本周最大的机会就是温茨坐在那里。今年他为维京人队在 101 次抢断中传出 5 次达阵。

paras.en: Murray, meanwhile, has been inconsistent and thrown 6 TDs in over 300 snaps.
paras.zh: 与此同时，穆雷表现不稳定，在 300 多次抢断中投出 6 次达阵。

articles.title: Chinese carmaker BYD’s offices in Netherlands raided over JLR ‘copycat car’ claim
articles.author: Julia Kollewe

paras.en: Bailiffs acting for Jaguar Land Rover raided the Dutch offices of a Chinese “copycat” rival before a legal showdown this week over whether its “Defender clone” infringes intellectual property rights.
paras.zh: 代表捷豹路虎的法警突击搜查了一家中国“山寨”竞争对手在荷兰的办事处，随后本周就其“山寨卫士”是否侵犯知识产权展开法律对决。

paras.en: Bailiffs acting on behalf of JLR reportedly seized digital records from the offices of Chinese carmaker BYD in Schiedam and Hoofddorp in August, according to the Sunday Times.
paras.zh: 据《星期日泰晤士报》报道，据报道，代表捷豹路虎的法警于 8 月从中国汽车制造商比亚迪位于斯希丹和霍夫多普的办公室查获了数字记录。

paras.en: The raid took place before a court case in the The Hague this week which will decide whether the BYD has a case to answer over allegations that its Ti7 SUV infringes the intellectual property of the Land Rover Defender.
paras.zh: 这次突袭是在本周海牙法庭审理案件之前进行的，该法庭将决定比亚迪是否应就其 Ti7 SUV 侵犯路虎卫士知识产权的指控做出回应。

paras.en: Motoring experts have likened BYD’s seven-seat plug-in hybrid SUV to the Defender since it went on sale in China in September last year. The company is scheduled to launch the vehicle, which the BBC’s Top Gear magazine called the “Chinese Defender clone”, in the UK market in January at a price of £47,995, undercutting the Defender by more than £20,000.
paras.zh: 自去年9月在中国上市以来，汽车专家将比亚迪的七座插电式混合动力SUV比作卫士。该公司计划于 1 月份在英国市场推出这款被 BBC 的《Top Gear》杂志称为“中国卫士克隆版”的车辆，售价为 47,995 英镑，比卫士便宜 20,000 多英镑。

paras.en: BYD says on its website that “an unapologetically boxy profile delivers the imposing, chunky design that finds favour among SUV buyers, yet delivers a contemporary look”.
paras.zh: 比亚迪在其网站上表示，“毫无歉意的四四方方的轮廓提供了雄伟、厚实的设计，深受 SUV 买家的青睐，同时又具有现代感”。

paras.en: The price of JLR’s seven-seat Defender 110 starts from £68,465and is one of the country’s bestselling cars. The UK-based carmaker, which is owned by India’s Tata Motors, sold 29,500 Defenders to retail customers between July and September this year, compared with 25,370a year earlier.
paras.zh: JLR 七座 Defender 110 起价为 68,465 英镑，是英国最畅销的汽车之一。这家总部位于英国的汽车制造商隶属于印度塔塔汽车公司，今年 7 月至 9 月期间向零售客户销售了 29,500 辆卫士，而去年同期为 25,370 辆。

paras.en: The raid in the Netherlands was carried out by court-ordered bailiffs, with JLR suspecting that BYD reverse-engineered some of the technology that could be used in the Ti7, the Times reported. JLR wanted to secure the digital records before they could be destroyed.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，荷兰的这次突袭是由法院下令的法警进行的，捷豹路虎怀疑比亚迪对 Ti7 中使用的一些技术进行了逆向工程。 JLR 希望在数字记录被销毁之前确保其安全。

paras.en: JLR and BYD declined to comment on the “ongoing legal proceedings”.
paras.zh: 捷豹路虎和比亚迪拒绝就“正在进行的法律诉讼”发表评论。

paras.en: The dispute with BYD is not the first legal case JLR has pursed against a Chinese company over copycat allegations. It won a legal case to stop Jiangling Motor Corporation selling a copycat vehicle in 2019 after a three-year court battle.
paras.zh: 与比亚迪的纠纷并不是捷豹路虎因抄袭指控而针对中国公司提起的第一起法律诉讼。经过三年的法庭斗争，它于 2019 年赢得了阻止江铃汽车公司销售山寨汽车的法律诉讼。

paras.en: In some cases JLR has taken a collaborative approach to dealing with the rise of China’s carmakers. It agreed to form a joint venture with Chery in a 2012 deal which later included licensing its discontinued Freelander brand with the company.
paras.zh: 在某些情况下，捷豹路虎采取了合作的方式来应对中国汽车制造商的崛起。它同意在 2012 年的一项交易中与奇瑞组建一家合资企业，其中包括向该公司授予其已停产的神行者品牌的许可。

paras.en: Chery’s Jaecoo model, which is not part of the joint venture, has been called the Temu Range Rover because of its similarities to the JLR vehicle after years of collaboration between the pair. It costs £10,000 less than JLR’s Range Rover.
paras.zh: 奇瑞的 Jaecoo 车型并非合资企业的一部分，经过双方多年的合作，由于与捷豹路虎汽车相似，因此被称为 Temu Range Rover。它的成本比捷豹路虎的路虎揽胜便宜 10,000 英镑。

paras.en: The Jaecoo was the bestselling car in the UK in October, with 10,813 registrations, taking its market share from 2.07% to 4.30%, according to the Society of Motor Manufacturers & Traders. JLR’s sales of the Range Rover fell to 43,300 in the third quarter of this year, from 47,196 cars sold in the same months last year.
paras.zh: 根据汽车制造商和贸易商协会的数据，Jaecoo 是 10 月份英国最畅销的汽车，注册量为 10,813 辆，其市场份额从 2.07% 上升至 4.30%。今年第三季度，捷豹路虎揽胜的销量从去年同期的 47,196 辆下降至 43,300 辆。

articles.title: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: Seven people were killed and more than 100 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，周日两列火车在埃及首都开罗以南相撞，造成 7 人死亡、100 多人受伤。

paras.en: The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 30 miles south of Cairo, when a train travelling to the south-western Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.
paras.zh: 据交通部称，事故发生在开罗以南约30英里的吉萨省艾亚特地区，当时一列开往西南部法尤姆省的火车与一列开往南部阿斯旺省的火车尾部相撞。

paras.en: An inspection indicated that the Cairo-Aswan train had been stationary on the same track, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，检查表明开罗至阿斯旺的列车一直停在同一条轨道上。

paras.en: Train derailments and crashes are common in Egypt, where the railway system has a history of mismanagement and poor maintenance of equipment. In recent years the government has announced modernisation initiatives to improve its railways.
paras.zh: 火车脱轨和撞车事故在埃及很常见，该国铁路系统有管理不善和设备维护不善的历史。近年来，政府宣布了改善铁路的现代化举措。

paras.en: Ayman Gamal, a resident of Kafr Girza in al-Ayyat where the crash occurred, said people rushed to the scene, pulled out survivors and called ambulances.
paras.zh: 艾曼·贾迈勒 (Ayman Gamal) 是事故发生地艾亚特 (al-Ayyat) 卡夫吉尔扎 (Kafr Girza) 的居民，他说人们赶到现场，救出幸存者并叫了救护车。

paras.en: Gamal said he saw about 80 of the injured being taken by ambulances to hospital. He said some passengers were trapped inside one of the carriages of the stationary train and died.
paras.zh: 加迈勒说，他看到大约 80 名伤者被救护车送往医院。他说，一些乘客被困在静止火车的一节车厢内并死亡。

paras.en: Egypt’s president, Abdel Fatah al-Sisi, said in a social media post that he had ordered a prompt investigation.
paras.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西在社交媒体帖子中表示，他已下令立即展开调查。

paras.en: Emergency teams and cranes were dispatched to the scene to clear the wreckage and restore train services to their normal schedule as soon as possible, the Egyptian railway authority said.
paras.zh: 埃及铁路局表示，应急小组和起重机已赶赴现场清理残骸，并尽快恢复列车正常运行。

paras.en: Last September, a train driver and his assistant were injured after two freight trains collided in the same district.
paras.zh: 去年9月，同一地区两列货运列车相撞，一名火车司机和他的助手受伤。

paras.en: Egypt’s deadliest train crash was in 2002 when more than 300 people were killed after a fire broke out on an overnight train journeying from Cairo to southern Egypt.
paras.zh: 埃及最严重的火车事故发生在 2002 年，当时一列从开罗开往埃及南部的夜间火车发生火灾，造成 300 多人死亡。

articles.title: Gadi Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies as he strives to form government
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: Israel’s former military chief Gadi Eisenkot started the tough task of forming a government on Sunday, reaching out to Benjamin Netanyahu’s allies as he said the veteran prime minister had brought the country to a historic crisis.
paras.zh: 以色列前军事首长加迪·艾森科特周日开始了组建政府的艰巨任务，他与本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的盟友进行了接触，他表示这位资深总理使该国陷入了历史性危机。

paras.en: Eisenkot, 66, the leader of the Yashar party, who has vowed to bridge Israel’s deep polarisation under Netanyahu, formally received a mandate from the president, Isaac Herzog, who gave him 28 days to form a government despite his bloc lacking a clear majority.
paras.zh: 66 岁的亚沙尔党 (Yashar party) 领导人艾森科特 (Eisenkot) 发誓要弥合内塔尼亚胡 (Netanyahu) 领导下的以色列深度两极分化，他正式收到总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格 (Isaac Herzog) 的授权，尽管他的集团缺乏明显多数，但总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格 (Isaac Herzog) 给了他 28 天的时间组建政府。

paras.en: “We are in a state of emergency, approaching a point of no return for the state of Israel,” said Eisenkot, who had traded his usual all black for a suit and tie, at a ceremony at the presidential office.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在总统办公室举行的仪式上说：“我们正处于紧急状态，以色列国家已经到了无可挽回的地步。”艾森科特把平时的全黑衣服换成了西装领带。

paras.en: “We must form a national emergency government. This will require creative and unconventional political steps.”
paras.zh: “我们必须组建一个国家紧急政府。这需要采取创造性和非常规的政治步骤。”

paras.en: Eisenkot faces significant challenges on the road to becoming prime minister. He has three options: a power-sharing agreement with Netanyahu, support from Arab-led parties – something several members of his bloc do not support – or an agreement with the ultra-Orthodox parties, which demand military exemptions for their community.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在成为总理的道路上面临着重大挑战。他有三个选择：与内塔尼亚胡达成权力分享协议，获得阿拉伯领导政党的支持（他的集团的一些成员不支持这一点），或者与极端正统政党达成协议，要求其社区获得军事豁免。

paras.en: Both Eisenkot and Herzog acknowledged Israel’s growing isolation under Netanyahu, who is wanted by the international criminal court.
paras.zh: 艾森科特和赫尔佐格都承认，内塔尼亚胡领导下的以色列日益孤立，国际刑事法院正在通缉内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: In the US, Israel’s closest ally, Democrats on Tuesday swept the midterm elections, with calls to rein in Israel after the devastation in Gaza and the unpopular Iran war, which Netanyahu launched with Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 在以色列最亲密的盟友美国，民主党周二在中期选举中大获全胜，在加沙的破坏和内塔尼亚胡与唐纳德·特朗普发动的不受欢迎的伊朗战争之后，民主党呼吁控制以色列。

paras.en: “We are in the midst of a devastating diplomatic crisis. Even our closest friends and strategic allies are saying their relationship with Israel must be reassessed,” Eisenkot said.
paras.zh: “我们正处于一场毁灭性的外交危机之中。即使是我们最亲密的朋友和战略盟友也表示必须重新评估他们与以色列的关系，”艾森科特说。

paras.en: Eisenkot appealed to Netanyahu’s Likud party as well as the far-right party of the finance minister, Bezalel Smotrich, to join – but only with himself as prime minister.
paras.zh: 艾森科特呼吁内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团以及财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇领导的极右翼政党加入 — — 但仅限于他自己担任总理。

paras.en: “My door is open and my hand is extended, wholeheartedly and willingly, to anyone who understands the gravity of this moment,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我的大门是敞开的，我的手是全心全意、心甘情愿地向任何理解这一时刻的严重性的人伸出的。”

paras.en: Should Eisenkot succeed in forming a coalition, he would take over as prime minister from Netanyahu, Israel’s longest-serving premier.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特成功组建联合政府，他将接替以色列任期最长的总理内塔尼亚胡担任总理。

paras.en: Eisenkot’s wide-ranging opposition bloc won 48 of the Israeli parliament’s 120 seats in the October elections, while Netanyahu’s camp secured 53, leaving neither with a majority.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导的广泛反对派集团在 10 月份的以色列议会 120 个席位中赢得了 48 个席位，而内塔尼亚胡阵营则获得了 53 个席位，双方均未获得多数席位。

paras.en: During party consultations with Herzog, Eisenkot received the endorsements of both Arab-majority lists, who could now play kingmakers after making unprecedented gains in the vote.
paras.zh: 在与赫尔佐格进行政党磋商期间，艾森科特获得了两个阿拉伯多数名单的认可，他们在获得前所未有的选票后可以扮演国王缔造者的角色。

paras.en: He has laid out a series of conditions for any Arab party to join his coalition, including recognition of Israel as a Jewish state and declaring the Palestinian militant group Hamas a terrorist organisation. One of Eisenkot’s partners, the more conservative Yisrael Beiteinu party, has already said it will not join a coalition with Arab-led parties.
paras.zh: 他为任何阿拉伯政党加入其联盟提出了一系列条件，包括承认以色列为犹太国家，并宣布巴勒斯坦激进组织哈马斯为恐怖组织。艾森科特的合作伙伴之一、较为保守的以色列贝泰努党已表示不会加入与阿拉伯领导的政党组成的联盟。

paras.en: Eisenkot, a former army chief, and his partners made equal military service a central part of their campaign. Specifically, they are seeking an end to the longstanding draft exemptions enjoyed by the ultra-Orthodox.
paras.zh: 前陆军参谋长艾森科特和他的伙伴们将平等兵役作为他们竞选活动的核心部分。具体来说，他们正在寻求结束极端正统派长期以来享有的征兵豁免。

paras.en: Netanyahu has repeatedly claimed the election was “stolen” by Arab parties, which rallied their supporters to vote in large numbers. But he has offered little to no evidence to support the claims.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡一再声称选举被阿拉伯政党“窃取”，这些政党召集了大批支持者投票。但他几乎没有提供任何证据来支持这些说法。

paras.en: Netanyahu is expected to continue his pressure tactics against Eisenkot, saying any alliance with the Arab parties would be an act of betrayal.
paras.zh: 预计内塔尼亚胡将继续对艾森科特施压，称任何与阿拉伯政党的联盟都是背叛行为。

paras.en: Israel’s Shin Bet security agency has launched an investigation into possible foreign interference in the vote, but the country’s Central Elections Committee – and Herzog – say the vote was valid and even if wrongdoing was found, it did not have a significant impact on the result.
paras.zh: 以色列辛贝特安全机构已对可能存在的外国干预投票展开调查，但该国中央选举委员会和赫尔佐格表示，投票是有效的，即使发现不当行为，也不会对结果产生重大影响。

paras.en: Netanyahu called for a “national unity” government with Eisenkot on Saturday night but it remains unclear whether the two rivals could agree on a power-sharing agreement; these types of coalition governments are notoriously fragile and often collapse.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周六晚呼吁与艾森科特组建“民族团结”政府，但目前尚不清楚这两个对手是否能就权力分享协议达成一致；这类联合政府是出了名的脆弱，而且常常崩溃。

paras.en: Eisenkot, the military chief of staff from 2015 to 2019, has set out to unite Israelis after Netanyahu’s divisive tenure, under which the country moved sharply to the right.
paras.zh: 艾森科特曾于 2015 年至 2019 年担任军事参谋长，在内塔尼亚胡任期内导致以色列急剧右倾，他已着手团结以色列人。

paras.en: He has vowed to crack down on extremist West Bank settlers who have attacked Palestinians with impunity, decrying recent incidents as “Jewish terror” abetted by Netanyahu’s government.
paras.zh: 他发誓要打击袭击巴勒斯坦人而不受惩罚的极端主义西岸定居者，谴责最近发生的事件是内塔尼亚胡政府煽动的“犹太恐怖”。

paras.en: But he opposes the creation of a Palestinian state and vowed to end Hamas’s rule in Gaza and destroy the Islamist movement’s military wing.
paras.zh: 但他反对建立巴勒斯坦国，并发誓要结束哈马斯在加沙的统治，并摧毁伊斯兰运动的军事力量。

paras.en: Commanding the military during the 2006 war with Hezbollah, Eisenkot devised the so-called “Dahiya doctrine”. The idea, named after a Beirut suburb heavily damaged in that war, involves Israel vowing to use massive force against civilian infrastructure in areas controlled by the Lebanese militant movement Hezbollah.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在 2006 年与真主党的战争中指挥军队时，提出了所谓的“达希亚主义”。这一想法以在那场战争中严重受损的贝鲁特郊区命名，以色列誓言对黎巴嫩武装运动真主党控制地区的民用基础设施使用大规模武力。

paras.en: After his appointment, Eisenkot will have 28 days to come up with the 61 votes needed for a government. If he comes up short, Herzog can provide a 14-day extension before he has to offer the mandate to someone else.
paras.zh: 任命后，艾森科特将有 28 天的时间来获得组建政府所需的 61 票。如果他达不到要求，赫尔佐格可以提供 14 天的延期，然后他必须将授权委托给其他人。

paras.en: If neither side succeeds, Israel will head to fresh elections. The country held five elections between 2019 and 2022 owing to repeated deadlocks.
paras.zh: 如果双方都无法成功，以色列将举行新的选举。由于屡次陷入僵局，该国在2019年至2022年期间举行了五次选举。

articles.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali

paras.en: Millions across India are celebrating Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights, illuminating homes, temples, offices and streets with oil lamps and colourful lights to symbolise the triumph of light over darkness.
paras.zh: 印度各地数百万人正在庆祝印度教排灯节，用油灯和彩色灯光照亮房屋、寺庙、办公室和街道，象征光明战胜黑暗。

paras.en: The festival falls on the darkest night of the Hindu lunar month of Kartik, when the moon is not visible in the sky.
paras.zh: 这个节日发生在印度农历卡尔提克月最黑暗的夜晚，此时天空中看不到月亮。

paras.en: Although Diwali traditions vary across India's regions and communities, the festival is widely marked by prayers, family gatherings, the exchange of sweets and the lighting of firecrackers.
paras.zh: 尽管印度各个地区和社区的排灯节传统各不相同，但这个节日的广泛特征是祈祷、家庭聚会、交换糖果和燃放鞭炮。

paras.en: But the celebrations come amid growing concerns over air pollution, particularly in northern India.
paras.zh: 但庆祝活动是在人们对空气污染日益担忧的背景下举行的，特别是在印度北部。

paras.en: Seasonal weather conditions and the burning of crop residue contribute to deteriorating air quality, while firecrackers set off during Diwali can make the situation worse.
paras.zh: 季节性天气条件和燃烧农作物残茬会导致空气质量恶化，而排灯节期间燃放的鞭炮会使情况变得更糟。

paras.en: Air pollution in the Indian capital Delhi has reached such hazardous levels that it is the most polluted Diwali festival in a decade. New measures to improve air quality do not seem to have been successful.
paras.zh: 印度首都德里的空气污染已达到危险水平，成为十年来污染最严重的排灯节。改善空气质量的新措施似乎并不成功。

paras.en: India's financial capital, Mumbai, has also experienced high pollution levels in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 印度金融首都孟买最近几周也经历了严重污染。

paras.en: In an effort to limit pollution, India's Supreme Court on Monday permitted the manufacture, sale and use of certified "green" firecrackers in Delhi and surrounding areas for a limited period.
paras.zh: 为了限制污染，印度最高法院周一允许在德里及周边地区在有限时间内制造、销售和使用经过认证的“绿色”鞭炮。

paras.en: These firecrackers are designed to produce 20-30% fewer emissions than conventional fireworks. But critics have questioned how effective they are at reducing pollution and raised concerns that conventional firecrackers could still make their way into the capital from neighbouring states.
paras.zh: 这些鞭炮的排放量比传统烟花少 20-30%。但批评人士质疑它们在减少污染方面的效果如何，并担心传统鞭炮仍可能从邻国进入首都。

paras.en: Despite the debate over fireworks, Diwali is about much more than firecrackers.
paras.zh: 尽管关于烟花的争论颇多，但排灯节的意义远不止于鞭炮。

paras.en: The festival celebrates the return of Lord Ram to Ayodhya after his victory over Ravan, the main antagonist in the Hindu epic Ramayana, and symbolises the triumph of good over evil, light over darkness, and knowledge over ignorance.
paras.zh: 这个节日庆祝罗摩勋爵战胜印度史诗《罗摩衍那》中的主要对手拉万后返回阿约提亚，象征着正义战胜邪恶、光明战胜黑暗、知识战胜无知。

paras.en: In the days leading up to the festival, families clean and decorate their homes with flowers, colourful lights and traditional oil lamps known as diyas.
paras.zh: 在节日前几天，各家各户都会用鲜花、彩灯和被称为“迪亚”的传统油灯来打扫和装饰自己的房屋。

paras.en: The celebrations also bring families and friends together for prayers, elaborate feasts and the exchange of gifts, and lots of traditional Indian sweets.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动还让家人和朋友聚集在一起祈祷、精心准备的盛宴、交换礼物以及许多传统的印度糖果。

paras.en: Colourful patterns known as rangoli are created at entrances to homes, while markets bustle with shoppers buying festive essentials beneath brightly lit decorations.
paras.zh: 各家各户的入口处都饰有被称为“rangoli”的彩色图案，市场里熙熙攘攘，购物者在灯火通明的装饰下购买节日必需品。

paras.en: The celebrations began on 6 November with Dhanteras, when buying gold, silver or new utensils is considered auspicious and believed to bring good fortune.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动从 11 月 6 日的 Dhanteras 开始，届时购买黄金、白银或新器皿被认为是吉祥的，并相信会带来好运。

paras.en: The second day, known as Chhoti Diwali, or small Diwali, is marked by the lighting of oil lamps and, in some households, setting off firecrackers.
paras.zh: 第二天被称为“Chhoti Diwali”或“小排灯节”，人们会点起油灯，有些家庭还会燃放鞭炮。

paras.en: The third day is the main celebration, when families offer evening prayers to Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, before gathering for festive meals and fireworks.
paras.zh: 第三天是主要的庆祝活动，家人会向印度教财富和繁荣女神拉克希米进行晚间祈祷，然后聚集在一起享用节日大餐和烟花。

paras.en: The fourth day is celebrated differently across India, with family gatherings and New Year festivities in some communities. The fifth and final day, known as Bhai Dooj, celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters.
paras.zh: 印度各地庆祝第四天的方式各不相同，一些社区举行家庭聚会和新年庆祝活动。第五天也是最后一天，被称为 Bhai Dooj，庆祝兄弟姐妹之间的联系。

paras.en: The festival is also celebrated by Sikhs and Jains along with other important religious observances.
paras.zh: 锡克教徒和耆那教徒也庆祝这个节日以及其他重要的宗教仪式。

paras.en: Sikhs mark Bandi Chhor Divas, or Prisoner Release Day, commemorating the release of their sixth guru, Guru Hargobind, from imprisonment at Gwalior Fort in the early 17th Century.
paras.zh: 锡克教徒会庆祝 Bandi Chhor Divas（囚犯释放日），纪念他们的第六位古鲁古鲁哈戈宾德（Guru Hargobind）于 17 世纪初从瓜廖尔堡的监禁中获释。

paras.en: For Jains, Diwali marks the attainment of moksha, or liberation from the cycle of rebirth, by Lord Mahavira, the 24th and last Tirthankara, or spiritual teacher, of the current era.
paras.zh: 对于耆那教徒来说，排灯节标志着当今时代第 24 任也是最后一位 Tirthankara（精神导师）Mahavira 勋爵获得解脱，即从重生循环中解放出来。

paras.en: With Indian communities spread across the world, Diwali is also celebrated internationally, with families and friends coming together for festive gatherings and exchanging gifts.
paras.zh: 随着印度社区遍布世界各地，排灯节也在国际上庆祝，家人和朋友聚集在一起进行节日聚会并交换礼物。

paras.en: The festival is considered an auspicious time to make new purchases, which many believe bring prosperity and good fortune. India's stock exchanges even hold a special one-hour trading session for investors who consider buying and selling shares on Diwali favourable. Known as Muhurat trading, it will take place on 8 November this year.
paras.zh: 这个节日被认为是购物的好时机，许多人认为这会带来繁荣和好运。印度证券交易所甚至为那些认为在排灯节买卖股票有利的投资者举办了一个特别的一小时交易时段。该交易被称为 Muhurat 交易，将于今年 11 月 8 日举行。

paras.en: Although rooted in Hindu traditions, Diwali is celebrated by people across different faiths and communities.
paras.zh: 尽管排灯节植根于印度教传统，但不同信仰和社区的人们都会庆祝排灯节。

articles.title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt

paras.en: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
paras.zh: 视频显示埃及致命火车相撞后车厢脱轨

paras.en: A train collision has killed at least seven people and injured dozens in northern Egypt.
paras.zh: 埃及北部发生的火车相撞事故已造成至少七人死亡、数十人受伤。

paras.en: Footage showed multiple overturned carriages and dozens of people surrounding them.
paras.zh: 视频显示多辆翻倒的车厢，周围有数十人。

paras.en: One train was travelling from Giza to the Fayoum oasis, south west of Cairo, while the other was heading from Cairo to Aswan in the south.
paras.zh: 其中一列火车从吉萨开往开罗西南部的法尤姆绿洲，另一列火车则从开罗开往南部的阿斯旺。

paras.en: It is yet unclear what caused the accident but Egyptian President Abdul Fattah al-Sisi said an investigation was underway and would "hold accountable anyone who proves their negligence".
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚事故原因，但埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西表示，调查正在进行中，并将“追究任何证明其疏忽的人的责任”。

articles.title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says

paras.en: One of the two surgeons who rushed to save lives in the aftermath of a mass shooting in Poland says his colleague stopped the bleeding of the police officer, "undoubtedly" saving his life.
paras.zh: 波兰发生大规模枪击事件后，两名赶赴现场救人的外科医生之一表示，他的同事为这名警察止血，“毫无疑问”挽救了他的生命。

paras.en: Professor Michal PÄdziwiatr and Dr Mateusz Wierdak were having lunch in central Krakow with their families when they heard gunshots, local media reports.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，Michal Pädziwiatr 教授和 Mateusz Wierdak 博士正在克拉科夫市中心与家人共进午餐，突然听到枪声。

paras.en: "Suddenly my son ran up and said: 'Dad, they're shooting at people there, people are falling to the ground'," PÄdziwiatr told news outlet Fakt.
paras.zh: “突然，我的儿子跑过来说：‘爸爸，他们向那里的人开枪，人们倒在地上’，”帕齐维亚特告诉新闻媒体 Fakt。

paras.en: PÄdziwiatr said when they got to the scene, they treated both the apparent attacker and the police officers.
paras.zh: 帕齐维亚特说，当他们到达现场时，他们治疗了明显的袭击者和警察。

paras.en: "When it comes to saving lives, it doesn't matter who is who."
paras.zh: “说到拯救生命，谁是谁并不重要。”

paras.en: Police are continuing to investigate Saturday's incident after six people were killed in the Krakow's market square. Sixteen more were injured, including Senior Police Constables Jakub Kulik and Artur MoraÅski.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫市场广场造成六人死亡后，警方正在继续调查周六的事件。还有 16 人受伤，其中包括高级警员 Jakub Kulik 和 Artur MoraÅski。

paras.en: Three other bodies were found in the alleged gunman's apartment who were identified by police as the suspect's parents and sister.
paras.zh: 在枪手的公寓里还发现了另外三具尸体，警方确认他们是嫌疑人的父母和妹妹。

paras.en: Once the shooting stopped, PÄdziwiatr said he took care of the other victims and the apparent perpetrator who needed help, while Wierdak began working on the police officer who was shot in the chest during the gunfight.
paras.zh: 枪击事件停止后，帕兹维亚特表示，他负责照顾其他受害者和需要帮助的明显肇事者，而维尔达克则开始照顾在枪战中胸部中弹的警官。

paras.en: "He, to put it colloquially, stuffed all the bandages into [the police officer's] chest and stuck his hands in," he told Fakt.
paras.zh: “通俗地说，他把所有绷带都塞进了（警察）的胸口，然后把手伸了进去，”他告诉 Fakt。

paras.en: "If not for that, I don't know how things would have turned out, as there was a long wait for the ambulance".
paras.zh: “如果不是这样，我不知道事情会怎样，因为等待救护车的时间很长”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, PÄdziwiatr said he called John Paul II Hospital where the Department of Thoracic and Cardiac Surgery is located.
paras.zh: 与此同时，帕兹维亚特表示，他给胸心外科所在的约翰·保罗二世医院打了电话。

paras.en: "I insisted they take him there because, in my opinion, he had the best chance of survival there, where there were specialists for precisely this type of injury," he told Fakt.
paras.zh: “我坚持要求他们把他带到那里，因为在我看来，他在那里生存的机会最大，那里有专门治疗这种类型伤害的专家，”他告诉 Fakt。

paras.en: According to local media, Wierdak is a renowned surgeon in Krakow. The University Hospital in Krakow states PÄdziwiatr is head of General, Oncological, Metabolic and Emergency Surgery.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，维尔达克是克拉科夫著名的外科医生。克拉科夫大学医院表示，Pädziwiatr 是普通外科、肿瘤外科、代谢外科和急诊外科的负责人。

paras.en: Four women and two men were among those killed, including four polish nationals, a British man and a non-Polish citizen whose nationality has not yet been disclosed.
paras.zh: 遇难者中有四名女性和两名男性，其中包括四名波兰公民、一名英国男性和一名国籍尚未透露的非波兰公民。

paras.en: The National Public Prosecutor's Office in Poland is launching an investigation into the attack with a unit specialising in "terrorist offences" taking the lead.
paras.zh: 波兰国家检察官办公室正在对这起袭击事件展开调查，由专门负责“恐怖犯罪”的部门牵头。

paras.en: Separately, six Dublin Civil Defence volunteers reportedly also assisted in the aftermath of the shooting.
paras.zh: 另外，据报道，六名都柏林民防志愿者也在枪击事件发生后提供了协助。

paras.en: James McConnell, an officer, told RTE News the group were on a city break and were close to the main square, external when the shooting happened.
paras.zh: 警官詹姆斯·麦康奈尔 (James McConnell) 告诉 RTE 新闻，枪击事件发生时，这群人正在城市度假，靠近主广场，位于外部。

paras.en: The volunteers who are trained to provide medical care immediately sought to help injured people, providing "CPR and haemorrhage control".
paras.zh: 接受过医疗护理培训的志愿者立即寻求帮助受伤人员，提供“心肺复苏和出血控制”。

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.

The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.

articles.title: Georgia, Oklahoma, Kansas elect new insurance commissioners; California still counting votes
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: In Georgia, Democrat Keisha Sean Waites defeated incumbent Republican John King, winning 54% of the vote.
King has held the position since 2019, when he was appointed by the Governor. He was elected for a full term in 2022.
Sean Waites is a former state representative and Atlanta city councilwoman.

She also previously worked as a disaster reservist/commercial loan specialist for the U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster Assistance Division and in several Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) roles, according to her LinkedIn.
Waites says that the rate freeze initiative is a top priority on her campaign page. This includes aggressively reviewing and challenging unjustified auto and home insurance rate hikes.
She also wants to end ZIP code and credit score discrimination by investing in modern equipment and faster response times for Georgia’s rural and underserved communities.
Another of Waites’s priorities is a “Consumer Fraud Strike Force” to protect seniors and vulnerable families from predatory insurance scams.
Republican Bob Sullivan won the race for Insurance Commissioner in Oklahoma with 59% of the vote. He ran against Democrat Craig MacIntyre.
Current commissioner, Glen Mulready, has reached the end of his second term. Insurance commissioners in the state hold the position for four years and are limited to eight-years in the position.
Sullivan identifies himself as a “property and casualty insurance expert” on his campaign website.

He states his expertise includes being a certified insurance counselor, certified risk manager, chartered property and casualty underwriter, associate in Fidelity & Surety Bonding and a certified environmental specialist.
Sullivan currently works for the Alera Group and previously for Rich and Cartmill, the website states.

“Bob has seen carriers pull out of Oklahoma, leaving entire industries with one option and homeowners forced to pay more—or go without,” the website states. “He’s running to restore competition, cut costs, and deliver fast, fair claims for the people who actually pay the premiums.”
Kansas voters elected Republican Daniel Hawkins to the insurance commissioner position with 58% of the vote. He ran against Democrat Dinah Sykes.
The four-year position has no term limits. Vicki Schmidt, a Republican, has served in the role since 2019. She did not run again so she could pursue the Republican nomination for governor.

Hawkins, Republican speaker of the Kansas House of Representatives, started a career in the insurance business in 1995. He specialized in employee benefits for small businesses, according to the website.
He was elected to the Kansas House in 2013.

“As Insurance Commissioner, I will wake up early every day and get to work, making sure we have an Insurance Department that stands strong for the hardworking people of Kansas,” Hawkins says on the website. “I’ll never stop fighting to lower costs, improve transparency, and hold fraudsters accountable.”
Hawkins’ website states he will focus on lower costs, holding the powerful and fraudsters accountable, and restoring competition and choice.
As of Wednesday evening, the California race for two Democrats running for the Insurance Commissioner position was still too close to call.
Jane Kim had 52.2% of the vote and Ben Allen 47.8%, as of Wednesday evening.
Political Action Committees (PACs) have contributed a record $6 million in campaign donations to the California Insurance Commission race, according to a CalMatters report.
The article says this includes $3.2 million to support Allen and $1.5 million to oppose Kim.

Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.

“Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.

“My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
This would include higher upfront payments for coverage, requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.

articles.title: Celette AI Webtools wins SEMA Show’s best new collision repair and refinish product award
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Celette AI Webtools won first place for the 2026 SEMA Show’s New Product Awards for Best Collision Repair and Refinish Product Tuesday.
Bossauto Innova’s Ionizer Pro and Innovative Tools & Technologies’ Innovative Truck Cab Protectors were runners-up for Best Collision Repair and Refinish Product.

Celette describes its Webtools AI as a “unified software ecosystem for modern structural repair,” in a February news release. All of Celette’s structural software, databases and compatible measurement tools converge on the one platform, it adds.
It functions as a cloud-based software hub, the release says. This includes compatibility layers for selected third-party benches and gauges. It also digitally documents and reports tools.
Andrew Batenhorst, Barry Dorn and Kye Yeung, all Collision Industry Conference (CIC) committee chairs, served as judges for the awards and spoke about the products during the CIC meeting Tuesday.
Batenhorst said he uses the new Celette Webtools AI in his shop.

“It is a generational leap in terms of ease of use and connectivity,” Batenhorst said. “It has fixed a lot of the bugs it had in the past, but what is cool is that it is compatible with other brands.”
He adds that it has made life easier for the technicians in his shop.
Yeung said Bossauto Innova’s Ionizer Pro is different from other guns he’s used.
“It basically can record and tell you firsthand what distance and what temperature is needed,” Yeung said.
Batenhorst said Innovative Tools & Technologies’ Innovative Truck Cab Protectors is simple but ingenious.
“As you’re lifting the bed up and away from the frame, it gives a really nice cushion to prevent you from accidentally chipping the paint on the back of the cab,” Batenhorst said.
Dorn said that the protector was debated by the judges because the idea is simple.
“But we’ve never seen anything like it,” he said.
A lot of thought went into each decision made by the judges, he added.
“We want to bring forth the best thing that’s going to revolutionize the collision industry,” he said.
Yeung added that SEMA looks for industry experts to judge.
“We take it seriously because this could be life-changing for these companies,” Yeung said. “We look at innovation; we look at price point. We look at how the industry can use this product.”
Justine Hubbard, SEMA new product showcase manager, told CIC that the showcase is the number one destination for all buyers that attend the SEMA show.
“We call it a trade show within a trade show,” Hubbard said. “So we are a one-stop shop of everything that is new this year.”

It is a way for an exhibitor to increase their brand exposure, she said. She said the average visitor spent 21 minutes in New Products and 78% of buyers/media reported visiting an exhibitor’s booth after seeing their product in the showcase.
The showcase can be found in the Lower South Hall, Booth #41271.
More than 1,300 products competed for top honors across 15 New Products Showcases categories.

“The SEMA Show New Product Awards celebrate the ingenuity driving the automotive aftermarket forward,” SEMA CEO Mike Spagnola said in a release. “This year’s honorees demonstrate how our industry continues to anticipate customer needs and turn bold ideas into market-ready products.”
