paras.en: "These findings challenge the prevailing view that psilocybin simply increases neural connectivity and suggest that its effects depend on the brain's underlying condition," Zuo added.
paras.zh: Zuo 补充道：“这些发现挑战了普遍的观点，即裸盖菇素只是增加神经连接，并表明其影响取决于大脑的潜在状况。”

paras.en: "This provides a new perspective on how psychedelics might help restore neural circuits disrupted by stress, with potentially important implications for understanding their therapeutic effects in depression and other psychiatric disorders."
paras.zh: “这为迷幻药如何帮助恢复因压力而中断的神经回路提供了新的视角，对于理解其对抑郁症和其他精神疾病的治疗效果具有潜在的重要意义。”

paras.en: Could Psilocybin Rewire the Brain Without Hallucinations?
paras.zh: 赛洛西宾能否在没有幻觉的情况下重塑大脑？

paras.en: Perhaps the most significant implication of the research concerns a longstanding question in psychedelic medicine: Are hallucinations and altered states of consciousness necessary for the brain changes that might contribute to therapeutic benefits?
paras.zh: 也许这项研究最重要的意义涉及迷幻医学中一个长期存在的问题：幻觉和意识状态改变对于可能有助于治疗效果的大脑变化是否是必要的？

paras.en: To explore this possibility, the scientists examined the role of serotonin 2A receptors (5-HT2ARs), which are proteins on the surfaces of cells that respond to chemical signals. These receptors are central to the effects of psilocybin and other classic psychedelics.
paras.zh: 为了探索这种可能性，科学家们研究了血清素 2A 受体 (5-HT2AR) 的作用，这些受体是细胞表面对化学信号做出反应的蛋白质。这些受体对于裸盖菇素和其他经典致幻剂的作用至关重要。

paras.en: The researchers focused on a group of nerve cells called Layer 5 pyramidal neurons. These cells are located in the cerebral cortex, the outer region of the brain involved in complex functions such as perception, reasoning, and decision-making.
paras.zh: 研究人员重点关注一组称为第 5 层锥体神经元的神经细胞。这些细胞位于大脑皮层，大脑的外部区域，参与感知、推理和决策等复杂功能。

paras.en: Layer 5 pyramidal neurons serve as important communication pathways that send information from the cortex to other brain regions. They also contain high levels of serotonin 2A receptors, making them especially relevant to understanding psilocybin's effects.
paras.zh: 第 5 层锥体神经元是重要的通信通路，将信息从皮层发送到其他大脑区域。它们还含有高水平的血清素 2A 受体，这使得它们对于了解裸盖菇素的作用特别重要。

paras.en: Using genetically modified mice, the team selectively changed whether these neurons possessed the receptors.
paras.zh: 研究小组使用基因改造小鼠，选择性地改变这些神经元是否拥有受体。

paras.en: The results revealed a striking separation between changes in brain connections and a behavior associated with psychedelic activity.
paras.zh: 结果显示，大脑连接的变化和与迷幻活动相关的行为之间存在显着的区别。

paras.en: When the researchers restored serotonin 2A receptors only in Layer 5 pyramidal neurons, psilocybin was still able to stimulate the development of new synapses and help stabilize them.
paras.zh: 当研究人员仅在第 5 层锥体神经元中恢复血清素 2A 受体时，裸盖菇素仍然能够刺激新突触的发育并帮助稳定它们。

paras.en: Surprisingly, these mice did not display the characteristic head twitch response that researchers commonly use as an indicator of psychedelic activity in rodents.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，这些小鼠并没有表现出研究人员通常用作啮齿动物迷幻活动指标的特征性头部抽搐反应。

paras.en: The scientists then performed the opposite experiment.
paras.zh: 然后科学家们进行了相反的实验。

paras.en: When they removed serotonin 2A receptors specifically from Layer 5 pyramidal neurons, psilocybin lost its ability to stimulate the same structural growth of synapses.
paras.zh: 当他们专门从第 5 层锥体神经元去除血清素 2A 受体时，裸盖菇素就失去了刺激突触相同结构生长的能力。

paras.en: However, the mice still exhibited the head twitch response.
paras.zh: 然而，小鼠仍然表现出头部抽搐反应。

paras.en: These contrasting results demonstrate that serotonin 2A receptor signaling in Layer 5 pyramidal neurons is necessary and sufficient for the structural brain changes observed in the experiments, while those same receptors are not required for the psychedelic-associated behavioral response.
paras.zh: 这些对比结果表明，第 5 层锥体神经元中的血清素 2A 受体信号传导对于实验中观察到的大脑结构变化是必要且充分的，而与迷幻相关的行为反应则不需要这些相同的受体。

paras.en: In other words, the cellular pathway responsible for psilocybin's brain rewiring can be separated from the pathway responsible for this particular behavioral marker of psychedelic activity.
paras.zh: 换句话说，负责裸盖菇素大脑重新布线的细胞途径可以与负责迷幻活动的这种特定行为标记的途径分开。

paras.en: Because mice cannot describe subjective experiences, the head twitch response does not directly establish whether an animal is experiencing hallucinations. Nevertheless, the findings provide important evidence that these two effects involve distinct cellular mechanisms.
paras.zh: 由于小鼠无法描述主观体验，因此头部抽搐反应并不能直接确定动物是否正在经历幻觉。然而，这些发现提供了重要的证据，证明这两种效应涉及不同的细胞机制。

paras.en: A Potential Path Toward Psychedelic Treatments Without the Trip
paras.zh: 无需旅行即可进行迷幻治疗的潜在途径

paras.en: The discovery could have major implications for the development of future psychiatric medications.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能对未来精神药物的开发产生重大影响。

paras.en: If researchers can identify compounds that activate the brain's ability to rebuild and reorganize neural connections without triggering psychedelic effects, it may become possible to create treatments that preserve some of psilocybin's therapeutic potential while avoiding the need for patients to undergo intense altered states of consciousness.
paras.zh: 如果研究人员能够识别出能够激活大脑重建和重组神经连接的能力而不引发迷幻效应的化合物，那么就有可能创造出保留裸盖菇素部分治疗潜力的治疗方法，同时避免患者经历强烈的意识状态改变。

paras.en: Such medications could be easier to administer and might require less intensive clinical supervision than conventional psychedelic-assisted therapies.
paras.zh: 与传统的迷幻辅助疗法相比，此类药物可能更容易管理，并且可能需要更少的密集临床监督。

paras.en: "By showing that therapeutic circuit remodeling and hallucinogenic effects operate through distinct cellular pathways, our study provides a promising blueprint for designing non-hallucinogenic drug analogs," Zuo said.
paras.zh: “通过表明治疗回路重塑和致幻作用通过不同的细胞途径发挥作用，我们的研究为设计非致幻药物类似物提供了有希望的蓝图，”左说。

paras.en: "Such therapeutics could deliver the fast and lasting antidepressant benefits of psychedelics while eliminating hallucinogenic side effects -- making neuroplasticity treatments safer, more scalable, and accessible to a broader patient population."
paras.zh: “这种疗法可以提供迷幻药快速而持久的抗抑郁功效，同时消除致幻副作用，使神经可塑性治疗更安全、更可扩展，并且可供更广泛的患者群体使用。”

paras.en: Although the results are promising, the experiments were conducted in mice. Additional research will be necessary to determine whether the same cellular mechanisms operate in humans and whether separating brain rewiring from psychedelic effects can produce effective treatments for depression, PTSD, or other psychiatric disorders.
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但实验是在小鼠身上进行的。还需要进行更多的研究来确定相同的细胞机制是否在人类中发挥作用，以及将大脑重新布线与迷幻作用分开是否可以有效治疗抑郁症、创伤后应激障碍或其他精神疾病。

paras.en: For now, the findings provide a more detailed picture of how psilocybin changes the brain and reveal a potential strategy for harnessing its effects on neural connections without relying on the psychedelic experience itself.
paras.zh: 目前，这些发现提供了裸盖菇素如何改变大脑的更详细图片，并揭示了一种在不依赖迷幻体验本身的情况下利用其对神经连接的影响的潜在策略。

paras.en: The study's other UC Santa Cruz coauthors include molecular and cell biologists Jacob Baker, Emily Kogan, Shaorong Ma, and Ju Lu, alongside Zuo.
paras.zh: 该研究的其他加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的共同作者包括分子和细胞生物学家 Jacob Baker、Emily Kogan、Shaorong Ma 和 Ju Lu，以及 Zuo。

paras.en: Funding came from the National Institute of Mental Health and the National Institute on Aging. The psilocybin used in the experiments was supplied through the National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA) Drug Supply Program.
paras.zh: 资金来自国家心理健康研究所和国家老龄化研究所。实验中使用的裸盖菇素是通过国家药物滥用研究所 (NIDA) 药物供应计划提供的。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of California - Santa Cruz. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由加州大学圣克鲁斯分校提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Jacob J. Baker, Emily Kogan, Shaorong Ma, Ju Lu, Yi Zuo. 5-HT2A receptors in layer 5 pyramidal neurons mediate the neuroplastic but not the hallucinogenic effects of psilocybin. Nature Neuroscience, 2026; DOI: 10.1038/s41593-026-02490-y
paras.zh: - Jacob J. Baker、Emily Kogan、马少荣、Ju Lu、Yi Zuo。第 5 层锥体神经元中的 5-HT2A 受体介导裸盖菇素的神经塑性作用，但不介导致幻作用。自然神经科学，2026； DOI：10.1038/s41593-026-02490-y

articles.title: Rubin Observatory discovers two hidden companions of the Milky Way. Hundreds more may be waiting

paras.en: Rubin Observatory discovers two hidden companions of the Milky Way. Hundreds more may be waiting
paras.zh: 鲁宾天文台发现了银河系的两个隐藏伴星。可能还有数百人在等待

paras.en: - The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has already uncovered two previously unknown companions of the Milky Way using preliminary observations covering just 7% of the night sky. The discoveries include an extremely faint galaxy 355,000 light-years away and a star cluster hidden behind cosmic dust. Scientists suspect hundreds of additional satellite galaxies remain undiscovered, and Rubin's powerful telescope could finally bring them into view.
paras.zh: - Vera C. Rubin 天文台已经通过仅覆盖夜空 7% 的初步观测发现了两个以前未知的银河系伴星。这些发现包括 355,000 光年外的一个极其微弱的星系和一个隐藏在宇宙尘埃后面的星团。科学家怀疑还有数百个卫星星系尚未被发现，而鲁宾强大的望远镜最终可以将它们带入视野。

paras.en: The powerful new Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile has already uncovered two previously unknown companions of the Milky Way, offering an early glimpse of what could become a much larger wave of discoveries. Astronomers believe hundreds of faint galaxies may still be hiding around our galaxy, and the observatory could finally bring many of them into view.
paras.zh: 位于智利的强大的新维拉·C·鲁宾天文台已经发现了两个以前未知的银河系伴星，为可能成为更大的发现浪潮提供了早期的一瞥。天文学家认为，数百个微弱的星系可能仍然隐藏在我们的银河系周围，天文台最终可以将其中的许多星系带入视野。

paras.en: Located on Cerro Pachón in the Chilean Andes, the recently completed NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory is designed to explore the sky in extraordinary detail. Its initial observations have now revealed two elusive objects that had escaped detection, demonstrating the telescope's ability to find some of the faintest members of our galactic neighborhood.
paras.zh: 最近竣工的 NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin 天文台位于智利安第斯山脉的帕琼山，旨在以非凡的细节探索天空。它的初步观测现在已经揭示了两个难以捉摸的物体，它们逃脱了探测，这证明了望远镜有能力找到我们银河系附近一些最微弱的成员。

paras.en: Large galaxies such as the Milky Way are surrounded by smaller companions known as satellites. These include dwarf galaxies and star clusters, many of which contain so few stars that they are extremely difficult to detect. Astronomers have identified approximately 65 satellite galaxies around the Milky Way, but some estimates suggest that hundreds more remain undiscovered.
paras.zh: 像银河系这样的大型星系被称为卫星的较小星系包围着。其中包括矮星系和星团，其中许多恒星的恒星数量极少，极难探测到。天文学家已经在银河系周围发现了大约 65 个卫星星系，但一些估计表明还有数百个仍未被发现。

paras.en: Two new studies, including one led by a Yale astronomer, suggest that Rubin could play a major role in finding these missing objects and completing the picture of our galaxy's surroundings.
paras.zh: 两项新研究，其中一项由耶鲁大学天文学家领导，表明鲁宾可以在寻找这些失踪物体和完成银河系周围环境的图像方面发挥重要作用。

paras.en: Two Hidden Companions of the Milky Way Discovered
paras.zh: 银河系的两个隐藏伴侣被发现

paras.en: Using observations collected before the observatory's official launch, researchers identified two exceptionally faint satellites that had never been seen before.
paras.zh: 利用天文台正式发射前收集的观测结果，研究人员发现了两颗以前从未见过的异常​​微弱的卫星。

paras.en: The first, Aquarius IV, is a tiny galaxy located in the distant outskirts of the Milky Way, approximately 355,000 light-years from Earth. The second, Rubin-GC1, is a star cluster on the opposite side of our galaxy, hidden within a region where thick clouds of cosmic dust make observations especially challenging.
paras.zh: 第一个是水瓶座 IV，是一个位于银河系遥远郊区的微小星系，距地球约 355,000 光年。第二个是 Rubin-GC1，是位于银河系另一侧的一个星团，隐藏在一个区域内，那里厚厚的宇宙尘埃云使观测变得特别困难。

paras.en: Both discoveries are remarkable because astronomers made them using only a small amount of the data Rubin is expected to collect over its lifetime.
paras.zh: 这两项发现都是非凡的，因为天文学家只使用了鲁宾在其一生中预计收集的少量数据。

paras.en: "What I find especially exciting is that these discoveries are just the beginning for Rubin," said William Cerny, an astronomy student in Yale's Graduate School of Arts and Sciences.
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学艺术与科学研究生院的天文学学生威廉·塞尔尼说：“我觉得特别令人兴奋的是，这些发现对于鲁宾来说只是一个开始。”

paras.en: Cerny is the lead author of the Aquarius IV study, published in Research Notes of the AAS, and the second author of the Rubin-GC1 study, which has been accepted by The Astrophysical Journal Letters.
paras.zh: Cerny 是 Aquarius IV 研究的第一作者，该研究发表在 AAS 研究笔记上，也是 Rubin-GC1 研究的第二作者，该研究已被《天体物理学杂志快报》接受。

paras.en: "If the observatory can find systems this faint and difficult with only its preview data, its full 10-year survey will undoubtedly provide us with many more Milky Way satellite discoveries," Cerny said. "These new satellites will give us new opportunities to test models of galaxy formation, trace the assembly history of the Milky Way, and investigate the nature of dark matter."
paras.zh: 塞尔尼说：“如果天文台仅凭预览数据就能找到如此微弱和困难的系统，那么其为期十年的调查无疑将为我们提供更多的银河系卫星发现。” “这些新卫星将为我们提供新的机会来测试星系形成模型，追踪银河系的组装历史，并研究暗物质的性质。”

paras.en: A Powerful New Telescope Is Just Getting Started
paras.zh: 强大的新型望远镜才刚刚开始

paras.en: Rubin began its ambitious 10-year Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) in June. The project aims to produce an exceptionally detailed record of the changing night sky while searching for objects that previous telescopes have been unable to detect.
paras.zh: 鲁宾于 6 月开始了雄心勃勃的为期 10 年的时空遗产调查 (LSST)。该项目旨在对不断变化的夜空进行极其详细的记录，同时寻找以前的望远镜无法探测到的物体。

paras.en: One of its major scientific goals is to map the Milky Way's "halo," a vast, roughly spherical region that surrounds the galaxy's main disk. This halo contains scattered stars, gas, and dark matter, along with faint satellite galaxies, star clusters, and other structures that preserve clues about the Milky Way's past.
paras.zh: 它的主要科学目标之一是绘制银河系的“光环”地图，这是一个围绕银河系主盘的巨大的、大致呈球形的区域。这个光环包含分散的恒星、气体和暗物质，以及微弱的卫星星系、星团和其他保留了银河系过去线索的结构。

paras.en: To carry out this enormous survey, Rubin uses the 8.4-meter Simonyi Survey Telescope and the largest digital camera ever constructed, capable of capturing images with 3.2 gigapixels of resolution. By repeatedly photographing large areas of the Southern Hemisphere sky, the observatory will build an extraordinarily wide-ranging time-lapse record of the universe.
paras.zh: 为了进行这项大规模的勘测，鲁宾使用了 8.4 米的西蒙尼勘测望远镜和有史以来最大的数码相机，能够捕捉分辨率为 3.2 十亿像素的图像。通过反复拍摄南半球天空的大片区域，该天文台将建立一个范围极其广泛的宇宙延时记录。

paras.en: The facility is jointly funded by the National Science Foundation and the U.S. Department of Energy's Office of Science.
paras.zh: 该设施由美国国家科学基金会和美国能源部科学办公室共同资助。

paras.en: Just 7% of the Night Sky Revealed Two New Satellites
paras.zh: 只有 7% 的夜空出现了两颗新卫星

paras.en: For the new studies, astronomers examined preview observations gathered between April 2025 and January 2026. These images covered only about 7% of the entire night sky, yet they were sufficient to reveal two previously unknown companions of the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，天文学家检查了 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 1 月期间收集的预览观测结果。这些图像仅覆盖了整个夜空的约 7%，但足以揭示银河系的两个以前未知的伴星。

paras.en: The discoveries offer an encouraging indication of what could emerge as Rubin continues collecting data across a much larger portion of the sky.
paras.zh: 这些发现提供了令人鼓舞的迹象，表明随着鲁宾继续在更大范围的天空中收集数据，可能会出现什么情况。

paras.en: "Finding new Milky Way satellites in Rubin Observatory data has been an exciting future prospect for most of my career," said Marla Geha, a professor of astronomy and physics in Yale's Faculty of Arts and Sciences, and co-author on both studies. "It is remarkable this is now a reality."
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学文理学院天文学和物理学教授、两项研究的合著者玛拉·格哈 (Marla Geha) 表示：“在鲁宾天文台的数据中寻找新的银河系卫星对我职业生涯的大部分时间来说都是一个令人兴奋的未来前景。” “值得注意的是，这现在已成为现实。”

paras.en: The research involved a broad international collaboration. In addition to Yale, participating institutions included the University of Chicago, the University of Virginia, the University of Washington, Dartmouth College, the University of Tampa, NSF NOIRLab, Duke University, the University of Toronto, the Instituto de Astrofísica de Andalucía in Spain, the University of Colorado-Boulder, and Lund University in Sweden.
paras.zh: 该研究涉及广泛的国际合作。除耶鲁大学外，参与机构还包括芝加哥大学、弗吉尼亚大学、华盛顿大学、达特茅斯学院、坦帕大学、NSF NOIRLab、杜克大学、多伦多大学、西班牙安达卢西亚天文研究所、科罗拉多大学博尔德分校和瑞典隆德大学。

paras.en: Aashay Pai of the University of Chicago served as the first author of the study describing Rubin-GC1.
paras.zh: 芝加哥大学的 Aashay Pai 是该研究的第一作者，该研究描述了 Rubin-GC1。

paras.en: Hidden Galaxies Could Reveal New Clues About Dark Matter
paras.zh: 隐藏的星系可能揭示有关暗物质的新线索

paras.en: Finding additional satellites could do much more than expand the known population of galaxies surrounding the Milky Way. These faint objects may also help astronomers investigate one of the universe's greatest mysteries: dark matter.
paras.zh: 寻找更多的卫星不仅仅可以扩大银河系周围已知的星系数量。这些微弱的物体还可能帮助天文学家调查宇宙最大的谜团之一：暗物质。

paras.en: Dark matter is an invisible form of matter that does not emit or reflect light, making it impossible to observe directly with conventional telescopes. Scientists infer its existence from the gravitational effects it produces on stars, galaxies, and other cosmic structures. It accounts for most of the matter in the universe and provides much of the gravitational framework that holds galaxies together.
paras.zh: 暗物质是一种不可见的物质形式，不发射或反射光，因此无法用传统望远镜直接观察。科学家根据它对恒星、星系和其他宇宙结构产生的引力效应来推断它的存在。它解释了宇宙中的大部分物质，并提供了将星系聚集在一起的大部分引力框架。

paras.en: Ultra-faint galaxies such as Aquarius IV are particularly valuable for studying dark matter. They contain only a small fraction of the stars found in larger galaxies, yet dark matter dominates their total mass. By examining their properties and movements, researchers can test ideas about how dark matter behaves and influences the formation of galaxies.
paras.zh: 像水瓶座 IV 这样的超微弱星系对于研究暗物质特别有价值。它们只包含较大星系中发现的恒星的一小部分，但暗物质在它们的总质量中占主导地位。通过检查它们的性质和运动，研究人员可以测试有关暗物质如何行为和影响星系形成的想法。

paras.en: These discoveries could also help scientists reconstruct the Milky Way's long history. The positions, motions, and properties of small satellite galaxies can reveal how larger galaxies assembled over billions of years, including how they accumulated matter and interacted with smaller systems.
paras.zh: 这些发现还可以帮助科学家重建银河系的悠久历史。小卫星星系的位置、运动和特性可以揭示较大的星系在数十亿年的时间里如何聚集，包括它们如何积累物质并与较小的系统相互作用。

paras.en: Rubin's early findings may also provide important clues about how the universe's smallest and faintest galaxies form, evolve, and survive.
paras.zh: 鲁宾的早期发现也可能为宇宙中最小和最微弱的星系如何形成、演化和生存提供重要线索。

paras.en: "These discoveries are incredibly promising," Geha said. "Continued discoveries will allow us to complete the census of satellite galaxies around the Milky Way, which is a key to understanding how the faintest galaxies form."
paras.zh: “这些发现非常有希望，”格哈说。 “持续的发现将使我们能够完成对银河系周围卫星星系的普查，这是了解最微弱星系如何形成的关键。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Yale University. Original written by Jim Shelton. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.

articles.title: What's that bright 'star' in the early morning sky? It's not a star at all!
articles.author: Joe Rao

paras.en: Early morning risers heading to work or school before sunrise are likely to notice a very bright, star-like object appearing low in the east-southeast sky just before sunrise. What is somewhat amazing is that just a couple of weeks ago this object wasn't there at all, but now it literally stands out with such brilliance as to almost command the attention of commuters who might be traveling in an easterly direction to "Look at me!"
paras.zh: 早起在日出前去上班或上学的人可能会注意到日出前在东南偏东的天空中出现了一个非常明亮的恒星状物体。令人惊奇的是，就在几周前，这个物体根本不存在，但现在它确实如此耀眼，几乎吸引了可能向东行驶的通勤者的注意力，让他们“看我！”

paras.en: The object in question is, of course, the planet Venus, which is currently amid one of its most spectacular forays into the morning sky, literally "vaulting up" into prominence.
paras.zh: 当然，所讨论的天体是金星，它目前正处于早晨天空中最壮观的一次尝试中，字面意思是“跃升”到显着位置。

paras.en: On Oct. 24, Venus came to inferior conjunction, passing between the Earth and sun and shifting from the evening into the morning sky. And the view is only going to get better in the days and weeks to come!
paras.zh: 10月24日，金星发生内合，穿过地球和太阳之间，从傍晚的天空转移到早晨的天空。在接下来的几天和几周内，景色只会变得更好！

paras.en: In terms of morning visibility, Venus is now in a literal and figurative sense "rising to the occasion." It's now rising before the break of dawn, more than 90 minutes before sunrise. From here on, it will rise three minutes earlier each day, so that by Dec. 17 it will rise 3 hours and 50 minutes before sunrise and blaze in a completely dark sky for more than two hours before the first vestige of morning twilight.
paras.zh: 就早晨的能见度而言，金星现在无论是字面意义上还是比喻意义上都“应势而生”。现在黎明前已经升起，距离日出还有 90 多分钟。从现在开始，它每天会提前三分钟升起，这样到12月17日，它将在日出前3小时50分钟升起，并在晨曦初现之前在完全黑暗的天空中闪耀两个多小时。

paras.en: It will reach peak brilliance on Nov. 29, when it will shine at an eye-popping magnitude of -4.9. That's 12 times brighter than its nearest planetary competitor, Jupiter and a full 25 times more dazzling than Sirius, the brightest of all stars. If you live in a rural location with no light pollution to interfere, you might be able to make out that it is casting a visible shadow and if you follow it right on through sunrise, it will be evident to your naked eye in full daylight: a tiny white speck plainly evident against the blue daytime sky.
paras.zh: 它将于 11 月 29 日达到峰值亮度，届时它将达到令人瞠目结舌的 -4.9 星等。它比最接近的行星竞争对手木星亮 12 倍，比所有恒星中最亮的天狼星亮 25 倍。如果你住在没有光污染干扰的乡村地区，你可能会发现它正在投下可见的阴影，如果你在日出时一直跟踪它，那么在白天，你的肉眼就会看到它：一个微小的白色斑点在蓝色的白天天空中清晰可见。

paras.en: In a way, we could even regard Venus as this year's version of a "Christmas Star," glowing with stunning radiance ". . . in the east" like the biblical quote mentioned in St. Matthew.
paras.zh: 在某种程度上，我们甚至可以将金星视为今年版本的“圣诞之星”，“……在东方”闪耀着令人惊叹的光芒，就像《马太福音》中提到的圣经引言一样。

paras.en: After reaching its high point in terms of morning visibility in mid-December, Venus will start a long, slow slide back toward the sun, rising about 1½ minutes later each morning from New Year's Day through late March. By then, Venus will be coming up as dawn is breaking, roughly 100 minutes before sunrise. Venus will continue to get gradually lower and rise progressively later during the spring and by late June it will be coming up less than an hour before sunrise, ultimately vanishing into the bright dawn twilight by July. Venus will then go on a "summer sabbatical" of sorts and will not reappear again until about this time next year when it will begin a very fine evening apparition.
paras.zh: 在 12 月中旬达到早晨能见度的最高点后，金星将开始漫长而缓慢地滑回太阳，从元旦到三月下旬，每天早上金星都会晚约 1.5 分钟升起。到那时，金星将在黎明时分升起，大约在日出前 100 分钟。金星将在春季继续逐渐降低并逐渐上升，到六月下旬，它将在日出前不到一个小时出现，最终在七月消失在明亮的黎明暮色中。然后金星将进行某种“夏季休假”，直到明年这个时候它才会再次出现，届时它将开始一个非常美好的夜晚显现。

paras.en: So, if any of your friends or relatives remark to you that they saw a "strange UFO" on the way to work or school recently, you now can set them straight.
paras.zh: 因此，如果您的任何朋友或亲戚对您说他们最近在上班或上学的路上看到了“奇怪的不明飞行物”，您现在可以纠正他们。

paras.en: Joe Rao serves as an instructor and guest lecturer at New York's Hayden Planetarium. He writes about astronomy for Natural History magazine, Sky and Telescope, The Old Farmer's Almanac and other publications.
paras.zh: Joe Rao 担任纽约海登天文馆的讲师和客座讲师。他为《自然历史》杂志、《天空与望远镜》、《老农年鉴》和其他出版物撰写有关天文学的文章。

paras.en: Joe Rao is Space.com's skywatching columnist, as well as a veteran meteorologist and eclipse chaser who also serves as an instructor and guest lecturer at New York's Hayden Planetarium. He writes about astronomy for Natural History magazine, Sky & Telescope and other publications. Joe is an 8-time Emmy-nominated meteorologist who served the Putnam Valley region of New York for over 21 years. You can find him on Twitter and YouTube tracking lunar and solar eclipses, meteor showers and more. To find out Joe's latest project, visit him on Twitter.
paras.zh: 乔·拉奥 (Joe Rao) 是 Space.com 的天空观察专栏作家，也是一位资深气象学家和日食追踪者，同时也是纽约海登天文馆的讲师和客座讲师。他为《自然历史》杂志、《天空与望远镜》和其他出版物撰写有关天文学的文章。 Joe 是一位曾 8 次获得艾美奖提名的气象学家，为纽约普特南谷地区服务超过 21 年。您可以在 Twitter 和 YouTube 上找到他跟踪月食、日食、流星雨等。要了解 Joe 的最新项目，请访问他的 Twitter。

articles.title: 'I think we will prevail': NASA chief Jared Isaacman on Artemis, China and the new moon race (exclusive)
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

paras.en: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman is serious about launching "big rockets" to the moon every single year for the agency's Artemis program. And the new space race with China is fueling that ambition.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼认真考虑每年为该机构的阿尔忒弥斯计划向月球发射“大型火箭”。与中国的新太空竞赛正在助长这一雄心。

paras.en: "I feel good. I feel like we are certainly on a more achievable path to the lunar surface today than where we were before," Isaacman told Space.com.
paras.zh: “我感觉很好。我觉得今天我们肯定比以前更容易到达月球表面，”艾萨克曼告诉 Space.com。

paras.en: We recently sat down with the NASA chief to discuss the state of the Artemis program, and, off the bat, he made it clear that he's confident in the U.S. space program following the success of April's Artemis II mission around the moon. In fact, just prior to our conversation, it was announced that Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman will become the new deputy director of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. But the road from Artemis II's success to crewed lunar landings and, later, a permanent moon base will take a lot of launches of NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) megarocket, Isaacman stressed.
paras.zh: 我们最近与美国宇航局局长坐下来讨论阿尔忒弥斯计划的状况，他立即明确表示，继四月阿尔忒弥斯二号绕月任务取得成功后，他对美国的太空计划充满信心。事实上，就在我们谈话之前，有消息称阿耳忒弥斯二号指挥官里德·怀斯曼将成为美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的新副主任。但艾萨克曼强调，从阿耳忒弥斯二号的成功到载人登月以及后来的永久月球基地，将需要美国宇航局太空发射系统（SLS）巨型火箭进行多次发射。

paras.en: "You know, a lot of people, especially in the space community, start getting [into] if the landers are there or not. I don't really care about that right now. What I care about is that we are launching big rockets no less than once a year," he said.
paras.zh: “你知道，很多人，尤其是太空界的人，开始关注着陆器是否存在。我现在并不关心这个。我关心的是我们每年至少发射一次大型火箭，”他说。

paras.en: "I think that's imperative for NASA to be doing these deep-space human spaceflight missions right now," Isaacman added. "So, we had a great mission in April of '26. We will launch again in '27."
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼补充说：“我认为美国宇航局现在必须执行这些深空载人航天任务。” “所以，我们在 26 年 4 月肩负着一项伟大的使命。我们将在 27 年再次发射。”

paras.en: That coming launch will be for Artemis III, a crewed mission to low Earth orbit that will test docking procedures between NASA's Orion capsule and one or both of the Artemis program's private lunar landers — SpaceX's Starship and Blue Origin's Blue Moon.
paras.zh: 即将发射的阿耳忒弥斯 III 号是一项近地轨道载人任务，将测试 NASA 的猎户座太空舱与阿耳忒弥斯计划的一个或两个私人月球着陆器（SpaceX 的星舰和蓝色起源的蓝月亮）之间的对接程序。

paras.en: "We need to continue to exercise those muscles," he said, referring to SLS liftoffs. "And, honestly, once a year isn't great, either. I mean, I don't think we're going to get back to the early [space] shuttle days, you know, four missions a year. I don't think we're going to get back to where we were with Apollo, but once a year is the minimum … I would testify that to Congress in this role years down the road.
paras.zh: “我们需要继续锻炼这些肌肉，”他在谈到 SLS 升空时说道。 “而且，老实说，每年一次也不是很好。我的意思是，我不认为我们会回到早期的[太空]航天飞机时代，你知道，每年四次任务。我不认为我们会回到阿波罗计划的状态，但每年一次是最少的......我会在未来几年向国会证明这一点。

paras.en: "If NASA is going to be doing deep-space missions, complicated missions, [we should] launch at least once a year and get as much out of it as you can for taking the risk and spending the taxpayer dollars and building towards something greater," Isaacman added. "That's what we're doing with Artemis III, and that's what's going to better prepare us for Artemis IV."
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼补充道：“如果美国宇航局要执行深空任务、复杂的任务，我们应该每年至少发射一次，并尽可能多地利用它来承担风险，花纳税人的钱，朝着更伟大的目标迈进。” “这就是我们对阿耳忒弥斯三号所做的事情，这也是我们为阿耳忒弥斯四号做好更好准备的事情。”

paras.en: So, how is NASA coping with the challenges that face them as they approach Artemis III ahead of a crewed lunar landing on Artemis IV, which is targeted for 2028? While NASA can learn some lessons from past moon missions with Apollo, today it's primarily relying on the extensive experience and talent within the agency, according to Isaacman.
paras.zh: 那么，在计划于 2028 年载人登月阿耳忒弥斯四号之前，NASA 如何应对在接近阿耳忒弥斯三号时所面临的挑战呢？艾萨克曼表示，虽然美国宇航局可以从过去的阿波罗登月任务中吸取一些教训，但如今它主要依赖于该机构内部的丰富经验和人才。

paras.en: "Artemis II is very different from Apollo 8, and Artemis III will be very different from Apollo 9," he said. "Our approach is not exactly the same as it was … But what is the same right now? The spirit, the energy, the potential within NASA. The talent of the workforce and industry is no different than the 1960s."
paras.zh: “阿耳忒弥斯二号与阿波罗 8 号有很大不同，阿耳忒弥斯三号也将与阿波罗 9 号有很大不同，”他说。 “我们的方法与以前不完全相同……但现在有什么相同之处？NASA 内部的精神、活力和潜力。劳动力和行业的人才与 1960 年代没有什么不同。”

paras.en: There's another similarity to the Apollo era: NASA has a rival in its race to the moon. While the adversary in the 1960s was the Soviet Union, today the U.S. is competing against China.
paras.zh: 与阿波罗时代还有另一个相似之处：美国宇航局在登月竞赛中有一个竞争对手。 20世纪60年代的对手是苏联，而今天美国的对手是中国。

paras.en: "It is a real space race," Isaacman said. But, he added, "this one is very different than the first one."
paras.zh: “这是一场真正的太空竞赛，”艾萨克曼说。但是，他补充道，“这一次与第一个非常不同。”

paras.en: "Everything is closer than it was, not just in space. I mean, we had the edge in computing [and] every one of the technology domains during the Cold War. Our capabilities were better by a mile," he said. "[But with] China, it's not [like that]. They're very close."
paras.zh: “一切都比以前更近了，不仅仅是在太空。我的意思是，冷战期间我们在计算和每一个技术领域都拥有优势。我们的能力要好得多，”他说。 “[但对于]中国来说，情况并非如此。他们非常接近。”

paras.en: "We're saying we're going to land on the moon at the end of 2028. China is saying by the end of 2029," Isaacman added. "And it's like, Well, are they going to pull it off? Yes, they will. They've showcased their landers, their rovers, their suits, two-launch architecture with built-in reusability."
paras.zh: “我们说我们将在 2028 年底登陆月球。中国说是 2029 年底，”艾萨克曼补充道。 “这就像，好吧，他们会成功吗？是的，他们会的。他们展示了他们的着陆器、漫游车、宇航服、具有内置可重复使用性的两次发射架构。”

paras.en: So NASA is taking the Chinese threat very seriously, according to Isaacman.
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼表示，美国宇航局正在非常严肃地对待中国的威胁。

paras.en: "The consequence of getting this wrong, I'm telling you — it's going to be felt around the world," he said. "It will call everything into question."
paras.zh: “我告诉你，犯错的后果——全世界都会感受到，”他说。 “这会让一切都受到质疑。”

paras.en: "Should I be using American superintelligence or AI? Should I be doing Chinese? Should I be buying their computers? Should I be [buying] ours? Buying their cars, their airplanes, their ships? Whose security guarantees to trust?" Isaacman added. "I think the implications are pretty severe, which is why we're taking it so seriously and putting such extreme focus on the mission right now. But we have that playbook of success, and I think we will prevail."
paras.zh: “我应该使用美国的超级智能还是人工智能？我应该做中国的吗？我应该购买他们的计算机吗？我应该[购买]我们的吗？购买他们的汽车、飞机、轮船？谁的安全保证值得信任？”艾萨克曼补充道。 “我认为其影响相当严重，这就是为什么我们如此认真地对待它，并高度关注现在的使命。但我们有成功的剧本，我认为我们会取得胜利。”

paras.en: Chelsea Gohd served as a Senior Writer for Space.com from 2018 to 2022 before returning in 2026, covering everything from climate change to planetary science and human spaceflight in both articles and on-camera in videos. With a M.S. in Biology, Chelsea has written and worked for institutions including NASA JPL, the American Museum of Natural History, Scientific American, Discover Magazine Blog, Astronomy Magazine, and Live Science. When not writing, editing or filming something space-y, Gohd is writing music and performing as Foxanne, even launching a song to space in 2021 with Inspiration4. You can follow her online @chelsea.gohd and @foxanne.music

articles.title: Star Wars is experiencing a golden age of video games
articles.author: Fran Ruiz

paras.en: After a tumultuous start to EA's rebooted Star Wars Battlefront series, in 2021 Lucasfilm and Disney decided to open up the development of new Star Wars games by bringing in different publishers and studios under the Lucasfilm Games banner. Now, over five years on, we can confidently say we're entering a new golden era of amazing Star Wars games.
paras.zh: 在 EA 重新启动的《星球大战：前线》系列经历了动荡的开局后，卢卡斯影业和迪士尼于 2021 年决定在卢卡斯影业旗下引入不同的发行商和工作室，以开放新的《星球大战》游戏的开发。现在，五年多过去了，我们可以自信地说，我们正在进入令人惊叹的星球大战游戏的新黄金时代。

paras.en: With LucasArts' successor calling the shots and coordinating a multitude of projects set in a galaxy far, far away, even EA's latest efforts like Squadrons and the Jedi series have taken bigger and bolder swings. Now, in 2026, the full potential of the Star Wars universe has become clearer with specific releases squarely aimed at niche audiences.
paras.zh: 随着 LucasArts 的继任者发号施令，并协调众多以遥远星系为背景的项目，就连 EA 的最新作品，如《中队》和《绝地》系列，也采取了更大、更大胆的举措。现在，到了 2026 年，《星球大战》宇宙的全部潜力已经变得更加清晰，专门针对小众受众推出了特定版本。

paras.en: It's become clear that future Star Wars games needn't be expensive endeavors full of familiar faces or concepts. Star Wars Zero Company and Galactic Racer's restrained scope and confidence have been infectious, and, as it turns out, they're already recognized by all the parties involved as double-A success stories.
paras.zh: 很明显，未来的星球大战游戏不必是充满熟悉面孔或概念的昂贵努力。 《星球大战零号公司》和《银河赛车手》的克制范围和信心具有感染力，事实证明，它们已经被所有相关方视为双 A 的成功故事。

paras.en: A Burnout-inspired Star Wars racer (created by a bunch of ex-Burnout devs) is a fantastic pitch if you know your video games, but looking at EA's recent and current direction, it's easy to see why it didn't happen under their reign. The original Burnout studio, Criterion, would have been an excellent candidate, but instead they were sent to work in the Battlefield mines. Still, someone was interested in the idea, and the end result is glorious.
paras.zh: 如果你了解自己的电子游戏，那么受《火爆狂飙》启发的《星球大战》赛车游戏（由一群前《火爆狂飙》开发者创建）是一个很棒的宣传，但看看 EA 最近和当前的发展方向，很容易明白为什么在他们的统治下这没有发生。最初的《Burnout》工作室 Criterion 本来是一个很好的候选者，但他们却被派往战地矿井工作。尽管如此，还是有人对这个想法感兴趣，最终的结果是辉煌的。

paras.en: Fast and furious, Star Wars: Galactic Racer ignores recent racing game trends and bets big on arcade-y vibes, uncomplicated controls, and a high skill ceiling that challenges you with extremely high speeds, tight turns, and unexpected interruptions as other drivers try to ruin your day.
paras.zh: 《星球大战：银河赛车》速度与激情无视最近的赛车游戏趋势，并在街机氛围、简单的控制和高技能上限上下了大赌注，在其他车手试图毁掉你的一天时，以极高的速度、急转弯和意想不到的中断来挑战你。

paras.en: The not-so-secret sauce, however, was its runs-based structure, which injects the flexibility and replay value of roguelite games into the more traditional arcade racing structure that older gamers are familiar with.
paras.zh: 然而，不那么秘密的调味品是其基于奔跑的结构，它将 Roguelite 游戏的灵活性和重玩价值注入到老玩家熟悉的更传统的街机赛车结构中。

paras.en: Fully confident in its central gameplay idea and devoid of modern live-service baggage, Fuse Games' debut title makes the most of the Star Wars setting within the restrictions of simply making a fun and engaging Star Wars racer.
paras.zh: Fuse Games 对其核心游戏理念充满信心，并且没有现代实时服务的包袱，它的首个游戏充分利用了星球大战的背景，只是制作了一款有趣且引人入胜的星球大战赛车游戏。

paras.en: It's almost the same approach we felt in Zero Company, a turn-based tactical strategy-RPG that comes from the minds of another team of ex-triple-A developers. "Star Wars but XCOM" should've happened earlier, but we're glad it did this year, and, unsurprisingly, it's a banger.
paras.zh: 这与我们在《零连》中感受到的方法几乎相同，这是一款回合制战术策略角色扮演游戏，来自另一个前 3A 开发团队的想法。 《星球大战但幽浮》本来应该早点上映，但我们很高兴今年上映了，而且不出所料，它很轰动。

paras.en: The correct read of their success should be obvious (and so far, it appears the powers that be are seeing it): Let seasoned and fresh developers cook games they're excited about.
paras.zh: 对他们成功的正确解读应该是显而易见的（到目前为止，似乎当权者已经看到了这一点）：让经验丰富和新鲜的开发人员制作他们感兴趣的游戏。

paras.en: Big, medium, or small, players will react positively to experiences that really feel genuine and aren't brought down by tacked-on systems or monetization. Ubisoft's Massive Entertainment also got it right with Star Wars Outlaws, but that ambitious open-world title — hardly a fresh pitch nowadays — also faced high sales expectations due to an inevitably gigantic production budget.
paras.zh: 无论是大、中还是小，玩家都会对真正感觉真实且不会被附加系统或货币化所影响的体验做出积极反应。育碧旗下的 Massive Entertainment 在《星球大战：亡命徒》中也取得了不错的成绩，但这款雄心勃勃的开放世界游戏——如今已经不是什么新鲜事了——也由于不可避免的巨额制作预算而面临着很高的销售预期。

paras.en: Allowing Star Wars to get weirder and more specific could also help the movie and TV side of things. We know Star Wars has finally locked in clearer big-screen plans for the coming years, and with Disney Plus TV series being seemingly scaled down and targeting more distinct stories better suited for a non-theatrical medium, the crowds' responses to Lucasfilm Games' wins shouldn't be overlooked.
paras.zh: 让星球大战变得更怪异、更具体也可能对电影和电视方面有所帮助。我们知道《星球大战》最终在未来几年锁定了更清晰的大银幕计划，而迪士尼+电视剧似乎正在缩小规模，并瞄准更适合非戏剧媒体的更独特的故事，观众对卢卡斯影业游戏获胜的反应不应被忽视。

paras.en: You can't manufacture a viral character like Biddy Blas, arguably Star Wars' most popular new character since Grogu's debut in 2019. It just happens. And it happens naturally if Star Wars is allowed to explore the weird corners of a galaxy.
paras.zh: 你不可能创造出像 Biddy Blas 这样病毒式传播的角色，它可以说是自 2019 年 Grogu 首次亮相以来《星球大战》中最受欢迎的新角色。它只是发生了。如果《星球大战》允许探索银河系的奇怪角落，这种情况就会自然发生。

paras.en: Devoid of ties to the larger canon and set away from the Imperial era, Galactic Racer makes the post-war period richer by going smaller. It's a reminder of much of the promise introduced by The Mandalorian's first season, before it became distractingly "relevant" to the larger saga.
paras.zh: 《银河赛车》与更大的经典没有联系，也远离帝国时代，它通过变得更小，让战后时期变得更加丰富。这让人回想起《曼达洛人》第一季所做出的承诺，然后才与更大的传奇故事产生令人分心的“相关性”。

paras.en: Even the Clone Wars-set Zero Company keeps things relatively low-profile. Yes, major characters like Anakin Skywalker make cameos, but they don't rob the A-Team and Suicide Squad-inspired tale of camaraderie and subterfuge of its valuable independence. Sure, hits like Andor and Rogue One were obvious inspirations for its tone, but the story stands alone, allowing even Star Wars newcomers to jump in and enjoy it with minimal context.
paras.zh: 即使是克隆人战争背景下的零连也保持着相对低调的态度。是的，像阿纳金·天行者这样的主要角色都会客串，但他们并没有剥夺《特遣队》和《自杀小队》启发的故事中的友情和其宝贵的独立性。当然，像《安多》和《侠盗一号》这样的热门作品显然是其基调的灵感来源，但这个故事是独立的，即使是《星球大战》的新手也能在最少的背景下加入并享受它。

paras.en: At a time when giant decades-old franchises often struggle to recruit new fans, the last two Star Wars games reinforce the property's new direction in a medium that can reach more potential Padawans than any other.
paras.zh: 在拥有数十年历史的大型特许经营权经常难以招募新粉丝的时代，最后两款《星球大战》游戏以比其他任何游戏都更能接触到更多潜在学徒的媒介强化了该产业的新方向。

paras.en: The good trick? Just allowing Star Wars to be fresh and smaller — and with no homework required — from time to time. In turn, the larger stories on the horizon will be stronger with the Force.
paras.zh: 好招数？只是时不时地让星球大战变得新鲜、更小——而且不需要做作业。反过来，随着原力的到来，即将到来的更大的故事也会变得更加强大。

paras.en: Command an elite squad in a gritty, authentic Star Wars story set in the twilight of the Clone Wars. Step into the boots of Hawks, a former Republic officer leading Zero Company on a covert operation against an emerging threat that could consume the galaxy.
paras.zh: 在以克隆人战争末期为背景的真实的星球大战故事中指挥一支精英小队。霍克斯是一名前共和国军官，领导零连开展秘密行动，应对可能吞噬银河系的新威胁。

paras.en: Available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
paras.zh: 适用于 PS5、Xbox Series X|S 和 PC。

paras.en: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the Star Wars galaxy.
paras.zh: 《星球大战：银河赛车》是一款高风险的赛车重塑游戏，诞生于星球大战银河系无法无天的外环。

paras.en: Available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
paras.zh: 适用于 PS5、Xbox Series X|S 和 PC。

paras.en: Fran Ruiz is our resident Star Wars guy. His hunger for movies and TV series is only matched by his love for video games. He got a BA of English Studies, focusing on English Literature, from the University of Malaga, in Spain, as well as a Master's Degree in English Studies, Multilingual and Intercultural Communication. On top of writing features and other longform articles for Space.com since 2021, he is a frequent collaborator of VG247 and other gaming sites. He also serves as associate editor over at Star Wars News Net and its sister site, Movie News Net.
paras.zh: 弗兰·鲁伊斯是我们的星球大战常驻人员。他对电影和电视剧的渴望与他对电子游戏的热爱相匹配。他在西班牙马拉加大学获得英语研究学士学位，主修英国文学，以及英语研究、多语言和跨文化交流硕士学位。自 2021 年以来，他除了为 Space.com 撰写专题文章和其他长篇文章外，还经常与 VG247 和其他游戏网站合作。他还担任星球大战新闻网及其姊妹网站电影新闻网的副编辑。

articles.title: ESI supplying solar array components to missile defense programs
articles.author: ESI Motion

paras.en: Oct. 30, 2026 – ESI Motion Inc. is proud to announce that it is supplying the Solar Array Drive Electronics (SADE) to Lockheed Martin for its work on the Space Development Agency’s Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) programs.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 30 日 – ESI Motion Inc. 自豪地宣布，它正在向洛克希德·马丁公司提供太阳能阵列驱动电子设备 (SADE)，用于其太空发展局扩散作战空间架构 (PWSA) 项目的工作。

paras.en: Under the agreement, ESI Motion’s SADE technology will support SDA as the PWSA is developed.
paras.zh: 根据协议，随着 PWSA 的开发，ESI Motion 的 SADE 技术将支持 SDA。

paras.en: Defending our nation in space is more important than ever. The Space Development Agency’s PWSA programs provide the military with a network of satellites with secure communication, missile tracking and space-based support to make sure our troops have the latest and greatest technology.
paras.zh: 在太空中保卫我们的国家比以往任何时候都更加重要。太空发展局的 PWSA 计划为军队提供了一个卫星网络，提供安全通信、导弹跟踪和天基支持，以确保我们的部队拥有最新、最先进的技术。

paras.en: The SADE consists of our Space-rated, flight heritage, SuperNova and Pulsar motor controllers. These motion controllers ensure all mission parameters are fulfilled, with high-reliable technology.
paras.zh: SADE 由我们的太空级、飞行传统、SuperNova 和 Pulsar 电机控制器组成。这些运动控制器采用高可靠性技术，确保满足所有任务参数。

paras.en: ESI Motion Inc., U.S. Company, is a trusted supplier and partner, supporting mission operations for space, military and industrial customers around the world for over 20 years. Please visit our website; www.esimotion.com
paras.zh: ESI Motion Inc.，美国公司，是值得信赖的供应商和合作伙伴，20 多年来为世界各地的太空、军事和工业客户的任务运营提供支持。请访问我们的网站； www.esimotion.com

paras.zh: 媒体联系人：Mitchell Haerterich，高级营销和销售专家

articles.title: DETUMBLER: Airbus’ Passive Spin Stabilization Solution
articles.author: Airbus

paras.en: The tumbling crisis: why dead satellites threaten orbit
paras.zh: 翻滚危机：为何失效卫星威胁轨道

paras.en: Every year, hundreds of satellites reach end-of-life, most are deorbited, but some fail abruptly. Yet, even when properly decommissioned, some dead satellites may start tumbling on their own, through the accumulation of tiny disturbances like solar radiation pressure, to the point where they become impossible to capture by active debris removal missions.
paras.zh: 每年都有数百颗卫星报废，大多数卫星脱离轨道，但也有一些卫星突然失效。然而，即使正确退役，一些报废的卫星也可能会通过太阳辐射压力等微小扰动的积累而开始自行翻滚，直至主动碎片清除任务无法捕获它们。

paras.en: With over 36,500 tracked debris objects in orbit, the risk of cascading collisions is real. ESA warns that without ADR (Active Debris Removal) solutions, some LEO orbits will become unusable. Ensuring that all dead satellites are properly detumbled would be a major element towards making ADR economically feasible.
paras.zh: 轨道上有超过 36,500 个被跟踪的碎片物体，级联碰撞的风险是真实存在的。欧空局警告说，如果没有 ADR（主动碎片清除）解决方案，一些低地球轨道将变得无法使用。确保所有报废卫星得到适当的修复将是使 ADR 在经济上可行的一个主要因素。

paras.en: Detumbler: the game-changing alternative
paras.zh: Detumbler：改变游戏规则的替代方案

paras.en: Developed by Airbus R&D, the Detumbler is a passive magnetic damping device that stabilizes tumbling satellites before they become uncontrollable. Acting like an induction brake, it dissipates kinetic energy through the Earth’s magnetic field, stopping tumbling in a few months. For the first time, operators have a reliable, low-cost, fully passive solution to prevent post-mission tumbling.
paras.zh: Detumbler 由空客研发部开发，是一种无源磁阻尼装置，可在翻滚的卫星变得失控之前稳定它们。它的作用就像感应制动器，通过地球磁场耗散动能，几个月后就停止翻滚。运营商第一次拥有了可靠、低成本、完全被动的解决方案来防止任务后翻滚。

paras.en: Without power and thus actuators, the only phenomenon that can limit tumbling rates in a dead spacecraft are the natural eddy currents created by the Earth’s magnetic field in the satellite’s rotating metallic structure. Short circuiting the magnetorquers at the end of life could help boost that natural effect. Unfortunately, the resulting resistive torque is proportional to the low magnetic field squared (the induced dipole moment M is proportional to B, and the resulting magnetic torque is MxB), making such effects extremely weak, too weak to prevent spontaneous tumbling in case of any asymmetry in the external disturbances. As an example, in 2017, 12 years after decommissioning, Topex-Poseidon had reached a spin rate of 34 deg/s (40,000 Nms of accumulated momentum).
paras.zh: 在没有电源和执行器的情况下，唯一可以限制报废航天器翻滚速率的现象是地球磁场在卫星旋转金属结构中产生的自然涡流。在磁力器寿命结束时将其短路可能有助于增强这种自然效应。不幸的是，产生的阻力矩与低磁场的平方成正比（感应偶极矩M与B成正比，产生的磁力矩为MxB），使得这种效应极其微弱，太弱以至于无法在外部干扰不对称的情况下防止自发翻滚。例如，2017 年，即退役 12 年后，Topex-Poseidon 的旋转速度达到了 34 度/秒（累积动量 40,000 Nms）。

paras.en: Despite its very modest mass and volume, the Detumbler can reach efficiencies many orders of magnitude higher, by using permanent magnets so that the braking torque is proportional to B, not B².
paras.zh: 尽管其质量和体积非常适中，但通过使用永磁体，制动力矩与 B 而不是 B² 成正比，Detumbler 的效率可以提高许多数量级。

paras.en: ESA’s Space Safety Program requires detumbling capacities for LEO missions >500kg (1100 lbs), targeting detumbling performances from 3°/s to 0.75°/s in less than a year. Airbus’ Detumbler is a leading solution for meeting ESA’s requirements and thus enabling active debris removal (ADR).
paras.zh: ESA 的空间安全计划要求低地球轨道任务的减滚能力 >500 公斤（1100 磅），目标是在不到一年的时间内将减滚性能从 3°/s 提高到 0.75°/s。空中客车公司的 Detumbler 是一种领先的解决方案，可满足 ESA 的要求，从而实现主动碎片清除 (ADR)。

paras.en: How the Detumbler works: a satellite’s “magnetic brake”
paras.zh: Detumbler 的工作原理：卫星的“磁力制动器”

paras.en: The magnetized rotor inside the Detumbler tends to remain aligned with the Earth’s magnetic field. As the satellite tumbles, the Detumbler’s conductive housing rotates around the magnetized rotor, thus causing magnetic braking through eddy currents. This slowly but steadily dissipates the satellite’s kinetic energy, reducing the angular momentum exponentially, ultimately reaching a detumbled steady-state with very low residual rates. This is achieved without the need for any electrical or computing power, contrary to all other attitude control actuators.
paras.zh: Detumbler 内部的磁化转子往往与地球磁场保持一致。当卫星翻滚时，Detumbler 的导电外壳围绕磁化转子旋转，从而通过涡流产生磁力制动。这缓慢但稳定地消耗了卫星的动能，以指数方式减少角动量，最终达到残余率非常低的稳定状态。与所有其他姿态控制执行器相反，这是不需要任何电力或计算能力即可实现的。

paras.en: The Detumbler can then cancel or respectively prevent tumbling in all situations that might cause it:
paras.zh: 然后，Detumbler 可以在所有可能导致翻滚的情况下取消或分别防止翻滚：

paras.en: - catastrophic dynamic events (leaks, propulsion failures, impacts from debris or micrometeoroids)
paras.zh: - 灾难性动态事件（泄漏、推进故障、碎片或微流星体的影响）

paras.en: - slow buildup of angular momentum through the relentless action of tiny disturbance sources such as asymmetric solar radiation pressure (similar to the YORP effect in astronomy).
paras.zh: - 通过微小扰动源（例如不对称太阳辐射压力）的持续作用，角动量缓慢积累（类似于天文学中的 YORP 效应）。

paras.en: Weighing around 200g (0,440 lbs), the palm-sized device can be integrated almost anywhere (just not too close to the magnetometer) into existing platform designs, with little-to-no modifications, making it an easy decision for future LEO space missions.
paras.zh: 这款手掌大小的设备重约 200 克（0,440 磅），几乎可以在任何地方（只是距离磁力计不太近）集成到现有平台设计中，几乎不需要任何修改，这使其成为未来低地球轨道太空任务的一个轻松决定。

paras.en: Detumbler is no longer in R&D, it’s TRL 8 and already commercially available through the Airbus Space Electronics product portfolio.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不再处于研发阶段，它是 TRL 8，并且已经通过空中客车航天电子产品组合投入商业使用。

paras.en: ✔ 100% passive: Neither power nor attitude-control actuators intervention; working even after the end of the mission
paras.zh: ✔ 100%被动：动力和姿态控制执行器均不干预；任务结束后仍继续工作

paras.en: ✔ Compatible with a large range of platform sizes (from ~150 kg (330 lbs) to ~1.5 tons (3300 lbs)
paras.zh: ✔ 与多种平台尺寸兼容（从约 150 公斤（330 磅）到约 1.5 吨（3300 磅））

paras.en: ✔ Detumbling within weeks for the smaller platforms, within a year for the upper end of the size range
paras.zh: ✔ 对于较小的平台，可在数周内进行除滚；对于较大尺寸的平台，可在一年内进行除滚

paras.en: ✔ Prevents tumbling despite average external disturbances up to 5 µNm
paras.zh: ✔ 即使平均外部干扰高达 5 µNm，也能防止翻滚

paras.en: ✔ Tested under launch vibrations and orbital conditions.
paras.zh: ✔ 在发射振动和轨道条件下进行测试。

paras.en: While available now, Detumbler’s potential lies in large-scale adoption. MDA Space has selected the Detumbler for its first MDA AURORATM LEO satellite constellation order, with a view to tangibly ensuring a safer, sustainable use of Space. When the constellation launches, it will mark the first commercial large-scale integration of passive detumbling in orbit.
paras.zh: Detumbler 现已推出，其潜力在于大规模采用。 MDA Space 为其首个 MDA AURORATM LEO 卫星星座订单选择了 Detumbler，以切实确保更安全、可持续地利用太空。当该星座发射时，将标志着被动减滚在轨的首次商业化大规模集成。

paras.en: Detumbler is more than a product; it’s a cornerstone of Airbus’ sustainable space vision. By enabling active debris removal, it supports ESA’s Zero Debris targets and EU Space Traffic Management regulations, ensuring long-term orbital viability.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不仅仅是一种产品；它更是一种产品。它是空客可持续太空愿景的基石。通过主动清除碎片，它支持欧空局的零碎片目标和欧盟空间交通管理法规，确保长期轨道可行性。

paras.en: For Airbus, Detumbler proves that even the most complex space challenges can be solved through innovation and responsibility. As mega-constellations expand, technologies like Detumbler will be essential to preserving the usability of the shared low Earth orbit environment.
paras.zh: 对于空中客车公司来说，Detumbler 证明即使是最复杂的太空挑战也可以通过创新和责任来解决。随着巨型星座的扩张，像 Detumbler 这样的技术对于保持共享的近地轨道环境的可用性至关重要。

paras.en: The Detumbler effect: stability for a sustainable future
paras.zh: Detumbler 效应：稳定的未来

paras.en: The problem of tumbling satellites has persisted for decades, but Detumbler, ESA’s mandates, and renewed urgency for sustainability now require industry to solve it. By stabilizing uncontrolled satellites, Detumbler reduces ADR risks, costs, and complexity, making removal feasible at scale.
paras.zh: 卫星翻滚的问题已经持续了数十年，但 Detumbler、欧空局的指令以及可持续发展的新紧迫性现在需要工业界来解决这个问题。通过稳定不受控制的卫星，Detumbler 降低了 ADR 风险、成本和复杂性，使大规模移除成为可能。

paras.en: For operators, the message is clear: integrating Detumbler is not just compliance, it’s a business imperative. For the industry, it’s a step toward a stable and accessible orbit.
paras.zh: 对于运营商来说，信息很明确：集成 Detumbler 不仅仅是合规性，更是业务的当务之急。对于该行业来说，这是迈向稳定且可进入的轨道的一步。

paras.en: Ready to upgrade your next platform for meeting the sustainability imperatives of the upcoming decades? Contact Airbus Space Electronics to learn how the Detumbler secures the endgame in your mission’s life-cycle.
paras.zh: 准备好升级您的下一个平台以满足未来几十年的可持续发展要求了吗？联系空中客车航天电子公司，了解 Detumbler 如何确保任务生命周期的最后阶段。

paras.zh: 航空电子执行器|空间设备|空客

paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请联系：space_ electronics.sales@airbus.com

articles.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission
articles.author: CesiumAstro

paras.en: CesiumAstro Inc., a global leader in space and defense communications systems and satellites, today announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion. The financing brings CesiumAstro’s total capital announced in 2026 to more than $1.2 billion and supports its expansion into developing and operating its own satellite infrastructure.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro Inc. 是太空和国防通信系统及卫星领域的全球领导者，今天宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元。此次融资使 CesiumAstro 宣布的 2026 年总资本超过 12 亿美元，并支持其扩张至开发和运营自己的卫星基础设施。

paras.en: The company also announced Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation for commercial, sovereign, and defense missions. The announcement follows the launch of CesiumAstro’s first satellite Element-1, and the start of its on-orbit operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还宣布了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座，用于商业、主权和国防任务。该公告是在 CesiumAstro 的第一颗卫星 Element-1 发射并开始在轨运行之后发布的。

paras.en: This expansion builds on three strategic acquisitions that have strengthened CesiumAstro’s vertical integration from semiconductors to mission operations, helping accelerate the development and deployment of Synchronicity. The company is also expanding its engineering and manufacturing operations worldwide. As part of that effort, CesiumAstro has announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its Austin-area headquarters, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space.
paras.zh: 此次扩张建立在三项战略收购的基础上，这些收购加强了 CesiumAstro 从半导体到任务运营的垂直整合，有助于加速 Synchronicity 的开发和部署。该公司还在全球范围内扩展其工程和制造业务。作为这一努力的一部分，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元来扩建其奥斯汀地区总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。

paras.en: The equity round was led by Janus Henderson, with participation from Insight Partners, Sands Capital, Sumitomo Corporation of Americas, Woven Capital – Toyota’s Growth Fund, Incharge Capital, Magnetar, AV, and NewSpace Capital, alongside $100 million in debt financing provided through the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) and JPMorgan.
paras.zh: 此轮股权融资由 Janus Henderson 领投，Insight Partners、Sands Capital、Sumitomo Corporation of Americas、Woven Capital – 丰田成长基金、Incharge Capital、Magnetar、AV 和 NewSpace Capital 参与，此外还通过美国进出口银行 (EXIM) 和摩根大通提供了 1 亿美元的债务融资。

paras.en: The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: 新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: “For nearly a decade, we have invested in the engineering, intellectual property, manufacturing infrastructure, and the talented people required to build an enduring space technology company,” said Shey Sabripour, Founder and CEO of CesiumAstro. “With our technology proven on orbit, on the ground and in the air, a significantly expanded set of capabilities, and more than $1.2 billion in new capital raised this year, we are positioned to take the next major step in our growth.”
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 创始人兼首席执行官 Shey Saripour 表示：“近十年来，我们在工程、知识产权、制造基础设施和人才方面进行了投资，以建立一家持久的太空技术公司。” “凭借我们在轨道、地面和空中验证的技术、显着扩展的能力以及今年筹集的超过 12 亿美元的新资本，我们已准备好在增长方面迈出下一个重大步骤。”

paras.en: “Shey Sabripour is an extraordinary entrepreneur, and CesiumAstro is poised to revolutionize the space communications industry. This industry is at an inflection point; legacy solutions are not equipped for the demands of today’s customers,” said Aaron Schaechterle, Portfolio Manager, Janus Henderson. “When we met Shey and his team, it became clear that CesiumAstro provides transformative technology that is critical to the industry’s future. This investment was originated through the Janus Henderson Ascent platform, which was created to provide private market capital to visionary companies that redefine their industries and to support these companies on the journey from private to public markets.”
paras.zh: Janus Henderson 产品组合经理 Aaron Schaechterle 表示：“Shey Sabripour 是一位杰出的企业家，CesiumAstro 有望彻底改变太空通信行业。这个行业正处于拐点；传统解决方案无法满足当今客户的需求。” “当我们见到 Shey 和他的团队时，我们发现 CesiumAstro 提供的变革性技术对行业的未来至关重要。这项投资源自 Janus Henderson Ascent 平台，该平台的创建是为了向有远见的公司提供私募市场资本，重新定义其行业，并支持这些公司从私募市场走向公开市场。”

paras.en: Introducing Synchronicity: A 737-Satellite, AI-Enabled Constellation
paras.zh: 同步性简介：由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座

paras.en: Synchronicity takes CesiumAstro beyond supplying advanced space technologies and complete spacecraft to developing and operating its own integrated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 同步性使 CesiumAstro 不仅提供先进的空间技术和完整的航天器，还开发和运营自己的综合空间基础设施。

paras.en: The constellation is designed around a dynamically managed, multi-beam, multi-frequency architecture supporting Ku-, Ka-, and V-band communications, advanced edge compute, and multi-orbit operations. This unified system aims to deliver more flexible, resilient, and adaptable connectivity across a broad range of commercial and national security missions.
paras.zh: 该星座围绕动态管理、多波束、多频率架构设计，支持 Ku、Ka 和 V 频段通信、高级边缘计算和多轨道操作。这个统一的系统旨在为广泛的商业和国家安全任务提供更灵活、有弹性和适应性强的连接。

paras.en: AI is integrated throughout the architecture, enabling network optimization, dynamic allocation of communications resources, and autonomous adaptation to changing mission requirements and operating conditions. Edge processing capabilities are intended to bring compute closer to where data is generated, reducing dependence on terrestrial infrastructure and supporting increasingly time-sensitive applications.
paras.zh: 人工智能集成在整个架构中，可实现网络优化、通信资源的动态分配以及自主适应不断变化的任务要求和操作条件。边缘处理功能旨在使计算更接近数据生成的地方，减少对地面基础设施的依赖并支持对时间日益敏感的应用程序。

paras.en: Unlike architectures assembled from independently sourced components, Synchronicity will leverage CesiumAstro’s vertically integrated technology portfolio, including custom silicon, best-in-class active phased arrays, software-defined payloads, advanced processors, spacecraft, mission software, and terminals for air, ground, mobility, and maritime platforms. This approach enables system-wide performance optimization.
paras.zh: 与由独立采购的组件组装而成的架构不同，Synchronicity 将利用 CesiumAstro 的垂直集成技术组合，包括定制芯片、一流的有源相控阵、软件定义的有效载荷、先进处理器、航天器、任务软件以及空中、地面、移动和海上平台的终端。这种方法可以实现系统范围的性能优化。

paras.en: “Synchronicity is the culmination of the technology stack we have methodically built since CesiumAstro was founded,” said Sabripour. “We designed the silicon, the active phased array, the payload, processors, the spacecraft, ground terminals, and the network as one system. That vertical integration gives us the ability to build capabilities in space that evolve as mission requirements, technology, and operating conditions change.”
paras.zh: “同步性是我们自 CesiumAstro 成立以来有条不紊地构建的技术堆栈的顶峰，”Saripour 说。 “我们将芯片、有源相控阵、有效载荷、处理器、航天器、地面终端和网络设计为一个系统。这种垂直整合使我们能够在太空中构建随着任务要求、技术和操作条件的变化而发展的能力。”

paras.en: Three Strategic Acquisitions Expand CesiumAstro’s Capabilities
paras.zh: 三项战略收购扩大了 CesiumAstro 的能力

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has brought critical semiconductor, mission software, and artificial intelligence capabilities together through three acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr.
paras.zh: 在过去 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项收购将关键的半导体、任务软件和人工智能能力整合在一起：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr。

paras.en: Jariet Technologies — A leading millimeter-wave RF System-on-Chip (RF-SoC) semiconductor company specializing in advanced solutions for satellite communications, electronic warfare, and radar systems. The acquisition strengthens CesiumAstro’s technology portfolio with advanced mixed-signal semiconductors, digital signal processing, and digital beamforming capabilities, enabling greater performance and control across its communications payloads, active phased arrays, and spacecraft.
paras.zh: Jariet Technologies — 一家领先的毫米波射频片上系统 (RF-SoC) 半导体公司，专注于卫星通信、电子战和雷达系统的先进解决方案。此次收购增强了 CesiumAstro 的技术组合，包括先进的混合信号半导体、数字信号处理和数字波束形成功能，从而实现其通信有效载荷、有源相控阵和航天器的更高性能和控制。

paras.en: 1Aardvark — A company specializing in mission software, algorithms, and systems engineering for national defense programs. The acquisition expands CesiumAstro’s autonomous mission capabilities, enabling spacecraft to dynamically respond to changing conditions, operate with greater resilience, and maintain mission effectiveness in contested or connectivity-constrained environments.
paras.zh: 1Aardvark — 一家专门从事国防项目任务软件、算法和系统工程的公司。此次收购扩大了CesiumAstro的自主任务能力，使航天器能够动态响应不断变化的条件，以更大的弹性运行，并在有争议或连接受限的环境中保持任务有效性。

paras.en: Vidrovr — An AI company specializing in real-time multimodal signal analysis. The acquisition accelerates CesiumAstro’s integration of AI into space communications and sensing systems, enabling intelligent RF optimization, autonomous satellite operations, and reconfigurable edge compute across its space and defense platforms.
paras.zh: Vidrovr — 一家专门从事实时多模态信号分析的人工智能公司。此次收购加速了 CesiumAstro 将人工智能集成到空间通信和传感系统中，从而在其空间和国防平台上实现智能射频优化、自主卫星操作以及可重新配置的边缘计算。

paras.en: Element: A Decade of Engineering Proven on Orbit
paras.zh: 元素：在轨道上经过十年验证的工程

paras.en: CesiumAstro successfully launched and began on-orbit operation of Element-1 in October 2026.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 于 2026 年 10 月成功发射 Element-1 并开始在轨运行。

paras.en: Element-1 integrates CesiumAstro’s proprietary communications payloads, active phased array technology, compute systems, and spacecraft engineering in an operational satellite. The mission validates nearly a decade of investment in proprietary intellectual property, specialized engineering expertise, and in-house manufacturing capabilities.
paras.zh: Element-1 在一颗运行卫星中集成了 CesiumAstro 专有的通信有效载荷、有源相控阵技术、计算系统和航天器工程。该任务验证了近十年来在专有知识产权、专业工程专业知识和内部制造能力方面的投资。

paras.en: Element-1 is the first of eight planned spacecraft, with seven more launches secured for the next deployment phase. The Element program also advances CesiumAstro’s space-based edge processing and compute capabilities, enabling data to be processed closer to its source and supporting more intelligent, responsive, and autonomous missions.
paras.zh: Element-1 是计划中的八艘航天器中的第一艘，下一部署阶段还有七次发射。 Element 计划还提升了 CesiumAstro 的天基边缘处理和计算能力，使数据能够在更接近其来源的地方进行处理，并支持更智能、响应更快和自主的任务。

paras.en: Expanding Global Operations and Manufacturing Capacity
paras.zh: 扩大全球运营和制造能力

paras.en: In Texas, CesiumAstro announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its global headquarters in Austin, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space. The expansion will support precision electronics and spacecraft manufacturing, engineering, integration, and test, with plans to add 550 jobs and grow the Austin-area workforce to more than 1,000 employees by 2030.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元，以扩建其位于奥斯汀的全球总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。此次扩建将支持精密电子和航天器制造、工程、集成和测试，计划到 2030 年增加 550 个就业岗位，并将奥斯汀地区的员工人数增加到 1,000 多人。

paras.en: Across the United States, the company is investing hundreds of millions of dollars to expand its engineering, manufacturing, and operational capabilities, with additional facilities in Colorado, California, Alabama, Florida, and the Washington, D.C. area.
paras.zh: 在美国各地，该公司正在投资数亿美元来扩大其工程、制造和运营能力，并在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和华盛顿特区设立了额外的工厂。

paras.en: In Europe and Asia, the company is expanding its presence, with operations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Taiwan, Singapore, and Japan.
paras.zh: 在欧洲和亚洲，该公司正在扩大其业务，在英国、德国、瑞士、台湾、新加坡和日本开展业务。

paras.en: These expansions will support scaled production of its communications and sensing systems, advanced compute technologies, and spacecraft, as well as development and deployment of its next-generation space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些扩建将支持其通信和传感系统、先进计算技术和航天器的规模生产，以及下一代空间基础设施的开发和部署。

articles.title: Taking a Gander at Utah’s Goosenecks

paras.en: Tens of millions of years ago, the San Juan River in what is now southern Utah shared some characteristics with today's Mississippi River. In a bygone geologic era, the San Juan flowed across a relatively flat plain that formed in an ancient marine environment. Unencumbered by rugged terrain, the river was free to take a long, meandering path on its gradual journey downslope.
paras.zh: 数千万年前，现在犹他州南部的圣胡安河与今天的密西西比河有一些共同的特征。在过去的地质时代，圣胡安河流经在古代海洋环境中形成的相对平坦的平原。河流不受崎岖地形的阻碍，可以自由地沿着一条漫长而蜿蜒的小路缓缓下坡。

paras.en: But this part of the San Juan changed when geologic forces pushed the Colorado Plateau upward. Some experts think that within the later stages of this “still-enigmatic” history, starting around 20 million years ago, the plateau’s rise elevated the San Juan’s headwaters, which increased the river’s gradient and sped its flow. With that, the water’s erosive power intensified, and the river started carving its winding path deeper and deeper through 300-million-year-old rock.
paras.zh: 但当地质力量将科罗拉多高原向上推时，圣胡安河的这一部分发生了变化。一些专家认为，在这段“仍然神秘”的历史后期，从大约2000万年前开始，高原的上升抬高了圣胡安河的源头，从而增加了河流的坡度并加快了水流。随之而来的是，水流的侵蚀力增强了，河流开始在三亿年前的岩石中蜿蜒前行，越陷越深。

paras.en: Today, on its westward path to Lake Powell, the San Juan River flows through an impressive series of entrenched meanders, also known as “goosenecks.” An astronaut aboard the International Space Station photographed the stark desert topography on October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: 如今，圣胡安河在向西流向鲍威尔湖的途中，流经一系列令人印象深刻的根深蒂固的河曲，也称为“鹅颈河”。 2026 年 10 月 6 日，国际空间站上的一名宇航员拍摄了荒凉的沙漠地形。

paras.en: In Utah’s Goosenecks State Park, the river runs through a canyon 1,000 feet (300 meters) deep. In places, it nearly loops back on itself, making horseshoe-shaped bends. One section is so curvy that the river travels 5.5 miles (8.9 kilometers) between two points that are only 1.3 miles (2.1 kilometers) apart as the crow—nay, goose—flies.
paras.zh: 在犹他州的鹅颈州立公园，河流流经 1,000 英尺（300 米）深的峡谷。在某些地方，它几乎会自行绕回，形成马蹄形的弯曲。其中一段非常弯曲，以至于河流在相距仅 1.3 英里（2.1 公里）的两点之间蜿蜒行驶 5.5 英里（8.9 公里）。

paras.en: While the goosenecks are an unusual geologic wonder to behold by day, the area’s dark skies are a spectacle by night. Goosenecks State Park’s remote, high-desert location and 360-degree views of the sky helped earn it an International Dark Sky Park designation in 2021. According to DarkSky International, features such as the Double Cluster in Perseus and the Messier 24 star cloud in the Sagittarius spiral arm of the Milky Way are visible to the unaided eye from the park. In November 2026, dark skies offer the chance to view several meteor showers, with the Northern Taurids, Southern Taurids, and Leonids reaching their peaks throughout the month.
paras.zh: 虽然鹅颈在白天是一个不寻常的地质奇观，但该地区黑暗的天空在夜间却是一个奇观。鹅颈州立公园地处偏远、高沙漠位置，加上 360 度的天空视野，使其在 2021 年获得国际暗夜公园称号。根据 DarkSky International 的说法，从公园肉眼可以看到英仙座双星团和银河系人马座旋臂中的梅西耶 24 星云等特征。 2026 年 11 月，黑暗的天空提供了观看多场流星雨的机会，北金牛座流星雨、南金牛座流星雨和狮子座流星雨在整个月达到顶峰。

paras.en: Astronaut photograph ISS075-E-188830 was acquired on October 6, 2026, with a Nikon Z9 digital camera using a focal length of 400 millimeters. It is provided by the ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility and the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit at NASA Johnson Space Center. The image was taken by a member of the Expedition 75 crew. The image has been cropped and enhanced to improve contrast, and lens artifacts have been removed. The International Space Station Program supports the laboratory as part of the ISS National Lab to help astronauts take pictures of Earth that will be of the greatest value to scientists and the public, and to make those images freely available on the internet. Additional images taken by astronauts and cosmonauts can be viewed at the NASA/JSC Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth. Photo by Bob Wick (BLM), via Flickr. Story by Lindsey Doermann.
paras.zh: 宇航员照片 ISS075-E-188830 于 2026 年 10 月 6 日使用尼康 Z9 数码相机拍摄，焦距为 400 毫米。它由国际空间站机组人员地球观测设施和美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心的地球科学与遥感部门提供。这张照片是由 Expedition 75 号船员拍摄的。图像经过裁剪和增强以提高对比度，并且镜头伪影已被消除。国际空间站计划支持该实验室作为国际空间站国家实验室的一部分，帮助宇航员拍摄对科学家和公众最有价值的地球照片，并在互联网上免费提供这些图像。宇航员拍摄的其他图像可以在 NASA/JSC 地球宇航员摄影网关查看。摄影：Bob Wick (BLM)，来自 Flickr。林赛·杜尔曼的故事。

paras.en: - DarkSky International (2021, March 25) Goosenecks State Park. Accessed November 5, 2026.
paras.zh: - DarkSky International（2021 年，3 月 25 日）鹅颈州立公园。访问日期：2026 年 11 月 5 日。

paras.en: - Karlstrom, K.E., et al. (2022) Tectonics of the Colorado Plateau and Its Margins. Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences, 50:295-322.
paras.zh: - Karlstrom, K.E. 等人(2022) 科罗拉多高原及其边缘的构造。地球与行星科学年度评论，50：295-322。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Observatory (2020, July 19) Meandering Mississippi River. Accessed November 5, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球观测站（2020 年 7 月 19 日）蜿蜒的密西西比河。访问日期：2026 年 11 月 5 日。

paras.en: - Utah Geological Survey (2013, September) GeoSights: The Goosenecks of the San Juan River, San Juan County, Utah. Accessed November 5, 2026.
paras.zh: - 犹他州地质调查局（2013 年 9 月）GeoSights：犹他州圣胡安县圣胡安河的鹅颈。访问日期：2026 年 11 月 5 日。
