articles.title: NASA Seeks Next Generation of Explorers to Join Astronaut Corps
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: NASA is looking for the explorers who will help write the next chapter of human spaceflight.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在寻找能够帮助谱写人类航天新篇章的探险家。

paras.en: Applications are now open for the agency’s next class of astronauts, who will join NASA as America returns to the Moon, builds the Moon Base, and lays the groundwork for the first crewed missions to Mars.
paras.zh: 该机构的下一届宇航员的申请现已开放，他们将在美国重返月球时加入美国宇航局，建造月球基地，并为首次载人火星任务奠定基础。

paras.en: The next generation of astronauts will train to operate on the lunar surface, live and work beyond Earth, and take on missions that will push the boundaries of human exploration farther than ever before.
paras.zh: 下一代宇航员将接受在月球表面操作、在地球以外生活和工作的训练，并承担将人类探索的界限推得比以往更远的任务。

paras.en: U.S. citizens interested in joining the astronaut corps have until 11:59 p.m. EST Thursday, Dec. 3, to submit their completed application materials at:
paras.zh: 有兴趣加入宇航员队伍的美国公民必须在晚上 11 点 59 分之前参加。美国东部时间 12 月 3 日星期四，将填妥的申请材料提交至：

paras.en: “This is an extraordinary time to join NASA’s astronaut corps,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “The people we select could walk on the Moon, live and work at the Moon Base, and help pioneer the systems and operations that will ultimately carry crews to Mars. Those missions will demand technical excellence, sound judgment, teamwork, and courage. NASA’s astronaut corps has always called on remarkable Americans willing to take on extraordinary challenges in service to the nation. If you are ready to join that tradition, come help write the next chapter of humanity’s greatest adventure.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示：“这是加入美国宇航局宇航员队伍的非凡时刻。” “我们选择的人可以在月球上行走，在月球基地生活和工作，并帮助开拓最终将宇航员送上火星的系统和操作。这些任务需要卓越的技术、良好的判断力、团队合作和勇气。美国宇航局的宇航员队伍一直呼吁杰出的美国人愿意接受非凡的挑战，为国家服务。如果你准备好加入这一传统，那就来帮助书写人类最伟大冒险的下一个篇章。”

paras.en: NASA expects to make its final selection in late 2027 to begin training as the next class of astronaut candidates.
paras.zh: NASA 预计将在 2027 年底做出最终选择，开始下一期宇航员候选人的训练。

paras.en: “The window is open. The mission is waiting. And the only thing missing from the greatest adventure humanity has ever embarked upon is you,” said NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson.
paras.zh: “窗户是打开的。任务正在等待。人类有史以来最伟大的冒险中唯一缺少的就是你，”美国宇航局副局长马特·安德森说。

paras.en: The agency last opened applications in 2024. From more than 8,000 applications, 10 astronaut candidates were selected in 2025 and are currently completing nearly two years of training.
paras.zh: 该机构上次开放申请是在 2024 年。2025 年，从 8000 多名申请中选出了 10 名宇航员候选人，目前正在完成近两年的培训。

paras.en: “For those who apply, becoming a NASA astronaut is more than a career opportunity,” said Scott Tingle, chief astronaut and chair of the Astronaut Selection Board at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. “It is a chance to join a legacy of explorers who have pushed the boundaries of discovery and play a role in the missions that will shape humanity’s future in space. The next generation of astronaut candidates could help write history while inspiring future scientists, engineers, and explorers.”
paras.zh: “对于那些申请的人来说，成为美国宇航局宇航员不仅仅是一个职业机会，”休斯敦美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心首席宇航员兼宇航员选拔委员会主席斯科特·廷格尔说。 “这是一个加入探索者遗产的机会，他们突破了探索的界限，并在塑造人类太空未来的任务中发挥了作用。下一代宇航员候选人可以帮助书写历史，同时激励未来的科学家、工程师和探险家。”

paras.en: Since the 1960s, NASA has selected 370 people to train as astronaut candidates for its increasingly challenging missions. The agency has 32 astronauts active in the astronaut corps, and selected applicants will join their ranks to study spacewalking, lunar geology, operations of high-performance aircraft, and more.
paras.zh: 自 20 世纪 60 年代以来，NASA 已选拔了 370 名宇航员作为候选人进行培训，以应对日益具有挑战性的任务。该机构有 32 名活跃在宇航员队伍中的宇航员，被选中的申请者将加入他们的行列，学习太空行走、月球地质学、高性能飞机的操作等。

paras.en: The basic requirements to apply include United States citizenship and a master’s degree in a STEM field, including engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science from an accredited institution. The requirement for the master’s degree can also be met by:
paras.zh: 申请的基本要求包括美国公民身份和 STEM 领域的硕士学位，包括来自认可机构的工程、生物科学、物理科学或计算机科学。硕士学位的要求还可以通过以下方式满足：

paras.en: - Completion of at least two years of work toward a doctoral program in an appropriate technical field of engineering, biological science, physical science, computer science, or mathematics.
paras.zh: - 在工程、生物科学、物理科学、计算机科学或数学等适当技术领域完成至少两年的博士课程学习。

paras.en: - Completion of a Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine, Physician Assistant, Doctor of Nursing Practice, Family Nurse Practitioner, or a related medical degree.
paras.zh: - 完成医学博士、整骨医学博士、医师助理、护理实践博士、家庭护士执业者或相关医学学位。

paras.en: - Completion of, or current enrollment in, a nationally recognized Test Pilot School program, provided the program is completed by July 2027. If Test Pilot School is the only advanced technical degree, then completion of a bachelor’s degree in a STEM field, including engineering, biological science, physical science, or computer science is required.
paras.zh: - 完成或正在注册国家认可的试飞员学校项目，前提是该项目在 2027 年 7 月之前完成。如果试飞员学校是唯一的高级技术学位，则需要完成 STEM 领域的学士学位，包括工程、生物科学、物理科学或计算机科学。

paras.en: Candidates must also have at least three years of related professional experience after completing their qualifying degree.
paras.zh: 候选人在完成合格学位后还必须具有至少三年的相关专业经验。

paras.en: For pilots, the professional experience requirement may be met through the following flight experience:
paras.zh: 对于飞行员来说，可以通过以下飞行经验来满足专业经验要求：

paras.en: - High-performance jet aircraft: 750 hours of pilot-in-command time.
paras.zh: - 高性能喷气式飞机：750 小时的机长时间。

paras.en: - Other fixed-wing aircraft: 1,500 total flight hours, including 750 hours as pilot in command.
paras.zh: - 其他固定翼飞机：总飞行小时数为 1,500 小时，其中机长飞行小时数为 750 小时。

paras.en: - Rotary-wing aircraft: 1,000 total flight hours, including 300 hours as pilot in command.
paras.zh: - 旋翼飞机：总飞行小时数为 1,000 小时，其中机长飞行小时数为 300 小时。

paras.en: For medical doctors, residency training may count toward the professional experience requirement and must be completed by July 2027.
paras.zh: 对于医生来说，住院医师培训可能会计入专业经验要求，并且必须在 2027 年 7 月之前完成。

paras.en: Astronaut candidates must pass NASA’s long-duration astronaut flight physical and demonstrate strong leadership, teamwork, and communication skills.
paras.zh: 宇航员候选人必须通过美国宇航局的长期宇航员飞行体检，并表现出强大的领导力、团队合作和沟通能力。

paras.en: Since its inception, NASA’s astronaut corps has represented the very best of American ingenuity, skill, and determination, carrying out missions that achieve the near impossible, expanding humanity’s understanding of Earth, the Moon, and beyond.
paras.zh: 自成立以来，美国宇航局的宇航员队伍代表了美国最优秀的聪明才智、技能和决心，执行着几乎不可能完成的任务，扩大了人类对地球、月球及其他地方的了解。

paras.en: As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send astronauts on increasingly difficult missions near the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery through its Artemis missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为创新和探索黄金时代的一部分，美国宇航局将派遣宇航员前往月球南极附近执行日益艰巨的任务，以探索比以往更多的月球区域。除了通过阿尔忒弥斯任务提供经济效益和推进科学发现外，美国宇航局还将在月球表面建立持久的人类存在，并为该机构首次载人火星任务奠定基础。

paras.en: Learn more about the application process and a career as a NASA astronaut at:
paras.zh: 了解有关 NASA 宇航员申请流程和职业生涯的更多信息：

paras.en: george.a.alderman@nasa.gov / cheryl.m.warner@nasa.gov
paras.zh: george.a.alderman@nasa.gov / cheryl.m.warner@nasa.gov

articles.title: NASA Awards Moon Base Transportation, Technology, Science Projects
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: NASA announced a suite of awards and mission updates on Saturday to expand the agency’s Moon Base exploration, science, and infrastructure capabilities. The investments will advance commercial robotic deliveries, a nuclear-powered rover named PROMISE, launch and orbital transfer services, and surface infrastructure as the agency works with American industry to establish a sustained presence on the Moon’s South Pole.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局周六宣布了一系列奖项和任务更新，以扩大该机构的月球基地探索、科学和基础设施能力。这些投资将推进商业机器人交付、名为 PROMISE 的核动力漫游车、发射和轨道转移服务以及地面基础设施，因为该机构与美国工业界合作，在月球南极建立了持续存在。

paras.en: The agency shared the news at the MAX POWER aerospace expo and air show at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 该机构在佛罗里达州 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心举行的 MAX POWER 航空航天博览会和航空展上分享了这一消息。

paras.en: “We are building the Moon Base mission by mission,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “Today’s announcements expand nearly every part of that campaign, using the playbook that carried NASA through its greatest eras: fly often, learn, apply those lessons, and get more better and more capable with every mission. When our astronauts return to the Moon, they will arrive with the first elements of the Moon Base already waiting for them on the surface.”
paras.zh: “我们正在一个接一个地建造月球基地，”美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼说。 “今天的公告几乎扩展了该活动的每个部分，沿用了美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 最伟大时代的剧本：经常飞行、学习、应用这些经验教训，并在每次任务中变得更好、更有能力。当我们的宇航员返回月球时，他们将带着已经在月球表面等待他们的第一批月球基地部件抵达。”

paras.en: “In the eight months since Ignition, we’ve made incredible strides in accomplishing the near impossible: establishing a permanent outpost on the lunar surface,” said Carlos García-Galán, manager, Moon Base Program. “We’ve consolidated numerous efforts into a streamlined program, evolving our human exploration architecture into an iterative and sustained campaign for Moon Base technology development and implementation. Most importantly, we’ve taken action, awarding new contracts and forging new partnerships to accelerate development.”
paras.zh: 月球基地计划经理卡洛斯·加西亚-加兰 (Carlos García-Galán) 表示：“自‘点火’以来的八个月里，我们在完成几乎不可能的任务方面取得了令人难以置信的进步：在月球表面建立永久前哨基地。” “我们将大量的努力整合到一个精简的计划中，将我们的人类探索架构发展成为月球基地技术开发和实施的迭代和持续的活动。最重要的是，我们已经采取行动，授予新合同并建立新的合作伙伴关系以加速发展。”

paras.en: To strengthen the cargo lander network needed to support the Moon Base, NASA selected eight companies for the next phase of its CLPS (Commercial Lunar Payload Services) initiative. The companies are eligible to compete for future lunar surface delivery missions under the new CLPS 2 contract:
paras.zh: 为了加强支持月球基地所需的货运着陆器网络，NASA 选择了八家公司参与下一阶段的 CLPS（商业月球有效载荷服务）计划。根据新的 CLPS 2 合同，这些公司有资格竞争未来的月球表面交付任务：

paras.en: Under the CLPS 2 framework, the companies will provide lunar delivery services, including managing, building, and operating landers that transport NASA science, technology, and infrastructure payloads to the Moon.
paras.zh: 根据 CLPS 2 框架，两家公司将提供月球交付服务，包括管理、建造和运营将 NASA 科学、技术和基础设施有效载荷运送到月球的着陆器。

paras.en: The CLPS 2 framework is a 10-year, multiple-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity master contract with a combined maximum value of $10 billion. NASA increased the value of the current CLPS 1.0 contract from $2.6 billion to $4.2 billion to support initial Phase One Moon Base objectives. The original CLPS contract will remain in place through November 2028, with an additional five-year period to complete awarded lunar deliveries through November 2033.
paras.zh: CLPS 2框架是一份为期10年、多次授予、无限期交付/无限数量的主合同，总价值最高可达100亿美元。 NASA 将当前 CLPS 1.0 合同的价值从 26 亿美元增加到 42 亿美元，以支持最初的第一阶段月球基地目标。最初的 CLPS 合同将持续到 2028 年 11 月，并有额外的五年期限到 2033 年 11 月完成授予的月球交付。

paras.en: NASA also announced it is moving forward with development of PROMISE (Polar Rover for Observation, Mapping, and In-Situ Exploration). Carrying science instruments and technology demonstrations, the six-wheeled rover will land at the Moon’s South Pole to characterize the surface and subsurface, assess resource potential, and provide data to enable landing site selection, as well as future infrastructure and exploration activities. The nuclear-powered rover can operate during long lunar nights and within permanently shadowed regions thought to harbor ice, which is crucial for a sustained human presence on the Moon.
paras.zh: NASA 还宣布正在推进 PROMISE（用于观测、测绘和原位探索的极地漫游车）的开发。携带科学仪器和技术演示的六轮漫游车将降落在月球南极，以表征月球表面和地下特征，评估资源潜力，并提供数据以实现着陆地点选择以及未来的基础设施和勘探活动。核动力漫游车可以在漫长的月球夜晚和被认为有冰的永久阴影区域内运行，这对于人类在月球上的持续存在至关重要。

paras.en: The agency’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California, a division of Caltech, will manage the mission and build the rover from a combination of spare flight components and engineering test models for NASA’s Curiosity and Perseverance Mars rovers. Using proven hardware, software, and Mars rover operation approaches significantly reduces cost and enables integration and testing of the complex PROMISE rover on a shorter timeline. NASA has assessed the compatibility of the hardware with the lunar environment and determined it can tolerate the harsh conditions found near the Moon’s South Pole.
paras.zh: 该机构位于南加州的喷气推进实验室（加州理工学院的一个部门）将管理这项任务，并利用美国宇航局好奇号和毅力号火星漫游车的备用飞行部件和工程测试模型来建造漫游车。使用经过验证的硬件、软件和火星探测器操作方法可显着降低成本，并能够在更短的时间内集成和测试复杂的 PROMISE 探测器。美国宇航局已经评估了硬件与月球环境的兼容性，并确定它可以承受月球南极附近的恶劣条件。

paras.en: The PROMISE rover will carry a drill to extract regolith, or lunar dust, to characterize ice and other resources from approximately 3 feet (1 meter) below the surface, spectrometers for analyzing the chemical composition of surface material, temperature and radiation sensors, and visible-light cameras. It will demonstrate a next-generation, radiation-tolerant computing system, NASA’s High Performance Spaceflight Computing, and advanced autonomy sensors and algorithms. NASA is targeting late 2028 to launch PROMISE and planning an 18-month mission for the rover.
paras.zh: PROMISE漫游车将携带钻头提取风化层或月球尘埃，以表征地表以下约3英尺（1米）处的冰和其他资源，还携带用于分析表面材料化学成分的光谱仪、温度和辐射传感器以及可见光相机。它将展示下一代耐辐射计算系统、美国宇航局的高性能航天计算以及先进的自主传感器和算法。 NASA 的目标是在 2028 年底发射 PROMISE，并为漫游者计划为期 18 个月的任务。

paras.en: NASA awarded Blue Origin a $94 million base contract, with an option period worth an additional $140 million based on performance to deliver PROMISE to the lunar South Pole. The award expands the task order awarded in May 2026 to deliver two lunar terrain vehicles to the Moon. Blue Origin will use its Mark 1 lander to deliver and deploy the rover as part of the Moon Base’s first phase.
paras.zh: NASA 授予 Blue Origin 一份价值 9400 万美元的基础合同，并根据向月球南极运送 PROMISE 的表现，附加价值 1.4 亿美元的额外选择期。该合同扩展了 2026 年 5 月授予的向月球运送两辆月球地形车的任务订单。作为月球基地第一阶段的一部分，蓝色起源将使用其 Mark 1 着陆器来交付和部署月球车。

paras.en: Delivering Moon Base infrastructure will require a robust transportation network between Earth and the Moon. Orbital Transfer Vehicles (OTVs) act like long-distance freight trucks, carrying large loads across space. Lunar landers handle the final delivery, bringing supplies, equipment, and infrastructure safely down to the Moon’s surface.
paras.zh: 提供月球基地基础设施将需要地球和月球之间强大的运输网络。轨道转运车 (OTV) 的作用就像长途货运卡车，在太空中运送大量货物。月球着陆器负责最后的交付，将物资、设备和基础设施安全地运送到月球表面。

paras.en: To demonstrate those capabilities, NASA awarded six task orders as part of the agency’s Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) launch services contract. The awards were given to Arrow Science and Technology, Blue Origin, and Impulse Space to integrate and transport Moon Base cargo.
paras.zh: 为了展示这些能力，NASA 授予了六项任务订单，作为该机构风险级专用和共享乘车 (VADR) 发射服务合同的一部分。该奖项授予了艾睿科技（Arrow Science and Technology）、蓝色起源（Blue Origin）和脉冲空间（Impulse Space），以整合和运输月球基地货物。

paras.en: Three mission types will allow NASA flexibility to fly science and technology demonstrations when they are ready.
paras.zh: 三种任务类型将使美国宇航局能够在准备就绪时灵活地进行科学和技术演示。

paras.en: The first will include missions to reduce risks of future long-term human spaceflight for lunar exploration. The missions will verify that communication and navigation methods work properly during the journey from Earth orbit to the Moon, and OTV capability to support delivery of a CLPS lunar lander to a desired orbit. This mission type will deliver the CAPSTONE 02 spacecraft to deep space to test proximity maneuvers, navigation, and communications around the Moon.
paras.zh: 第一个任务将包括降低未来长期载人航天月球探索风险的任务。这些任务将验证从地球轨道到月球的旅程中通信和导航方法是否正常工作，以及支持将 CLPS 月球着陆器运送到所需轨道的 OTV 能力。该任务类型将把 CAPSTONE 02 航天器运送到深空，以测试月球周围的邻近机动、导航和通信。

paras.en: The second category of missions will prepare the lunar South Pole for human exploration by sending a group of highly mobile drones to survey the surface before astronauts arrive, enabling safer, more informed human missions while demonstrating advanced robotic capabilities. Such missions will include the agency’s MoonFall drones, designed to scout areas beyond the reach of traditional rovers, as well as delivery of additional Moon Base assets necessary to support Phase One objectives.
paras.zh: 第二类任务将在宇航员到达之前派遣一组高度机动的无人机对月球表面进行勘察，为人类探索月球南极做好准备，从而实现更安全、更明智的人类任务，同时展示先进的机器人能力。此类任务将包括该机构的 MoonFall 无人机，旨在侦察传统漫游车无法到达的区域，以及交付支持第一阶段目标所需的额外月球基地资产。

paras.en: To reduce risk for future missions, the third mission type will test navigation technologies and demonstrate operations in multiple cislunar orbits, between Earth and the Moon. This mission type will demonstrate commercial orbital transfer capabilities intended to increase the amount of cargo that future landers can deliver to the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 为了降低未来任务的风险，第三种任务类型将测试导航技术并演示在地球和月球之间的多个地月轨道上的操作。这种任务类型将展示商业轨道转移能力，旨在增加未来着陆器可以运送到月球表面的货物量。

paras.en: The task orders have a value of approximately $1.3 billion combined and fall under the 10-year VADR indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract, which has a maximum total value of $5 billion across all contracts. The VADR contracts are managed by NASA’s Launch Services Program Office at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center as part of the agency’s Commercial Access to Space Program. By procuring multiple launch and in-space transportation services together, NASA provides industry with a more predictable set of mission opportunities while gaining access to a broader range of commercial capabilities for future lunar exploration.
paras.zh: 这些任务订单总价值约为 13 亿美元，属于 10 年期 VADR 无限期交付/无限数量合同，所有合同的总价值最高为 50 亿美元。 VADR 合同由 NASA 位于肯尼迪航天中心的发射服务计划办公室管理，作为该机构商业太空计划的一部分。通过共同采购多次发射和太空运输服务，美国宇航局为工业界提供了一系列更可预测的任务机会，同时为未来的月球探索获得了更广泛的商业能力。

paras.en: Some missions will launch aboard Blue Origin’s New Glenn, Relativity Space’s Terran R, and SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rockets. In-space transportation spacecraft for these missions will be provided by Blue Origin, Firefly Aerospace, Impulse Space, and Quantum Space.
paras.zh: 一些任务将在 Blue Origin 的 New Glenn、Relativity Space 的 Terran R 和 SpaceX 的 Falcon 9 火箭上发射。用于这些任务的太空运输航天器将由蓝色起源、萤火虫宇航、脉冲空间和量子空间提供。

paras.en: Complementing those in-space transportation demonstrations, NASA selected SpaceX for the Cislunar Communications Deployment Demonstration under an existing lunar logistics contract. Through a Specialized Delivery Mission task order, SpaceX will launch communications satellites aboard a Starship to cislunar space in 2028. The demonstration will help inform the development of future lunar communications networks that keep astronauts, mission controllers, and the Moon Base connected.
paras.zh: 为了补充这些太空运输演示，NASA 根据现有的月球物流合同选择 SpaceX 进行地月通信部署演示。通过专门交付任务订单，SpaceX 将在 2028 年通过星际飞船向地月空间发射通信卫星。此次演示将有助于为未来月球通信网络的发展提供信息，使宇航员、任务控制人员和月球基地保持连接。

paras.en: To extend infrastructure capabilities on the lunar surface, NASA plans to purchase commercial components for a Mini-Communications and Solar Tower (miniCAST), including solar arrays, batteries, and wireless power-transfer hardware. The agency awarded Honeybee Robotics, a Blue Origin company, for energy storage capability, Redwire for power generation, and Yank Technologies, Inc., for wireless power transfer in support of miniCAST.
paras.zh: 为了扩展月球表面的基础设施能力，NASA 计划购买迷你通信和太阳能塔 (miniCAST) 的商业组件，包括太阳能电池阵列、电池和无线功率传输硬件。该机构授予 Blue Origin 公司 Honeybee Robotics 的能源存储能力、Redwire 的发电能力以及 Yank Technologies, Inc. 的无线功率传输支持 miniCAST 的能力。

paras.en: The miniCAST will combine power and communications capabilities to support future Moon Base activities. Engineers at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, will assemble and test the systems before they are delivered to the lunar surface.
paras.zh: miniCAST 将结合电力和通信能力来支持未来的月球基地活动。美国宇航局位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的马歇尔太空飞行中心的工程师将在系统被运送到月球表面之前组装和测试这些系统。

paras.en: NASA expects work to begin within months, and the initial effort will involve components rather than a major integrated system. The agency also plans a separate solicitation for fully integrated power systems, which is anticipated in early 2027.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局预计工作将在几个月内开始，最初的工作将涉及组件而不是主要的集成系统。该机构还计划对完全集成的电力系统进行单独招标，预计将于 2027 年初进行。

paras.en: NASA intends to release a directed call under its Next Space Technologies for Exploration Partnerships, or NextSTEP-3 B, solicitation to help close architecture-driven, high-priority data gaps for Moon Base development. The effort will help NASA gather information it needs to plan future missions, reduce risk, and support technologies and infrastructure for sustained operations on the Moon’s South Pole. The work could include small spacecraft missions, payloads on future Moon Base flights, or the purchase of data collected by commercial partners.
paras.zh: NASA 打算在其 Next Space Technologies for Exploration Partnerships（NextSTEP-3 B）招标中发布定向号召，以帮助缩小月球基地开发中架构驱动的高优先级数据差距。这项工作将帮助美国宇航局收集规划未来任务所需的信息，降低风险，并支持在月球南极持续运行的技术和基础设施。这项工作可能包括小型航天器任务、未来月球基地飞行的有效载荷或购买商业合作伙伴收集的数据。

paras.en: As part of a Golden Age of innovation and exploration, NASA will send Artemis astronauts on increasingly difficult missions to the lunar South Pole to explore more of the Moon than ever before. In addition to providing economic benefits and advancing scientific discovery through its Moon missions, NASA will establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface and build on this foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 作为创新和探索黄金时代的一部分，美国宇航局将派遣阿耳忒弥斯宇航员前往月球南极执行日益艰巨的任务，以探索比以往更多的月球区域。除了通过月球任务提供经济效益和推进科学发现外，美国宇航局还将在月球表面建立持久的人类存在，并在此基础上首次载人火星任务。

paras.en: To learn more about the Moon Base, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关月球基地的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: george.a.alderman@nasa.gov / james.h.gannon@nasa.gov
paras.zh: george.a.alderman@nasa.gov / james.h.gannon@nasa.gov

articles.title: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns

paras.en: Abyei: Deadly drone strikes mark ‘new and concerning’ threat, UN peacekeeping chief warns
paras.zh: 阿卜耶伊：联合国维和部队负责人警告说，致命的无人机袭击标志着“新的、令人担忧的”威胁

paras.en: Drone strikes that killed at least 30 people in Abyei last month have added “a new and concerning dimension” to security in the disputed area, the UN’s peacekeeping chief told the Security Council on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国维和事务负责人周四向安理会表示，上个月在阿卜耶伊发动的无人机袭击造成至少 30 人死亡，这给该争议地区的安全带来了“新的、令人担忧的层面”。

paras.en: Jean-Pierre Lacroix said the 19 October attacks were the first of their kind in Abyei. They set off major fires, injured about 59 people and forced dozens of civilians from their homes. Peacekeepers are still checking whether the death toll is an underestimate.
paras.zh: 让-皮埃尔·拉克鲁瓦 (Jean-Pierre Lacroix) 表示，10 月 19 日发生的袭击是阿卜耶伊首次发生此类袭击。他们引发大火，造成约 59 人受伤，并迫使数十名平民离开家园。维和人员仍在检查死亡人数是否被低估。

paras.en: The strikes followed violence on 15 September in and around Amiet Common Market, where clashes involving members of the Ngok Dinka, Misseriya and Nuba communities left 124 people dead and 40 injured.
paras.zh: 此次罢工是在 9 月 15 日阿米特共同市场及其周边发生暴力事件之后发生的，恩哥克-丁卡族、米塞里亚族和努巴族社区成员之间发生冲突，造成 124 人死亡、40 人受伤。

paras.en: Taken together, Mr. Lacroix said, the incidents show that threats to stability in Abyei “are evolving, extending beyond traditional intercommunal dynamics and are increasingly influenced by wider political and economic regional conflicts”.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生说，总的来说，这些事件表明，阿卜耶伊的稳定面临的威胁“正在演变，超出了传统的族群间动态，并越来越受到更广泛的政治和经济区域冲突的影响”。

paras.en: Amiet is now much more than a trading post. It is Abyei’s main economic hub and a transit point for more than 49,000 refugees and returnees who have fled the war in Sudan. Mr. Lacroix warned that this concentration of trade and people was opening the door to criminal networks and armed groups.
paras.zh: 阿米特现在不仅仅是一个贸易站。它是阿卜耶伊的主要经济中心，也是 49,000 多名逃离苏丹战争的难民和回返者的中转站。拉克鲁瓦警告说，贸易和人员的集中正在为犯罪网络和武装团体打开大门。

paras.en: He also pointed to real gains. Recorded security incidents fell by about 32 per cent compared with the same period last year, and this year’s seasonal cattle migration passed without a single related death.
paras.zh: 他还指出了实际收益。与去年同期相比，记录的安全事件减少了约32%，今年的季节性牛群迁徙没有发生一起相关死亡事件。

paras.en: Sudan and South Sudan resumed formal talks in August through their Joint Political and Security Mechanism, for the first time since January 2023. A second meeting is due in Khartoum from 8 to 10 November.
paras.zh: 苏丹和南苏丹于 8 月通过联合政治与安全机制恢复了正式会谈，这是自 2023 年 1 月以来的首次。第二次会议将于 11 月 8 日至 10 日在喀土穆举行。

paras.en: But the reported appointment by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) of its own representative to the Abyei Joint Oversight Committee risks setting up competing claims of authority and drawing the area further into Sudan’s conflict, he said.
paras.zh: 但他表示，据报道，准军事快速支援部队（RSF）在阿卜耶伊联合监督委员会任命了自己的代表，这可能会引发相互竞争的权力主张，并使该地区进一步陷入苏丹冲突。

paras.en: As the council weighs the future mandate of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA), Mr. Lacroix said the conditions for any major change to the mission’s set-up “do not yet exist”. He called for stronger protection for peacekeepers against aerial threats.
paras.zh: 在安理会权衡联合国阿卜耶伊临时安全部队（联阿安全部队）的未来任务时，拉克鲁瓦先生表示，对该特派团的设置进行任何重大改变的条件“尚不存在”。他呼吁加强保护维和人员免受空中威胁。

paras.en: “UNISFA needs the Council’s support now more than ever,” he said.
paras.zh: “联阿安全部队现在比以往任何时候都更需要安理会的支持，”他说。

paras.en: The Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for the Horn of Africa, Guang Cong, called the October drone strikes one of the deadliest incidents in Abyei’s history. He urged a prompt and independent investigation and called on both governments to uphold the area’s demilitarized status.
paras.zh: 秘书长非洲之角特使丛光称十月份的无人机袭击是阿卜耶伊历史上最致命的事件之一。他敦促立即进行独立调查，并呼吁两国政府维持该地区的非军事地位。

paras.en: In Sudan, Humanitarian Coordinator Denise Brown warned again that drone strikes are hitting power stations and fuel facilities. Where fuel is scarce, she said, lifesaving aid work is being badly affected.
paras.zh: 在苏丹，人道主义协调员丹尼斯·布朗再次警告说，无人机袭击正在袭击发电站和燃料设施。她说，在燃料短缺的地方，救生援助工作就会受到严重影响。

paras.en: According to local sources, drones struck an electricity transmission station and the Ar Rusayris Dam in Ed Damazine on Tuesday, causing widespread blackouts.
paras.zh: 据当地消息人士称，周二，无人机袭击了埃德达马辛的一个输电站和 Ar Rusayris 大坝，导致大范围停电。

paras.en: Another strike on a residential area killed two civilians. The same day, airstrikes in Um Bader killed two women, injured 10 people and badly damaged two water stations.
paras.zh: 另一次对住宅区的袭击造成两名平民死亡。同一天，乌姆巴德的空袭造成两名妇女死亡、十人受伤，两个水站严重受损。

paras.en: Aid is still getting through. The UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) has delivered malaria treatment to 765 health facilities across Darfur and West Kordofan, enough for 800,000 people. But with the year nearly over, the $2.9 billion humanitarian appeal for Sudan is less than half funded.
paras.zh: 援助仍在进行中。联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 已向达尔富尔和西科尔多凡州的 765 个医疗机构提供疟疾治疗，足以满足 80 万人的需要。但随着这一年即将结束，为苏丹筹集的 29 亿美元人道主义援助资金还不到一半。

paras.en: On the Sudan–South Sudan border, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) warned that about 100,000 people could lose healthcare if the only clinic at the Wunthou crossing closes. It could shut by December without urgent funding.
paras.zh: 在苏丹和南苏丹边境，国际移民组织 (IOM) 警告称，如果文图过境点唯一的诊所关闭，大约 10 万人可能会失去医疗服务。如果没有紧急资金，它可能会在 12 月关闭。

paras.en: The clinic has carried out more than 400,000 consultations, given over 260,000 vaccinations and helped deliver more than 1,000 babies. It still sees more than 1,000 outpatients every week.
paras.zh: 该诊所已开展了超过40万次咨询，接种了超过26万次疫苗，帮助接生了超过1000名婴儿。每周门诊量仍超过1000人次。

articles.title: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31

paras.en: World News in Brief: Korea tensions mount, UN demands answers over staff death in Yemen, Guterres in Spain, Nepal alert ahead of COP31
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：韩国紧张局势升级、联合国要求就也门工作人员死亡、西班牙古特雷斯、尼泊尔在 COP31 之前发出警报作出答复

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres remains concerned over the situation on the Korean Peninsula, including the potential escalation of tensions across the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), his Spokesperson said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯的发言人周四表示，他仍然对朝鲜半岛局势感到担忧，包括非军事区（DMZ）紧张局势可能升级。

paras.en: The Secretary-General encouraged the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) and neighbouring Republic of Korea – more commonly known as North and South Korea – to resume communication channels, including on the military-to-military level, to avoid unintended accidents or miscalculations, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric told journalists in New York.
paras.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克在纽约对记者表示，秘书长鼓励朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（朝鲜）和邻国大韩民国（通常称为朝鲜和韩国）恢复沟通渠道，包括军事层面的沟通渠道，以避免意外事故或误判。

paras.en: “Diplomatic engagement and renewed dialogue remain the only pathway to reduce tensions and to achieve sustainable peace on the Korean Peninsula,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“外交接触和重新对话仍然是缓解朝鲜半岛紧张局势和实现可持续和平的唯一途径。”

paras.en: Yemen: UN calls for investigation into staffer’s death
paras.zh: 也门：联合国呼吁对工作人员死亡事件进行调查

paras.en: The circumstances surrounding the death of UN staff member Mohammad el Shami, who was arbitrarily detained by the Houthi de facto authorities in Yemen, “raise serious concerns about possible ill-treatment”, the UN said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国周四表示，被也门胡塞事实上的当局任意拘留的联合国工作人员穆罕默德·沙米的死亡情况“引起了人们对可能遭受虐待的严重担忧”。

paras.en: These include the Houthis’ prolonged failure to disclose reliable information about his fate and well-being, Mr. Dujarric said.
paras.zh: 杜贾里克说，其中包括胡塞武装长期未能透露有关他的命运和福祉的可靠信息。

paras.en: He called for a prompt, independent, impartial and transparent investigation into the exact time, cause and circumstances of Mr. el Shami’s death.
paras.zh: 他呼吁对沙米先生死亡的确切时间、原因和情况进行迅速、独立、公正和透明的调查。

paras.en: It should cover the conditions of his detention, whether he received adequate and timely medical care, and why his family and the UN were not promptly informed, Mr. Dujarric continued.
paras.zh: 杜哈里克先生继续说，其中应涵盖他的拘留条件、他是否得到充分和及时的医疗护理，以及为什么他的家人和联合国没有得到及时通知。

paras.en: Those responsible must be identified and held to account, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，必须查明责任人并追究其责任。

paras.en: Mr. el Shami is the second UN colleague to die while arbitrarily detained by Houthi forces, raising grave concerns for all other UN and humanitarian personnel held in similar conditions – particularly those with serious medical conditions.
paras.zh: 沙米先生是第二位在胡塞武装任意拘留期间死亡的联合国同事，这引起了所有其他处于类似条件下的联合国和人道主义人员的严重关切，特别是那些患有严重疾病的人员。

paras.en: The UN called on Houthi leadership to provide verifiable information on all detainees’ whereabouts and health, and to release all arbitrarily detained UN personnel immediately and unconditionally.
paras.zh: 联合国呼吁胡塞领导人提供有关所有被拘留者下落和健康状况的可核实信息，并立即无条件释放所有被任意拘留的联合国人员。

paras.en: Meanwhile, nearly 135,000 people are now displaced within Taiz, more than 40 per cent of all those recently uprooted across Yemen.
paras.zh: 与此同时，塔伊兹境内目前有近 135,000 人流离失所，占也门最近背井离乡人数的 40% 以上。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) delivered four trucks of essential medical supplies, including surgical kits, to hospitals in the encircled city.
paras.zh: 周三，红十字国际委员会向被包围城市的医院运送了四卡车的基本医疗用品，其中包括手术包。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) and its partners launched an emergency meals initiative using locally sourced ingredients, initially aiming to reach 2,000 vulnerable families across three districts.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 及其合作伙伴发起了一项使用当地食材的紧急膳食计划，最初旨在为三个地区的 2,000 个弱势家庭提供帮助。

paras.en: Shelter partners have so far provided emergency shelter to about 5,600 displaced families, just over one in ten of the more than 51,000 families displaced since August.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，庇护所合作伙伴已为约 5,600 个流离失所家庭提供了紧急庇护所，仅占 8 月份以来超过 51,000 个流离失所家庭的十分之一。

paras.en: Guterres warns of AI shaped by ‘a handful of companies’
paras.zh: 古特雷斯警告人工智能由“少数公司”塑造

paras.en: Addressing the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Thursday, Mr. Guterres called for artificial intelligence “that speaks with all our voices – without a handful of companies deciding what we see, read and believe.”
paras.zh: 古特雷斯周四在马德里举行的第 30 届伊比利亚美洲峰会上发表讲话，呼吁人工智能“代表我们所有人的声音——而不是由少数公司决定我们所看到的、读到的和相信的内容。”

paras.en: “The more capable machines become, the more we will need what makes us human,” he said, urging more arts and humanities in education to cultivate critical thinking.
paras.zh: 他说：“机器的能力越强，我们就越需要人类的本质。”他敦促教育中更多的艺术和人文学科来培养批判性思维。

paras.en: The summit brings together the Spanish and Portuguese-speaking countries of Latin America and Europe, and was first held in Guadalajara, Mexico, 35 years ago.
paras.zh: 该峰会汇集了拉丁美洲和欧洲的西班牙语和葡萄牙语国家，35年前首次在墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉举行。

paras.en: “Ibero-America is not a military or economic superpower, but it is a cultural superpower,” the Secretary-General said.
paras.zh: “伊比利亚美洲不是一个军事或经济超级大国，但它是一个文化超级大国，”秘书长说。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres hosted the summit in Porto 28 years ago, and used this year’s address to bid farewell, thanking leaders for their friendship and support during his 10-year term.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生28年前在波尔图主办峰会，并在今年的致辞中告别，感谢各国领导人在他10年任期内的友谊和支持。

paras.en: Nepal floods: UN urges global support ahead of COP31
paras.zh: 尼泊尔洪水：联合国在 COP31 之前敦促全球支持

paras.en: Nepal needs international solidarity to recover from catastrophic floods that struck 10 weeks ago, the top UN official in the country said on Thursday, ahead of the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye.
paras.zh: 周四，在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候会议之前，尼泊尔驻尼泊尔高级官员表示，尼泊尔需要国际团结来从 10 周前发生的灾难性洪水中恢复过来。

paras.en: On 26 August, a glacier collapsed on the border with China’s Tibet Autonomous Region. UN Resident Coordinator Lila Pieters Yahia described the “awful wall of water, mud and heavy rock” which tore through 150 kilometres of Himalayan valleys.
paras.zh: 8月26日，中国西藏自治区边境的一座冰川崩塌。联合国驻地协调员莉拉·皮特斯·叶海亚 (Lila Pieters Yahia) 描述了“可怕的水、泥和重石墙”，它撕裂了 150 公里的喜马拉雅山谷。

paras.en: More than 1,450 people were killed, nearly 5,000 remain missing and over 84,000 were affected. Homes, schools, power grids and 115 bridges were damaged.
paras.zh: 超过 1,450 人死亡，近 5,000 人失踪，超过 84,000 人受到影响。房屋、学校、电网和 115 座桥梁遭到破坏。

paras.en: The World Bank puts the damage at $2.7 billion, and recovery will cost an estimated $4.7 billion. The authorities say the $21.5 million Nepal expects from the loss and damage fund falls far short.
paras.zh: 世界银行估计损失为 27 亿美元，恢复成本估计为 47 亿美元。当局表示，尼泊尔期望从损失和损害基金中获得的 2150 万美元远远低于预期。

paras.en: Ms. Pieters Yahia said many women who lost their husbands now support whole households, often while facing heavy debt.
paras.zh: 皮特斯·叶海亚女士表示，许多失去丈夫的女性现在要养活整个家庭，但往往还面临沉重的债务。

paras.en: Nepal and Bhutan want the needs of mountainous countries put on the COP31 agenda.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔和不丹希望将山区国家的需求列入 COP31 议程。

articles.title: ‘For the first time I have my own chair’: Gaza siblings find new freedom

paras.en: ‘For the first time I have my own chair’: Gaza siblings find new freedom
paras.zh: “我第一次拥有自己的椅子”：加沙兄弟姐妹找到新的自由

paras.en: In Gaza, 10-year-old Anas is one of three siblings born without legs and with only two fingers on each of their hands. They struggle to move around and perform daily activities like eating and writing independently.
paras.zh: 在加沙，10 岁的阿纳斯是三个出生时没有腿的兄弟姐妹之一，每只手上只有两个手指。他们很难四处走动并进行日常活动，例如独立吃饭和写作。

paras.en: With funding from the UN’s aid coordination office (OCHA), and despite the ongoing violence across the Gaza Strip, the international non-governmental organisation EducAid helped the three siblings get customised devices to help them meet their daily needs.
paras.zh: 在联合国援助协调办公室 (OCHA) 的资助下，尽管加沙地带暴力事件仍在持续，国际非政府组织 EducAid 仍帮助三兄弟获得定制设备，以满足他们的日常需求。

paras.en: Before receiving support, Anas relied heavily on crawling using his hands, and his mother often had to carry him.
paras.zh: 在获得帮助之前，阿纳斯严重依赖双手爬行，他的母亲经常不得不背着他。

paras.en: Writing and eating were also particularly challenging due to poor balance and limited hand grip.
paras.zh: 由于平衡能力差和握力有限，写作和吃饭也特别具有挑战性。

paras.en: EducAid upgraded his wheelchair, adding a detachable wheelchair table and an adaptive waterproof protector shield for his lower body.
paras.zh: EducAid 升级了他的轮椅，为他的下半身添加了可拆卸的轮椅桌和自适应防水保护罩。

paras.en: He also received a customised pen grip and an adjustable slant table which enabled him to study more easily, along with hand-walking aids which allow him to move around more independently.
paras.zh: 他还收到了定制的笔握和可调节的倾斜桌子，使他能够更轻松地学习，以及助行器，使他能够更独立地走动。

paras.en: “I am very happy and I love you so much,” he told the support team.
paras.zh: “我很高兴，我非常爱你们，”他告诉支持团队。

paras.en: His mother was also very grateful for these upgrades.
paras.zh: 他的母亲也非常感谢这些升级。

paras.en: “Today, these assistive tools have helped him become more independent, especially with writing and eating,” she said.
paras.zh: “如今，这些辅助工具帮助他变得更加独立，尤其是在写作和吃饭方面，”她说。

paras.en: Sujood: ‘I feel that someone cares about me’
paras.zh: Sujood：“我感觉有人关心我”

paras.en: Sujood, Anas’ older sister, is a 17-year-old girl with similar disabilities. She was also born without legs and with only two fingers on each hand, which greatly inhibited her mobility and independence.
paras.zh: 阿纳斯 (Anas) 的姐姐苏乔德 (Sujood) 是一名 17 岁女孩，也有类似的残疾。她还天生没有双腿，每只手只有两根手指，这极大地限制了她的行动能力和独立性。

paras.en: To address these issues, EducAid provided a comprehensive set of solutions, including a size-40 wheelchair, fitted with a detachable dining table, and an adjustable slant table for daily use.
paras.zh: 为了解决这些问题，EducAid 提供了一套全面的解决方案，包括配备可拆卸餐桌的 40 号轮椅，以及供日常使用的可调节倾斜桌。

paras.en: “For the first time I have my own chair. I slept in it so that none of my siblings would take it from me,” Sujood said. “I feel that someone cares about me.”
paras.zh: “这是我第一次拥有自己的椅子。我睡在上面，这样我的兄弟姐妹就不会从我手中夺走它，”苏乔德说。 “我感觉有人关心我。”

paras.en: In addition, as with her brother Anas, she received an adaptive lower body waterproof protector shield and hand support walking aid to help her move around and protect her hands when she does so.
paras.zh: 此外，与她的兄弟阿纳斯一样，她还收到了一个自适应下半身防水保护罩和手部支撑助行器，以帮助她四处走动并在她这样做时保护双手。

paras.en: Before these devices, writing was exhausting and required her to lie down. With the new chair and table, she can write comfortably.
paras.zh: 在这些设备出现之前，写作很累人，需要她躺下来。有了新椅子和桌子，她可以舒服地写字了。

paras.en: “This chair will help me achieve my dreams and study the field I love – which is media. Now I can move outside the tent without messing up my clothes,” she said.
paras.zh: “这把椅子将帮助我实现我的梦想并研究我喜欢的领域——媒体。现在我可以走出帐篷而不会弄乱我的衣服，”她说。

paras.en: Mohammad: ‘My clothes no longer get dirty’
paras.zh: 穆罕默德：“我的衣服不再脏了”

paras.en: 15-year-old Mohammad was also born without legs and with only two fingers on each hand.
paras.zh: 15 岁的穆罕默德生来就没有双腿，每只手上只有两个手指。

paras.en: EducAid studied his needs both in school and home environments and designed and produced a range of customised devices in their workshops and laboratories to address the particular challenges he faces.
paras.zh: EducAid 研究了他在学校和家庭环境中的需求，并在其车间和实验室设计和生产了一系列定制设备，以解决他面临的特殊挑战。

paras.en: One of the final products was a specially adapted wheelchair with a skateboard, which Mohammad loves for his mobility.
paras.zh: 最终产品之一是一款经过特殊改造的带有滑板的轮椅，穆罕默德非常喜欢它的移动性。

paras.en: “The hand grips protect Mohammad’s hands from wounds, slipping, and the hardship of crawling,” said his mother. “The table is very helpful, and he was very happy using the small skateboard chair. The commode chair made a huge difference.”
paras.zh: “手柄可以保护穆罕默德的手免受伤害、滑倒和爬行时的困难，”他的母亲说。 “这张桌子非常有用，他很高兴使用小滑板椅。马桶椅带来了巨大的变化。”

paras.en: Like his sister Sujood, he enjoys his greater freedom of movement.
paras.zh: 和他的妹妹 Sujood 一样，他享有更大的行动自由。

paras.en: “I am very happy with the table – my clothes no longer get dirty,” he said.
paras.zh: “我对这张桌子非常满意——我的衣服不再弄脏了，”他说。

paras.en: “The children are distinguished in learning, they are eager to study, and they truly deserve a chance,” said their teacher, who noted that the children had “started writing more effectively”.
paras.zh: “孩子们学习成绩优异，他们渴望学习，他们确实应该得到一个机会，”他们的老师说，并指出孩子们“开始更有效地写作”。

paras.en: You can help children like Anas, Sujood and Mohammad enjoy their childhood and achieve their full potential by contributing here.
paras.zh: 您可以在这里做出贡献，帮助像阿纳斯、苏乔德和穆罕默德这样的孩子享受他们的童年并充分发挥他们的潜力。

articles.title: 'We squashed it' - Hamilton reveals details of talks with Leclerc after fall out

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton reveals details of talks with Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc in Brazil after Mexico fall out
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿透露了墨西哥队失利后与法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西会谈的细节

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc held talks with Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur in Brazil following their contentious opening lap incident last time out in Mexico; watch Sunday's Sao Paulo Grand Prix live at 5pm on Sky Sports F1, build-up from 3.30pm
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西与法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔进行了会谈，此前他们在墨西哥的首圈发生了有争议的事件；下午 5 点在天空体育 F1 频道观看周日圣保罗大奖赛的直播，下午 3.30 开始准备

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton says he and Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc have "squashed" their incident at the Mexico City Grand Prix after holding talks in Brazil.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，他和法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔在巴西举行会谈后，已经“平息”了他们在墨西哥城大奖赛上发生的事件。

paras.en: Hamilton, Leclerc and team principal Frederic Vasseur held talks on Thursday night to discuss the incident which saw Max Verstappen take advantage of the opening lap Ferrari squabble last Sunday to win the race.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿、勒克莱尔和车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔于周四晚上举行了会谈，讨论了马克斯·维斯塔潘上周日利用首圈法拉利争吵赢得比赛的事件。

paras.en: Hamilton has subsequently been critical of Leclerc in interviews and said that discussions were required to more clearly define their rules of combat to avoid costly repeats in future.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿随后在采访中批评勒克莱尔，并表示需要进行讨论以更明确地定义他们的战斗规则，以避免将来代价高昂的重蹈覆辙。

paras.en: Hamilton will start at the back of the grid for Sunday's Sao Paulo Grand Prix due to a power unit change and spoke to the media for the first time on Saturday since his talks with Leclerc.
paras.zh: 由于动力装置的变化，汉密尔顿将在周日的圣保罗大奖赛中从最后发车，这是他与勒克莱尔会谈后首次接受媒体采访。

paras.en: "Me and Charles sat and spoke and we squashed it, and we're moving on," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “我和查尔斯坐下来交谈，我们压垮了它，我们继续前进，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "We still have a huge amount of respect for each other and I'm glad we had a chat and now we move on.
paras.zh: “我们仍然非常尊重彼此，我很高兴我们进行了交谈，现在我们继续前进。

paras.en: "We've been getting along just fine as normal. Sometimes in those scenarios it takes having a conversation and there's been no demands from either side, it's both just giving our points and areas we can do better and support each other. I'm hoping to have better races moving forwards."
paras.zh: “我们和往常一样相处得很好。有时在这种情况下需要进行对话，双方都没有提出要求，这只是给予我们的积分和我们可以做得更好的领域并互相支持。我希望有更好的比赛向前推进。”

paras.en: Leclerc, who starts 14th after a 10-grid place penalty for a new internal combustion engine, had a similar opinion to Hamilton.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔因使用新型内燃机而被罚退 10 个发车位，最终以第 14 名发车，他也有与汉密尔顿类似的观点。

paras.en: "Obviously, there's been a lot of things, probably too much things in the last week," he said.
paras.zh: “显然，上周发生了很多事情，可能太多了，”他说。

paras.en: "We've spoken. I think everything is settled, and I'm looking forward for the rest of the weekend now."
paras.zh: “我们已经谈过了。我想一切都已经解决了，我现在期待着周末剩下的时间。”

paras.en: Vasseur: The guidelines are still the same
paras.zh: Vasseur：指导方针仍然相同

paras.en: The Mexico incident comes two months after Leclerc admitted he was at fault for his opening lap battle with Hamilton in Monza, where the latter was forced wide into the gravel and lost several positions.
paras.zh: 墨西哥事件发生两个月前，勒克莱尔承认他在蒙扎首圈与汉密尔顿的战斗中存在过错，汉密尔顿被迫进入砾石路并丢掉了几个位置。

paras.en: Vasseur says he reminded Hamilton and Leclerc that the team comes first and the drivers must "keep that in mind".
paras.zh: 瓦塞尔说，他提醒汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔，团队是第一位的，车手必须“牢记这一点”。

paras.en: "The guidelines are still the same. They accumulated perhaps a bit of frustration because they are starting each weekend side by side, and you have a kind of accumulation of fact," he said.
paras.zh: “指导方针仍然是一样的。他们可能积累了一些挫败感，因为他们每个周末都同时开始，而且你有一种事实的积累，”他说。

paras.en: "But at the end of the day, the guideline is always the same - it's that they need to respect each other.
paras.zh: “但归根结底，指导方针总是一样的——那就是他们需要互相尊重。

paras.en: "They are two competitors with the fighting spirit for sure, but they need to have a respect for the other one.
paras.zh: “他们肯定是两个具有战斗精神的竞争对手，但他们需要尊重对方。

paras.en: "But mainly and firstly, they need to respect the brand, the team, the people working at home, the people working at the on track.
paras.zh: “但首先，他们需要尊重品牌、团队、在家工作的人、在赛道上工作的人。

paras.en: "I think we are putting a lot of effort on this, and the message was clear and will stay clear."
paras.zh: “我认为我们在这方面付出了很多努力，而且信息很明确并且将保持明确。”

articles.title: 'Very disappointed' Russell says Mercedes error cost him Sao Paulo GP pole

paras.en: George Russell: 'Very disappointed' Mercedes driver says team error cost him Sao Paulo GP pole in chaotic wet qualifying
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔：“非常失望”梅赛德斯车手称车队失误让他在混乱的湿地排位赛中失去了圣保罗大奖赛杆位

paras.en: George Russell was beaten to pole for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix by Lando Norris; Russell believes Mercedes' instruction for him to abort a flying lap cost him pole; watch Sunday's Sao Paulo Grand Prix live at 5pm on Sky Sports F1, build-up from 3.30pm
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔 (George Russell) 在圣保罗大奖赛中被兰多·诺里斯 (Lando Norris) 击败获得杆位；拉塞尔认为梅赛德斯指示他中止飞行圈让他失去了杆位；下午 5 点在天空体育 F1 频道观看周日圣保罗大奖赛的直播，下午 3.30 开始准备

paras.en: George Russell said he was "really disappointed" as he insisted a "misjudgement" by his Mercedes team had cost him pole position for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 乔治·拉塞尔表示，他“真的很失望”，因为他坚称梅赛德斯车队的“误判”导致他在圣保罗大奖赛上失去了杆位。

paras.en: Russell drove impressively throughout a hugely-challenging wet qualifying session at Interlagos but ultimately missed out on pole position by two tenths to McLaren's Lando Norris.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔在英特拉格斯赛道上极具挑战性的潮湿排位赛中表现出色，但最终以十分之二之差落后于迈凯伦车队的兰多·诺里斯，错失杆位。

paras.en: The Mercedes driver had led Norris by four tenths of a second after their first runs in Q3, but was then told to abort his second run when he was being held up by the Williams of Alex Albon.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车手在第三季度的第一次比赛后领先诺里斯十分之四秒，但当他被威廉姆斯车队的亚历克斯·阿尔本（Alex Albon）阻挡时，他被告知放弃第二次比赛。

paras.en: Mercedes thought that Russell would have time to complete another push lap, but the rain intensified moments later and prevented anyone from going faster for the seven minutes of the session that remained.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯认为拉塞尔还有时间完成另一次推圈，但不久之后雨势加大，在剩下的七分钟时间里，任何人都无法加快速度。

paras.en: Russell reacted with fury over team radio, questioning the instruction for him to abort and insisting that regardless of the time he was losing behind Albon, he would have been able to better Norris' time.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔在球队无线电中做出了愤怒的反应，质疑他中止比赛的指示，并坚称无论他落后阿尔本多少时间，他都能够比诺里斯做得更好。

paras.en: As Russell is serving a five-place grid penalty in Brazil for taking a new internal combustion engine, he would not have started from pole in any case, and will now begin Sunday's race in seventh.
paras.zh: 由于拉塞尔在巴西因使用新内燃机而被罚退五位，因此无论如何他都不会从杆位发车，现在将以第七名开始周日的比赛。

paras.en: "I think it was just a bit of miscommunication," Russell said. "I need to speak with the team because we believed we'd get another lap before the rain came in.
paras.zh: “我认为这只是一些沟通不畅，”拉塞尔说。 “我需要和车队谈谈，因为我们相信在下雨之前我们还能再跑一圈。

paras.en: "So, I was on a really strong lap and I was asked to back off because I caught up Albon, and then obviously the rain came.
paras.zh: “所以，我的圈速非常强劲，我被要求后退，因为我追上了阿尔本，然后显然下雨了。

paras.en: "So, yeah, it was very disappointing. I need to understand how it happened and why we got that wrong.
paras.zh: “所以，是的，这非常令人失望。我需要了解它是如何发生的以及为什么我们会犯错。

paras.en: "But I felt very strong, the whole session. Similar to Lando, I had more confidence in the wet than I had in the dry. But yeah, I definitely felt pole was there for the taking."
paras.zh: “但整个训练过程中我感觉非常强大。与兰多类似，我在湿地比在干地更有信心。但是，是的，我确实感觉到杆子就在那里。”

paras.en: Asked whether he considered overriding the instruction to abort his lap, Russell added: "They've got the weather forecast in front of them and I don't. And this is where you need that trust and you're relying on one another.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否考虑过推翻中止一圈的指示时，拉塞尔补充道：“他们面前有天气预报，而我没有。这就是你需要信任的地方，你们需要互相依赖。”

paras.en: "Obviously, it was the wrong decision, and it was a decision that I think, as soon as it was made, I think we knew it was the wrong one because already they could actually feel the rain pouring harder."
paras.zh: “显然，这是一个错误的决定，我认为，一旦做出这个决定，我想我们就知道这是错误的，因为他们实际上已经感觉到雨下得更大了。”

paras.en: Despite his clear frustration, Russell insisted his race engineer Marcus Dudley, along with other colleagues, weren't necessary responsible given the decision would have been led by the information they were seeing.
paras.zh: 尽管拉塞尔明显感到沮丧，但他坚称他的赛车工程师马库斯·达德利和其他同事没有必要承担责任，因为这个决定是由他们所看到的信息决定的。

paras.en: "We need to understand, we're relying on a lot of systems. We can't point the finger at somebody," Russell said.
paras.zh: “我们需要明白，我们依赖很多系统。我们不能指责某人，”拉塞尔说。

paras.en: "We need to understand why we made that decision and were our systems telling us what we needed to know because you're relying on the radar.
paras.zh: “我们需要了解为什么我们做出这个决定，以及我们的系统是否告诉我们需要知道什么，因为你依赖雷达。

paras.en: "But it doesn't make it any less frustrating for me. It's not my engineer's fault. He's relaying information.
paras.zh: “但这并没有让我感到沮丧。这不是我工程师的错。他正在传递信息。

paras.en: "He's ultimately the one who passes the message on. But he's got 12 people talking to him, giving him that information to relay on, so we just need to understand why we made that decision."
paras.zh: “他最终是传递信息的人。但有 12 个人与他交谈，向他提供可以转达的信息，所以我们只需要了解为什么我们会做出这个决定。”

paras.en: Wolff unsure Russell would have got pole with aborted lap
paras.zh: 沃尔夫不确定拉塞尔是否会因单圈中止而获得杆位

paras.en: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said he didn't think Russell would have been able to beat Norris to pole on the aborted lap due to the time his driver was losing behind Albon.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫表示，他认为拉塞尔无法在中止的一圈中击败诺里斯获得杆位，因为他的车手落后于阿尔本。

paras.en: "If we were to have a crystal ball to know whether you should back off or not, that would be helpful," Wolff told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: 沃尔夫告诉天空体育F1：“如果我们有一个水晶球来知道你是否应该后退，那将会很有帮助。”

paras.en: "It was a difficult one, a 50-50 call. He was running into Albon.
paras.zh: “这是一场艰难的比赛，50-50的比分。他遇到了阿尔本。

paras.en: "He was 18 milliseconds up on Norris at that stage. I don't think it would have been enough for pole, but he drove perfectly all session and merited to be on pole.
paras.zh: “当时他比诺里斯领先 18 毫秒。我认为这不足以获得杆位，但他在整个比赛中都表现出色，值得获得杆位。

paras.en: "He deserved it but you can't make that call. It's 50 per cent right or wrong. George was in a league of his own today."
paras.zh: “他应得的，但你不能做出这样的决定。这有 50% 的正确或错误。乔治今天处于他自己的联盟​​。”

paras.en: Russell's frustrations follow his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who qualified third, being crowned world champion at last weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔的队友基米·安东内利感到沮丧，他在上周末的墨西哥城大奖赛上获得第三名并加冕世界冠军。

paras.en: The Brit was excused from his media duties after the race in Mexico as Wolff described him as "distraught", with Russell revealing in Brazil that he had found the situation hard to deal with, especially after a technical issue saw him drop back from second on the grid on the opening lap.
paras.zh: 这位英国人在墨西哥比赛结束后被免除了媒体职责，沃尔夫称他“心烦意乱”，拉塞尔在巴西透露，他发现这种情况很难处理，特别是在技术问题导致他在第一圈从第二位退后之后。

paras.en: As Russell expressed his anger at the instruction to abort the lap in Brazil, Wolff came on the radio in an apparent attempt to diffuse the situation as he told his driver second was a strong result.
paras.zh: 当拉塞尔对巴西取消单圈的指示表示愤怒时，沃尔夫在广播中告诉他的车手第二名是一个很好的结果，显然是试图缓和局势。

paras.en: Asked for his feelings on Wolff's radio communication with him, Russell said he understood that the Austrian was attempting to protect the wider morale of the team.
paras.zh: 当被问及对沃尔夫与他的无线电通讯有何感受时，拉塞尔表示，他理解奥地利人试图保护球队更广泛的士气。

paras.en: "When you're a driver, you're the one who feels it the most," Russell said. "And going back to his (Wolff's) leadership skills, we've got to remember, we collectively made a misjudgement today, and there's members of my team who are going to be feeling as bad as I am currently.
paras.zh: “当你是一名车手时，你是感受最深的人，”拉塞尔说。 “回到他（沃尔夫）的领导能力，我们必须记住，我们今天集体做出了错误判断，我的团队成员将会像我现在一样感觉糟糕。

paras.en: "So, it's important to remember that and we need to just keep the morale high.
paras.zh: “所以，记住这一点很重要，我们需要保持高昂的士气。

paras.en: "It was a very solid performance, and I guess we take the positive from that. There are no points for a pole, but it would have just been a nice little one to add to the tally."
paras.zh: “这是一场非常稳定的表现，我想我们从中得到了积极的一面。杆位没有积分，但如果能增加积分的话，那就太好了。”

paras.en: Sky Sports pundits Karun Chandhok and Bernie Collins were split on whether Russell would have claimed pole had he completed the lap behind Albon.
paras.zh: 天空体育评论员卡伦·钱德霍克和伯尼·柯林斯对于如果拉塞尔落后阿尔本完成一圈是否会获得杆位存在分歧。

paras.en: Chandhok said: "In George's mind, he felt like he should have carried on.
paras.zh: 钱多克说：“在乔治看来，他觉得自己应该继续前进。

paras.en: "I don't think he would have beaten Lando to be honest. He was so close to Alex and would have had to follow him. I don't know if he would have got pole.
paras.zh: “老实说，我不认为他会击败兰多。他离亚历克斯太近了，必须跟随他。我不知道他是否会获得杆位。

paras.en: "I can see the frustration but personally, I think he would have lost more time being stuck behind Albon and I don't think he would have beaten Lando."
paras.zh: “我可以看到这种挫败感，但就我个人而言，我认为他会因为被困在阿尔本身后而损失更多时间，而且我认为他不会击败兰多。”

paras.en: But Collins said: "I can see why he's disappointed.
paras.zh: 但柯林斯说：“我明白他为什么感到失望。

paras.en: "I think he would have been on pole on that second lap because his fastest first and second sector, with Albon's fastest third sector is enough for pole.
paras.zh: “我认为他会在第二圈获得杆位，因为他最快的第一区和第二区，以及阿尔本最快的第三区足以获得杆位。

paras.en: "His middle sector on that lap was actually seven tenths up."
paras.zh: “那一圈他的中间部分实际上上升了十分之七。”

articles.title: Can Verstappen, Hamilton come from the back in Sao Paulo 'reverse grid' race?

paras.en: Sao Paulo GP: Can Max Verstappen, Lewis Hamilton come from the back again as Lando Norris hopes for rain to fight Kimi Antonelli
paras.zh: 圣保罗大奖赛：马克斯·维斯塔潘、刘易斯·汉密尔顿能否再次从后面回来，兰多·诺里斯希望下雨来对抗基米·安东内利

paras.en: Lando Norris starts on pole in Brazil from Kimi Antonelli but there will be plenty of attention further down the field with Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton starting at the back; watch Sunday's Sao Paulo Grand Prix live at 5pm on Sky Sports F1, build-up from 3.30pm
paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯 (Lando Norris) 在巴西比赛中从基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 手中取得杆位，但马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 和刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 首发，后面的赛场将会受到大量关注；下午 5 点在天空体育 F1 频道观看周日圣保罗大奖赛的直播，下午 3.30 开始准备

paras.en: A mixed up grid and rain on the forecast has set up the prospect of a thrilling Sao Paulo Grand Prix on Sunday.
paras.zh: 天气预报中的混乱发车和降雨为周日激动人心的圣保罗大奖赛奠定了基础。

paras.en: For the third year in a row, Lando Norris will start on pole position in Brazil with new F1 world champion Kimi Antonelli alongside him on the front row.
paras.zh: 兰多·诺里斯 (Lando Norris) 将连续第三年在巴西站获得杆位，新任 F1 世界冠军基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 坐在前排。

paras.en: Unusually though, there will be plenty of attention further down the field as power unit changes for Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton mean they start at the back, while Ferrari's Charles Leclerc starts 14th for a 10-grid place penalty.
paras.zh: 但不同寻常的是，随着红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘和法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿的动力装置发生变化，他们将在后面发车，而法拉利车队的查尔斯·勒克莱尔将从第 14 名起步，并受到 10 次发车位的处罚，因此赛场上将会有大量的关注。

paras.en: And Mercedes' George Russell, who was left frustrated to not qualify first after a strategic error from the team, starts seventh following a five-place grid penalty for a new internal combustion engine, so several of F1's biggest names will begin the Sao Paulo Grand Prix - lights out at 5pm on Sunday with build-up from 3.30pm, live on Sky Sports F1 - out of position.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔因车队战略失误而未能获得第一名而感到沮丧，但在因新内燃机而被罚后五位后，他从第七位发车。因此，几位 F1 大腕将开始圣保罗大奖赛——周日下午 5 点熄灯，从下午 3 点 30 分开始，天空体育 F1 直播——失位。

paras.en: "It's almost a reverse grid race, no?" Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “这几乎是一场反向发车赛，不是吗？”梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "Yeah, exciting. I think we want to lock in the points for the Constructors' Championship. But it's all floodgates open, the better. Let's race."
paras.zh: “是的，令人兴奋。我想我们想锁定车队锦标赛的积分。但一切都已打开，那就更好了。让我们比赛吧。”

paras.en: How far can Verstappen and Hamilton climb up the field?
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘和汉密尔顿能在赛场上爬多远？

paras.en: Verstappen is no stranger to making his way through the pack at Interlagos after his remarkable victory from 17th in 2024 in the rain.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在 2024 年的雨中取得了第 17 名的非凡胜利后，在英特拉格斯的比赛中脱颖而出并不陌生。

paras.en: The Red Bull driver, who has won three times in Brazil, gained 11 places in the opening 11 laps before making the right strategy call to take a crucial victory.
paras.zh: 这位在巴西赢得三场胜利的红牛车手在前 11 圈中获得了 11 位，然后做出了正确的策略，取得了关键的胜利。

paras.en: Last year, Verstappen started from the pit lane and impressively charged his way to the podium in dry conditions, but he thinks it will be more difficult to get towards the front this time around.
paras.zh: 去年，维斯塔潘从维修站起步，在干燥的条件下冲上领奖台，令人印象深刻，但他认为这次要冲到前面会更加困难。

paras.en: "It's going to be a bit harder to overtake. The Overtake Mode doesn't really do a lot around here. Everyone is draining their battery from the last corner to Turn 1. Everyone has their wings open, so the effect is less than normal," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “超车会有点困难。超车模式在这里并没有多大作用。从最后一个弯道到一号弯，每个人都在耗尽电池。每个人都张开翅膀，所以效果比正常情况要差，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "That will make it a bit harder to overtake once you get to the cars that are similar on lap times. The first few cars are not a problem. The others will be a little harder."
paras.zh: “一旦你遇到单圈时间相似的赛车，超车就会变得更加困难。前几辆车不是问题。其他的会更难一些。”

paras.en: Hamilton memorably went from 20th to fifth in the 2021 Sprint in Brazil, after he was disqualified from Qualifying, then won the Grand Prix after starting 10th.
paras.zh: 令人难忘的是，汉密尔顿在 2021 年巴西冲刺赛中被取消资格后，从第 20 位上升到第 5 位，然后以第 10 位出发，赢得了大奖赛。

paras.en: However, Hamilton will not have the same car advantage from five years ago with Ferrari struggling this weekend compared to their recent form.
paras.zh: 然而，汉密尔顿将不再拥有五年前的赛车优势，法拉利本周末与最近的状态相比表现不佳。

paras.en: But, the high chance of rain means Hamilton, and Verstappen, will have the chance to showcase their extraordinary skill and could still find themselves towards the pointy end of the field with a special performance.
paras.zh: 但是，下雨的可能性很大，这意味着汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘将有机会展示他们非凡的技术，并且仍然可以通过特殊的表现找到自己的优势。

paras.en: "It will be tricky conditions but I love racing in the rain," said Hamilton.
paras.zh: “这将是一个棘手的条件，但我喜欢在雨中比赛，”汉密尔顿说。

paras.en: "I was basically using the qualifying as a test to make sure the engine is working, and making sure the car felt good. I feel good for tomorrow."
paras.zh: “我基本上使用排位赛作为测试，以确保发动机正常工作，并确保赛车感觉良好。我对明天感觉良好。”

paras.en: Leclerc has less cars to overtake from 14th and feels he learned a lot from the wet qualifying by experimenting with set-up tweaks which will benefit him in the race.
paras.zh: 从第 14 位开始，勒克莱尔需要超越的赛车越来越少，他觉得自己从湿地排位赛中学到了很多东西，通过尝试调整设置来让他在正赛中受益。

paras.en: "It's going to be very tricky. My biggest strength in the junior categories has been wet driving. Since my nine years with Ferrari, we have never found a way around it," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “这将非常棘手。我在青少年组中最大的优势是湿地驾驶。自从我在法拉利工作了九年以来，我们从未找到解决办法，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "I still believe if we manage to find the right window of this car, we can fight for much better than top six."
paras.zh: “我仍然相信，如果我们能够找到这辆车的合适窗口，我们就能比前六名更好地争夺。”

paras.en: Norris hoping for 'dark, gloomy day' to fight Antonelli
paras.zh: 诺里斯希望在“黑暗、阴沉的一天”与安东内利作战

paras.en: Perhaps quite fittingly, last year's F1 world champion Norris will start on pole from the new world champion Antonelli in the first race since the latter secured this year's title a week ago in Mexico.
paras.zh: 也许非常恰当的是，去年的F1世界冠军诺里斯将在新任世界冠军安东内利一周前在墨西哥获得今年冠军后的第一场比赛中从杆位发车。

paras.en: McLaren have brought a new front wing, rear wing, beam wing and floor elements to their car this weekend and it appears to have made an immediate performance impact.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦本周末为他们的赛车带来了新的前翼、后翼、梁翼和地板元件，它似乎对性能产生了立竿见影的影响。

paras.en: Norris and Antonelli traded lap times throughout Friday's practice sessions in the dry but the McLaren driver feels he needs rain to beat Antonelli on Sunday.
paras.zh: 诺里斯和安东内利在周五的练习赛中在干燥的情况下交换了单圈时间，但迈凯轮车手认为他需要在周日下雨才能击败安东内利。

paras.en: "I expect a battle no matter what. If it's dry, I probably expect a bigger battle because I don't think we quite have the speed compared to them," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “无论如何，我都期待一场战斗。如果天气干燥，我可能会期待一场更大的战斗，因为我认为我们没有与他们相比的速度，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "That's why I feel like we had a very good day today. We made the most of conditions where it's not so much about who has the best car, it's more who can push things to the limit and make the most of that opportunity.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我觉得我们今天度过了非常美好的一天。我们充分利用了条件，谁拥有最好的汽车并不重要，更重要的是谁能够将事情推向极限并充分利用这个机会。

paras.en: "I'm hoping when I wake up it's a dark, gloomy day because we will have a better chance then."
paras.zh: “我希望当我醒来时是黑暗、阴沉的一天，因为那时我们会有更好的机会。”

paras.en: Norris pointed to Antonelli's impressive long run pace in the dry on Friday as the reason he's hoping for rain, whereas the Mercedes driver says he's open to any conditions.
paras.zh: 诺里斯指出，安东内利周五在干燥天气中令人印象深刻的长跑速度是他希望下雨的原因，而梅赛德斯车手则表示他对任何条件都持开放态度。

paras.en: "Hopefully, we can get off the line well, and let's see if it's going to be wet or dry," said Antonelli.
paras.zh: 安东内利说：“希望我们能顺利下线，看看会是湿的还是干的。”

paras.en: "In the dry, I felt very good over a single lap and on the long run, especially in FP2. So let's see. I'm looking forward to it.
paras.zh: “在干燥的情况下，我在单圈和长距离跑中都感觉非常好，尤其是在 FP2 中。所以让我们看看。我很期待。

paras.en: Mercedes have a big opportunity to win the Constructors' Championship with Antonelli starting in second and Russell in seventh, while the two Ferraris are outside of the top 13.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯有很大机会赢得车队冠军，安东内利排名第二，拉塞尔排名第七，而两辆法拉利都在前 13 名之外。

paras.en: If Mercedes outscore Ferrari by three points, or more, they will seal their ninth title since 2014 but the result of the race itself appears to be more important to the drivers, and Russell is hoping for more rain following his impressive qualifying.
paras.zh: 如果梅赛德斯以三分或更多的优势击败法拉利，他们将锁定自 2014 年以来的第九个冠军头衔，但比赛本身的结果似乎对车手来说更重要，拉塞尔希望在他令人印象深刻的排位赛后能有更多降雨。

paras.en: "I felt really confident in the rain. I think my pace, along with Lando's, was by far the best out there," he said
paras.zh: “我在雨中感到非常自信。我认为我的配速和兰多的配速是迄今为止最好的，”他说

paras.en: "In the rain here, it's always a challenge. I hope it is wet. I feel I've got a greater chance if it's wet."
paras.zh: “在这里下雨，这总是一个挑战。我希望它是湿的。我觉得如果湿了，我的机会就会更大。”

articles.title: Melania Trump calls for ‘enduring’ Russia-Ukraine peace as she hosts top officials at the White House
articles.author: Monica Alba

paras.en: First lady Melania Trump expressed hope that a humanitarian ceasefire around a city in Ukraine would inspire progress toward a “more enduring” peace, as she hosted representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House on Thursday.
paras.zh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普周四在白宫接待了俄罗斯和乌克兰的代表，她表示希望乌克兰一座城市周围的人道主义停火能够激励实现“更持久”的和平。

paras.en: The unprecedented meeting came as the Trump administration pushes for progress in broader peace negotiations, with the United States set to lead renewed trilateral talks with Russia and Ukraine in the United Arab Emirates next week.
paras.zh: 这次史无前例的会议召开之际，特朗普政府正在推动更广泛的和平谈判取得进展，美国将于下周在阿拉伯联合酋长国与俄罗斯和乌克兰重新举行三边会谈。

paras.en: Speaking at the White House, the first lady expressed hope that the six-day ceasefire around Oleshky would inspire a peace “more enduring than a temporary ceasefire,” before praising the “highly cooperative” Russian and Ukrainian leaders for helping bring about the pause.
paras.zh: 第一夫人在白宫发表讲话时表示，希望奥列什基周围为期六天的停火能够激发“比临时停火更持久”的和平，然后赞扬俄罗斯和乌克兰领导人“高度合作”帮助实现停火。

paras.en: Melania Trump was joined by Kirill Dmitriev, Vladimir Putin’s special envoy, who thanked her on behalf of the Russian leader. “This humanitarian mission shows what can be achieved when compassion, determination and cooperation come together,” he said.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京的特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫也与梅拉尼娅·特朗普一起，代表俄罗斯领导人向她表示感谢。他说：“这项人道主义使命表明，当同情心、决心和合作齐心协力时，可以取得什么样的成就。”

paras.en: Russia has repeatedly rejected calls for a wider ceasefire since launching its full-scale invasion of Ukraine nearly five years ago.
paras.zh: 自近五年前全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯一再拒绝更广泛停火的呼吁。

paras.en: The limited ceasefire around Oleshky, which started Oct. 27 and lasted six days, allowed for the evacuation of hundreds of people trapped by fighting, blockades and extensive minefields, via neighboring Belarus. The city in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region was home to 2,000 remaining residents on the brink of starvation.
paras.zh: 奥列什基周围的有限停火于 10 月 27 日开始，持续了六天，使数百名因战斗、封锁和大片雷区而被困的人能够经由邻国白俄罗斯撤离。这座位于乌克兰南部赫尔松地区的城市有 2000 名仍处于饥饿边缘的居民。

paras.en: Both sides held fire throughout the truce, making it the largest de-escalation effort since the war began.
paras.zh: 双方在整个休战期间一直交火，这是自战争开始以来最大规模的降级努力。

paras.en: Urging the first lady to keep going with her mission, David Arakhamia, the head of President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s ruling faction in Ukraine’s parliament, said he hoped the deal would create momentum “to actually keep the peace when the peace comes.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰议会总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)领导的派别领导人戴维·阿拉卡米亚(David Arakhamia)敦促第一夫人继续履行她的使命，他表示希望该协议能够创造动力，“在和平到来时真正维护和平”。

paras.en: Dmytro Lubinets, the Ukrainian parliamentary commissioner for human rights, then presented Melania Trump with Ukraine’s highest state honor, the Order of Princess Olga, 1st Class.
paras.zh: 乌克兰议会人权专员德米特罗·鲁宾涅茨随后向梅拉尼娅·特朗普颁发了乌克兰最高国家荣誉——一级奥尔加公主勋章。

paras.en: Melania Trump then gave Dmitriev and Arakhamia personal letters to deliver to Putin and Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普随后将私人信件交给德米特里耶夫和阿拉卡米亚，让他们转交给普京和泽连斯基。

paras.en: She did not respond to shouted questions from NBC News.
paras.zh: 她没有回答 NBC 新闻的大声提问。

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV and some officials in Europe also lobbied heavily for the ceasefire in Oleshky.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世和欧洲一些官员也大力游说奥列什基停火。

paras.en: Thursday’s gathering appears to be the first time both sides met face to face at the White House.
paras.zh: 周四的聚会似乎是双方首次在白宫面对面会面。

paras.en: It comes as President Donald Trump ramped up pressure on Kyiv, after he agreed on deals with the Kremlin in a bid to break a monthslong deadlock in negotiations to settle the war.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统与克里姆林宫达成协议，以打破解决战争的谈判长达数月的僵局，随后加大了对基辅的压力。

paras.en: Next week’s Abu Dhabi peace talks will be the first since Republicans suffered major losses in the midterm elections, a blow to the president’s authority.
paras.zh: 下周的阿布扎比​​和平谈判将是共和党在中期选举中遭受重大损失以来的首次和平谈判，这对总统的权威造成了打击。

paras.en: Ukraine has been reeling from the worst collapse in relations with Washington since the start of the war. Trump signed a deal to buy Russian diesel and waived new sanctions on Moscow last month, while Kyiv complained of gaps in U.S. intelligence sharing and the slowdown of tech billionaire Elon Musk’s Starlink service, crucial for Ukraine’s military and air defense.
paras.zh: 自战争开始以来，乌克兰与华盛顿的关系一直处于最严重的崩溃之中。特朗普上个月签署了购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，并放弃了对莫斯科的新制裁，而基辅则抱怨美国情报共享存在缺陷，以及科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克的星链服务速度放缓，该服务对乌克兰的军事和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Ukraine has since said that both intelligence sharing and Starlink service have been restored, and that it was looking forward to resuming trilateral talks with the U.S. and Russia next week.
paras.zh: 乌克兰此后表示情报共享和星链服务均已恢复，并期待下周恢复与美国和俄罗斯的三边会谈。

paras.en: “This will be a team-level format, and we count on the work in this format and our other diplomatic steps opening the way to a trilateral format at the leaders’ level,” Zelenskyy said Tuesday. “It is precisely such a format — at the leaders’ level — that can resolve the key issues in order to achieve a lasting peace and guaranteed security.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周二表示：“这将是团队级别的形式，我们指望这种形式的工作以及我们的其他外交步骤为领导人级别的三边形式开辟道路。” “正是这样一种形式——在领导人层面——能够解决关键问题，以实现持久和平和有保障的安全。”

paras.en: The meeting comes after Democrats captured full control of Congress in a striking repudiation of Trump’s agenda.
paras.zh: 这次会议召开之前，民主党人完全控制了国会，对特朗普的议程进行了惊人的否定。

paras.en: The Kremlin said it “sincerely hoped” that Trump would continue his “peace-building efforts” after the midterm elections. Ukraine offered no official response to the dramatic results, but some in the country expressed cautious optimism the Democratic surge would ease pressure from Washington.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，“真诚地希望”特朗普在中期选举后继续其“建设和平的努力”。乌克兰没有对这一戏剧性的结果做出官方回应，但该国一些人对民主党的崛起将缓解华盛顿的压力表示谨慎乐观。

paras.en: The negotiations to settle the war, led by Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner, have stalled over the key question of Ukraine’s eastern Donbas industrial region, which Putin wants to seize in its entirety.
paras.zh: 由特朗普特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和女婿贾里德·库什纳领导的解决战争的谈判因乌克兰东部顿巴斯工业区的关键问题陷入僵局，普京希望完全占领该地区。

paras.en: Ukraine still controls key stronghold cities in the Donbas and has refused to give up this land, arguing Putin may be eyeing not just a public relations success but a powerful launchpad for future invasion attempts.
paras.zh: 乌克兰仍然控制着顿巴斯的主要据点城市，并拒绝放弃这片土地，认为普京可能不仅着眼于公共关系的成功，而且着眼于未来入侵企图的强大发射台。

articles.title: Snow blankets parts of NSW just weeks away from summer

paras.en: Snow has fallen in parts of NSW after a cold front dropped temperatures and produced rain and storms.
paras.zh: 冷锋降低气温并产生降雨和风暴后，新南威尔士州部分地区出现降雪。

paras.en: A Thredbo local says the snow was "beautiful", but "unexpected" after a warm winter.
paras.zh: 斯雷德伯当地人表示，这场雪“很漂亮”，但在暖冬之后却“出乎意料”。

paras.en: Suburbs that hit 30 degrees Celsius on Saturday dropped by more than 10C by the evening.
paras.zh: 周六气温达到 30 摄氏度的郊区到晚上下降了 10 多摄氏度。

paras.en: Parts of New South Wales have been blanketed in snow just a few weeks out from summer after a strong cold front swept along the state's coast.
paras.zh: 距离夏季仅几周，新南威尔士州部分地区就被大雪覆盖，一股强冷锋席卷了该州海岸。

paras.en: David Crock from the Bureau of Meteorology said November was a "very volatile time of year", with the cold snap not that unusual, but was always "striking when it happens".
paras.zh: 气象局的戴维·克罗克 (David Crock) 表示，11 月是“一年中非常不稳定的时期”，寒流并不罕见，但总是“发生时令人震惊”。

paras.en: "We saw snow maybe down as low as 400 to 500 metres through parts of Tasmania yesterday, also snow on the Alps through Victoria and NSW down to about 800m," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“昨天，我们看到塔斯马尼亚部分地区的降雪可能低至 400 至 500 米，维多利亚州和新南威尔士州阿尔卑斯山的降雪也低至约 800 米。”

paras.en: The heat in the north of the country, the senior meteorologist explained, coupled with a really cold ocean in the south was behind the change.
paras.zh: 这位高级气象学家解释说，该国北部的炎热，加上南部海洋的寒冷，是造成这种变化的原因。

paras.en: "So we've got that really strong temperature gradient between northern Australia and the Southern Ocean," he said.
paras.zh: “因此，澳大利亚北部和南大洋之间的温度梯度非常大，”他说。

paras.en: "And that's what creates these strong cold fronts with a big push of cold air up through NSW and even into southern parts of Queensland."
paras.zh: “这就是产生这些强烈冷锋的原因，大量冷空气推动新南威尔士州，甚至进入昆士兰州南部地区。”

paras.en: On Saturday, Sydney hit 29.7C just after lunch time, dropping to 14C by the evening.
paras.zh: 周六，午餐时间过后，悉尼气温达到 29.7 摄氏度，到晚上则降至 14 摄氏度。

paras.en: The massive drop was also experienced in Penrith, which went from 31.5C at 3pm, to 14C by late evening. Night time in Parramatta hit 13.C after sweating through 30.4 earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 彭里斯 (Penrith) 也经历了大幅降温，下午 3 点气温从 31.5 摄氏度降至傍晚时分的 14 摄氏度。帕拉马塔 (Parramatta) 当天早些时候出汗温度高达 30.4 摄氏度，夜间气温升至 13 摄氏度。

paras.en: The change also brought heavy rain and storms.
paras.zh: 这种变化还带来了大雨和暴风雨。

paras.en: Thredbo, in the state's alpine region, received a dumping of snow overnight when temperatures fell to -5.0 degrees Celsius.
paras.zh: 该州高山地区的斯雷德伯 (Thredbo) 夜间降雪，气温降至 -5.0 摄氏度。

paras.en: It was 0C on Sunday morning and snow was still falling.
paras.zh: 周日早上气温为 0 摄氏度，雪还在下。

paras.en: Madeleine McVie said while it was unexpected after a warm winter, it was "beautiful" and enough to build a snowman.
paras.zh: 玛德琳·麦克维说，虽然在暖冬之后出现这样的情况是出乎意料的，但它“很漂亮”，足以堆雪人。

paras.en: "It certainly was hard to get out of bed. It is very cold down here," she said.
paras.zh: “起床确实很困难。这里很冷，”她说。

paras.en: "We got a little bit [of snow] a couple of days ago, and yesterday it started snowing about four in the afternoon.
paras.zh: “几天前我们下了一点雪，昨天下午四点左右开始下雪。

paras.en: "I looked out the window and it was dumping down big fat flakes."
paras.zh: “我向窗外望去，它正在倾泻出大块的脂肪片。”

paras.en: People who had gone hiking at Mount Kosciuszko were ecstatic, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，在科修斯科山徒步旅行的人们都欣喜若狂。

paras.en: "They certainly wasn't expecting it to snow down here in November.
paras.zh: “他们当然没想到十一月这里会下雪。

paras.en: "And we're prepping for our mountain biking season, so we weren't expecting it either."
paras.zh: “我们正在为山地自行车赛季做准备，所以我们也没想到会发生这种情况。”

paras.en: On Sunday, cooler temperatures hovering between 10C and 12C degrees dominated across the state.
paras.zh: 周日，全州气温较低，徘徊在 10 至 12 摄氏度之间。

paras.en: Strong southerly winds and hazardous conditions are forecasted along the NSW coast on Monday, with the chill expected to continue.
paras.zh: 预计周一新南威尔士州海岸将出现强烈南风，天气恶劣，寒冷天气预计将持续。

paras.en: Rugby League World Cup live: Jillaroos vs Fiji, Kangaroos vs Samoa semifinals

paras.en: The Jillaroos try to take down Fiji in the Women's Rugby League World Cup semifinals before the Kangaroos endeavour to join them in reaching the men's decider as they meet Samoa.
paras.zh: 吉拉鲁队试图在女子橄榄球联盟世界杯半决赛中击败斐济队，随后袋鼠队将与萨摩亚队一起进入男子决赛。

paras.en: Follow all the action in our live blog below.
