articles.title: This Bull and Male Donkey Have a Surprisingly Sexual Relationship, Providing Insights Into Interspecies and Same-Sex Bonds

paras.en: Earlier this year, researchers were studying monkeys on an Ethiopian plateau when members of two other species caught their eye. They spotted something unexpected: a bull mounting a male donkey.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，研究人员在埃塞俄比亚高原上研究猴子时，另外两个物种的成员引起了他们的注意。他们发现了一些意想不到的东西：一头公牛骑着一头公驴。

paras.en: “We were not sure if we had actually seen it or if it was some type of mirage,” recalls André Beirão da Cruz, an ecologist at the University of Pisa in Italy and the NOVA University of Lisbon in Portugal, to Mary Randolph at Scientific American.
paras.zh: “我们不确定我们是否真的看到过它，或者它是否是某种海市蜃楼，”意大利比萨大学和葡萄牙里斯本新星大学的生态学家安德烈·贝朗·达克鲁斯向《科学美国人》的玛丽·伦道夫回忆道。

paras.en: It wasn’t. Over the course of several days, da Cruz and colleagues observed the two ungulates licking and rubbing each other and having sex despite the availability of members of their own species. Their findings, described in the journal Current Biology on November 2, suggest that scientists still have a lot to learn about social and sexual interactions between members of different species.
paras.zh: 事实并非如此。在几天的时间里，达克鲁兹和同事观察到这两只有蹄类动物互相舔舐、摩擦并发生性行为，尽管有同种成员。他们的研究结果发表在 11 月 2 日的《当代生物学》杂志上，表明科学家对于不同物种成员之间的社会和性互动仍有很多东西需要了解。

paras.en: “It is really, really unusual,” says study co-author Elisabetta Palagi, an ecologist at the University of Pisa, to Nicola Davis at the Guardian. “And it is the first time it is reported in literature.”
paras.zh: “这真的非常非常不寻常，”该研究的合著者、比萨大学的生态学家 Elisabetta Palagi 对《卫报》的 Nicola Davis 说道。 “这是第一次在文献中报道。”

paras.en: Achille and Patroclo, the bull and donkey’s respective nicknames, belong to different owners but spend time together on the pasture. So, the researchers observed the two animals on four days when they were together and four days when they were separated this past March.
paras.zh: 公牛和驴各自的昵称阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛属于不同的主人，但在牧场上度过了时光。因此，研究人员在今年三月观察了两只动物在一起的四天和分开的四天。

paras.en: Overall, the team recorded 51 mountings between Patroclo and Achille in that window, 34 of which involved penetration. The donkey often initiated interactions by presenting his hindquarters to the bull and nibbling him. They displayed affectionate behaviors before and after each rendezvous.
paras.zh: 总体而言，该团队在该窗口内记录了 Patroclo 和 Achille 之间的 51 次挂架，其中 34 次涉及穿透。驴经常通过将后腿展示给公牛并咬它来发起互动。每次约会前后，他们都会表现出深情的行为。

paras.en: The pair specifically picked each other for these intimate encounters. When another bull tried to approach Patroclo, the donkey displayed aggressive behaviors like chasing and biting. Achille, meanwhile, tried to mount another male donkey, but the animal showed avoidance and threatening behaviors, like flattened ears—something Patroclo never did to him.
paras.zh: 两人特意挑选了对方来进行这些亲密的接触。当另一头公牛试图接近帕特罗克洛时，驴子表现出了追逐和撕咬等攻击性行为。与此同时，阿奇勒试图骑上另一头公驴，但这只动物表现出回避和威胁行为，比如耳朵被压扁——而帕特罗克洛从未对他做过这种事。

paras.en: The two ungulates don’t seem to have chosen each other out of convenience or because they had no other options. Numerous male and female cattle and donkeys grazed alongside Achille and Patroclo, yet the duo continued to spend time together when the opportunity arose.
paras.zh: 这两只有蹄类动物似乎并不是出于方便或因为别无选择而选择了对方。许多雄性和雌性牛和驴与阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛一起吃草，但当机会出现时，二人继续一起度过时光。

paras.en: “What really caught our attention was that these interactions were embedded in a very selective and consistent social relationship between the two individuals,” Palagi says in a statement.
paras.zh: 帕拉吉在一份声明中说：“真正引起我们注意的是，这些互动植根于两个人之间非常有选择性和一致的社会关系中。”

paras.en: The bond between the two animals—which the researchers discovered was common knowledge among local herders—raises further questions. While same-sex sexual behaviors are widespread in animals, they usually involve members of the same species, like penguins and bonobos. In nonhuman primates, research suggests these behaviors might reinforce social bonds and help the animals live longer. However, it’s unclear why the male ungulates of different species would pick their trysts.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，这两种动物之间的联系是当地牧民的共识，这引发了进一步的问题。虽然同性性行为在动物中很普遍，但它们通常涉及同一物种的成员，例如企鹅和倭黑猩猩。在非人类灵长类动物中，研究表明这些行为可能会加强社会联系并帮助动物活得更久。然而，目前尚不清楚为什么不同物种的雄性有蹄类动物会选择幽会。

paras.en: “Achille and Patroclo cannot tell us why they choose one another. This short study can’t tell us what evolutionary purpose, if any, their relationship serves,” writes Jo Setchell, a biological anthropologist at Durham University in England who wasn’t involved in the study, for the Conversation. “But it does remind us that animal behavior can be more diverse than our theories suggest.”
paras.zh: “阿基尔和帕特罗克洛无法告诉我们为什么他们选择彼此。这项简短的研究无法告诉我们他们的关系有什么进化目的（如果有的话），”英国达勒姆大学的生物人类学家乔·塞切尔（Jo Setchell）在《对话》中写道，他没有参与这项研究。 “但它确实提醒我们，动物的行为可能比我们的理论所暗示的更加多样化。”

paras.en: Vincent Savolainen, an ecologist at Imperial College London who wasn’t involved in the work, tells Scientific American that Achille and Patroclo’s behavior could be influenced by their domestication, meaning wild animals might not exhibit the same social traits or patterns.
paras.zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院的生态学家文森特·萨沃莱宁（Vincent Savolainen）没有参与这项工作，他告诉《科学美国人》，阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛的行为可能会受到驯化的影响，这意味着野生动物可能不会表现出相同的社会特征或模式。

paras.en: “It’s important to publish and publicize this example just to show the diversity of what can happen, but it is obviously limited to two animals from two species that are domesticated,” Savolainen adds. “If we want to make massive steps in the field of behavior ecology, you would want to study a larger group of wild animals.”
paras.zh: “发布和宣传这个例子很重要，只是为了展示可能发生的事情的多样性，但它显然仅限于两个驯化物种的两种动物，”萨沃莱宁补充道。 “如果我们想在行为生态学领域取得重大进展，你就需要研究更多的野生动物。”

paras.en: Still, Josh Luke Davis, a science writer at the Natural History Museum in London and author of A Little Gay Natural History, cautions against “reading too much into the significance” of Achille and Patroclo’s relationship.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，伦敦自然历史博物馆的科普作家、《同性恋自然史》一书的作者乔什·卢克·戴维斯（Josh Luke Davis）警告说，不要“过度解读”阿基尔和帕特罗克洛关系的意义。

paras.en: Given that queer behaviors are common in the natural world and interspecies connections aren’t that unusual, it’s “probably not that surprising” that the two have overlapped, he tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 他告诉《卫报》，考虑到酷儿行为在自然界中很常见，而且种间联系也并不罕见，因此两者重叠“可能并不令人惊讶”。

articles.title: China Announces a Plan to Put Astronauts on the Moon by 2030, Revealing Details of Four Upcoming Missions

paras.en: In the wake of a recent NASA update on the schedule of its upcoming Artemis 3 mission into Earth’s orbit, China has announced details about its own lunar program, shining a rare light on how the nation plans to land humans on the moon by 2030.
paras.zh: 在美国宇航局 (NASA) 最近更新即将执行的阿耳忒弥斯 3 号进入地球轨道的任务时间表后，中国宣布了有关其月球计划的详细信息，为中国计划如何在 2030 年将人类送上月球提供了罕见的线索。

paras.en: Wang Xiang, deputy chief designer of China’s manned space program and chief designer of the lunar exploration program, explained how the moon landing will be executed at the Seventh Manned Space Symposium in Beijing on Saturday, according to the state-run Chinese news agency Xinhua.
paras.zh: 据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，中国载人航天工程副总设计师兼探月工程总设计师王翔在周六于北京举行的第七届载人航天研讨会上解释了如何实施登月。

paras.en: The release of details comes within the context of what’s widely seen as a new space race, this time between China and the United States. NASA is currently targeting 2028 for its highly anticipated lunar return, but many external experts are dubious that the agency will be able to stick to its timeline, reports Kenneth Chang for the New York Times.
paras.zh: 细节的发布是在人们普遍认为的一场新的太空竞赛的背景下进行的，这次竞赛的对手是中国和美国。据《纽约时报》的 Kenneth Chang 报道，美国宇航局目前的目标是 2028 年进行备受期待的月球返回，但许多外部专家怀疑该机构是否能够坚持其时间表。

paras.en: China unveils detailed plan for manned moon landing China plans to land Chinese taikonauts on the Moon before 2030, with a crew of three, two of whom are expected to set foot on the lunar surface, according to information released at the 7th Human Space Symposium on Saturday. The mission will use a “two launches, one lunar landing” approach, involving two Long March-10 carrier rockets. Check the details. #ChinaSpaceMission #moon
paras.zh: 中国公布载人登月详细计划 根据周六第七届载人航天研讨会发布的信息，中国计划在 2030 年之前让中国航天员登陆月球，搭载 3 名宇航员，其中两人预计将踏上月球表面。此次任务将采用“两次发射、一次登月”的方式，涉及两枚长征十号运载火箭。检查详细信息。 #中国太空任务#moon

paras.en: — CGTN Frontline (@Frontlinestory) November 1, 2026
paras.zh: — CGTN 前线 (@Frontlinestory) 2026 年 11 月 1 日

paras.en: Wang said that China’s planned moon landing mission, slated for “before 2030,” will involve launching two separate Long March 10 rockets—one for a Mengzhou spacecraft, carrying a three-person crew, and the other for a Lanyue lunar lander. Once the two spacecraft reach the moon’s orbit, they will attach, or dock, and two of the Chinese astronauts, referred to as taikonauts, will move into the lander. The lander will then take them down to the surface of the moon.
paras.zh: 王说，中国计划在“2030年之前”实施的登月任务将涉及发射两枚独立的长征十号火箭——一枚用于运载三名宇航员的孟州飞船，另一枚用于兰月月球着陆器。一旦两艘航天器到达月球轨道，它们将附着或对接，两名中国宇航员（称为太古宇航员）将进入着陆器。然后着陆器将把他们带到月球表面。

paras.en: There, the astronauts will use a Tansuo lunar rover to drive around, collect samples and carry out experiments, according to China Daily’s Zhao Lei. The third taikonaut will wait for them in lunar orbit, providing support from the Mengzhou spacecraft.
paras.zh: 据《中国日报》记者赵雷报道，宇航员将在那里驾驶探索月球车绕行、采集样本并进行实验。第三名航天员将在月球轨道上等待他们，由孟洲飞船提供支持。

paras.en: “It is notable that we will deploy a lunar rover on our first crewed landing mission,” Wang tells China National Radio, as reported by China Daily. “This will substantially expand our capability to conduct a wide range of operations on the lunar surface and enhance operational flexibility.”
paras.zh: 据《中国日报》报道，王告诉中央人民广播电台：“值得注意的是，我们将在首次载人着陆任务中部署月球车。” “这将大大扩展我们在月球表面进行广泛行动的能力，并增强行动灵活性。”

paras.en: But before this complicated feat, the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program will test out its technological capabilities in uncrewed missions, Wang explains in a CCTV interview. “In an unmanned state, we will validate as many key technologies of the entire crewed process as possible, including launch, orbiting the moon, docking with the Mengzhou spacecraft, landing and staying on the lunar surface, taking off again and re-docking with the Mengzhou spacecraft,” he says, translated by the outlet. “This is to ensure that the crewed flight is safe and reliable.”
paras.zh: 但王在接受中央电视台采访时解释说，在这项复杂的壮举之前，中国探月计划将在无人任务中测试其技术能力。 “在无人状态下，我们将尽可能多地验证整个载人过程的关键技术，包括发射、绕月、与孟舟飞船对接、在月球表面着陆和停留、再次起飞以及与孟舟飞船重新对接，”他说。 “这是为了确保载人飞行安全可靠。”

paras.en: Did you know? China’s lunar sample return
paras.zh: 你可知道？中国月球样本返回

paras.en: While China has not landed humans on the moon, it has seen success with robotic moon missions in recent years: The Chang’e-5 spacecraft brought samples of lunar soil to Earth in 2020, and in 2024, Chang’e-6 retrieved the world’s first-ever samples from the lunar far side.
paras.zh: 虽然中国尚未将人类送上月球，但近年来在机器人探月任务方面取得了成功：嫦娥五号航天器于 2020 年将月球土壤样本带到了地球，嫦娥六号于 2024 年从月球背面取回了世界上第一个样本。

paras.en: China is working toward three uncrewed test missions before its crewed lunar landing, reports Arstechnica’s Eric Berger, citing presentation slides posted on social media. The first, expected early next year, is slated to launch the Mengzhou spacecraft into low-Earth orbit on a Long March 10A rocket. That will be followed by a lunar mission in 2028 involving the larger Long March 10 rocket and the uncrewed Lanyue lunar lander, which will land on and depart from the moon’s surface.
paras.zh: Arstechnica 的埃里克·伯杰 (Eric Berger) 援引社交媒体上发布的演示幻灯片报道称，中国正在努力在载人登月之前进行三项无人驾驶测试任务。第一个预计于明年初发射，计划利用长征十号甲运载火箭将孟州飞船送入近地轨道。随后，2028 年将执行一次探月任务，其中包括更大的长征十号火箭和无人载人的揽月月球着陆器，该着陆器将在月球表面着陆和离开。

paras.en: But the 2028 mission won’t be touch-and-go. Scientists back in China will use the opportunity to collect lunar data on features such as surface temperature and lunar dust conditions, according to CCTV. They’ve also opened a call for scientific experiments from other researchers to be included in the mission.
paras.zh: 但 2028 年的任务不会是一蹴而就的。据中央电视台报道，中国科学家将利用这个机会收集月球表面温度和月球尘埃状况等特征的数据。他们还呼吁其他研究人员进行科学实验，将其纳入此次任务中。

paras.en: “Because it is an unmanned mission, we will have some surplus resources, and we must make full use of them. Through a selection process, we will choose scientific experiment projects that are meaningful and necessary to be conducted on the moon,” explains Wang, as reported by Bastille Post Global. “It is like giving them a ‘free ride’ to the moon to conduct corresponding scientific experiments or technical explorations, achieving the goal of benefiting multiple parties with a single flight.”
paras.zh: 据《巴士底邮报》报道，王解释说：“因为这是一项无人任务，我们会有一些剩余资源，我们必须充分利用它们。通过筛选过程，我们将选择在月球上进行有意义且必要的科学实验项目。” “这就像让他们‘搭便车’到月球去进行相应的科学实验或技术探索，达到一次飞行多方受益的目的。”

paras.en: Then, 2029 will see another test mission in which two Long March 10 rockets will separately launch the Mengzhou spacecraft and the Lanyue lunar lander to the moon, where they will meet in lunar orbit. The long-awaited crewed lunar landing mission is expected to follow.
paras.zh: 2029年，两枚长征十号运载火箭将分别发射孟舟飞船和揽月着陆器飞向月球，并在月球轨道上相遇。期待已久的载人登月任务预计将随之而来。

paras.en: Both China and the U.S. hope to soon establish lunar bases near the moon’s south pole, which is thought to host valuable resources, including water ice. Last year, G. Scott Hubbard, a former director of NASA’s Ames Research Center, told the Los Angeles Times’ Michael Wilner that beating China to the moon would be “a stretch” for NASA.
paras.zh: 中国和美国都希望很快在月球南极附近建立月球基地，那里被认为蕴藏着包括水冰在内的宝贵资源。去年，美国宇航局艾姆斯研究中心前主任斯科特·哈伯德 (G. Scott Hubbard) 告诉《洛杉矶时报》的迈克尔·维尔纳 (Michael Wilner)，对美国宇航局来说，击败中国登上月球将是“一个延伸”。

paras.en: “It’ll take an intense effort by the best engineers and appropriate funding,” he added. But “it’s not inconceivable.”
paras.zh: “这需要最优秀的工程师的大力努力和适当的资金，”他补充道。但“这并非不可想象”。

articles.title: Michelangelo Used These Custom, Multi-Headed Brushes While Painting 'The Last Judgment' to Replicate His Intricate Sculpting Techniques

paras.en: This spring, the Vatican restored the Sistine Chapel for the first time in 30 years. Restorers worked for three months to remove layers of calcium lactate—a whitish salt from the dried sweat from millions of visitors and the plaster in the walls—that had settled onto Michelangelo’s immaculate 16th-century murals.
paras.zh: 今年春天，梵蒂冈三十年来首次修复了西斯廷教堂。修复人员花了三个月的时间，去除了米开朗基罗 16 世纪完美壁画上的乳酸钙层（数百万游客的干汗和墙上的灰泥中产生的白色盐分）。

paras.en: As experts climbed temporary scaffolding and applied distilled water and absorbent Japanese paper to clean away the grime, they got a rare, close-up view of Michelangelo’s vivid masterpieces. They noticed something unique about The Last Judgment, the massive mural located behind the chapel’s altar, as its original colors emerged. Michelangelo had painted with wavy brushstrokes that appeared to have moved in synchronization.
paras.zh: 当专家们爬上临时脚手架并使用蒸馏水和吸水性日本纸清除污垢时，他们罕见地近距离观察了米开朗基罗生动的杰作。他们注意到位于教堂祭坛后面的巨大壁画《最后的审判》的一些独特之处，因为它原来的颜色出现了。米开朗基罗用波浪形的笔触作画，这些笔触似乎是同步移动的。

paras.en: “I initially saw that Michelangelo painted with parallel strokes, often perpendicular to each to give a cross-hatching effect,” Paolo Violini, the Vatican’s chief restorer, tells the London Times’ Tom Kington. “Then I saw that when a stroke wobbled slightly, other strokes parallel to it had an identical wobble. That meant one thing: Michelangelo was using special brushes with multiple heads, each with a small brush on the end of it, allowing him to produce parallel strokes with one large brush.”
paras.zh: “我最初看到米开朗基罗用平行笔画作画，通常每笔画都是垂直的，以产生交叉阴影效果，”梵蒂冈首席修复师保罗·维奥利尼告诉伦敦时报的汤姆·金顿。 “然后我发现，当一个笔画轻微摆动时，与其平行的其他笔画也会出现相同的摆动。这意味着一件事：米开朗基罗使用具有多个头的特殊画笔，每个画笔的末端都有一个小画笔，使他能够用一支大画笔产生平行的笔画。”

paras.en: A close analysis of the mural indicated that Michelangelo used at least two specific brushes, including one with three brush-tips and others that reached nearly six-inches wide with 10 brush tips. Not only did these tools help Michelangelo work faster, but they allowed him to replicate one of his sculpting techniques—creating a cross-hatching pattern with a multi-pointed chisel known as a gradina—on a two-dimensional surface. The effect, in both cases, is to create a richer interaction between medium and light.
paras.zh: 对这幅壁画的仔细分析表明，米开朗基罗至少使用了两种特定的画笔，其中一种具有三个笔尖，另一种则达到近六英寸宽，具有十个笔尖。这些工具不仅帮助米开朗基罗更快地工作，而且使他能够在二维表面上复制他的一种雕刻技术——用称为“gradina”的多尖凿子创建交叉影线图案。在这两种情况下，效果都是在介质和光之间创建更丰富的交互。

paras.en: “Michelangelo painted magnificently—as a sculptor,” Barbara Jatta, director of the Vatican Museums, writes in the organization’s new book, Michelangelo 2026: The Extraordinary Conservation of the Last Judgment, which chronicles the restoration and these new observations.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈博物馆馆长芭芭拉·贾塔（Barbara Jatta）在该组织的新书《米开朗基罗 2026：最后审判的非凡保护》中写道：“作为一名雕塑家，米开朗基罗的绘画非常出色。”该书记录了修复工作和这些新的观察结果。

paras.en: In addition to the remarkable brush discovery, researchers also had a chance to more clearly view Michelangelo’s hidden self-portraits among the more than 300 figures painted in The Last Judgement’s depiction of Jesus Christ’s Resurrection.
paras.zh: 除了非凡的画笔发现之外，研究人员还有机会更清楚地看到米开朗基罗隐藏在《最后的审判》描绘耶稣基督复活的 300 多个人物中的自画像。

paras.en: His most visible self-portrait is in the flayed skin held out by St. Bartholomew. “It is a tragic face, with fearful eyes and deep lines of bitterness. This is more than a self-portrait; it is a symbol and a revelation,” an unnamed Italian art critic told the New York Times’ Fitzhugh Lee Minnigerode in 1925. “Michelangelo depicts himself as a second St. Bartholomew, a martyr, oppressed and overwhelmed by the calamities of the world.”
paras.zh: 他最明显的自画像是圣巴塞洛缪举起的剥皮的皮肤。 1925 年，一位不愿透露姓名的意大利艺术评论家对《纽约时报》的 Fitzhugh Lee Minnigerode 表示：“这是一张悲剧性的面孔，眼神充满恐惧，皱纹深邃。这不仅仅是一幅自画像，更是一种象征和启示。米开朗基罗将自己描绘成第二个圣巴塞洛缪，一位烈士，被世界的灾难所压迫和压倒。”

paras.en: - Contrary to popular belief, Michelangelo didn’t paint the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel on his back. Instead, he stood on scaffolding with his neck craned back at a painful angle.
paras.zh: - 与普遍的看法相反，米开朗基罗并没有在他的背上画西斯廷教堂的天花板。相反，他站在脚手架上，脖子向后伸成一个痛苦的角度。

paras.en: - “My beard toward Heaven, I feel the back of my brain upon my neck,” he wrote to a friend in comical poem.
paras.zh: - “我的胡须指向天堂，我感觉到我的大脑在我的脖子上，”他在滑稽的诗中写给一位朋友。

paras.en: The second is more subtle, appearing in the bottom left-hand corner of the 45-foot-tall mural in the cloak-folds of a figure meant to represent Death.
paras.zh: 第二个更微妙，出现在 45 英尺高壁画的左下角，斗篷褶皱中的一个人物代表死亡。

paras.en: “It is the last section of The Last Judgment to be completed by Michelangelo in 1541 after he had started it in 1536, and while painting it he fell off the scaffolding,” Fabrizio Biferali, curator of the Vatican Museums’ Renaissance department, explains to the Times. “Luckily, he was only a few meters off the ground, but still broke his leg and had to down tools for a few months.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈博物馆文艺复兴部馆长法布里奇奥·比费拉利 (Fabrizio Biferali) 向《泰晤士报》解释道：“这是米开朗基罗自 1536 年开始创作《最后的审判》后，于 1541 年完成的最后一部分，在绘画时他从脚手架上摔了下来。” “幸运的是，他距离地面只有几米，但仍然摔断了腿，并且不得不在几个月内放下工具。

paras.en: Biferali added: “I believe he then painted his own face among the dead being reborn because he felt reborn after his injury, as well as feeling reborn because he was coming to the end of five years of work.”
paras.zh: 比法拉利补充道：“我相信他随后在重生的死者中画了自己的脸，因为他在受伤后感到重生，也因为他五年的工作即将结束而感到重生。”

articles.title: The 10 Best Early Black Friday Headphone Deals (2026)
articles.author: Harry Rabinowitz

paras.en: Right now is a great time to buy a new pair of headphones. Brands have largely finished launching their latest models for the year, and many companies are either offering great discounts on older generations or putting the latest and greatest models on sale for the first time—or both. I've been reviewing headphones for more than four years, and I'm currently eyeing the 50-percent-off deals on older Sony headphones.
paras.zh: 现在是购买一副新耳机的好时机。各大品牌已经基本完成了今年最新型号的推出，许多公司要么对老一代产品提供大幅折扣，要么首次发售最新、最好的型号，或者两者兼而有之。我对耳机的评测已经有四年多了，目前我正在关注旧款索尼耳机的 50% 折扣优惠。

paras.en: All the deals below are WIRED-tested products we stand by, including wireless earbuds and over-ear headphones.
paras.zh: 以下所有优惠都是我们支持的经过有线测试的产品，包括无线耳塞和耳罩式耳机。

paras.en: For more great November offers, check out our Best Early Black Friday Deals, as well as pre-holiday sales on TVs, mattresses, and espresso machines.
paras.zh: 如需更多 11 月优惠，请查看我们的黑色星期五最佳早期优惠，以及电视、床垫和浓缩咖啡机的节前促销。

paras.en: Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best wireless earbuds not only for anyone with an iPhone but also for anyone who wants to keep things simple. They sound great and have some of the best active-noise-canceling (ANC) and transparency modes on the market. They also seamlessly sync with all of your Apple devices. While 20 percent off isn't the best price I've seen for them, it's still a solid discount.
paras.zh: Apple AirPods Pro 3 是最好的无线耳机，不仅适合拥有 iPhone 的任何人，也适合任何想要简单的人。它们听起来很棒，并且拥有市场上最好的主动降噪 (ANC) 和通透模式。它们还可以与您的所有 Apple 设备无缝同步。虽然 20% 的折扣并不是我见过的最优惠价格，但仍然是一个不错的折扣。

paras.en: This is the lowest price I've seen for Bose's class-leading ANC earbuds since Black Friday 2025. While this price doesn't quite match that all-time low, it's still a nice discount on some pricey but excellent earbuds. If you want to truly block out the world around you, these are the earbuds to get, despite their mouthful of a name.
paras.zh: 这是自 2025 年黑色星期五以来我见过的 Bose 一流 ANC 耳塞的最低价格。虽然这个价格与历史最低价不太相符，但对于一些昂贵但优秀的耳塞来说，它仍然是一个不错的折扣。如果你想真正隔绝周围的世界，这些耳塞就是你的最佳选择，尽管它们的名字拗口。

paras.en: $169 for Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 is a good deal. Sure, 26 percent off may not sound very impressive, but it still puts these earbuds at a nice middle ground between budget and premium price, despite their premium performance. These buds make many of WIRED's best-of lists thanks to their small size, secure fit, great performance, and stellar battery life.
paras.zh: 169 美元购买 Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 很划算。当然，26% 的折扣听起来可能不是很令人印象深刻，但尽管它们的性能卓越，但它仍然使这些耳塞处于预算和高价之间的一个不错的中间地带。这些耳机因其体积小、佩戴牢固、性能出色和电池寿命长而跻身《连线》杂志的许多最佳列表。

paras.en: Want workout earbuds that won't fall out? Get these Beats Powerbeats Pro 2. They're some of the more secure-fitting earbuds I've ever tested. Plus, they have great noise-canceling, transparency, and even built-in heart-rate sensors, so you can track your workout even if you left your fitness tracker at home.
paras.zh: 想要一款不会掉落的健身耳机吗？购买这些 Beats Powerbeats Pro 2。它们是我测试过的佩戴更牢固的耳塞之一。此外，它们还具有出色的降噪功能、透明度，甚至内置心率传感器，因此即使您将健身追踪器留在家里，您也可以跟踪您的锻炼情况。

paras.en: My main gripe with the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) is price. At 45 percent off (their lowest price ever), that complaint vanishes, making this a top headphone deal to shop. The headphones are exceedingly comfortable and have stellar ANC—far better than basically every other set of headphones at this new low price of $200.
paras.zh: 我对 Bose QuietComfort 耳机（第二代）的主要不满是价格。由于 45% 的折扣（有史以来的最低价格），这种抱怨就消失了，使其成为耳机购物的最佳选择。这款耳机非常舒适，并且具有出色的 ANC 功能，比 200 美元的新低价中的所有其他耳机都要好得多。

paras.en: The more premium XM6 and the newly revived, cheaper XM4C have effectively replaced the Sony WH-1000XM5. But I am still seeing the blue colorway of these excellent headphones at the lowest price I've clocked for these sunsetting cans. When they launched in 2022, they were our top pick for over-ear headphones. They remain excellent and far outperform other options at this limited price.
paras.zh: 更优质的 XM6 和新近复兴、更便宜的 XM4C 已经有效取代了索尼 WH-1000XM5。但我仍然以我所见过的这些日落罐的最低价格看到了这些出色的蓝色耳机。当它们于 2022 年推出时，它们是我们头戴式耳机的首选。它们仍然非常出色，并且在这个有限的价格下远远优于其他选择。

paras.en: Sony recently launched the WH-CN730N to replace these headphones, hence the rock-bottom price of 50 percent off. While these headphones can't compete with most specs of more premium options on this list, they're ultra-lightweight at just 192 grams. That and 35 hours of battery life with ANC on is nothing to scoff at.
paras.zh: 索尼最近推出了 WH-CN730N 来替代这些耳机，因此价格最低可享受 50% 的折扣。虽然这些耳机无法与此列表中更高级选项的大多数规格竞争，但它们超轻，仅重 192 克。加上 ANC 打开时 35 小时的电池续航时间，这没什么值得嘲笑的。

paras.en: Want the best ANC available in over-ear headphones? Look no further than the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen). They are the benchmark to which I compare other ANC headphones. Plus, they are comfortable, premium, and sound excellent.
paras.zh: 想要耳罩式耳机中最好的 ANC 功能吗？ Bose QuietComfort Ultra 耳机（第二代）就是您的最佳选择。它们是我比较其他 ANC 耳机的基准。此外，它们舒适、优质且音质极佳。

paras.en: My top over-ear headphone pick, the best-in-class Sony WH-1000XM6 is matching the lowest price I've seen. These headphones are amazing across the board, with their high comfort, superior sound quality, and great noise-canceling capability.
paras.zh: 我最喜欢的头戴式耳机是同类中最好的索尼 WH-1000XM6，它的价格是我见过的最低价格。这些耳机在各方面都令人惊叹，具有高舒适度、卓越的音质和出色的降噪能力。

paras.en: AirPods Max 2 are excellent over-ear headphones for Apple fans, but the $550 sticker price is frankly absurd. Thankfully, they are almost always a little bit on sale, including now. This is far from the best deal I've seen on these headphones, and I do expect the price to dip further during Black Friday sales events, so I would add them to my cart and wait … for now.
paras.zh: AirPods Max 2 对于苹果粉丝来说是一款出色的耳罩式耳机，但 550 美元的标价坦率地说是荒谬的。值得庆幸的是，它们几乎总是有一点折扣，包括现在。这远不是我在这些耳机上见过的最好的交易，我确实预计黑色星期五销售活动期间价格会进一步下跌，所以我会将它们添加到我的购物车并等待......现在。

articles.title: Best Wi-Fi Routers (2026): My Honest Picks After Testing 50+
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: The humble router is an essential fixture in every home. Benefits extend to everything from streaming movies and online gaming to video calls. Most people can get by just fine with a single Wi-Fi router, and I’ve collected recommendations to suit different needs, spaces, and budgets. I have tested all of these in my busy family home, which is full of Netflix-addicted gamers.
paras.zh: 不起眼的路由器是每个家庭的必备设备。好处扩展到从流媒体电影和在线游戏到视频通话的所有方面。大多数人使用一个 Wi-Fi 路由器就可以过得很好，我收集了一些建议来满足不同的需求、空间和预算。我在我忙碌的家里测试了所有这些，那里挤满了 Netflix 上瘾的游戏玩家。

paras.en: After testing more than 50 routers (some have since been discontinued or removed, but many are reviewed on this page), the Asus RT-BE58U is the best Wi-Fi router for most people, especially thanks to its affordable price. I have plenty of alternatives to suit different households and budgets though, including a mesh Wi-Fi option if dead zones plague you.
paras.zh: 在测试了 50 多个路由器（其中一些已停产或删除，但本页对许多路由器进行了评测）后，华硕 RT-BE58U 是大多数人最好的 Wi-Fi 路由器，特别是由于其实惠的价格。不过，我有很多选择来适应不同的家庭和预算，包括网状 Wi-Fi 选项（如果死区困扰您）。

paras.en: Make sure to check out our Best Mesh Wi-Fi Routers guide for larger homes. If you’re confused about terminology, my How to Buy a Router guide can help, along with my explainer on mesh systems versus single routers.
paras.zh: 请务必查看我们针对大型家庭的最佳网状 Wi-Fi 路由器指南。如果您对术语感到困惑，我的《如何购买路由器》指南以及我对网状系统与单个路由器的解释会有所帮助。

paras.en: Note: The FCC’s foreign-made router ban announced in March may stop any company that doesn’t secure an exemption (Conditional Approval) from selling new routers in the US, however, existing routers can continue to be sold (everything listed here). They can also be updated with new firmware, at least until January 1, 2029. So far, Netgear, Eero, and Asus, among others (here’s the full list), have secured a Conditional Approval.
paras.zh: 注意：FCC 在 3 月份宣布的外国制造路由器禁令可能会阻止任何未获得豁免（有条件批准）的公司在美国销售新路由器，但现有路由器可以继续销售（此处列出的所有内容）。它们还可以使用新固件进行更新，至少在 2029 年 1 月 1 日之前。到目前为止，Netgear、Eero 和华硕等（完整列表）已获得有条件批准。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I added the Asus ROG Rapture BN98 Pro as the best Wi-Fi 8 router and the TP-Link Archer 8 Ultra to Other Routers I Tested and Liked.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我将华硕 ROG Rapture BN98 Pro 添加为最佳 Wi-Fi 8 路由器，并将 TP-Link Archer 8 Ultra 添加到我测试和喜欢的其他路由器中。

paras.en: This is how the throughput compares on different bands averaged over multiple devices and tests in the same room with a clear line of sight to the routers.
paras.zh: 这是在多个设备上平均不同频段上的吞吐量比较，并在同一房间内对路由器进行清晰的视线测试。

paras.en: I have tested many other models and have several more in the queue. These aren’t as great as the picks above, but they are worth considering.
paras.zh: 我已经测试了许多其他模型，并且还有更多模型在等待中。这些不如上面的选择那么好，但值得考虑。

paras.en: TP-Link Archer 8 Ultra for £900: The only other Wi-Fi 8 router I’ve tried so far is TP-Link’s tri-band tower, but the company has so far been unsuccessful in its attempts to win Conditional Approval from the FCC in the US, so availability is limited right now. I tested it in the UK, though, and it’s a very solid performer, offering stable and expansive Wi-Fi. But the Asus ROG Rapture BN98 Pro I recommend above is better and cheaper. You also need subscriptions to unlock full-fat parental controls and security features on the TP-Link model. However, there are two reasons you might look at the Archer 8 Ultra: the subtle tower design with internal antennas and the combo port that can take an SFP+ module (both lacking in the BN98 Pro). But unless it's on sale at a decent discount, I’d go for the Asus or wait for more systems to hit the market.
paras.zh: TP-Link Archer 8 Ultra 售价 900 英镑：到目前为止，我尝试过的唯一一款 Wi-Fi 8 路由器是 TP-Link 的三频塔，但该公司迄今为止未能成功获得美国 FCC 的有条件批准，因此目前的可用性有限。不过，我在英国测试了它，它的性能非常稳定，提供稳定且广泛的 Wi-Fi。但我上面推荐的华硕ROG Rapture BN98 Pro更好更便宜。您还需要订阅才能解锁 TP-Link 型号上的全功能家长控制和安全功能。然而，您可能会关注 Archer 8 Ultra 的原因有两个：带有内置天线的精妙塔式设计以及可容纳 SFP+ 模块的组合端口（BN98 Pro 中均缺少这两个端口）。但除非它以相当大的折扣出售，否则我会选择华硕或等待更多系统上市。

paras.en: Fortify Router (GL.iNet with ExpressVPN) for $200: A home router with built-in VPN service is a tempting idea, even more so when it’s built on GL.iNet’s Flint 2 platform and includes one year of ExpressVPN service (redeemable with the order ID). VPN service set up at the router level means every device that connects is protected, and ExpressVPN is in our best VPNs guide. Now, you could set up a VPN of your choice with most routers (all of our Asus picks above), but the Fortify Router makes it easy. Beyond that, this is a decent dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router (it’s essentially the GL-MT6000) with a 2.5 Gbps WAN, a 2.5 Gbps WAN/LAN, four Gigabit LAN ports, and a USB 3.0 port. Performance-wise, this router will suffice for average family homes with 1 Gbps or lower connections and modern construction (you’re limited to around 900 Mbps with VPN service, but likely slower). Speed and stability are very good, and latency on the 5-GHz band is low. But it struggled to fully cover my old thick-walled property. Configuration is easy via the web interface, and it supports various apps and plug-ins, including AdGuard, Tailscale, and Tor.
paras.zh: Fortify Router（带有 ExpressVPN 的 GL.iNet）售价 200 美元：带有内置 VPN 服务的家用路由器是一个诱人的想法，尤其是当它基于 GL.iNet 的 Flint 2 平台构建并包含一年的 ExpressVPN 服务（可使用订单 ID 兑换）时更是如此。在路由器级别设置 VPN 服务意味着连接的每个设备都受到保护，而 ExpressVPN 位于我们的最佳 VPN 指南中。现在，您可以使用大多数路由器（上面我们选择的所有华硕路由器）设置您选择的 VPN，但 Fortify 路由器让这一切变得简单。除此之外，这是一款不错的双频 Wi-Fi 6 路由器（本质上是 GL-MT6000），具有 2.5 Gbps WAN、2.5 Gbps WAN/LAN、四个千兆 LAN 端口和一个 USB 3.0 端口。就性能而言，这款路由器足以满足具有 1 Gbps 或更低连接速度和现代建筑的普通家庭家庭使用（使用 VPN 服务时速度限制在 900 Mbps 左右，但可能会更慢）。速度和稳定性都非常好，并且 5 GHz 频段上的延迟很低。但它很难完全覆盖我的旧厚墙房产。通过 Web 界面可以轻松进行配置，并且支持各种应用程序和插件，包括 AdGuard、Tailscale 和 Tor。

paras.en: TP-Link Archer BE600 for $250: This standalone router supports Wi-Fi 7. I don’t love the design, but the six adjustable antennas allow for tinkering, and TP-Link has been very generous with the ports (one 10 Gbps, four 2.5 Gbps, and a USB 3.0), though it’s a little annoying that the USB is on the side. This model also offers excellent close-range speeds on the 6-GHz band, and solid speeds on both the 5-GHz and 2.4-GHz bands, though TP-Link’s dual-band BE260 slightly outperformed it on those two bands. But it does offer a pretty expansive range (up to 2,600 square feet).
paras.zh: TP-Link Archer BE600 售价 250 美元：这款独立路由器支持 Wi-Fi 7。我不喜欢这个设计，但六个可调节天线允许修补，而且 TP-Link 在端口方面非常慷慨（一个 10 Gbps、四个 2.5 Gbps 和一个 USB 3.0），尽管 USB 在侧面有点烦人。该型号还在 6 GHz 频段上提供出色的近距离速度，并在 5 GHz 和 2.4 GHz 频段上提供稳定的速度，尽管 TP-Link 的双频段 BE260 在这两个频段上的表现略胜一筹。但它确实提供了相当广阔的范围（高达 2,600 平方英尺）。

paras.en: TP-Link Roam 7 (BE3600) for $88: This dual-band, Wi-Fi 7 travel router was my pick, but the Asus RT-BE58 Go above is a slightly better performer for around the same money. This is still a good, portable device, capable of keeping you online in your hotel room or modest apartment. It also supports mobile tethering, VPN, and can serve as a Wi-Fi range extender. There’s a USB-C for power that works with portable chargers, and a USB-A for file sharing or backup.
paras.zh: TP-Link Roam 7 (BE3600) 售价 88 美元：这款双频 Wi-Fi 7 旅行路由器是我的选择，但上面的华硕 RT-BE58 Go 的性能稍好，价格大约相同。这仍然是一个很好的便携式设备，能够让您在酒店房间或简陋的公寓中保持在线。它还支持移动网络共享、VPN，并可用作 Wi-Fi 范围扩展器。有一个可与便携式充电器配合使用的 USB-C 电源，以及一个用于文件共享或备份的 USB-A。

paras.en: Asus RT-BE86U for $240: The new Wi-Fi 7 version of the Asus RT-AX86U, this dual-band (2.4- and 5-GHz) router is similar to the Asus RT-BE88U below. It lacks the 6-GHz band but brings all the other improvements that Wi-Fi 7 offers. The RT-BE86U proved reliable in my tests and performed extremely well on the 5-GHz band, matching the slightly more expensive RT-BE88U. It is slightly smaller but still has one 10-Gbps and four 2.5-Gbps Ethernet ports, alongside a USB 2.0 and a USB 3.0 port.
paras.zh: 华硕 RT-BE86U 售价 240 美元：华硕 RT-AX86U 的新 Wi-Fi 7 版本，这款双频（2.4 GHz 和 5 GHz）路由器与下面的华硕 RT-BE88U 类似。它缺少 6 GHz 频段，但带来了 Wi-Fi 7 提供的所有其他改进。 RT-BE86U 在我的测试中证明是可靠的，并且在 5 GHz 频段上表现非常好，与稍贵的 RT-BE88U 相匹配。它稍小一些，但仍然具有 1 个 10 Gbps 和 4 个 2.5 Gbps 以太网端口，以及一个 USB 2.0 和一个 USB 3.0 端口。

paras.en: AVM FRITZ!Box 5690 Pro for £344: AVM has dominated the German router market for years and is expanding across Europe and the UK, so I tested the FRITZ!Box 5690 Pro. AVM’s range is distinctive in white and red plastic, but there’s a focus on functionality. This tri-band Wi-Fi 7 router boasts a 2.5-Gbps WAN/LAN, four gigabit LAN, and a USB 3.1 port. It’s fast, scoring mid- to high-table results in my tests, and it proved reliable. It also has DSL or fiber-optic modems, an integrated DECT base station for cordless phones, built-in storage (NAS), and support for Zigbee to connect smart home devices. You don’t need an account to set it up or configure it. There’s a firewall and guest network option in the straightforward web interface (you can use the mobile app if you prefer). AVM’s routers are developed and manufactured in Europe, making them an interesting, privacy-focused alternative to routers from China or the US. The company also has a strong track record of supporting its products for years after release. Folks in the UK and Europe looking to upgrade to Wi-Fi 7 should consider this router. My fingers are crossed that AVM expands into the US next.
paras.zh: AVM FRITZ!Box 5690 Pro 售价 344 英镑：AVM 多年来一直主导着德国路由器市场，并且正在欧洲和英国扩张，因此我测试了 FRITZ!Box 5690 Pro。 AVM 的产品系列以白色和红色塑料为特色，但注重功能性。这款三频 Wi-Fi 7 路由器拥有 2.5 Gbps WAN/LAN、四个千兆位 LAN 和一个 USB 3.1 端口。它速度很快，在我的测试中取得了中高水平的结果，而且事实证明它是可靠的。它还具有 DSL 或光纤调制解调器、用于无绳电话的集成 DECT 基站、内置存储 (NAS)，并支持 Zigbee 连接智能家居设备。您不需要帐户来设置或配置它。简单的 Web 界面中有防火墙和访客网络选项（如果您愿意，可以使用移动应用程序）。 AVM 的路由器在欧洲开发和制造，使其成为中国或美国路由器的有趣且注重隐私的替代品。该公司还拥有在其产品发布后多年为其产品提供支持的良好记录。英国和欧洲想要升级到 Wi-Fi 7 的人们应该考虑这款路由器。我祈祷 AVM 接下来能够扩展到美国。

paras.en: Asus RT-BE92U for $265: After a simple setup and a trouble-free week of speedy, stable internet across the 2.4-, 5-, and 6-GHz bands, I can recommend this router. It has Wi-Fi 7 benefits like MLO and 320-MHz channels, support for a guest network, VPN services, free security software, and parental controls. It also boasts a 10-Gbps WAN/LAN, a 2.5-Gbps WAN/LAN, three 2.5-Gbps LANs, and a USB 3.2 port. This tri-band Wi-Fi 7 device came perilously close to claiming the midrange spot above, but was a smidge slower on the 5-GHz and 6-GHz bands and had a considerably shorter range. However, if your home is around 1,500 square feet and you’d rather avoid a subscription, the RT-BE92U is an excellent alternative. Customer reviews suggest some folks have had trouble with this router, but the latest firmware was rock solid for me.
paras.zh: Asus RT-BE92U for $265: After a simple setup and a trouble-free week of speedy, stable internet across the 2.4-, 5-, and 6-GHz bands, I can recommend this router.它具有 Wi-Fi 7 的优势，例如 MLO 和 320 MHz 通道、对访客网络的支持、VPN 服务、免费安全软件和家长控制。它还拥有一个 10 Gbps WAN/LAN、一个 2.5 Gbps WAN/LAN、三个 2.5 Gbps LAN 和一个 USB 3.2 端口。 This tri-band Wi-Fi 7 device came perilously close to claiming the midrange spot above, but was a smidge slower on the 5-GHz and 6-GHz bands and had a considerably shorter range.然而，如果您的房屋面积约为 1,500 平方英尺，并且您不想订阅，那么 RT-BE92U 是一个很好的选择。客户评论表明有些人在使用这款路由器时遇到了麻烦，但最新的固件对我来说坚如磐石。

paras.en: Asus RT-BE88U for $339: This dual-band Wi-Fi 7 router is an odd prospect because it does not offer the 6-GHz band at all, just 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz. But you can still combine those bands with MLO and enjoy features like 4K QAM, and this router will be fast enough for the average home. It has ports galore (two 10 Gbps, four 2.5 Gbps, four Gigabit, and one USB 3.0). It outperformed several more expensive routers on the 5-GHz band, and that’s likely what most of your devices are using most of the time right now. Asus also offers free security software and parental controls with its routers, so there’s no need for subscriptions. But when I consider that you can snag the Netgear Nighthawk RS300 listed above for less, I find it tough to recommend this router to folks in the US. If the 6-GHz band is unavailable or nerfed in your country, the RT-BE88U is for you.
paras.zh: Asus RT-BE88U for $339: This dual-band Wi-Fi 7 router is an odd prospect because it does not offer the 6-GHz band at all, just 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.但您仍然可以将这些频段与 MLO 结合起来，并享受 4K QAM 等功能，而且这款路由器的速度对于普通家庭来说足够快了。它具有丰富的端口（两个 10 Gbps、四个 2.5 Gbps、四个千兆位和一个 USB 3.0）。 It outperformed several more expensive routers on the 5-GHz band, and that’s likely what most of your devices are using most of the time right now.华硕还为其路由器提供免费的安全软件和家长控制，因此无需订阅。 But when I consider that you can snag the Netgear Nighthawk RS300 listed above for less, I find it tough to recommend this router to folks in the US.如果 6 GHz 频段在您的国家/地区不可用或被削弱，那么 RT-BE88U 适合您。

paras.en: Netgear Nighthawk RS700 for $540: Although I had setup issues that required a factory reset, there’s no hiding the top-notch performance of this router. It’s a Wi-Fi 7 tri-band router with two 10-Gbps Ethernet ports, four gigabit ports, and a USB 3.2. The tower design is new for the Nighthawk line, and it looks great. This router will blend in far better than our bulky Wi-Fi 7 pick above from Asus, and it was slightly faster on the 6-GHz band, though not the 5-GHz or 2.4-GHz bands. It mainly misses out on a recommendation because it is more expensive. We’re already seeing discounts on the RT-BE96U, and Asus offers free security software and parental controls. If you get the Nighthawk RS700S, the “S” at the end denotes a free year of Netgear Armor, which costs $100 a year thereafter. If you need parental controls, that’s another $70 a year.
paras.zh: Netgear Nighthawk RS700 售价 540 美元：虽然我遇到了需要恢复出厂设置的设置问题，但这款路由器的一流性能是无法隐藏的。它是一款 Wi-Fi 7 三频路由器，配有两个 10 Gbps 以太网端口、四个千兆端口和一个 USB 3.2。塔式设计是夜鹰系列的全新设计，看起来很棒。这款路由器的融入效果比我们上面选择的华硕笨重 Wi-Fi 7 好得多，而且它在 6 GHz 频段上速度稍快，但在 5 GHz 或 2.4 GHz 频段上则稍快一些。它主要错过了推荐，因为它更贵。我们已经看到 RT-BE96U 的折扣，并且华硕提供免费的安全软件和家长控制。如果您购买 Nighthawk RS700S，末尾的“S”表示一年免费的 Netgear Armor，此后每年收费 100 美元。如果您需要家长控制，每年还要另外支付 70 美元。

paras.en: TP-Link Archer BE800 for $400: With a fresh design that’s more desktop PC than router, the BE800 tri-band beast came out high up in my tests on the 2.4-GHz, 5-GHz, and 6-GHz bands, proving impressively swift for file transfers and downloads. It also boasts speedy ports galore, a cool but kind of pointless customizable dot-matrix LED screen, and the Tether app offers a guest network, IoT network, VPN server or client, EasyMesh, QoS for device prioritization, and remote management.
paras.zh: TP-Link Archer BE800售价400 $ ： BE800三频BE800采用新颖的设计，比路由器更具台式电脑功能，在我对2.4 GHz、5 GHz和6 GHz频段的测试中表现出色，证明了文件传输和下载的速度令人印象深刻。它还拥有丰富的快速端口、酷炫但毫无意义的可定制点阵LED屏幕， Tether应用程序提供访客网络、物联网网络、VPN服务器或客户端、EasyMesh、用于设备优先级排序的QoS和远程管理。

paras.en: Netgear M3 for £450: I was very impressed by this mobile 5G router. Slip a SIM in there, and it connects to 4G or 5G networks to deliver Wi-Fi to your devices. It’s a dual-band Wi-Fi 6 model that’s speedy on the 5-GHz band. The M3 had no trouble handling multiple connected devices (up to 32) and served a stable internet connection for around 10 hours. You can charge via the USB-C port, and there’s a 2.4-inch LCD color screen for configuration. It’s a solid hot spot for business or personal travel. Sadly, the M3 doesn’t seem to be available in the US, but folks in the UK can save some money and snag this instead of the M7 above (it’s frequently discounted).
paras.zh: Netgear M3 售价 450 英镑：这款移动 5G 路由器给我留下了深刻的印象。将 SIM 卡插入其中，它就会连接到 4G 或 5G 网络，为您的设备提供 Wi-Fi。它是一款双频 Wi-Fi 6 型号，在 5 GHz 频段上速度很快。 M3 在处理多个连接设备（最多 32 个）时没有遇到任何问题，并提供稳定的互联网连接约 10 小时。您可以通过 USB-C 端口充电，并有 2.4 英寸 LCD 彩屏可供配置。这是商务或个人旅行的可靠热点。遗憾的是，M3 似乎在美国买不到，但英国人可以省点钱买这个，而不是上面的 M7（它经常打折）。

paras.en: Firewalla Gold SE for $549: This quirky portable device is perfect for people who worry about security and privacy. It offers comprehensive tools for monitoring all traffic in and out of your house, robust and detailed parental controls, ad-blocking, and enhanced security with a built-in firewall and VPN option. It serves as a router, but you will want to pair another router in access point mode for Wi-Fi in your home. It’s expensive and may prove intimidating for inexperienced folks, but it offers deep insight into your network and an impressive depth of security features without an additional subscription. The Gold SE has two 2.5-Gbps ports and two gigabit ports and is suitable for folks with up to 2-gigabit connections. If your internet is only one gigabit, try the more affordable but slightly less capable Firewalla Purple ($399).
paras.zh: Firewalla Gold SE 售价 549 美元：这款奇特的便携式设备非常适合担心安全和隐私的人们。它提供了全面的工具来监控进出您家的所有流量、强大且详细的家长控制、广告拦截以及通过内置防火墙和 VPN 选项增强的安全性。它可用作路由器，但您需要在接入点模式下与另一个路由器配对，以实现家中的 Wi-Fi。它价格昂贵，而且对于没有经验的人来说可能会令人生畏，但它可以提供对您的网络的深入洞察和令人印象深刻的安全功能，而无需额外订阅。 Gold SE 有两个 2.5 Gbps 端口和两个千兆位端口，适合拥有高达 2 千兆位连接的用户。如果您的互联网只有 1 GB，请尝试更实惠但功能稍差的 Firewalla Purple（399 美元）。

paras.en: What About Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 6 Routers?
paras.zh: Wi-Fi 6E 和 Wi-Fi 6 路由器怎么样？

paras.en: While I recommend buying a Wi-Fi 7 router if you’re upgrading, there are loads of Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 6 routers that will serve the average family well. With Wi-Fi 6E you still get the faster 6-GHz band. The bulk of household traffic still likely uses 5 GHz, and you can save a lot of money by sticking with Wi-Fi 6 for a bit longer.
paras.zh: 虽然我建议您在升级时购买 Wi-Fi 7 路由器，但还有大量 Wi-Fi 6E 和 Wi-Fi 6 路由器可以很好地服务于普通家庭。借助 Wi-Fi 6E，您仍然可以获得更快的 6 GHz 频段。大部分家庭流量可能仍然使用 5 GHz，如果您坚持使用 Wi-Fi 6 一段时间，可以节省大量资金。

paras.en: Netgear Nighthawk RAXE300 for $300: The curvy spaceship design in matte black is a little more stealthy than your average gaming gear, but those wings contain antennas for a strong signal throughout your home. The Nighthawk RAXE300 is a tri-band router with Wi-Fi 6E support, covering the 2.4-GHz, 5-GHz, and 6-GHz bands. It served seamless, speedy Wi-Fi during two weeks of testing, with zero issues while handling a revolving mix of four simultaneous gaming and video streams. A single 2.5-Gbps WAN/LAN port, five gigabit LAN ports, and a USB-C 3.0 port will be enough for most folks.
paras.zh: Netgear Nighthawk RAXE300 售价 300 美元：哑光黑色的曲线宇宙飞船设计比普通游戏装备更加隐秘，但这些机翼包含天线，可在您的整个家中提供强信号。 Nighthawk RAXE300 是一款支持 Wi-Fi 6E 的三频路由器，覆盖 2.4 GHz、5 GHz 和 6 GHz 频段。在两周的测试中，它提供了无缝、快速的 Wi-Fi，在处理四个同时游戏和视频流的循环混合时出现了零问题。对于大多数人来说，一个 2.5 Gbps WAN/LAN 端口、五个千兆位 LAN 端口和一个 USB-C 3.0 端口就足够了。

paras.en: The Nighthawk app is excellent and offers band splitting, guest network options, and a host of analytical tools. The Premium Smart Parental Controls ($8/month or $70/year) and Netgear Armor ($100/year) are slick, but the extra expense is hard to swallow when many competitors offer cheaper or free alternatives with similar features. This is discontinued, but a few places still have stock, and it’s still a great router.
paras.zh: Nighthawk 应用程序非常出色，提供频段分割、访客网络选项和大量分析工具。 The Premium Smart Parental Controls ($8/month or $70/year) and Netgear Armor ($100/year) are slick, but the extra expense is hard to swallow when many competitors offer cheaper or free alternatives with similar features.该路由器已停产，但有些地方仍有库存，而且它仍然是一款很棒的路由器。

paras.en: TP-Link Archer AX55 for $90: This affordable Wi-Fi 6 router is still a decent pick for the average home. The slick black finish is attractive, and there are four antennas to direct Wi-Fi to every corner (it is worth tweaking and testing different positions). Performance was solid throughout my two-floor, 1,600-square-foot home but dropped off slightly in the back garden. Stability was excellent over a couple of weeks of testing, and this router ticks many feature boxes (MU-MIMO, beamforming, WPA3). It has four Gigabit Ethernet LAN ports, a single Gigabit WAN port, and a USB 3.0 port on the back, which is enough for most people.
paras.zh: TP-Link Archer AX55 售价 90 美元：这款经济实惠的 Wi-Fi 6 路由器仍然是普通家庭的不错选择。光滑的黑色表面很有吸引力，有四个天线可以将 Wi-Fi 引导到每个角落（值得调整和测试不同的位置）。我的 1,600 平方英尺的两层楼房屋的性能表现稳定，但后花园的性能略有下降。经过几周的测试，稳定性非常好，并且该路由器满足了许多功能（MU-MIMO、波束成形、WPA3）。它有四个千兆以太网 LAN 端口、一个千兆 WAN 端口和背面的 USB 3.0 端口，这对于大多数人来说已经足够了。

paras.en: I’m a fan of TP-Link’s Tether app, where you can review traffic, split bands, create a guest network, schedule reboots, set automatic updates, and even tell the LED to turn off at night. TP-Link’s basic free HomeShield tier offers network scanning, QoS (Quality of Service) for device prioritization, and basic parental controls so you can filter and blacklist websites and set the same bedtime every day. If you want a variable schedule, time limits, downtime, and real-time security protection, you must upgrade to HomeShield Pro (30-day free trial, then $6 per month or $55 for the year). If money is tight, you may even consider the next system down, the TP-Link Archer AX21 ($90). Performance is slightly weaker, but the experience is broadly similar.
paras.zh: 我是 TP-Link Tether 应用程序的粉丝，您可以在其中查看流量、分割频段、创建访客网络、安排重启、设置自动更新，甚至告诉 LED 在夜间关闭。 TP-Link 的基本免费 HomeShield 层提供网络扫描、设备优先级 QoS（服务质量）以及基本家长控制，以便您可以过滤网站并将其列入黑名单，并每天设置相同的就寝时间。如果您想要可变的时间表、时间限制、停机时间和实时安全保护，则必须升级到 HomeShield Pro（30 天免费试用，然后每月 6 美元或每年 55 美元）。如果资金紧张，您甚至可以考虑下一个系统，即 TP-Link Archer AX21（90 美元）。性能稍弱，但体验大致相似。

paras.en: These are the internet routers we had issues with or can’t recommend for one reason or another.
paras.zh: 这些是我们遇到问题或由于某种原因无法推荐的互联网路由器。

paras.en: Acer Connect X6E 5G: This is an interesting Wi-Fi 6E model with a 5G SIM card slot capable of keeping you online using a mobile network should your main broadband connection fail. It has two Gigabit Ethernet ports, a WAN/LAN, LAN, and an RJ-11 port for a phone line. It’s easy to set up and offers an NFC connection option, so you can just wave your phone over it to connect. This unusual blend of features could be good for business travelers. Performance was solid when it worked, and you can get a very fast connection at close range on both the 6-GHz and 5-GHz bands. Sadly, the range was limited, and the Connect X6E 5G was intermittently unstable during my testing, dropping devices randomly and cutting out repeatedly.
paras.zh: Acer Connect X6E 5G：这是一款有趣的 Wi-Fi 6E 型号，带有 5G SIM 卡插槽，能够在您的主要宽带连接出现故障时让您使用移动网络保持在线。它有两个千兆位以太网端口、一个 WAN/LAN、LAN 和一个用于电话线的 RJ-11 端口。它易于设置，并提供 NFC 连接选项，因此您只需在其上挥动手机即可进行连接。这种不寻常的功能组合可能对商务旅行者有好处。工作时性能稳定，您可以在 6 GHz 和 5 GHz 频段上近距离获得非常快速的连接。遗憾的是，范围有限，Connect X6E 5G 在我的测试过程中间歇性不稳定，随机掉落设备并反复断电。

paras.en: D-Link AX3000 DBR-330: This lightweight, rectangular travel router from D-Link is aimed at business professionals who travel for work. It’s a dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router that can also serve as a hot spot, with a connection via USB. There’s even a potentially handy microSD/TF card slot for up to 2 TB of storage for file sharing or backup. Setup via the browser is easy, and there’s built-in VPN support. It proved nice and fast at close range, but it dropped off quickly, and I couldn’t get a signal two rooms away. It will work fine for a hotel room, though. You can get our TP-Link travel router pick above or the Asus RT-AX57 Go for similar money, and I prefer both of them.
paras.zh: D-Link AX3000 DBR-330：这款来自 D-Link 的轻型矩形旅行路由器面向出差的商务专业人士。它是一款双频 Wi-Fi 6 路由器，也可以通过 USB 连接充当热点。甚至还有一个可能很方便的 microSD/TF 卡插槽，可提供高达 2 TB 的存储空间，用于文件共享或备份。通过浏览器进行设置非常简单，并且有内置的 VPN 支持。事实证明，它在近距离时效果很好，速度也很快，但信号很快就消失了，我在两个房间之外就收不到信号了。不过，它对于酒店房间来说效果很好。您可以以类似的价格购买我们上面的 TP-Link 旅行路由器选择或华硕 RT-AX57 Go，我更喜欢它们。

paras.en: Netgear Nighthawk RS200: The RS200 is Netgear’s dual-band (2.4- and 5-GHz) router and the cheapest in its Wi-Fi 7 lineup. After the tri-band RS300 won a recommendation, I expected this router to perform decently, but I encountered several issues, including random drops and poor range. After turning the router off and on again, many devices, including my Pixel and iPhone, struggled to reconnect. Perhaps I have too many devices in my home for it, though Netgear suggests it can handle up to 80. It has two 2.5 Gbps ports, three gigabit Ethernet ports, and a USB 3.0 port. Test results were OK, but significantly slower than the RT-BE86U.
paras.zh: Netgear Nighthawk RS200: The RS200 is Netgear’s dual-band (2.4- and 5-GHz) router and the cheapest in its Wi-Fi 7 lineup.在三频 RS300 获得推荐后，我预计这款路由器的性能表现不错，但我遇到了一些问题，包括随机掉线和范围较差。 After turning the router off and on again, many devices, including my Pixel and iPhone, struggled to reconnect.也许我家里的设备太多了，尽管 Netgear 建议它最多可以处理 80 个。它有两个 2.5 Gbps 端口、三个千兆位以太网端口和一个 USB 3.0 端口。 Test results were OK, but significantly slower than the RT-BE86U.

paras.en: What Features Should I Look for in a Router?
paras.zh: 我应该寻找路由器的哪些功能？

paras.en: My How to Buy a Router guide answers a lot of questions on the terminology you’ll come across when shopping for a new router. Still, here are a few other considerations.
paras.zh: 我的《如何购买路由器指南》回答了您在购买新路由器时会遇到的许多术语问题。不过，这里还有一些其他考虑因素。

paras.en: Wi-Fi Standards: The Wi-Fi 8 standard is still a while away from final certification, though we are starting to see Wi-Fi 8 routers based on the latest spec. That's why most of my main picks are still Wi-Fi 7. That doesn’t mean Wi-Fi 6 or Wi-Fi 6E routers aren’t worth having, necessarily. But with cheaper dual-band Wi-Fi 7 routers available, there’s not much reason to buy anything older. Only Wi-Fi 6E, 7, and 8 routers offer extra bandwidth and faster speeds on the 6-GHz band, but devices like phones and laptops must also support the same standard for you to take advantage. The 6-GHz band is also short-range compared to the 2.4-GHz and 5-GHz bands, though Wi-Fi 8 extends it a bit.
paras.zh: Wi-Fi 标准：Wi-Fi 8 标准距离最终认证还有一段时间，但我们已经开始看到基于最新规范的 Wi-Fi 8 路由器。这就是为什么我的大部分主要选择仍然是 Wi-Fi 7。这并不一定意味着 Wi-Fi 6 或 Wi-Fi 6E 路由器不值得拥有。但随着更便宜的双频 Wi-Fi 7 路由器的出现，没有太多理由去购买任何旧的路由器。只有 Wi-Fi 6E、7 和 8 路由器在 6 GHz 频段上提供额外的带宽和更快的速度，但手机和笔记本电脑等设备也必须支持相同的标准，您才能利用。与 2.4 GHz 和 5 GHz 频段相比，6 GHz 频段的范围也很短，尽管 Wi-Fi 8 稍微扩展了它。

paras.en: Internet Speeds: Your maximum internet speed is set by your ISP and depends on your internet plan. It will likely fluctuate, depending on the time of day. Some ISPs guarantee a minimum download and upload speed. While your router can’t provide an internet connection that exceeds that speed, it can potentially go faster when you stream from a server in your home or move files from one device on your local network to another.
paras.zh: 互联网速度：您的最大互联网速度由您的 ISP 设置，并取决于您的互联网套餐。它可能会根据一天中的时间而波动。一些 ISP 保证最低下载和上传速度。虽然您的路由器无法提供超过该速度的互联网连接，但当您从家中的服务器进行流传输或将文件从本地网络上的一台设备移动到另一台设备时，它的速度可能会更快。

paras.en: Coverage: It’s worth checking a prospective router’s coverage and speed, but understand that your home Wi-Fi mileage may vary. Construction materials in your house, your neighbors’ activity and Wi-Fi networks, your devices, and the position of your router are just a few of the factors that will impact your wireless performance.
paras.zh: 覆盖范围：值得检查潜在路由器的覆盖范围和速度，但要了解您的家庭 Wi-Fi 里程可能会有所不同。您家中的建筑材料、邻居的活动和 Wi-Fi 网络、您的设备以及路由器的位置只是影响无线性能的几个因素。

paras.en: Ports: Ethernet ports offer stable connections and are essential for some smart home setups that require a hub for lights or security cameras. Some network-attached storage (NAS) for backups or media will plug into your main router via USB. Ensure that the model you are considering has all the ports you need.
paras.zh: 端口：以太网端口提供稳定的连接，对于某些需要灯光或安全摄像头集线器的智能家居设置至关重要。一些用于备份或媒体的网络附加存储 (NAS) 将通过 USB 插入您的主路由器。确保您正在考虑的型号具有您需要的所有端口。

paras.en: What Is the Difference Between a Modem and a Router?
paras.zh: 调制解调器和路由器有什么区别？

paras.en: A modem (modulator-demodulator) connects your home to your internet service provider (ISP) and the external internet. A router connects the devices within your home to that internet connection wirelessly via Wi-Fi or with Ethernet cables. Check out my Router vs. Modem guide to learn more.
paras.zh: 调制解调器（调制器-解调器）将您的家连接到互联网服务提供商 (ISP) 和外部互联网。路由器通过 Wi-Fi 或以太网电缆将家中的设备无线连接到互联网连接。查看我的路由器与调制解调器指南以了解更多信息。

paras.en: Can a Single Wireless Router Cover Your Entire Home?
paras.zh: 单个无线路由器可以覆盖整个家庭吗？

paras.en: Manufacturers usually suggest a coverage range for a router in square feet, but every home is different, and the real-world range is likely to be shorter. Walls and other obstructions will weaken and block wireless signals. Ideal placement would be in the center of the home near the ceiling of the ground floor without any obstructions. A well-placed single router is generally enough to cover a typical two-floor home up to 2,000 square feet. For larger homes, it's worth considering mesh systems to create a reliable home network.
paras.zh: 制造商通常建议路由器的覆盖范围以平方英尺为单位，但每个家庭都不同，实际范围可能更短。墙壁和其他障碍物会削弱并阻挡无线信号。理想的放置位置是房屋的中心，靠近底层天花板，没有任何障碍物。放置得当的单个路由器通常足以覆盖面积达 2,000 平方英尺的典型两层住宅。对于较大的家庭，值得考虑使用网状系统来创建可靠的家庭网络。

paras.en: Physically moving your router can make a real difference to Wi-Fi speeds. It should be central, out in the open, and high up. Walls, cupboards, and even bookshelves can interfere with your Wi-Fi signal, as can fish tanks, TVs, or microwaves. Even changing the angle or moving the antennas can impact the strength of the Wi-Fi around your home, so don't be afraid to experiment with different positions.
paras.zh: 物理移动路由器可以对 Wi-Fi 速度产生真正的影响。它应该位于中心、露天、高处。墙壁、橱柜甚至书架都会干扰您的 Wi-Fi 信号，鱼缸、电视或微波炉也会干扰您的 Wi-Fi 信号。即使改变角度或移动天线也会影响家中 Wi-Fi 的强度，因此不要害怕尝试不同的位置。

paras.en: Can I Add Routers or Extenders to Make a Mesh?
paras.zh: 我可以添加路由器或扩展器来构建网格吗？

paras.en: Many manufacturers allow you to create a mesh network by adding more routers or devices like Wi-Fi extenders, but check what is supported before you buy. For example, Asus AiMesh enables you to link multiple routers, while TP-Link’s OneMesh only allows you to add power-line adapters or range extenders. EasyMesh is a standard certification by the Wi-Fi Alliance that hopes to allow the mixing and matching of devices from different manufacturers to form a mesh, but few devices support it so far. You can also buy single mesh routers, like an Amazon Eero, and then add more later if you find that you need them. Based on my testing, a mesh is always better than an extender.
paras.zh: 许多制造商允许您通过添加更多路由器或 Wi-Fi 扩展器等设备来创建网状网络，但在购买前请检查支持的内容。例如，华硕 AiMesh 使您能够链接多个路由器，而 TP-Link 的 OneMesh 只允许您添加电源线适配器或范围扩展器。 EasyMesh是Wi-Fi联盟的一项标准认证，希望允许不同制造商的设备混合搭配形成一个mesh，但目前支持它的设备很少。您还可以购买单个网状路由器，例如 Amazon Eero，然后在需要时添加更多路由器。根据我的测试，网格总是比扩展器更好。

paras.en: Running an Ethernet cable to create a wired connection between your home router and device will provide a faster and more secure link than Wi-Fi. But running Ethernet cables everywhere can be tricky. Read my Ethernet guide to learn more. Wireless connectivity makes life easy and is often fast enough for most tasks, such as browsing the web or streaming video.
paras.zh: 使用以太网电缆在家庭路由器和设备之间创建有线连接将提供比 Wi-Fi 更快、更安全的链接。但到处铺设以太网电缆可能会很棘手。请阅读我的以太网指南以了解更多信息。无线连接让生活变得轻松，而且速度通常足以完成大多数任务，例如浏览网页或流媒体视频。

paras.en: What About the US Ban on Foreign-Made Routers?
paras.zh: 美国对外国制造路由器的禁令怎么样？

paras.en: The Federal Communications Commission has banned new consumer internet routers manufactured outside the US because of national security concerns. The ban doesn’t affect any routers already in American homes or currently on sale in the US, but all new routers aimed at the consumer market must be approved.
paras.zh: 出于国家安全考虑，美国联邦通信委员会已禁止在美国境外生产新的消费者互联网路由器。该禁令不会影响美国家庭中已有的或目前在美国销售的任何路由器，但所有针对消费市场的新路由器都必须获得批准。

paras.en: The way the ban is described, it applies to every new Wi-Fi router, because there are no companies manufacturing routers or the components they are assembled from in the US. But companies can apply for exemptions.
paras.zh: 按照该禁令的描述，它适用于每台新的 Wi-Fi 路由器，因为美国没有公司生产路由器或组装路由器的组件。但公司可以申请豁免。

paras.en: All new models of foreign-produced routers will require Conditional Approval from the Department of Defense and the Department of Homeland Security before the FCC can clear them for sale in the US. Read “Everything You Need to Know About the Foreign-Made Router Ban in the US” to learn more.
paras.zh: 所有新型号的外国生产的路由器都需要获得国防部和国土安全部的有条件批准，然后联邦通信委员会才能批准它们在美国销售。阅读“关于美国外国制造路由器禁令您需要了解的一切”以了解更多信息。

paras.en: What About Firmware and Security Updates?
paras.zh: 固件和安全更新怎么样？

paras.en: While the FCC initially published a waiver covering software and firmware updates until March 1, 2027, it has now extended that waiver “at least until January 1, 2029.”
paras.zh: 虽然 FCC 最初发布了一项涵盖软件和固件更新的豁免，直至 2027 年 3 月 1 日，但现在该豁免已“至少延长至 2029 年 1 月 1 日”。

paras.en: What happens after that date is not clear, but if the FCC were to block further updates for the routers folks already own, it would exacerbate the very issue it is trying to address. The majority of routers that are compromised and used in cyberattacks are usually older devices that no longer receive security updates.
paras.zh: 该日期之后会发生什么尚不清楚，但如果 FCC 阻止人们已经拥有的路由器的进一步更新，这将加剧其试图解决的问题。大多数受到攻击并在网络攻击中使用的路由器通常是不再接收安全更新的旧设备。

paras.en: If you live in the US and need a router or a mesh, you should buy one. Asus, Netgear, Eero, and a few others have been granted Conditional Approval already. All the major manufacturers I asked who responded or have released a statement, including TP-Link and Synology, are confident about getting exemptions, but whether they will is impossible to say for sure. An FCC spokesperson told me, “We expect approvals to be granted in a timely manner.”
paras.zh: 如果您住在美国并且需要路由器或网格，您应该购买一个。华硕、Netgear、Eero 和其他一些公司已经获得有条件批准。我询问的所有做出回应或已发布声明的主要制造商，包括 TP-Link 和 Synology，都对获得豁免充满信心，但无法确定是否会获得豁免。一位 FCC 发言人告诉我，“我们希望能够及时获得批准。”

paras.en: The problem with waiting is that prices are likely to go up. I’ve already seen some price creep on systems from TP-Link, Netgear, and Eero, though this could also be due to the AI-driven RAM shortage.
paras.zh: 等待的问题是价格可能会上涨。我已经看到 TP-Link、Netgear 和 Eero 的系统价格有所上涨，尽管这也可能是由于人工智能驱动的 RAM 短缺造成的。

paras.en: To find the top Wi-Fi routers, I use each one for at least a week (usually longer) in a busy family home of four with lots of video streaming, gaming, and video calls. I also test the mobile apps and web interfaces to see how easy it is to change settings, set up parental controls, and access security features. My priority is to learn how well the router works in real-life rather than a lab, but I do also run a set of standardized tests, so that I have numbers to compare.
paras.zh: 为了找到最好的 Wi-Fi 路由器，我在一个繁忙的四口之家中使用每个路由器至少一周（通常更长），并且有大量视频流、游戏和视频通话。我还测试了移动应用程序和网络界面，看看更改设置、设置家长控制和访问安全功能有多么容易。我的首要任务是了解路由器在现实生活中而不是在实验室中的工作情况，但我也运行了一组标准化测试，以便我有数据可以比较。

paras.en: I run speed tests (downloads and uploads). I transfer files on the network on multiple devices (including iPhones, Android phones, Windows PCs, and MacBooks) from different spots around my home. I use NetSpot to survey signal strength throughout the house and create heat maps for comparison. I run the TamoSoft Throughput Test. I turn the power and modem off and on to find out how each system recovers.
paras.zh: 我运行速度测试（下载和上传）。我在家里不同地点的多台设备（包括 iPhone、Android 手机、Windows PC 和 MacBook）上通过网络传输文件。我使用 NetSpot 测量整个房子的信号强度并创建热图进行比较。我运行 TamoSoft 吞吐量测试。我关闭并打开电源和调制解调器，以了解每个系统如何恢复。

paras.en: How Did I Select Products to be Reviewed
paras.zh: 我如何选择要审核的产品

paras.en: I try to test as many routers as I can. It’s not possible to test every device, so while I will typically test flagship releases, I also call in more affordable routers and try to find models to suit the average family home in terms of budget and performance. We are brand agnostic, so we will test routers from any manufacturer, provided we can get ahold of them. But we do lean toward testing more systems from the most popular brands. All the routers we test are provided by the manufacturers or their PR companies.
paras.zh: 我尝试测试尽可能多的路由器。不可能测试所有设备，因此虽然我通常会测试旗舰版本，但我也会使用更实惠的路由器，并尝试找到在预算和性能方面适合普通家庭的型号。我们与品牌无关，因此我们将测试任何制造商的路由器，只要我们能找到它们。但我们确实倾向于测试来自最受欢迎品牌的更多系统。我们测试的所有路由器均由制造商或其公关公司提供。

paras.en: Most are loaned for a month or so and then returned. A handful of our recommended picks are kept for longer term testing. The remainder are donated to charities. I recently dropped off a batch to Reusing IT and have donated several devices to Oxfam and Shelter.
paras.zh: 大多数都是借一个月左右然后归还。我们推荐的一些选择将被保留以进行长期测试。其余部分捐赠给慈善机构。我最近向 Reusing IT 捐赠了一批设备，并向乐施会和庇护所捐赠了几台设备。

articles.title: The Fridge-Hacking Spree Is an Internet-of-Things Wake-Up Call
articles.author: Lily Hay Newman, Matt Burgess

paras.en: Amid an onslaught of AI vulnerability discovery and AI-assisted hacking, some of the most consequential critical infrastructure attacks this year may have little to do with the technology at all—instead providing a stark reminder that cybersecurity fundamentals are still key to digital defense.
paras.zh: 在人工智能漏洞发现和人工智能辅助黑客攻击的冲击下，今年一些最严重的关键基础设施攻击可能与该技术根本没有关系，而是明确提醒人们，网络安全基础仍然是数字防御的关键。

paras.en: Three sites in France that handle blood and plasma bags were briefly impacted this week by widespread attacks on vulnerable internet-connected refrigerators. On Wednesday, the Établissement Français du Sang (EFS) confirmed that cold rooms storing blood were “raised to very high temperatures” on November 2. The blood samples, thankfully, weren’t altered or damaged, the EFS said, because the organization’s alarm facilities and staff quickly detected the changes and implemented fail-safe measures.
paras.zh: 本周，法国三个处理血液和血浆袋的地点因脆弱的联网冰箱遭到广泛攻击而受到短暂影响。周三，法国卫生部 (EFS) 证实，储存血液的冷藏室在 11 月 2 日“升至非常高的温度”。EFS 表示，值得庆幸的是，血液样本没有被改变或损坏，因为该组织的警报设施和工作人员很快发现了变化并采取了故障安全措施。

paras.en: The incident, however, comes amid a wave of cyberattacks in recent days affecting supermarket chains in at least 11 European countries that also drastically increased the temperatures of their refrigerators. Pictures from across the continent show huge volumes of food being trashed following the spikes. Similar fridge attacks in October affected hundreds of French stores that were forced to throw away food. And in August, roughly six commissaries and grocery stores on United States military bases suffered similar incidents resulting in spoiled food. The Pentagon is investigating the incidents and is collaborating with French law enforcement, Reuters reported last week.
paras.zh: 然而，这一事件发生之际，最近几天发生了一波网络攻击，影响了至少 11 个欧洲国家的连锁超市，冰箱的温度也急剧升高。来自非洲大陆各地的照片显示，大量食物在峰值后被丢弃。十月份类似的冰箱袭击影响了数百家法国商店，这些商店被迫扔掉食物。八月份，美国军事基地的大约六家小卖部和杂货店遭遇了类似事件，导致食物变质。据路透社上周报道，五角大楼正在调查这些事件，并与法国执法部门合作。

paras.en: “It's been true for more than a decade now that our dependence on connected technology is growing faster than our collective will to protect it, which has exposed us to accidents, adversaries, and now potentially agents,” says longtime critical infrastructure researcher Josh Corman, who is currently the executive in residence for public safety and resilience at the nonprofit Institute for Security and Technology. “These fragile cold-chain systems are too critical to fail, but we keep experiencing hard lessons.”
paras.zh: “十多年来，我们对互联技术的依赖增长速度超过了我们保护它的集体意愿，这让我们面临事故、对手和潜在代理的威胁，”长期关键基础设施研究员乔什·科曼（Josh Corman）说道，他目前是非营利性安全与技术研究所公共安全和复原力的常驻主管。 “这些脆弱的冷链系统至关重要，不能失败，但我们不断经历惨痛的教训。”

paras.en: It is still unclear who is behind the incidents and whether the attacks are all connected or being carried out by multiple actors. The first recent wave of attacks against French supermarkets last month appears to have been caused by attackers exploiting unpatched refrigeration controllers exposed to the internet—including software versions that allegedly used weak passwords formulated based on the date.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这些事件的幕后黑手是谁，以及这些攻击是否都是相互关联的或由多个参与者实施的。上个月针对法国超市的第一波攻击似乎是由攻击者利用暴露在互联网上的未打补丁的制冷控制器引起的，其中包括据称使用根据日期制定的弱密码的软件版本。

paras.en: Many of the hacks stem from attackers exploiting vulnerabilities in temperature controllers made by the Danish firm Danfoss, and researchers say the attacks would not have been particularly difficult to pull off. Danfoss did not return WIRED’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 许多黑客攻击源于攻击者利用丹麦公司丹佛斯制造的温度控制器中的漏洞，研究人员表示，这些攻击并不是特别难以实施。丹佛斯没有回复《连线》杂志的置评请求。

paras.en: In other statements, Danfoss said impacted systems “were running outdated firmware” and urged customers to keep products updated. In an alert on Thursday addressing the rash of incidents, the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency said attacks could exploit flaws in cold storage systems via authentication bypasses, arbitrary code injections, and weak configurations. Experts have long warned about the dire threats to critical infrastructure posed by these types of weaknesses in so-called internet-of-things devices.
paras.zh: 丹佛斯在其他声明中表示，受影响的系统“正在运行过时的固件”，并敦促客户保持产品更新。美国网络安全和基础设施安全局在周四针对一系列事件发出的警报中表示，攻击可能会通过绕过身份验证、任意代码注入和薄弱配置来利用冷存储系统的缺陷。专家们长期以来一直警告说，所谓的物联网设备中的此类弱点对关键基础设施构成了可怕的威胁。

paras.en: Russian hacktivists tried to claim responsibility for some of the attacks but did not provide credible evidence. Still, some researchers see signs that Russia-based actors may have been involved in at least some of the incidents. The Kremlin this week denied involvement. In other cases, researchers have found potential ties to Iran-linked actors. NextGov/FCW reported last week that unnamed US officials suspect Iran-linked attackers may have been behind the freezer attacks on US military bases, though they noted that the investigation is still ongoing.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯黑客活动分子试图声称对部分攻击负责，但没有提供可靠的证据。尽管如此，一些研究人员发现有迹象表明，俄罗斯的行为者可能参与了至少部分事件。克里姆林宫本周否认参与其中。在其他案例中，研究人员发现了与伊朗相关行为者的潜在联系。 NextGov/FCW 上周报道称，未透露姓名的美国官员怀疑与伊朗有关的袭击者可能是针对美国军事基地的冷冻库袭击的幕后黑手，不过他们指出调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: This type of refrigerator/freezer attack is not new. Back in 2022, 16 supermarkets in Russia were targeted at the start of the country’s full-scale war with Ukraine. That year, 40 stores in Israel were similarly attacked, according to a 2025 report by Danfoss.
paras.zh: 这种类型的冰箱/冰柜攻击并不新鲜。早在 2022 年，俄罗斯与乌克兰的全面战争爆发时，就有 16 家超市成为攻击目标。根据丹佛斯 2025 年的一份报告，当年以色列有 40 家商店遭到类似攻击。

paras.en: “Many businesses use older technology while the systems become increasingly connected,” Sweden’s National Cyber Security Center pointed out in a recent advisory about the freezer attacks, noting that companies should inventory which of their devices are connected to the internet, disconnect them whenever possible, and make sure they are kept access-controlled, patched, and monitored if they must be connected.
paras.zh: 瑞典国家网络安全中心在最近一份关于冰箱攻击的咨询中指出，“许多企业使用旧技术，而系统的连接性却越来越强。”他指出，企业应该清点哪些设备已连接到互联网，尽可能断开它们的连接，并确保它们在必须连接时保持访问控制、修补和监控。

articles.title: My Chemical Romance's 'The Black Parade' tops U.S. album chart

paras.en: Nov. 7 (UPI) -- My Chemical Romance's The Black Parade is the No. 1 album in the United States this week.
paras.zh: 11 月 7 日（UPI）——My Chemical Romance 的 The Black Parade 成为本周美国销量第一的专辑。

paras.en: Coming in at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 chart dated Saturday is Olivia Rodrigo's You Look Pretty Sad For a Girl So in Love, followed by Morgan Wallen's I'm the Problem at No. 3, Ella Langley's Dandelion at No. 4 and Noah Kahan's The Great Divide at No. 5.
paras.zh: 周六的 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第二的是奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的《You Look Pretty Sad For a Girl So in Love》，摩根·沃伦 (Morgan Wallen) 的《我就是问题》排名第三，埃拉·兰利 (Ella Langley) 的《蒲公英》排名第四，诺亚·卡汉的《The Great Divide》排名第五。

paras.en: Rounding out the top tier are Taylor Swift's Life of a Showgirl at No. 6, Zach Bryan's Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs at No. 7, Kahan's Stick Season at No. 8, Drake's Habibti at No. 9 and Olivia Dean's The Art of Loving at No. 10.
paras.zh: 排名第一的还有排名第六的泰勒·斯威夫特的《歌舞女郎的一生》、排名第七的扎克·布莱恩的《青年男子气和其他可捐赠器官》、排名第八的卡汉的《棍棒季节》、排名第九的德雷克的《哈比卜蒂》和排名第十的奥利维亚·迪恩的《爱的艺术》。

articles.title: CENTCOM creates task force to disrupt Iran's weapons ground routes

paras.en: Nov. 7 (UPI) -- The U.S. Central Command has created a new task force on Iran to prevent the country from using ground routes to move advanced weapons and materials, a press release said.
paras.zh: 11 月 7 日（UPI）——一份新闻稿称，美国中央司令部成立了一个新的伊朗特遣部队，以防止该国利用地面路线运输先进武器和材料。

paras.en: Task Force Iron Gate includes a staff of about 20 civilian and military personnel in Tampa, Fla. It will coordinate with other U.S. government agencies on preventing the movement of advanced weapons systems, dual-use technologies, sanctioned materials and illegal revenue streams across Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea, the release said Saturday.
paras.zh: 铁门特遣部队包括佛罗里达州坦帕市约 20 名文职和军事人员。周六的新闻稿称，该部队将与其他美国政府机构协调，防止先进武器系统、双重用途技术、受制裁材料和非法收入流越过伊朗陆地边界和里海。

paras.en: The move "reinforces the success of our ironclad blockade against Iran at sea," said Adm. Brad Cooper in a statement. "Strengthening CENTCOM's collaboration with U.S. interagency partners will further constrain Iran's ability to finance terrorism, rebuild weapons factories and replenish their military."
paras.zh: 布拉德·库珀海军上将在一份声明中表示，此举“加强了我们对伊朗海上铁定封锁的成功”。 “加强中央司令部与美国跨部门合作伙伴的合作将进一步限制伊朗资助恐怖主义、重建武器工厂和补充军队的能力。”

paras.en: The U.S. military blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has prevented Iran from exporting more than $25 billion in crude oil, CENTCOM said.
paras.zh: 美国中央司令部表示，美国对霍尔木兹海峡的军事封锁导致伊朗无法出口超过 250 亿美元的原油。

articles.title: Trump: U.S. hit anti-aircraft system on Qeshm Island in Iran

paras.en: Nov. 7 (UPI) -- President Donald Trump told reporters that the United States had hit Qeshm Island in Iran.
paras.zh: 11月7日（UPI）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普告诉记者，美国袭击了伊朗的格什姆岛。

paras.en: He confirmed Friday that U.S. forces had carried out minor strikes to remove an air defense system.
paras.zh: 他周五证实，美军进行了小规模打击，摧毁了一个防空系统。

paras.en: After he landed in West Palm Beach, Fla. he at first said of Iran strikes, "I don't want to talk about it."
paras.zh: 抵达佛罗里达州西棕榈滩后，他首先谈到伊朗的袭击，“我不想谈论它。”

paras.en: He added, "We do minor strikes, but they knock out. They built a little bit of an anti-aircraft device, and we knocked it out in about 15 minutes, maybe five."
paras.zh: 他补充道，“我们进行了小规模打击，但他们将其击毁。他们建造了一些防空装置，我们在大约 15 分钟（也许是 5 分钟）内将其击毁。”

paras.en: Trump's comments came soon after Iranian state media reported two missile strikes in the Suza area of Qeshm Island, which is in the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 特朗普发表此番言论之前不久，伊朗官方媒体报道了霍尔木兹海峡格什姆岛苏扎地区发生两起导弹袭击事件。

paras.en: Iran's state broadcaster IRIB also reported a statement from the Iranian army that said its air defense forces intercepted an American MQ-9 drone over the island, Al Jazeera reported.
paras.zh: 据半岛电视台报道，伊朗国家广播公司 IRIB 还报道了伊朗军队的一份声明，称其防空部队在该岛上空拦截了一架美国 MQ-9 无人机。

paras.en: The U.S. also struck Qeshm Island on Monday.
paras.zh: 美国周一还袭击了格什姆岛。

paras.en: It's the first attack since the heavy losses by Republicans in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 这是自共和党在中期选举中惨败以来的首次袭击。

paras.en: Trump also told reporters Friday that Iran wants "to make a deal very badly. They have 300% inflation. Their navy's gone. Their airport, everything's gone, and they want to make a deal."
paras.zh: 特朗普周五还告诉记者，伊朗“非常希望达成协议。他们的通货膨胀率为300%。他们的海军消失了。他们的机场，一切都消失了，他们希望达成协议。”

paras.en: When a reporter asked him if he wants to end the war soon, he replied, "Well, we have nobody getting hurt, nobody getting killed.
paras.zh: 当记者问他是否想尽快结束战争时，他回答说：“好吧，我们没有人受伤，没有人被杀。

paras.en: "You know, this is a war that we may have been there for seven months, but we probably fought for three or four weeks, really fought. And again, you look at World War I; that's a war. World War II; that's a war."
paras.zh: “你知道，这是一场我们可能已经打了七个月的战争，但我们可能打了三四个星期，真正打了。再一次，你看看第一次世界大战；那是一场战争。第二次世界大战；那是一场战争。”

paras.en: On Friday, the Deputy Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council Ali Bagheri Kani told IRIB that Iran won't settle for "paper commitments," Iran's PressTV reported.
paras.zh: 据伊朗 PressTV 报道，伊朗最高国家安全委员会副秘书阿里·巴盖里·卡尼 (Ali Bagheri Kani) 周五告诉 IRIB，伊朗不会满足于“书面承诺”。

paras.en: "It is the Islamic Republic of Iran's right not to settle for U.S. commitments on paper when considering entering a new phase of diplomacy," he said. "We must see practical measures by the Americans, and this is only natural. Once these actions are implemented, the groundwork will be laid for a new diplomatic opening."
paras.zh: 他说：“在考虑进入外交新阶段时，伊朗伊斯兰共和国有权不满足于美国的书面承诺。” “我们必须看到美国人的实际举措，这是很自然的。一旦这些行动付诸实施，将为新的外交开放奠定基础。”

paras.en: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Iran's speaker of parliament, posted on X Wednesday about the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 伊朗议会议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫 (Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf) 在 X 周三发布了有关中期选举的信息。

paras.en: "Conscience or the cost of living, Americans said NO TO WAR, and we endorse this message," his post said. "If the U.S. govt betrays their public will to serve international paymasters and blackmailers, it will learn our NO comes with a Nightmare."
paras.zh: 他的帖子称：“出于良心或生活成本，美国人对战争说不，我们赞同这一信息。” “如果美国政府背叛了为国际金主和勒索者服务的公众意愿，它就会知道我们的拒绝伴随着一场噩梦。”

paras.en: CENTCOM also announced a new bounty system that offers up to "$20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran's nuclear program, including its facilities, equipment and associated personnel, such as those in the scientific community or the movement of any of the above," it posted on X Friday evening.
paras.zh: 中央司令部还宣布了一项新的赏金制度，该制度提供“高达 2000 万美元的奖励，并可能重新安置有关伊朗核计划的信息，包括其设施、设备和相关人员，例如科学界的人员或上述任何人员的动向”，它在周五晚间发布。

articles.title: Sony’s New Hello Kitty Headphones Come With an Ultra-Chic Carrying Case That Deserves Its Own Spotlight
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: Attention Hello Kitty fans: Your next favorite fashion accessory is designed to carry your headphones.
paras.zh: Hello Kitty 粉丝请注意：您最喜欢的下一个时尚配饰是专为携带耳机而设计的。

paras.en: Sony has teamed up with the iconic Sanrio character for a limited-edition collection featuring three models from Sony’s existing headphone lineup, including the WH-CH530, WH-CH730N and WH-1000XM6. Each pair of headphones offers different noise-reduction technology and comes in either black or pink. While the headphones themselves have a simple design, the accompanying accessories are where the collection really stands out.
paras.zh: 索尼与标志性的三丽鸥角色合作推出了限量版系列，其中包括索尼现有耳机系列中的三款型号，包括 WH-CH530、WH-CH730N 和 WH-1000XM6。每副耳机都提供不同的降噪技术，有黑色或粉色可供选择。虽然耳机本身设计简单，但随附的配件才是该系列真正的亮点。

paras.en: Each headphone comes with a black tote bag and a grunge-inspired black Hello Kitty carrying case that can clip onto a bag or clothing. The case features Hello Kitty’s signature ears and bow, along with headphone-shaped storage compartments that make it look like she’s wearing a pair of headphones herself. Available now for preorder with a scheduled release before the holidays, the collection makes a fun Christmas gift for music lovers and Hello Kitty fans alike.
paras.zh: 每个耳机都配有一个黑色手提包和一个垃圾摇滚风格的黑色 Hello Kitty 手提箱，可以夹在包或衣服上。这款保护套饰有 Hello Kitty 标志性的耳朵和蝴蝶结，以及耳机形状的储物格，让她看起来就像戴着耳机一样。该系列现已开放预购，预计在假期前发布，是送给音乐爱好者和 Hello Kitty 粉丝的一份有趣的圣诞礼物。

paras.en: The most affordable option in the collection, the WH-CH530 is a lightweight pair of on-ear headphones. They offer up to 55 hours of battery life, so you can go several days without reaching for the charger. Need a quick boost? A three-minute charge provides up to 1.5 hours of playback. They also feature a built-in microphone for calls.
paras.zh: WH-CH530 是该系列中最实惠的选择，是一款轻便的贴耳式耳机。它们的电池续航时间长达 55 小时，因此您可以连续几天不用充电。需要快速提升吗？充电 3 分钟即可播放长达 1.5 小时。它们还具有用于通话的内置麦克风。

paras.en: If you want to tune out background noise, the WH-CH730N offers noise cancellation to help make listening more focused. Its Ambient Sound Mode also lets outside sounds come through when you need to hear what’s happening around you. The foldable design makes these headphones easy to pack for trips, while the battery lasts up to 50 hours with noise cancellation on or 75 hours with it off. They also include a microphone designed to make phone calls clearer.
paras.zh: 如果您想消除背景噪音，WH-CH730N 提供噪音消除功能，帮助您更加专注地聆听。当您需要听到周围发生的事情时，其环境声音模式还可以让外界声音通过。可折叠设计使这些耳机在旅行时易于携带，而电池在开启降噪功能时可持续使用长达 50 小时，在关闭降噪功能时可持续使用 75 小时。它们还包括一个麦克风，旨在使电话通话更加清晰。

paras.en: For those looking for Sony’s most advanced option in this collection, the WH-1000XM6 offers top-tier noise cancellation and high-quality sound. Its microphones and processors constantly adjust to help block out surrounding noise while keeping your music clear. You can also switch between noise cancellation and ambient sound when you want to stay aware of your surroundings. The headphones offer up to 30 hours of battery life and a quick three-minute charge provides up to three hours of playback.
paras.zh: 对于那些寻求索尼该系列中最先进选项的人来说，WH-1000XM6 提供顶级的噪音消除和高品质声音。它的麦克风和处理器不断调整，以帮助阻挡周围的噪音，同时保持音乐清晰。当您想了解周围环境时，您还可以在降噪和环境声音之间切换。该耳机的电池续航时间长达 30 小时，快速充电 3 分钟即可播放长达 3 小时。
